explanation_zh: 警告标志两侧变窄。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方车行道或路面狭窄情况，遇有来车应予减速避让。是车道或路面，不是桥。设在双车道路面宽度缩减为6m以下的路段起点前方。

question_en: This sign warns drivers to slow down and watch for cross traffic.
question_zh: 这个标志的作用是用以警告车辆驾驶人谨慎慢行，注意横向来车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This yellow warning sign warns drivers that a crossroads is ahead, so watch for traffic from the side.
explanation_zh: 警告标志，十字路口，驾驶人谨慎慢行，注意两侧横向来车。

question_en: A continuously flashing yellow light at an intersection warns drivers to look carefully and proceed only after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 路口黄灯持续闪烁，警示驾驶人要注意瞭望，确认安全通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A steady yellow light means wait, while a continuously flashing yellow light means proceed only after confirming it is safe.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁提示车辆注意减速，警示驾驶人注意瞭望，确认安全后缓慢通过。此题正确。

question_en: This sign means it warns that there is an obstacle on the road ahead and vehicles should go around it on the left.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是告示前方道路有障碍物，车辆左侧绕行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This yellow warning sign correctly warns of an obstacle ahead and directs vehicles to detour on the left.
explanation_zh: 用以警告标志左侧绕行，谨慎驾驶，注意安全。

question_en: The yellow dashed line in the road center separates opposing traffic flows; you may cross it to overtake or turn if it is safe to do so.
question_zh: 路中心黄色虚线的含义是分隔对向交通流，在保证安全的前提下，可越线超车或转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed while solid lines may not, and a yellow dashed line marks the boundary between opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 道路中心黄色虚线，用于分隔对象行驶的交通流，只是在保证安全的前提下，可以临时越线超车。道路中心实线，禁止压线或越线。此类线均属指示线。

question_en: When you see this sign, you should actively check the distance between you and the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 遇到这个标志时，您应该主动确认您与前车之间的距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This warning sign shows an inverted V representing following distance, reminding drivers to keep a safe distance.
explanation_zh: 该标志表示注意保持车距，警告驾驶人注意与前车保持安全距离。

question_en: This sign means it warns that the road ahead is under construction and vehicles should go around it on either side.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是告示前方道路施工，车辆左右绕行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This sign shows an obstacle with detour arrows on both sides, warning of an obstacle ahead rather than specifically road construction.
explanation_zh: 警告标志左右绕行。图中明显是障碍物，不是施工绕行。

question_en: When this signal light is lit at an intersection, you should stop before the stop line and look carefully.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯亮时，要在停止线前停车瞭望。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A green light permits vehicles to proceed, so there is no need to stop and look at the stop line.
explanation_zh: 红灯停，绿灯行。图中是绿灯，可放心行驶。如若再磨蹭变成黄灯就真需要停车瞭望了。

question_en: This signal light at the intersection prohibits passing.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯禁止通行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A green light permits vehicles to pass through the intersection, so it does not prohibit passing.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第三十八条：机动车信号灯和非机动车信号灯表示：(一)绿灯亮时，准许车辆通行，但转弯的车辆不得妨碍被放行的直行车辆、行人通行；(二)黄灯亮时，已越过停止线的车辆可以继续通行；(三)红灯亮时，禁止车辆通行。红灯停，绿灯行。此时路口亮绿灯，车辆是可以通行的。

question_en: This sign means it warns drivers of a sharp curve ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是提醒车辆驾驶人前方是急转弯路段。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This sign actually warns of a slippery road section ahead, not a sharp curve.
explanation_zh: 此标志为易滑路段标志，警告驾驶员前方路段容易发生侧滑，注意行车安全。注意不是急转标志。

question_en: This sign means it warns drivers of a section with a severe bridge-approach bump ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是提醒车辆驾驶人前方是桥头跳车较严重的路段。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This sign actually warns of an uneven, bumpy road surface in general, not specifically a severe bridge-approach bump.
explanation_zh: 警告标志驼峰桥。用以提醒车辆驾驶人谨慎驾驶。设在拱度很大，影响视距的驼峰桥以前适当位置。注意桥头跳车是路面不平的标志，有两个凸。

question_en: In this situation, you may not go straight or turn left.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在这种情况下不能直行和左转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This is a directional arrow signal light, and only the direction showing a green arrow is permitted to proceed.
explanation_zh: 红色箭头亮的车道禁止通行，图中直行和左转车道的箭头都是红色，因此禁止通行。不能直行或转弯。

question_en: In this situation, you may turn right.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在这种情况下可以右转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This is a directional arrow signal light, and the right-turn direction is not showing green, so a right turn is not permitted.
explanation_zh: 红色箭头亮的车道禁止通行，车辆通行要根据箭头的指示来行驶，由图可知，右转车道为红色，所以不能车辆右转弯。本题选择【错误】。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway start-point advance notice | B. Expressway exit advance notice | C. Expressway entrance advance notice | D. Expressway end-point advance notice
options_zh: A. 高速公路起点预告 | B. 高速公路出口预告 | C. 高速公路入口预告 | D. 高速公路终点预告
why_en: The expressway start-point and end-point signs differ by only one line, and this one marks the end point.
explanation_zh: 此标志是高速公路终点预告，没有红色斜线的是高速公路起点预告。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Drive at low speed | B. Watch for pedestrians | C. Pedestrians have priority | D. Pedestrians only
options_zh: A. 低速行驶 | B. 注意行人 | C. 行人先行 | D. 步行
why_en: This blue mandatory sign means the section is for pedestrians only, and vehicles may not enter.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示该段道路只供行人步行，任何车辆不准进入。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a right turn ahead | B. Indicates a U-turn ahead | C. Indicates going straight ahead | D. Indicates changing to the left lane
options_zh: A. 指示前方右转 | B. 指示前方掉头 | C. 指示前方直行 | D. 指示向左变道
why_en: The arrow's shape represents a U-turn, so it indicates a U-turn ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标线指示前方掉头。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Water-crossing road surface | B. Low-water crossing bridge | C. Ferry crossing | D. Boat dock
options_zh: A. 过水路面 | B. 漫水桥 | C. 渡口 | D. 船用码头
why_en: This sign indicates a ferry crossing ahead that can carry vehicles across the river.
explanation_zh: 水上有船，船上有辆车，渡口标志。渡口：用以提醒车辆驾驶人谨慎驾驶。设在车辆渡口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this road-surface directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 路面上导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates the road ahead is a Y-shaped intersection | B. Indicates the road ahead is a divided road | C. Indicates the road ahead permits only left or right turns | D. Indicates the road ahead requires merging left or right
options_zh: A. 指示前方道路是Y型交叉口 | B. 指示前方道路是分离式道路 | C. 指示前方道路仅可左右转弯 | D. 指示前方道路需向左右合流
why_en: The arrows point left and right, meaning only a left or right turn is possible ahead.
explanation_zh: 指示前方仅可向左或向右转弯，不能直行。注意不是Y形路口，Y形路口标志不带箭头。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway maximum speed in special weather | B. Expressway recommended speed in special weather | C. Expressway minimum speed in special weather | D. Expressway average speed in special weather
options_zh: A. 高速公路特殊天气最高速度 | B. 高速公路特殊天气建议速度 | C. 高速公路特殊天气最低速度 | D. 高速公路特殊天气平均速度
why_en: A yellow background with black text indicates a recommended speed, not a mandatory limit.
explanation_zh: 此标志是高速公路特殊天气建议速度。黄色数字是限制最高速度，数字白色是限最低速度，数字黑色是建议速度。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Water-crossing road surface | B. Ferry crossing | C. Muddy road | D. Low-lying road surface
options_zh: A. 过水路面 | B. 渡口 | C. 泥泞道路 | D. 低洼路面
why_en: The sign shows a vehicle splashing through water, indicating a water-crossing road surface ahead.
explanation_zh: 车辆行驶溅起一片水花，是过水路面标志。过水路面指的是：通过平时无水或流水很少的宽浅河流，而修筑的在洪水期间容许水流浸过的路面。

question_en: This sign means it warns drivers of an unguarded railway crossing ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是提醒车辆驾驶人前方是无人看守铁路道口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This sign shows a barrier/gate, which actually indicates a guarded railway crossing, not an unguarded one.
explanation_zh: 带栅栏是有人看守，带火车头才是无人看守。警告标志有人看守铁道口。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意慢行或及时停车。设在车辆驾驶人不易发现的道口以前适当位置。

question_en: When this signal light is lit at an intersection, you may not turn right.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯亮时，不能右转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Right turns are not controlled by the circular signal light, and drivers may turn right if it is safe to do so.
explanation_zh: 首先，这是圆形灯（如图），即使是红灯亮了也可以在不拥堵的情况下可以右转，但是不直行。再者，单向只有一个车道，绿灯亮时直行和右转都可以。

question_en: What type of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Warning sign | B. Prohibition sign | C. Mandatory (indication) sign | D. Guide sign
options_zh: A. 警告标志 | B. 禁令标志 | C. 指示标志 | D. 指路标志
why_en: Traffic signs are color-coded: yellow is a warning sign, red is a prohibition sign, and blue is a mandatory sign; this red sign is a prohibition sign.
explanation_zh: 黄色-警示，蓝色-指示指路，黑色-辅助，红色-禁令，红圈表示禁令标志，是对车辆加以禁止或限制的一种标志。

question_en: [Image] What kind of marking is the white solid line circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内白色实线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Variable directional lane line | B. Directional (guide) lane line | C. Direction guide line | D. One-way travel line
options_zh: A. 可变导向车道线 | B. 导向车道线 | C. 方向引导线 | D. 单向行驶线
why_en: Once a vehicle enters a lane marked by a directional lane line, it must not change lanes or cross the line.
explanation_zh: 具有固定行驶方向的导向车道线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No prolonged honking | B. Intermittent honking | C. No honking | D. Slow down and honk
options_zh: A. 禁止长时鸣喇叭 | B. 断续鸣喇叭 | C. 禁止鸣喇叭 | D. 减速鸣喇叭
why_en: A red circle with a diagonal slash over a horn icon means honking is prohibited on this section.
explanation_zh: 红圈是禁令标志，加一个喇叭就是禁止鸣喇叭。此标志设在需要禁止鸣喇叭的地方。禁止鸣喇叭的时间和范围可用辅助标志说明。

question_en: This sign means it warns drivers to slow down or stop to give priority to vehicles on the main road.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是告示车辆驾驶人应慢行或停车，确保干道车辆优先。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: An octagonal sign with the character for 'stop' means stop and yield, while a triangular sign with the character for 'yield' means slow down and give way.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志减速让行，告示车辆驾驶人应慢行或停车，确保干道车辆优先。

question_en: This sign means it warns drivers of a dangerous road along a mountainside ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是提醒车辆驾驶人前方是傍山险路路段。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This sign actually warns of falling rocks ahead, not a dangerous road along a mountainside.
explanation_zh: 警告标志注意落石，落石正在下降，很形象。设在有落石危险的傍山路段以前适当位置。

question_en: This road marking means it warns of an intersection ahead.
question_zh: 这个地面标记的含义是预告前方设有交叉路口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This marking resembles the character for 'person,' so it actually indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead, not an intersection.
explanation_zh: 这个标志是前方有人行横道，车辆应减速慢行或停车等待。

question_en: When this signal light is lit, if you have already crossed the stop line, you may continue to pass.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇到这种信号灯亮时，如果已越过停止线，可以继续通行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A yellow light is a warning, and a vehicle that has already crossed the stop line may continue through.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第三十八条规定：黄灯亮时，已越过停止线的车辆可以继续通行；未经过停止线的则禁止继续通行。

question_en: [Image] What is the yellow road marking in the center of the intersection shown?
question_zh: 图中路口中央黄色路面标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. Center circle | B. Channelizing (diversion) line | C. Yellow grid (box junction) marking | D. Parking zone
options_zh: A. 中心圈 | B. 导流线 | C. 网状线 | D. 停车区
why_en: Stopping is prohibited within the area enclosed by the yellow grid marking.
explanation_zh: 表示严禁一切车辆长时或临时停放。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Continuous uphill | B. Steep uphill | C. Steep downhill | D. Continuous downhill
options_zh: A. 连续上坡 | B. 上陡坡 | C. 下陡坡 | D. 连续下坡
why_en: The sign shows two downward-sloping arrows, indicating a continuous downhill warning.
explanation_zh: 一个箭头向上是上陡坡，一个箭头向下是下陡坡。两个箭头向上是连续上坡，两个箭头向下是连续下坡。提示驾驶人小心驾驶，注意安全。

question_en: When driving to this position, if the front wheels have already crossed the stop line, you may continue through.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车行驶到这个位置时，如果车前轮已越过停止线可以继续通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A red light means stop; even if the front wheels have crossed the stop line, the vehicle may not continue through.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第三十八条：机动车信号灯和非机动车信号灯表示：(一)绿灯亮时，准许车辆通行，但转弯的车辆不得妨碍被放行的直行车辆、行人通行；(二)黄灯亮时，已越过停止线的车辆可以继续通行；(三)红灯亮时，禁止车辆通行。在未设置非机动车信号灯和人行横道信号灯的路口，非机动车和行人应当按照机动车信号灯的表示通行。红灯亮时，右转弯的车辆在不妨碍被放行的车辆、行人通行的情况下，可以通行。应该是车体全部越过停止线才可以继续通过，红灯时前轮刚过线就必须停下来，不然闯红灯。

question_en: A continuously flashing yellow light means motor vehicles may accelerate and pass through.
question_zh: 黄灯持续闪烁，表示机动车可以加速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A steady yellow light means wait, while a flashing yellow light means proceed only after confirming it is safe.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁提示车辆注意减速，确认安全后缓慢通过。遇到此类黄灯时，需减速慢行。且机动车不能加速通过。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Go straight or turn left | B. Go straight or turn right | C. Go straight or turn right at a grade-separated interchange | D. Go straight or turn left at a grade-separated interchange
options_zh: A. 直行和左转弯行驶 | B. 直行和右转弯行驶 | C. 立体交叉直行和右转弯行驶 | D. 立体交叉直行和左转弯行驶
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign showing vehicles may go straight or turn right as indicated at the grade-separated interchange.
explanation_zh: 立体交叉直行和右转弯行驶：表示车辆在立交处可以直行和按图示路线右转弯行驶。此标志设在立交右转弯出口处适当位置。

question_en: What is the purpose of a guide (direction) sign?
question_zh: 指路标志的作用是什么？
options_en: A. Restrict vehicle passage | B. Show speed limit information | C. Provide direction information | D. Warn of danger ahead
options_zh: A. 限制车辆通行 | B. 提示限速信息 | C. 提供方向信息 | D. 警告前方危险
why_en: A blue sign showing direction, place names, or distance information is a guide sign.
explanation_zh: 指路标志用以指示市镇村的境界、目的地的方向和距离、高速公路出入口、著名地点所在等。指路标志是传递道路方向，地点，距离信息的标志。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No left turn | B. Dead end | C. No entry | D. Detour for oversized-height vehicles
options_zh: A. 禁止左转 | B. 此路不通 | C. 禁止通行 | D. 超高绕行
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning vehicles over 4 meters tall must detour, while those under 4 meters may pass straight through.
explanation_zh: 根据图中所知，高度超过4米的车辆被禁止直行，箭头指引绕行路线。而低于4米的车辆依然可以直行，因此图中是超高绕行标志。

question_en: What signal is given by this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Pull-over signal | B. Slow-down signal | C. Lane-change signal | D. Right-turn signal
options_zh: A. 靠边停车信号 | B. 减速慢行信号 | C. 变道信号 | D. 右转弯信号
why_en: Memory aid: the right arm swinging downward signals to slow down.
explanation_zh: 交警右手臂由与肩平行状态下压至腰部位置，发出减速慢行信号。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Watch for two-way traffic | B. Keep to both sides | C. Reversible lane | D. Watch for a tidal (reversible) lane
options_zh: A. 注意双向行驶 | B. 靠两侧行驶 | C. 可变车道 | D. 注意潮汐车道
why_en: A tidal lane is a reversible lane whose direction of travel is adjusted according to morning and evening traffic flow.
explanation_zh: 此标志为注意潮汐车道。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方为潮汐车道。“潮汐车道”是指根据早晚交通流量不同情况，对有条件的道路，试点开辟潮汐车道，通过车道灯的指示方向变化，控制主干道车道行驶方向，来调整车道数。

question_en: What does a solid white line along the edge of the roadway on both sides mean?
question_zh: 路两侧的车行道边缘白色实线是什么含义？
options_en: A. Motor vehicles may temporarily cross it | B. Non-motor vehicles may temporarily cross it | C. Vehicles may temporarily cross it | D. Vehicles are prohibited from crossing it
options_zh: A. 机动车可临时跨越 | B. 非机动车可临时跨越 | C. 车辆可临时跨越 | D. 禁止车辆跨越
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed, a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate lanes going the same direction, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 白色实线禁止跨越，可以理解为白色实线不可跨越。

question_en: This sign means that drivers are being warned of a one-way, poorly lit culvert ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是提醒车辆驾驶人前方是单向行驶并且照明不好的涵洞。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The yellow sign is a warning sign alerting drivers to a tunnel ahead, so caution is needed.
explanation_zh: 警告标志注意隧道。用以提醒车辆驾驶人注意慢行、谨慎驾驶。设在双向行驶并且照明不好的隧道口前适当位置。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Guide sign | B. Instruction sign | C. Prohibition sign | D. Warning sign
options_zh: A. 指路标志 | B. 指示标志 | C. 禁令标志 | D. 警告标志
why_en: Traffic signs are distinguished by color: yellow is a warning sign, red is a prohibition sign, and blue is an instruction sign.
explanation_zh: 指示标志的颜色为蓝底、白图案；形状分为圆形、长方形和正方形。题中从左至右依次为直行标志，会车先行标志，机动车行驶标志。

question_en: This sign means a Y-shaped intersection is coming up ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志的含义是前方即将行驶至Y形交叉路口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A yellow triangular sign is a warning sign alerting drivers to danger ahead, so caution is needed.
explanation_zh: 图中是警告标志，T型交叉路口警告标志。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Non-motor vehicle lane | B. Bicycles prohibited lane | C. Bicycle-only lane | D. Bicycle parking area
options_zh: A. 非机动车车道 | B. 禁止自行车通行车道 | C. 自行车专用车道 | D. 停放自行车路段
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning this lane is for non-motor vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 两边有虚线的是车道，此标志为非机动车车道。别误以为自行车专用车道，没有自行车专用车道这一说。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Pass on the left | B. No passage | C. Pass on both sides | D. Pass on the right
options_zh: A. 左侧通行 | B. 不准通行 | C. 两侧通行 | D. 右侧通行
why_en: On the red sign, a '∧' shape means pass on both sides, '/' means pass on the left, and '\' means pass on the right.
explanation_zh: 此标志是右侧通行，∧表示两侧通行，/这个方向的表示左侧通行，\这个方向表示右侧通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Warns drivers the road ahead runs along a reservoir, lake, or river | B. Warns drivers of an upward steep slope ahead | C. Warns drivers of two or more consecutive uphill sections ahead | D. Warns drivers of a downward steep slope ahead
options_zh: A. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方道路沿水库、湖泊、河流 | B. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向上的陡坡路段 | C. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有两个及以上的连续上坡路段 | D. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向下的陡坡路段
why_en: The yellow sign is a warning sign alerting drivers to an upward steep slope ahead.
explanation_zh: 看图说话题，斜面箭头向上，利用排除法，此标志表示提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向上的陡坡路段。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Emergency stopping lane on an expressway | B. Expressway refuge area | C. Expressway parking area | D. Expressway bus station
options_zh: A. 高速公路紧急停车带 | B. 高速公路避让处所 | C. 高速公路停车区 | D. 高速公路客车站
why_en: A bulge on the right side of the road with a dashed line in the middle is an emergency stopping lane; without the dashed line it is a passing bay.
explanation_zh: 黑色部分是紧急停车带，这里表示高速公路应急停车带，此图高速专用。

question_en: What does a yellow diagonal-line fill in the center of the road mean?
question_zh: 路中心的黄色斜线填充是何含义？
options_en: A. Opposing lanes may be crossed | B. Same-direction lanes may be crossed on both sides | C. Crossing the opposing lane dividing line is prohibited | D. Single-direction lane dividing line
options_zh: A. 可跨越对向车道分界线 | B. 双侧可跨越同向车道分界线 | C. 禁止跨越对向车行道分界线 | D. 单向行驶车道分界线
why_en: As long as it is a double solid yellow line, whether or not filled with diagonal hatching, crossing the opposing traffic dividing line is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 禁止跨越对向车道分界线，看到黄实线就不要跨越了，不管中间有没有填充物。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight-ahead lane | B. Left-turn lane | C. Right-turn lane | D. Directional (branching) lane
options_zh: A. 直线行驶车道 | B. 左转行驶车道 | C. 右转行驶车道 | D. 分向行驶车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign indicating vehicles may travel in different directions from this lane.
explanation_zh: 此标志是分向行驶车道。同向多车道的公路一般都设计了分向行驶车道，正常行驶过程中可以变更车道，当行驶至路口时要变换到要行驶的车道。例如要左转弯时要提前变更车道至左转弯车道；要右转弯时要提前变更车道至右转弯车道，不能占用他人行车道，以最大限度的保障通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Large livestock farm | B. Wildlife reserve | C. Watch for wild animals | D. Watch for livestock
options_zh: A. 大型畜牧场 | B. 野生动物保护区 | C. 注意野生动物 | D. 注意牲畜
why_en: A sign with a cow means watch for livestock, while one with a sheep means watch for wild animals.
explanation_zh: 牛表示注意牲畜，鹿表示注意野生动物。此标志表示注意牲畜。

question_en: What kind of marking are these alternating yellow and black diagonal stripes?
question_zh: 这种黄黑相间的倾斜线条是什么标记？
options_en: A. Deceleration marking | B. Solid-body marking | C. Raised marking | D. Elevation (surface) marking
options_zh: A. 减速标记 | B. 实体标记 | C. 突起标记 | D. 立面标记
why_en: Elevation markings are typically placed on overpasses, aqueducts, tunnel entrances, and similar structures.
explanation_zh: 记忆题，立面标记的作用是提醒驾驶人注意，在行车道或近旁有高出路面的物体，以防发生碰撞。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dedicated parking lot | B. Open-air parking lot | C. Indoor parking lot | D. Private/internal parking lot
options_zh: A. 专用停车场 | B. 露天停车场 | C. 室内停车场 | D. 内部停车场
why_en: A 'P' sign with an umbrella above it means indoor parking; without an umbrella it means open-air parking.
explanation_zh: 此标志是室内停车场。P字上边没有遮挡是露天停车场，P字上面有遮挡的是室内停车场。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Sharp left turn ahead | B. Sharp right turn ahead | C. Detour to the left | D. Continuous curves
options_zh: A. 向左急转弯 | B. 向右急转弯 | C. 向左绕行 | D. 连续弯路
why_en: This sign is generally placed at an appropriate location ahead of a sharp left turn in the road.
explanation_zh: 向右急转弯：箭头向左是向左急转弯，设在左急转弯的道路前方适当位置。

question_en: What does a double solid white line at the very front of an intersection mean?
question_zh: 路口最前端的双白实线是什么含义？
options_en: A. Waiting-to-proceed line | B. Stop-and-yield line | C. Yield-while-slowing line | D. Left-turn waiting area line
options_zh: A. 等候放行线 | B. 停车让行线 | C. 减速让行线 | D. 左弯待转线
why_en: Near intersections there are three types of white lines: a single solid line is a stop line, a double solid line is a stop-and-yield line, and a double dashed line is a slow-and-yield line.
explanation_zh: 双实线为停车让行线，用于没有交通信号灯的人行横道前，车辆需在此停车避让行人。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight-ahead lane | B. Right-turn lane | C. U-turn lane | D. Left-turn lane
options_zh: A. 直行车道 | B. 右转车道 | C. 掉头车道 | D. 左转车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning this lane is for going straight only.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志是直行车道，表示只准一切车辆直行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight ahead and right turn | B. Straight ahead and left turn | C. Straight ahead and left turn prohibited | D. Right and left turns only
options_zh: A. 直行和向右转弯 | B. 直行和向左转弯 | C. 禁止直行和向左转弯 | D. 只准向右和向左转弯
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning this lane allows only going straight or turning left.
explanation_zh: 直行和向左转弯指示标志：表示只准一切车辆直行和向左转弯。此标志设在车辆必须直行和向左转弯的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this road surface marking mean?
question_zh: 这个路面标记是何含义？
options_en: A. Minimum speed of 80 km/h | B. Average speed of 80 km/h | C. 80 km/h speed limit lifted | D. Maximum speed of 80 km/h
options_zh: A. 最低限速为80公里/小时 | B. 平均速度为80公里/小时 | C. 解除80公里/小时限速 | D. 最高限速为80公里/小时
why_en: Check the color of the number: yellow indicates a maximum speed limit, white indicates a minimum speed limit.
explanation_zh: 白色是最低速度限制，不能低于这个速度长期行驶。

question_en: What category of marking is a yellow dashed line in the center of the road?
question_zh: 路中心黄色虚线属于哪一类标线？
options_en: A. Instruction marking | B. Prohibition marking | C. Warning sign | D. Auxiliary marking
options_zh: A. 指示标线 | B. 禁止标线 | C. 警告标志 | D. 辅助标线
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed, a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction lanes, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 黄色虚线，用于分割对向行驶的交通流，为指示标线。白色表示同向可跨越车道，黄色表示反向可跨越车道，虚线表示可跨越车道。

question_en: [Image] As shown, if your speed is 95 km/h, which lane can you drive in?
question_zh: 如图所示，当您车速为95km/h时，您可以在哪条车道上行驶？
options_en: A. Lane A | B. Lane B | C. Lane C | D. Lane D
options_zh: A. 车道A | B. 车道B | C. 车道C | D. 车道D
why_en: When a speed limit sign is posted on the road, drivers must travel in the lane specified by the sign.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，道路限速标志标明车道B最高限速100KM/h，所以选择车道B。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Watch for disabled persons | B. Entrance/exit for disabled persons | C. Rest area for disabled persons | D. Lane reserved for disabled persons
options_zh: A. 注意残疾人 | B. 残疾人出入口 | C. 残疾人休息处 | D. 残疾人专用通道
why_en: It reminds drivers to drive cautiously and give way to people with disabilities.
explanation_zh: 黄色标志为警告标志，图中坐轮椅的人是残疾人，所以提醒驾驶员注意残疾人标志。

question_en: What is the purpose of an instruction sign?
question_zh: 指示标志的作用是什么？
options_en: A. Restrict vehicles and pedestrians from passing | B. Direct the movement of vehicles and pedestrians | C. Provide direction information | D. Warn of danger ahead
options_zh: A. 限制车辆、行人通行 | B. 指示车辆、行人行进 | C. 告知方向信息 | D. 警告前方危险
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign, whose purpose is to direct the behavior of vehicles and pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 指示标志是交通标志中主要标志的一种，用以指示车辆和行人按规定方向、地点行驶。指示标志的颜色为蓝底、白图案；形状分为圆形、长方形和正方形。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. One-way traffic | B. Detour to the right | C. Watch for danger | D. Detour to the left
options_zh: A. 单向通行 | B. 右侧绕行 | C. 注意危险 | D. 左侧绕行
why_en: It reminds drivers to drive cautiously, as there is a detour to the right ahead.
explanation_zh: 右侧绕行：用以指示前方道路有障碍物，车辆应按照标志指示减速慢行，注意行车安全，右侧绕行通过。箭头所指方向就是行驶方向。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No yielding | B. Yield to oncoming traffic | C. Stop and yield | D. Slow down and yield
options_zh: A. 不准让行 | B. 会车让行 | C. 停车让行 | D. 减速让行
why_en: An octagonal sign with the character for 'stop' means stop and yield; a triangular sign with the character for 'yield' means slow down and yield.
explanation_zh: 三角形的是减速让行，八角形的是停车让行，此标志表示减速让行，车辆应减速让行，告示车辆驾驶人应慢行或停车，观察干道行车情况，在确保干道车辆优先，确保安全的前提下，方可进入路口。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Tourist area sign | B. Work zone sign | C. Notice sign | D. Expressway sign
options_zh: A. 旅游区标志 | B. 作业区标志 | C. 告示标志 | D. 高速公路标志
why_en: A brown background with white graphics and text indicates a tourist area sign.
explanation_zh: 云居寺一看就是风景区，此标志是旅游区标志。旅游区标志：设在通往旅游区各连接道路的交叉口处。棕底、白字、白图案、白边框。

question_en: How should you drive when a motor vehicle encounters this signal light flashing continuously?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇到这种信号灯不断闪烁时怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Accelerate through as quickly as possible | B. Pull over and wait | C. Watch carefully and pass safely | D. Brake hard immediately
options_zh: A. 尽快加速通过 | B. 靠边停车等待 | C. 注意瞭望安全通过 | D. 紧急制动
why_en: A steady yellow light means wait, but a continuously flashing yellow light means proceed only after confirming it is safe.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁提示车辆注意减速，警示驾驶人要注意瞭望，确认安全后缓慢通过。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No entry into the intersection | B. No right turn | C. No U-turn | D. No lane change
options_zh: A. 禁止驶入路口 | B. 禁止向右转弯 | C. 禁止车辆掉头 | D. 禁止变更车道
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden from turning right.
explanation_zh: 红圈禁令，箭头指示右转，合起来就是禁止向右转弯，禁止一切车辆向右转弯。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a lane | B. Indicates no entry | C. Indicates a merge | D. Indicates going straight
options_zh: A. 指示车道 | B. 指示禁行 | C. 指示合流 | D. 指示直行
why_en: Check the direction of the arrow: it points straight ahead, meaning go straight.
explanation_zh: 垂直箭头标志指示，多画在车道的地面上，指示直行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. National highway number | B. Provincial highway number | C. County road number | D. Township road number
options_zh: A. 国道编号 | B. 省道编号 | C. 县道编号 | D. 乡道编号
why_en: A red background with white letters starting with G is a national highway; a yellow background with black letters starting with S is a provincial highway; white with black letters starting with X is a county road, and Y is a township road.
explanation_zh: 此标志为省道编号。省道标志黄底黑字S开头，国道标志红底白字G开头，县道标志X开头，乡道标志白底黑字Y开头。

question_en: What signal is given by this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Pull-over signal | B. Left-turn waiting signal | C. Slow-down signal | D. Left-turn signal
options_zh: A. 靠边停车信号 | B. 左转弯待转信号 | C. 减速慢行信号 | D. 左转弯信号
why_en: Memory aid: the right hand extends out and the left hand swings, signaling a left turn.
explanation_zh: 交警面向哪个方向就是在指挥哪个方向的车辆，就此图来说还是左转弯信号。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Sharp curve | B. Slippery road section | C. Test-driving section | D. Curved road section
options_zh: A. 急转弯路 | B. 易滑路段 | C. 试车路段 | D. 曲线路段
why_en: This sign indicates a slippery road ahead, reminding drivers to slow down.
explanation_zh: 路面上有车轮打滑的痕迹，是易滑路段标志。此标志设在路面的摩擦系数不能满足相应行驶速度下要求紧急刹车距离的路段前适当位置。行驶至此路段必须减速慢行。注意行车安全。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No going straight | B. No U-turn | C. No lane change | D. No left turn
options_zh: A. 禁止直行 | B. 禁止掉头 | C. 禁止变道 | D. 禁止左转
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden from making a U-turn.
explanation_zh: 红圈是禁令标志，箭头指示掉头，合起来就是禁止掉头，禁止在当前路段掉头。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Y-shaped intersection ahead | B. Crossroads ahead | C. T-junction ahead | D. Road fork ahead
options_zh: A. Y型交叉路口预告 | B. 十字交叉路口预告 | C. 丁字交叉路口预告 | D. 道路分叉处预告
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign giving drivers advance notice of the intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志为丁字交叉路口预告，路很明显组成一个“丁”字。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway boundary marker number | B. Expressway mileage number | C. Expressway route (naming) number | D. Expressway section number
options_zh: A. 高速公路界牌编号 | B. 高速公路里程编号 | C. 高速公路命名编号 | D. 高速公路路段编号
why_en: The green sign represents an expressway; the 'G' indicates it is an expressway and the number is its route designation.
explanation_zh: 国家高速公路网的命名规则，编号由字母标识符汉语拼音“G”和阿拉伯数字编号组成。G2为京沪国家高速

question_en: What does this white rectangular marking mean?
question_zh: 这种白色矩形标线框含义是什么？
options_en: A. Taxi-only pickup/drop-off parking space | B. Parallel parking space | C. Angled parking space | D. Perpendicular parking space
options_zh: A. 出租车专用上下客停车位 | B. 平行式停车位 | C. 倾斜式停车位 | D. 垂直式停车位
why_en: The two sides of the rectangle run parallel to the edge of the road.
explanation_zh: 和道路平行的停车位为平行式停车位。

question_en: Which of the following signs is a minimum speed limit sign?
question_zh: 下列哪个标志为最低限速标志？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is sound your horn, Figure 2 is minimum speed limit, Figure 3 is motor vehicles only, Figure 4 is non-motor vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 图1表示鸣喇叭；图2表示最低限速；图3表示机动车行驶标志；图4表示非机动车行驶标志。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Watch for pedestrians | B. Pedestrian crossing ahead | C. Village or town | D. School ahead
options_zh: A. 注意行人 | B. 有人行横道 | C. 村庄或集镇 | D. 有小学校
why_en: This warning sign reminds drivers that a village or town is ahead, so caution is needed.
explanation_zh: 房前一棵树，是村庄或集镇标志。用以提醒车辆驾驶人小心驾驶。设在紧靠村庄、集镇且视线不良的路段以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Watch out for and give way to trains | B. Attended railway crossing | C. Unattended railway crossing | D. Multiple railway tracks crossing the road
options_zh: A. 注意避让火车 | B. 有人看守铁路道口 | C. 无人看守铁路道口 | D. 多股铁路与道路相交
why_en: The sign shows an 'X' and a '∧' shape, meaning multiple railway tracks cross the road.
explanation_zh: 红边白底的表示铁路，很形象的多股铁路与道路相交标志。

question_en: [Image] What does the white dashed line inside the circle mean?
question_zh: 图中圈内白色虚线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Small-vehicle turning line | B. Lane connector line | C. Non-motor vehicle guide line | D. Intersection guide line
options_zh: A. 小型车转弯线 | B. 车道连接线 | C. 非机动车引导线 | D. 路口导向线
why_en: A dashed line inside an intersection, whether white or yellow, is an intersection guide line.
explanation_zh: 黄色白色都是路口导向线，黄色与黄实线相延续，白色与白实线相延续。转向时按虚线行驶。划于路口时，用以引导车辆行进。

question_en: What does a solid yellow line on a curb mean?
question_zh: 路缘石上的黄色实线是何含义？
options_en: A. Only boarding/alighting of passengers allowed | B. Only loading/unloading of goods allowed | C. No prolonged parking | D. No stopping at all
options_zh: A. 仅允许上下人员 | B. 仅允许装卸货物 | C. 禁止长时间停车 | D. 禁止停放车辆
why_en: A yellow dashed line on a curb means no prolonged parking but temporary stopping is allowed; a yellow solid line means no stopping at all.
explanation_zh: 实线禁止停车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Distance to location | B. Route to travel | C. Direction of travel | D. Destination place name
options_zh: A. 地点距离 | B. 行驶路线 | C. 行驶方向 | D. 终点地名
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign giving drivers advance information about the road ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示地点距离。很明显的地点距离标志，所以本题的答案是地点距离。如果有箭头的一般是行驶方向。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Y-shaped intersection | B. Yield on the main road | C. Watch for a diverge | D. Watch for a merge
options_zh: A. Y型交叉口 | B. 主路让行 | C. 注意分流 | D. 注意合流
why_en: The yellow sign is a warning sign reminding drivers that vehicles will be merging in ahead.
explanation_zh: 黄底为警告标志，此标志表示注意合流。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意左侧有车辆汇合进来。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Embankment road | B. Uphill slope | C. Consecutive uphill slopes | D. Downhill slope
options_zh: A. 堤坝路 | B. 上陡坡 | C. 连续上坡 | D. 下陡坡
why_en: The yellow sign contains an arrow pointing diagonally upward, which is the uphill-slope warning sign.
explanation_zh: 一个箭头向上是上陡坡，一个箭头向下是下陡坡。两个箭头向上是连续上坡，两个箭头向下是连续下坡。在上坡时会有视觉上的盲点，应减速慢行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Small vehicle lane | B. Small-vehicle-only lane | C. Motor vehicle lane | D. High-occupancy vehicle lane
options_zh: A. 小型车车道 | B. 小型车专用车道 | C. 机动车车道 | D. 多乘员车辆专用车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning this lane is for motor vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 此为机动车车道，此标志表示该车道只供机动车行驶。与多乘员车辆相比比多乘员车辆专用车道少俩人。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. 40-ton axle load limit | B. Maximum speed limit of 40 km/h | C. Slow down in 40 meters | D. Minimum speed of 40 km/h
options_zh: A. 限制40吨轴重 | B. 限制最高时速40公里 | C. 前方40米减速 | D. 最低时速40公里
why_en: A red circle on a white background indicates a maximum speed limit sign, unlike the blue background used for minimum speed limits.
explanation_zh: 限制最高时速40公里：表示该标志至前方限制速度标志的路段内，机动车行驶速度不得超过标志所示数值。此标志设在需要限制车辆速度的路段的起点。以图为例：限制行驶时速不得超过40公里。红边为限制，黑边中间加五条斜杠为解除限制。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a right turn ahead | B. Indicates a left lane change | C. Indicates going straight ahead | D. Indicates a left turn ahead
options_zh: A. 指示前方右转弯 | B. 指示向左变道 | C. 指示前方直行 | D. 指示前方左转弯
why_en: Check the direction of the arrow: it points to the left, meaning a left turn is allowed ahead.
explanation_zh: 箭头指向左边，指示前方左转。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Merge to the right | B. Diverge point | C. Increase in number of lanes | D. Road widens
options_zh: A. 向右变道 | B. 分流处 | C. 车道数增加 | D. 路面变宽
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign reminding drivers the number of lanes ahead increases.
explanation_zh: 两车道变成三车道，此标志是车道数增加标志。

question_en: How should you drive in this situation?
question_zh: 遇到这种情况时怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Vehicles are prohibited from using the lanes on both sides | B. Slow down and enter the lanes on both sides | C. Enter the right lane | D. Accelerate and enter the lanes on both sides
options_zh: A. 禁止车辆在两侧车道通行 | B. 减速进入两侧车道行驶 | C. 进入右侧车道行驶 | D. 加速进入两侧车道行驶
why_en: The middle lane shows a green arrow allowing passage, which means the lanes on both sides are closed to traffic.
explanation_zh: 两侧车道都是红灯，所以都不可以通行，因此是禁止车辆在两侧车道通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Keep to the left side of the road | B. Left turn only | C. Downhill slope on the left | D. Park on the left side of the road
options_zh: A. 靠左侧道路行驶 | B. 只准向左转弯 | C. 左侧是下坡路段 | D. 靠道路左侧停车
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning vehicles must keep to the left side only.
explanation_zh: 靠左侧道路行驶：表示只准一切车辆靠左侧道路行驶。此标志设在车辆必须靠左侧行驶的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this yellow road marking mean?
question_zh: 路面上的黄色标记是何含义？
options_en: A. No turning | B. No U-turn | C. U-turn allowed | D. No going straight
options_zh: A. 禁止转弯 | B. 禁止掉头 | C. 允许掉头 | D. 禁止直行
why_en: A yellow cross-shaped (X) marking indicates that the marked maneuver is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 禁止掉头，掉头是错误的，打个叉，要扣分的。

question_en: What signal is given by this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Right-turn signal | B. Slow-down signal | C. Left-turn waiting signal | D. Pull-over signal
options_zh: A. 右转弯信号 | B. 减速慢行信号 | C. 左转弯待转信号 | D. 靠边停车信号
why_en: Memory aid: the left hand extends out and the right hand swings toward the right, signaling a right turn.
explanation_zh: 交警面向哪个方向就是在指挥哪个方向的车辆，右手摆动，右转弯信号。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway next-exit advance notice | B. Expressway right-side exit advance notice | C. Expressway destination advance notice | D. Expressway left-side exit advance notice
options_zh: A. 高速公路下一出口预告 | B. 高速公路右侧出口预告 | C. 高速公路目的地预告 | D. 高速公路左侧出口预告
why_en: The green sign represents an expressway, giving drivers advance notice of an upcoming exit.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“左出口”几个字，此标志是高速公路左侧出口预告。告知驾驶人左侧出口可以达到的位置。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a left curve ahead or need to merge left | B. Indicates a right curve ahead or need to merge right | C. Indicates an obstacle on the right ahead or need to merge left | D. Indicates a left curve ahead or need to detour left
options_zh: A. 提示前方有左弯或需向左合流 | B. 提示前方有右弯或需向右合流 | C. 提示前方右侧有障碍或需向左合流 | D. 提示前方有左弯或需向左绕行
why_en: Check the direction of the arrow: it curves to the left, meaning there is a slight left curve ahead.
explanation_zh: 箭头意思是需要向左小转弯，有可能是道路左转或者需要向左合流。

question_en: What is the function of a yellow dividing line in the center of the road?
question_zh: 路中黄色分界线的作用是什么？
options_en: A. Separates traffic flow going the same direction | B. Prohibits crossing into the opposing lane | C. Allows driving in the left-hand lane | D. Separates traffic flow going in opposite directions
options_zh: A. 分隔同向行驶的交通流 | B. 禁止跨越对向行车道 | C. 允许在左侧车道行驶 | D. 分隔对向行驶的交通流
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed, a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction traffic, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 分隔对向车道的分界线。箭头是对向，黄虚线用于分隔对向车道。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Recommended speed | B. Minimum speed | C. Maximum speed | D. Speed limit
options_zh: A. 建议速度 | B. 最低速度 | C. 最高速度 | D. 限制速度
why_en: Check the color of the number on the sign: yellow means maximum, white means minimum, black means recommended.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示建议速度。用以提醒车辆驾驶人以标志速度行驶，设在弯道、出口、匝道的适当位置。此为建议时速30公里/小时标志。

question_en: What kind of marking is this ground marking?
question_zh: 这个地面标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. Pedestrian crossing advance warning | B. Intersection advance warning | C. Slow-and-yield advance warning | D. Stop-and-yield advance warning
options_zh: A. 人行横道预告 | B. 交叉路口预告 | C. 减速让行预告 | D. 停车让行预告
why_en: This marking is meant to remind vehicles to slow down and give way to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 此标线为人行横道预告，在距离人行横道30-50米处设置，用来提醒驾驶员已经接近人行横道，需要减速慢行，注意行车安全。

question_en: What traffic sign is this?
question_zh: 这是什么交通标志？
options_en: A. Narrows on both sides | B. Narrows on the right | C. Narrows on the left | D. Bridge deck narrows
options_zh: A. 两侧变窄 | B. 右侧变窄 | C. 左侧变窄 | D. 桥面变窄
why_en: The yellow sign shows two lines where the right line stays straight and the left line narrows from wide to narrow, indicating a narrowing on the left.
explanation_zh: 左侧变窄：左侧变窄，用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方车行道或路面狭窄情况，遇有来车应减速避让。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Prolonged parking allowed | B. Temporary parking allowed | C. No prolonged parking | D. No parking at all
options_zh: A. 允许长时停车 | B. 允许临时停车 | C. 禁止长时停车 | D. 禁止停放车辆
why_en: Inside a red circle, a red X means no parking, an empty circle means no entry, and a white bar through the middle means through traffic prohibited.
explanation_zh: 禁止停放车辆：表示在限定的范围内，禁止一切车辆临时或长时停放。禁止车辆停放的时间、车种和范围可用辅助标志说明。中间一个红叉是禁止停车，包含禁止长时停车和禁止临时停车，中间一个斜杠是禁止长时停车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. One-way street to the left | B. One-way street to the right | C. One-way street straight ahead | D. Yield when turning right
options_zh: A. 向左单行路 | B. 向右单行路 | C. 直行单行路 | D. 右转让行
why_en: A rectangular blue sign is a one-way street sign; the direction the arrow points is the direction of the one-way street.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示该道路为单向行驶，已进入车辆应依标志指示方向行车，图中为向右。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway card-collection point | B. Expressway toll station | C. Expressway checkpoint | D. Toll station with ETC
options_zh: A. 高速公路领卡处 | B. 高速公路收费处 | C. 高速公路检查站 | D. 设有ETC的收费站
why_en: ETC refers to the Electronic Toll Collection system for non-stop tolling.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“ETC”几个字，此标志为设有ETC的收费站，即电子不停车收费系统。是指车辆在通过收费站时，通过车载设备实现车辆识别、信息写入（入口）并自动从预先绑定的IC卡或银行帐户上扣除相应资金（出口），是国际上正在努力开发并推广普及的一种用于道路、大桥和隧道的电子收费系统。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Facility for crossing the road | B. Emergency shelter | C. Service area | D. Pedestrian-only passage
options_zh: A. 横过道路设施 | B. 应急避难场所 | C. 生活服务区 | D. 行人专用通道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign indicating an evacuation location for emergency shelter.
explanation_zh: 人在跑，明显是紧急情况，所以是应急避难场所。应急避难场所是应对突发公共事件的一项灾民安置措施，是现代化大城市用于民众躲避火灾、爆炸、洪水、地震、疫情等重大突发公共事件的安全避难场所。

question_en: Which of the following signs warns drivers of a downhill slope ahead?
question_zh: 下列哪个标志提示驾驶人下陡坡？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is a sharp left turn, Figure 2 is continuous curves, Figure 3 is a reverse curve, Figure 4 is a downhill slope.
explanation_zh: 图1表示向左急转弯，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图2表示连续弯路，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图3表示反向弯路，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图4表示下坡路，提醒驾驶人下陡坡小心驾驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. U-turn | B. Reverse | C. Left turn | D. Detour
options_zh: A. 掉头 | B. 倒车 | C. 左转 | D. 绕行
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning a U-turn is permitted here.
explanation_zh: 掉头标志，表示该处允许机动车掉头。

question_en: How are vehicles allowed to travel at this intersection?
question_zh: 这个路口允许车辆怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Turn left | B. Go straight | C. Go straight or turn right | D. Turn right
options_zh: A. 向左转弯 | B. 直行 | C. 直行或向右转弯 | D. 向右转弯
why_en: The signal shown is a directional arrow light; whichever direction shows green is permitted.
explanation_zh: 绿色箭头亮的车道允许通行。直行和右转弯都是红色，图中只有左转车道的箭头是绿色，所以可以向左转弯。

question_en: What kind of marking is this ground marking?
question_zh: 这个路面标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. No-driving zone | B. Net-shaped marking | C. Channelizing line | D. Center circle
options_zh: A. 禁驶区 | B. 网状线 | C. 导流线 | D. 中心圈
why_en: A center circle is generally used to distinguish large and small vehicle turns, and vehicles must not cross its line while passing through.
explanation_zh: 设置在交叉路口中心的白色圆形或菱形区域，车辆左转弯时不得压线，只能紧靠中心圈小转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dip in the road | B. Hump bridge | C. Uneven road surface | D. Raised road surface
options_zh: A. 路面低洼 | B. 驼峰桥 | C. 路面不平 | D. 路面高突
why_en: The yellow sign shows a raised bump, indicating a raised road surface, so drivers should proceed with caution.
explanation_zh: 一个凸起是高突，一个坑是低洼，一个凸中间有空间是驼峰桥，中间是实心的是高突，两个凸肯定是不平。所以此题显而易见是路面高突。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Height-based speed limit of 50 km/h | B. Minimum speed limit of 50 km/h | C. Horizontal elevation 50 meters | D. Altitude of 50 meters
options_zh: A. 高度限速50公里/小时 | B. 最低限速50公里/小时 | C. 水平高度50米 | D. 海拔高度50米
why_en: A minimum speed limit sign has a blue background with white text, while a maximum speed limit sign has a white background with red text.
explanation_zh: 此标志是最低限速50公里/小时，表示机动车驶入前方道路的最低时速限制，设在高速公路或其他道路限速路段的起点。最高限速标志是白底红字。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. T-junction | B. Y-shaped intersection | C. Crossroads | D. Roundabout
options_zh: A. T型交叉路口 | B. Y型交叉路口 | C. 十字交叉路口 | D. 环行交叉路口
why_en: The sign contains a sideways T shape, so look for the option matching a T-junction.
explanation_zh: T型交叉路口：丁字形标志原则上设在与交叉口形状相符的道路上。右侧丁字路口，此标志设在进入T字路口以前的适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. 150 meters to an attended railway crossing | B. 150 meters to an unattended railway crossing | C. 100 meters to an unattended railway crossing | D. 100 meters to an attended railway crossing
options_zh: A. 距有人看守铁路道口150米 | B. 距无人看守铁路道口150米 | C. 距无人看守铁路道口100米 | D. 距有人看守铁路道口100米
why_en: A fence symbol means attended, a train symbol means unattended; each diagonal bar represents 50 meters of distance.
explanation_zh: 黄色警告标志中栅栏表示有人看守，只有火车表示无人看守。警告标志下面的长方形，一条红杠杠代表50米，两条100米...依此类推。此标志为距无人看守铁路道口150米。

question_en: Which type of vehicle is this sign prohibiting?
question_zh: 这个标志提示哪种车型禁止通行？
options_en: A. Medium-sized buses | B. Small trucks | C. All types of vehicles | D. Small passenger cars
options_zh: A. 中型客车 | B. 小型货车 | C. 各种车辆 | D. 小型客车
why_en: The red sign is a prohibition sign banning small passenger cars from passing.
explanation_zh: 红色-禁令，此标志表示禁止小型客车驶入，轿车属于小型客车。

question_en: What does the marking inside the red circle mean?
question_zh: 红色圆圈内标线含义是什么？
options_en: A. Temporary stopping point | B. Bay-style stop (bus bay) | C. Emergency stopping lane | D. Bus stop
options_zh: A. 临时停靠站 | B. 港湾式停靠站 | C. 应急停车带 | D. 公交车停靠站
why_en: The white marking curves outward, which indicates a bay-style stop set back from the roadway.
explanation_zh: 这里实线是港湾式停靠站

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Customs | B. National border | C. Border defense | D. Boundary
options_zh: A. 海关 | B. 国界 | C. 边防 | D. 边界
why_en: Inside the red circle is a black horizontal bar plus the word 'Customs', indicating a customs checkpoint.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“海关”。排除其他几项。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight-ahead lane | B. Straight ahead only | C. One-way street | D. Turn right
options_zh: A. 直行车道 | B. 只准直行 | C. 单行路 | D. 向右转弯
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning all vehicles must turn right only.
explanation_zh: 向右转弯：此标志表示一切车辆只准向右转弯。此标志设在车辆必须向右转弯的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of the road mean?
question_zh: 路中心双黄实线是何含义？
options_en: A. Opposing lanes may be crossed | B. Crossing the opposing lane dividing line is prohibited | C. Same-direction lanes may be crossed on both sides | D. Single-direction lane dividing line
options_zh: A. 可跨越对向车道分界线 | B. 禁止跨越对向车行道分界线 | C. 双侧可跨越同向车道分界线 | D. 单向行驶车道分界线
why_en: A double solid yellow line may not be crossed or driven on.
explanation_zh: 双黄线严禁跨越或者压线行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Detour around construction | B. Two-way traffic | C. Watch for danger | D. Detour left or right
options_zh: A. 施工路段绕行 | B. 双向交通 | C. 注意危险 | D. 左右绕行
why_en: It reminds drivers of an obstacle ahead, so they should detour to the left or right.
explanation_zh: 此图标为警告标志，左右绕行，箭头往左是左侧绕行，往右是右侧绕行，同时往左右两边就是左右绕行。车辆应按照指示标志减速慢行，绕行通过，注意行车安全。箭头所指方向就是行驶方向。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Turn-guidance sign | B. Alignment-guidance sign | C. Merge-guidance sign | D. Diverge-guidance sign
options_zh: A. 转弯诱导标志 | B. 线形诱导标志 | C. 合流诱导标志 | D. 分流诱导标志
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meant to guide vehicles and alert drivers to a change in the road's alignment ahead.
explanation_zh: 线型诱导标志，用于引导车辆驾驶人改变行驶方向，促使安全运行。视需要设于易肇事之弯道路段，小半径匝道曲线或中央隔离设施及渠化设施的端部。线形诱导标的颜色规定为：指示性线形诱导标一般道路为蓝底白图案,高速公路为绿底白图案，用以提供一般性行驶指示;警告性线形诱导标为红底白图案，可使车辆驾驶人提高警觉，并准备防范应变之措施。

question_en: Which category does this sign belong to?
question_zh: 这属于哪一类标志？
options_en: A. Guide sign | B. Instruction sign | C. Prohibition sign | D. Warning sign
options_zh: A. 指路标志 | B. 指示标志 | C. 禁令标志 | D. 警告标志
why_en: A guide sign conveys route information to drivers.
explanation_zh: 指路标志指示市镇村的境界、目的地的方向和距离、高速公路出入口、著名地点所在等，用以传递道路方向，地点，距离信息。题中从左至右依次为交叉路口预告标志，国道编号，预告地点距离。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Directional lane | B. Right-turn lane | C. U-turn lane | D. Left-turn lane
options_zh: A. 分向车道 | B. 右转车道 | C. 掉头车道 | D. 左转车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only turn right.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志为右转车道。图中向右，表示只准一切车辆向右转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dangerous road along a mountainside | B. Cliffside road | C. Watch for falling rocks | D. Hazardous road section
options_zh: A. 傍山险路 | B. 悬崖路段 | C. 注意落石 | D. 危险路段
why_en: This sign is usually placed along mountainside roads at risk of falling rocks.
explanation_zh: 有石头从山上落下来，是注意落石标志。此标志设在左侧有落石危险的傍山路段之前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Intersection advance notice | B. Lane direction advance notice | C. Lane assignment advance notice | D. Fork-in-road advance notice
options_zh: A. 交叉路口预告 | B. 车道方向预告 | C. 分道信息预告 | D. 分岔处预告
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign informing drivers of the intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示大交通量的四车道以上公路交叉路口预告。分向行驶车道边上是虚线，下面没有距离标志。交叉路口标志是这个，有距离的数字。

question_en: How should a motor vehicle proceed when this signal light appears at a railway crossing?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在铁路道口看到这种信号灯时怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Watch carefully while crossing slowly | B. Accelerate through without shifting gears | C. Cross before the train arrives | D. Must not cross the stop line
options_zh: A. 边观察边缓慢通过 | B. 不换挡加速通过 | C. 在火车到来前通过 | D. 不得越过停止线
why_en: The signal follows the same rule as any traffic light: red or a warning signal here means drivers must stop and not cross the stop line.
explanation_zh: 在铁道路口，红灯一亮，表示有火车驶来，此时绝对禁止通行，不得越过停止线。

question_en: What is the purpose of a prohibition sign?
question_zh: 禁令标志的作用是什么？
options_en: A. Prohibit or restrict actions | B. Show direction information | C. Direct vehicle movement | D. Warn of danger ahead
options_zh: A. 禁止或限制行为 | B. 告知方向信息 | C. 指示车辆行进 | D. 警告前方危险
why_en: A prohibition sign forbids or restricts vehicles from performing certain actions.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志是交通标志中主要标志的一种，对车辆加以禁止或限制的标志，如禁止通行、禁止停车、禁止左转弯、禁止鸣喇叭、限制速度、限制重量等。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Warns drivers the road ahead runs along a reservoir, lake, or river | B. Warns drivers of an upward steep slope ahead | C. Warns drivers of a downward steep slope ahead | D. Warns drivers of two or more consecutive uphill sections ahead
options_zh: A. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方道路沿水库、湖泊、河流 | B. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向上的陡坡路段 | C. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向下的陡坡路段 | D. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有两个及以上的连续上坡路段
why_en: The yellow sign is a warning sign alerting drivers to a downward steep slope ahead.
explanation_zh: 和上坡标志区分记忆，此标志为下坡路，提醒驾驶员前方有向下的陡坡路段。

question_en: What does this road surface number marking mean?
question_zh: 这个路面数字标记是何含义？
options_en: A. Following-distance marking | B. Minimum-gap marking | C. Speed limit marking | D. Road numbering marking
options_zh: A. 保持车距标记 | B. 最小间距标记 | C. 速度限制标记 | D. 道路编号标记
why_en: Check the color of the number: yellow indicates a maximum speed limit, white indicates a minimum speed limit.
explanation_zh: 速度限制标志，黄色数字是最高限速，白色数字是最低限速。要按照规定速度行驶。

question_en: [Image] What kind of marking is the zigzag solid white line inside the circle?
question_zh: 图中圈内的锯齿状白色实线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Guide-lane line | B. Direction guide line | C. Variable guide-lane line | D. One-way traffic line
options_zh: A. 导向车道线 | B. 方向引导线 | C. 可变导向车道线 | D. 单向行驶线
why_en: A variable guide-lane line changes the direction it indicates according to traffic flow.
explanation_zh: 此标线是可变导向车道线。左转右转还是直行都是可以的，关键看信号灯或者路面上的指标牌。两条白实线是固定导向线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway right-side exit advance notice | B. Expressway next-exit advance notice | C. Expressway place-name and direction advance notice | D. Expressway left-side exit advance notice
options_zh: A. 高速公路右侧出口预告 | B. 高速公路下一出口预告 | C. 高速公路地点、方向预告 | D. 高速公路左侧出口预告
why_en: The green sign represents an expressway, showing drivers the place name and direction ahead.
explanation_zh: 高速公路地点、方向预告。多用在高速公路收费站后或和其他高速公路交接处。对地点、方向的预告。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No going straight or turning left | B. Going straight or changing lanes to the right allowed | C. Going straight or changing lanes to the left allowed | D. No going straight or turning right
options_zh: A. 禁止直行和向左转弯 | B. 允许直行和向右变道 | C. 允许直行和向左变道 | D. 禁止直行和向右转弯
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden from going straight or turning left.
explanation_zh: 红圈是禁令标志，箭头指示直行左转，合起来就是禁止直行和向左转弯，禁止车辆直行或左转弯。

question_en: Which of the following traffic signs represents a one-way street?
question_zh: 以下交通标志表示单行线的是哪一项？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: A one-way street sign has only a single arrow with no white dashed lines on either side.
explanation_zh: 图1表示单行路（直行）；图2表示直行车道；图3表示路口优先通行；图4表示靠右侧道路行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway public telephone | B. Expressway incident report phone | C. Expressway emergency phone | D. Expressway rescue phone
options_zh: A. 高速公路公用电话 | B. 高速公路报警电话 | C. 高速公路紧急电话 | D. 高速公路救援电话
why_en: An emergency phone sign has no text on it, while a rescue phone sign has the word 'rescue' written on it.
explanation_zh: 标志表示高速公路紧急电话，要与高速公路救援电话区分开，救援电话有“救援”二字。

question_en: What signal is given by this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Go-straight signal | B. Turn signal | C. Stop signal | D. Pull-over signal
options_zh: A. 直行信号 | B. 转弯信号 | C. 停止信号 | D. 靠边停车信号
why_en: Memory aid: both arms extend out and the right hand swings, signaling to go straight.
explanation_zh: 右手方向和左手方向在一条线上，右手做动作朝左手的方向，直行信号。

question_en: What does the following traffic sign mean?
question_zh: 以下交通标志表示的含义是什么？
options_en: A. Motor vehicles prohibited from entering | B. Small passenger cars prohibited from entering | C. All vehicles prohibited from entering | D. Non-motor vehicles prohibited from entering
options_zh: A. 禁止机动车驶入 | B. 禁止小客车驶入 | C. 禁止所有车辆驶入 | D. 禁止非机动车驶入
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign; the car symbol inside indicates motor vehicles are forbidden from entering here.
explanation_zh: 图中标志表示禁止机动车驶入。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Pedestrian crossing | B. Watch for pedestrians | C. Watch for children | D. School zone
options_zh: A. 人行横道 | B. 注意行人 | C. 注意儿童 | D. 学校区域
why_en: The yellow sign shows a pedestrian figure, which is the watch-for-pedestrians warning sign.
explanation_zh: 如图所示：黄底的警告标志是“注意行人”。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway parking area advance notice | B. Expressway refuge area advance notice | C. Expressway service area advance notice | D. Expressway parking lot advance notice
options_zh: A. 高速公路停车区预告 | B. 高速公路避险处预告 | C. 高速公路服务区预告 | D. 高速公路停车场预告
why_en: A knife-and-fork symbol indicates a service area, a teacup symbol indicates a parking area, and a plain 'P' indicates a parking lot.
explanation_zh: 此图标志是高速公路停车区预告，提供停车以及简单的饮茶服务。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Crossroads advance notice | B. Interchange (grade-separated junction) advance notice | C. Y-shaped intersection advance notice | D. Roundabout advance notice
options_zh: A. 十字交叉路口预告 | B. 互通式立体交叉预告 | C. Y型交叉路口预告 | D. 环行交叉路口预告
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign informing drivers of the intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志是互通式立体交叉预告。由直行车道，匝道，匝道连接部，立体交叉跨线桥和其他交通设施等组成。

question_en: What does this yellow road marking mean?
question_zh: 路面上的黄色标线是何含义？
options_en: A. Lane-increase marking | B. Road-width-transition marking | C. Approaching-obstacle marking | D. Construction-zone advance marking
options_zh: A. 车行道变多标线 | B. 路面宽度渐变标线 | C. 接近障碍物标线 | D. 施工路段提示线
why_en: The lower left of the image shows a left-side road-narrowing sign, indicating a gradual change in road width.
explanation_zh: 该标志是路面宽度渐变标线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Left-turn lane | B. U-turn lane | C. Detour lane | D. Directional lane
options_zh: A. 左转车道 | B. 掉头车道 | C. 绕行车道 | D. 分向车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only make a U-turn.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志是掉头车道。

question_en: What kind of marking consists of a white dashed line and a triangular area on the road?
question_zh: 路面由白色虚线和三角地带标线组成的是什么标线？
options_en: A. Road entrance marking | B. Crossable lane-dividing marking | C. Road exit deceleration marking | D. Road exit marking
options_zh: A. 道路入口标线 | B. 可跨越式分道线 | C. 道路出口减速线 | D. 道路出口标线
why_en: Check the arrow direction: entering on the left and exiting on the right; from the main road toward a side road is an exit, and toward the main road is an entrance.
explanation_zh: 道路出口标线为白色虚线，主要用在高速公路出口与引导车流使用。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway emergency call number | B. Expressway traffic radio frequency | C. Expressway rescue phone number | D. Expressway service phone number
options_zh: A. 高速公路报警电话号码 | B. 高速公路交通广播频率 | C. 高速公路救援电话号码 | D. 高速公路服务电话号码
why_en: The green sign represents an expressway; this sign shows the expressway's traffic radio broadcast frequency.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“道路交通信息”几个字，还有KHZ几个字母，表示千赫兹，此标志为高速公路交通广播频率。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Warning sign | B. Guide sign | C. Instruction sign | D. Prohibition sign
options_zh: A. 警告标志 | B. 指路标志 | C. 指示标志 | D. 禁令标志
why_en: Traffic signs are divided by color into: yellow (warning sign), red (prohibition sign), and blue (instruction sign).
explanation_zh: 黄色为警告标志，警告标志的颜色为黄底、黑边、黑图案，形状为等边三角形，顶角朝上。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Cliffside road | B. Embankment road | C. Dangerous road along a mountainside | D. Falling-rock road
options_zh: A. 临崖路 | B. 堤坝路 | C. 傍山险路 | D. 落石路
why_en: This sign indicates a road section prone to danger ahead, so caution is needed.
explanation_zh: 很形象的一座山，表示傍山险路标志。用以提醒车辆驾驶人小心驾驶。设在傍山险路路段以前适当位置。

question_en: What signal is given by this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Left-turn waiting signal | B. Left-turn signal | C. Slow-down signal | D. Right-turn signal
options_zh: A. 左转弯待转信号 | B. 左转弯信号 | C. 减速慢行信号 | D. 右转弯信号
why_en: Memory aid: the left hand swings out to the side, signaling to wait before turning left.
explanation_zh: 交警面向哪个方向就是在指挥哪个方向的车辆，减速慢行是右手，左转弯待转是左手。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a left turn or U-turn ahead | B. Indicates going straight or turning left ahead | C. Indicates going straight or making a U-turn ahead | D. Indicates going straight ahead with a left lane change
options_zh: A. 指示前方可左转或掉头 | B. 指示前方可直行或左转 | C. 指示前方可直行或掉头 | D. 指示前方直行向左变道
why_en: Check the arrow: it combines a straight arrow and a U-turn arrow, meaning drivers may go straight or make a U-turn.
explanation_zh: 指示此车道内的车辆掉头或直行均可。

question_en: [Image] What does the area between the two yellow dashed lines inside the circle mean?
question_zh: 图中圈内两条黄色虚线间的区域是何含义？
options_en: A. Large-bus-only lane | B. Commercial passenger vehicle lane | C. Taxi-only lane | D. Bus-only lane
options_zh: A. 大客车专用车道 | B. 营运客车专用车道 | C. 出租车专用车道 | D. 公交专用车道
why_en: During designated hours, this lane may only be used by buses.
explanation_zh: 写明了“公交专用”，黄色虚线是想突出引起驾驶员注意。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. National highway number | B. Provincial highway number | C. County road number | D. Township road number
options_zh: A. 国道编号 | B. 省道编号 | C. 县道编号 | D. 乡道编号
why_en: A red background with white letters starting with G is a national highway; yellow with black letters starting with S is a provincial highway; white with black letters starting with X is a county road, and Y is a township road.
explanation_zh: 此标志为县道编号。县道标志X开头，国道标志红底白字G开头，省道标志黄底黑字S开头，乡道标志白底黑字Y开头。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Emergency stopping lane | B. Open-air parking lot | C. Parking space | D. Passing bay
options_zh: A. 紧急停车带 | B. 露天停车场 | C. 停车位 | D. 错车道
why_en: A bulge on the right side of the road with a dashed line in the middle is an emergency stopping lane; without the dashed line it is a passing bay.
explanation_zh: 中间有虚线的是紧急停车带，没有虚线的是错车道。错车道指的是在单车道道路上，可通视的一定距离内，供车辆交错避让用的一段加宽车道。

question_en: What does a solid white line in the center of the road mean?
question_zh: 路中心白色实线是何含义？
options_en: A. Crossing the opposing lane dividing line is prohibited | B. Same-direction lanes may be crossed on both sides | C. Crossing the same-direction lane dividing line is prohibited | D. Same-direction lane dividing line may be crossed from one side
options_zh: A. 禁止跨越对向车行道分界线 | B. 双侧可跨越同向车道分界线 | C. 禁止跨越同向车行道分界线 | D. 单侧可跨越同向车道分界线
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed, a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction traffic, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 实线不可跨越，箭头指向同一方向，是禁止跨越同向车行道分界线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No changing lanes to merge | B. No lane change | C. No overtaking | D. No U-turn
options_zh: A. 禁止借道 | B. 禁止变道 | C. 禁止超车 | D. 禁止掉头
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign meaning overtaking is not allowed.
explanation_zh: 很形象的超车线路图。红色是禁令标志，此标志表示禁止超车。表示该标志至前方解除禁止超车标志的路段内，不准机动车超车。此标志设在禁止超车的起点。

question_en: What traffic sign is this?
question_zh: 这是什么交通标志？
options_en: A. Narrows on both sides | B. Narrows on the right | C. Narrows on the left | D. Bridge deck narrows
options_zh: A. 两侧变窄 | B. 右侧变窄 | C. 左侧变窄 | D. 桥面变窄
why_en: The yellow sign shows two lines both narrowing from wide to narrow, indicating the road narrows on both sides.
explanation_zh: 两侧变窄：上窄下粗，两边同时变窄表示两侧变窄。提醒驾驶人注意路面情况，遇到来车应予注意避让，减速慢行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Accident-prone section | B. Slow down | C. Watch for danger | D. Congested section
options_zh: A. 事故多发路段 | B. 减速慢行 | C. 注意危险 | D. 拥堵路段
why_en: The yellow sign contains an exclamation mark, indicating danger.
explanation_zh: 黄色标志为注意，感叹号表示危险。注意危险：用以促使车辆驾驶员谨慎慢行。

question_en: Which of the following indicates a decrease in the number of lanes on an ordinary road?
question_zh: 下列哪个表示一般道路车道数变少？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is a passing bay, Figure 2 is a decrease in lane number, Figure 3 is an increase in lane number, Figure 4 is a tunnel-exit distance advance notice.
explanation_zh: 图1表示错车道；图2表示车道数变少；图3表示车道数增加；图4表示隧道出口距离预告。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Uneven road surface | B. Hump bridge | C. Raised road surface | D. Dip in the road
options_zh: A. 不平路面 | B. 驼峰桥 | C. 路面高突 | D. 路面低洼
why_en: Memory aid: a hump bridge has a gate symbol, two bumps means uneven, a dip curving down means low, and a bump curving up means raised.
explanation_zh: 很形象的拱桥，也就是驼峰桥标志。驼峰桥：用以提醒车辆驾驶人谨慎驾驶。设在拱度很大，影响视距的驼峰桥以前适当位置。

question_en: What does a white dashed line along the right edge of the roadway mean?
question_zh: 路右侧车行道边缘白色虚线是什么含义？
options_en: A. Vehicles may temporarily cross the line | B. Vehicles are prohibited from crossing the line | C. Emergency-lane dividing line | D. Pedestrian-crossing dividing line
options_zh: A. 车辆可临时越线行驶 | B. 车辆禁止越线行驶 | C. 应急车道分界线 | D. 人行横道分界线
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed, a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction traffic, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 边缘线为实线的，禁止跨越实线行驶；边缘线为虚线的，可临时跨越行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway next-exit advance notice | B. Expressway right-side exit advance notice | C. Expressway destination advance notice | D. Expressway left-side exit advance notice
options_zh: A. 高速公路下一出口预告 | B. 高速公路右侧出口预告 | C. 高速公路目的地预告 | D. 高速公路左侧出口预告
why_en: The green sign represents an expressway, showing drivers the distance to the next exit and the destination reached.
explanation_zh: 高速公路下一出口预告，还有4公里，预告了下一个高速公路的出口和距离，所以选“高速公路下一出口预告”。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No U-turn | B. No right turn | C. No going straight | D. No left turn
options_zh: A. 禁止掉头 | B. 禁止向右转弯 | C. 禁止直行 | D. 禁止向左转弯
why_en: The red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden from going straight.
explanation_zh: 红圈禁令，箭头指示直行，合起来就是禁止直行，禁止一切车辆直行。

question_en: What traffic sign is this?
question_zh: 这是什么交通标志？
options_en: A. Slippery road section | B. Sharp curve | C. Reverse curve | D. Continuous curves
options_zh: A. 易滑路段 | B. 急转弯路 | C. 反向弯路 | D. 连续弯路
why_en: Memory aid: one sharp curve, two reverse curve, three continuous curves.
explanation_zh: 如图所示：斜着的字母“Z”或者“N”表示反向弯路。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Unattended railway crossing | B. Attended railway crossing | C. Multiple railway tracks crossing the road | D. Grade-separated railway crossing
options_zh: A. 无人看守铁路道口 | B. 有人看守铁路道口 | C. 多股铁路与道路相交 | D. 立交式的铁路道口
why_en: A fence symbol means attended, while a train symbol means unattended.
explanation_zh: 使用起栅栏表示有人看守，只有火车标志表示无人看守。此标志为有人看守铁路道口。

question_en: What does this directional arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates turning left or making a U-turn | B. Indicates going straight or changing lanes to the left | C. Indicates going straight or turning left | D. Indicates going straight or making a U-turn
options_zh: A. 指示向左转弯或掉头 | B. 指示直行或向左变道 | C. 指示直行或左转弯 | D. 指示直行或掉头
why_en: Check the arrow direction: it points ahead and to the left, meaning drivers may go straight or turn left.
explanation_zh: 此标线指示直行或左转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No right turn | B. No left turn | C. Turn left or right | D. No left or right turn
options_zh: A. 禁止向右转弯 | B. 禁止向左转弯 | C. 向左和向右转弯 | D. 禁止向左右转弯
why_en: The round blue sign is an instruction sign meaning all vehicles may only turn left or right.
explanation_zh: 向左和向右转弯：表示只准一切车辆向左和向右转弯。此标志设在车辆必须向左和向右转弯的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does a double dashed white line at the very front of an intersection mean?
question_zh: 路口最前端的双白虚线是什么含义？
options_en: A. Waiting-to-proceed line | B. Stop-and-yield line | C. Slow-and-yield line | D. Left-turn waiting area line
options_zh: A. 等候放行线 | B. 停车让行线 | C. 减速让行线 | D. 左弯待转线
why_en: Near intersections there are three types of white lines: a single solid line is a stop line, a double solid line is a stop-and-yield line, and a double dashed line is a slow-and-yield line.
explanation_zh: 双虚线为减速让行线，可以压线过去。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Horn should be sounded | B. No horn sounding | C. No high-pitched horn sounding | D. No low-pitched horn sounding
options_zh: A. 应当鸣喇叭 | B. 禁止鸣喇叭 | C. 禁止鸣高音喇叭 | D. 禁止鸣低音喇叭
why_en: This sign is generally placed on sections of road with obstructed sightlines.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示机动车行至该标志处应鸣喇叭，以提醒对向车辆驾驶人或路边行人注意并减速慢行。一般设在公路的急转弯处、陡坡等视线不良路段的起点。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dead end | B. T-junction | C. Diverge point | D. Slow down and proceed
options_zh: A. 此路不通 | B. T型路口 | C. 分流路口 | D. 减速通行
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning the road ahead does not go through.
explanation_zh: 此标志是此路不通，蓝底白车道红杠，不能通行。用以指示前方道路为死胡同，无出口、不能通行。该标志为蓝底白色街区红色图案。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Maintain a safe following distance | B. Distance-confirmation section | C. Speed-testing section | D. Narrows-on-both-sides section
options_zh: A. 注意保持车距 | B. 车距确认路段 | C. 车速测试路段 | D. 两侧变窄路段
why_en: The yellow sign is a warning; the inverted V shape represents distance, reminding drivers to keep a safe following distance.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示注意保持车距。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意和前车保持安全距离。避免事故的发生。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Bus route-only lane | B. Large-bus-only lane | C. Bus rapid transit (BRT)-only lane | D. High-occupancy vehicle lane
options_zh: A. 公交线路专用车道 | B. 大型客车专用车道 | C. 快速公交系统专用车道 | D. 多乘员车辆专用车道
why_en: The blue sign is an instruction sign meaning this lane is reserved exclusively for buses; other vehicles may not use it.
explanation_zh: 此标志为公交线路专用车道，表示此车道只允许公交车行驶。与快速公交系统专用车道的区别是少了“快速公交”四个字。

question_en: What is the purpose of an instruction line marking?
question_zh: 指示标线的作用是什么？
options_en: A. Prohibit passage | B. Direct passage | C. Restrict passage | D. Warn and alert
options_zh: A. 禁止通行 | B. 指示通行 | C. 限制通行 | D. 警告提醒
why_en: Instruction line markings exist to guide everyone through safely.
explanation_zh: 指示标线主要就是引导你正确的行驶，安全行驶，遵守法律法规。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Lifts the 3-meter width restriction | B. Height limit of 3 meters | C. Advance notice of 3-meter width | D. Width limit of 3 meters
options_zh: A. 解除3米限宽 | B. 限制高度为3米 | C. 预告宽度为3米 | D. 限制宽度为3米
why_en: Black corner marks above and below indicate a height limit, left and right indicate a width limit; the number is the limit value.
explanation_zh: 限制宽度为3米：表示禁止装载宽度超过标志所示数值的车辆通行。此标志设在最大允许宽度受限制的地方。以图为例：装载宽度不得超过3米。两个黑色三角在两边是限宽，在上下是限高。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Keep to the right | B. Keep to the left | C. Turn right | D. Roundabout
options_zh: A. 右侧通行 | B. 左侧通行 | C. 向右行驶 | D. 环岛行驶
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign; it means vehicles must keep to the right while circling the roundabout.
explanation_zh: 环岛行驶：表示只准车辆靠右环行。此标志设在环岛面向路口来车方向适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Tourist area category | B. Tourist area distance | C. Tourist area direction | D. Tourist area symbol
options_zh: A. 旅游区类别 | B. 旅游区距离 | C. 旅游区方向 | D. 旅游区符号
why_en: A brown sign showing the scenic area's name plus a distance in kilometers is a tourist area distance sign.
explanation_zh: 图中有旅游区名称、距离。所以此标志是旅游区距离。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Bus-only lane | B. BRT vehicle-only lane | C. Large passenger vehicle-only lane | D. Multi-occupant vehicle-only lane
options_zh: A. 公交车专用车道 | B. BRT车辆专用车道 | C. 大型客车专用车道 | D. 多乘员车专用车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign; it means this lane is reserved for BRT vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 此标志是BRT车辆专用车道，表示该车道专供BRT（快速公交）车辆行驶，BRT为快速公交的英文缩写。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Construction zone | B. Accident-prone section | C. Slow-down zone | D. Congested section
options_zh: A. 施工路段 | B. 事故易发路段 | C. 减速慢行路段 | D. 拥堵路段
why_en: This marks an accident-prone section; drivers must proceed with caution.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示事故易发路段。用以告示前方道路为事故易发路段，谨慎驾驶，注意安全。此标志设在交通事故易发路段以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. 50 meters to an unguarded railway crossing | B. 50 meters to a guarded railway crossing | C. 100 meters to an unguarded railway crossing | D. 100 meters to a guarded railway crossing
options_zh: A. 距无人看守铁路道口50米 | B. 距有人看守铁路道口50米 | C. 距无人看守铁路道口100米 | D. 距有人看守铁路道口100米
why_en: A gate icon indicates a guarded crossing, a train icon an unguarded one; each diagonal bar represents 50 meters.
explanation_zh: 黄色警告标志中栅栏表示有人看守，只有火车表示无人看守。标志下面的长方形，一条红杠杠代表50米，两条100米...依此类推。此标志为距无人看守铁路道口50米。

question_en: What does this diamond-block dashed road marking mean?
question_zh: 路面上的菱形块虚线是何含义？
options_en: A. Longitudinal deceleration marking | B. Road construction notice marking | C. Transverse deceleration marking | D. Lane reduction notice marking
options_zh: A. 车行道纵向减速标线 | B. 道路施工提示标线 | C. 车行道横向减速标线 | D. 车道变少提示标线
why_en: The longitudinal deceleration marking reminds drivers to slow down.
explanation_zh: 车行道纵向减速标线，提醒驾驶人需要减速行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Keep to the right | B. No going straight | C. One-way street straight ahead | D. Through traffic must yield
options_zh: A. 靠右侧行驶 | B. 不允许直行 | C. 直行单行路 | D. 直行车让行
why_en: A rectangular blue sign is a one-way street sign; the arrow shows the one-way direction of travel.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示该道路为单向行驶，已进入车辆应依标志指示方向行车，图中为直行。只准直行标志是圆形的，而直行单行路标志形状为方形，注意区分。

question_en: What does this road marking mean?
question_zh: 这个路面标记是何含义？
options_en: A. Bicycle-only lane | B. Non-motorized vehicle lane | C. Motorcycle-only lane | D. Electric bike-only lane
options_zh: A. 自行车专用道 | B. 非机动车道 | C. 摩托车专用道 | D. 电瓶车专用道
why_en: The bicycle icon in the marking represents non-motorized vehicles.
explanation_zh: 非机动车道，禁止机动车进入。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Speed-camera deceleration zone | B. Traffic flow monitoring | C. Full-route photo enforcement | D. Traffic surveillance equipment
options_zh: A. 减速拍照区 | B. 道路流量监测 | C. 全路段抓拍 | D. 交通监控设备
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign warning drivers that traffic surveillance equipment is ahead.
explanation_zh: 交通监控设备标志属于指路标志，蓝底、白图形、白边框、蓝色衬边。用于告知机动车驾驶人该区域设置有固定式交通监控设备。

question_en: What does this parking marking mean?
question_zh: 这种停车标线含义是什么？
options_en: A. Dedicated visitor parking space | B. Dedicated pick-up/drop-off parking space | C. Fixed-direction parking space | D. Time-limited motor vehicle parking space
options_zh: A. 专用待客停车位 | B. 专用上下客停车位 | C. 固定停车方向停车位 | D. 机动车限时停车位
why_en: At a fixed-direction parking space, vehicles must park facing the direction shown by the arrow.
explanation_zh: 这里是固定停车方向停车位，车头应该按箭头方向停放。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway ETC lane | B. Expressway toll-payment lane | C. Expressway inspection lane | D. Expressway ticket-collection lane
options_zh: A. 高速公路ETC车道 | B. 高速公路缴费车道 | C. 高速公路检查车道 | D. 高速公路领卡车道
why_en: Green signs represent expressways; ETC refers to the Electronic Toll Collection system.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“ETC”几个字，此标志为高速公路ETC车道。ETC车道指引。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Prohibition sign | B. Mandatory sign | C. Direction (guide) sign | D. Warning sign
options_zh: A. 禁令标志 | B. 指示标志 | C. 指路标志 | D. 警告标志
why_en: Traffic signs are distinguished by color: yellow is a warning sign, red is a prohibition sign, blue is a mandatory sign.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志是交通标志中主要标志的一种，对车辆加以禁止或限制的标志。如禁令标志的颜色，除个别标志外，为白底，红圈，红杠，黑图案。图案压杠。禁令标志的形状为圆形、八角形、顶角向下的等边三角形。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight-ahead lane | B. Straight ahead only | C. One-way street | D. No going straight
options_zh: A. 直行车道 | B. 只准直行 | C. 单行路 | D. 禁止直行
why_en: This round blue mandatory sign means straight ahead only; a one-way street sign is a rectangular blue sign instead.
explanation_zh: 蓝色-指示，此标志表示一切车辆只准直行。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一类标志？
options_en: A. Warning sign | B. Prohibition sign | C. Mandatory sign | D. Direction (guide) sign
options_zh: A. 警告标志 | B. 禁令标志 | C. 指示标志 | D. 指路标志
why_en: A blue sign showing direction, place names, or distance information is a direction (guide) sign.
explanation_zh: 此标志属于指路标志，是路径指引标志。指示标志都没有文字，有文字的都是指路标志。所以本题是指路标志。

question_en: What does this road-surface guide arrow mean?
question_zh: 路面上导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Warns of a left bend ahead or need to merge left | B. Warns of a right bend ahead or need to merge right | C. Warns of an obstacle ahead requiring a left merge | D. Warns of a left bend ahead or need to detour left
options_zh: A. 提示前方有左弯或需向左合流 | B. 提示前方有右弯或需向右合流 | C. 提示前方有障碍需向左合流 | D. 提示前方有左弯或需向左绕行
why_en: The arrow curves to the right, indicating a slight right bend ahead.
explanation_zh: 向右小转弯，可能需要右转或向右合流。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of a roundabout | B. Advance notice of a crossroads | C. Advance notice of a T-junction | D. Advance notice of a Y-junction
options_zh: A. 环行交叉路口预告 | B. 十字交叉路口预告 | C. 丁字交叉路口预告 | D. Y型交叉路口预告
why_en: Blue is an informational sign notifying drivers of the intersection layout ahead, shown here as a Y shape.
explanation_zh: 此标志为Y形交叉路口预告，两个箭头加上你所处的道路形成一个Y字。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight and left-turn lane | B. Straight and side-road exit lane | C. Combined straight and right-turn lane | D. Directional lane split
options_zh: A. 直行和左转车道 | B. 直行和辅路出口车道 | C. 直行和右转合用车道 | D. 分向行驶车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only go straight or turn right.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志是直行和右转合用车道，表示只准一切车辆直行和向右转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Keep to the left | B. No passing (closed to traffic) | C. Pass on both sides | D. Keep to the right
options_zh: A. 左侧通行 | B. 不准通行 | C. 两侧通行 | D. 右侧通行
why_en: On red-background signs, a white pointed shape means pass on both sides, a forward slash means keep left, a backslash means keep right.
explanation_zh: 此标志是左侧通行，∧表示两侧通行，/这个方向的表示左侧通行，\这个方向表示右侧通行。可以用“上左下右”来记，上左下右即为右侧通行，反之左侧通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Raised road surface | B. Hump bridge ahead | C. Uneven road surface | D. Low-lying (dip in) road surface
options_zh: A. 路面高突 | B. 有驼峰桥 | C. 路面不平 | D. 路面低洼
why_en: The yellow sign shows the road surface dipping downward, indicating a low-lying road.
explanation_zh: 一个坡是高突，一个坑是低洼，一个凸中间有空间是驼峰桥，两个凸肯定是不平。故此题是路面低洼。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Caution, wild animals | B. Caution, livestock | C. Animal park | D. Open grazing area
options_zh: A. 注意野生动物 | B. 注意牲畜 | C. 动物公园 | D. 开放的牧区
why_en: The deer icon on the yellow sign means caution for wild animals; drive carefully.
explanation_zh: 牛表示注意牲畜，鹿表示注意野生动物。此标志表示野生动物。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Narrow road | B. Narrows on the right | C. Narrows on the left | D. Narrow bridge
options_zh: A. 窄路 | B. 右侧变窄 | C. 左侧变窄 | D. 窄桥
why_en: Be careful to distinguish a narrow bridge sign from a narrow road sign; this one depicts a bridge.
explanation_zh: 窄桥：两头宽中间窄的是窄桥。窄路和窄桥的区别是：窄路图标没有上面放宽的那块，窄路是行道变窄，窄桥是一段变窄，然后路又变宽。

question_en: [Image] What is the yellow dashed marking circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内黄色虚线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Intersection guide line | B. Non-motorized vehicle guide line | C. Lane connector line | D. Small-vehicle turning line
options_zh: A. 路口导向线 | B. 非机动车引导线 | C. 车道连接线 | D. 小型车转弯线
why_en: A single dashed line inside an intersection, whether white or yellow, is an intersection guide line.
explanation_zh: 黄色白色都是路口导向线，黄色与黄实线相延续，白色与白实线相延续。转向时按虚线行驶。

question_en: How are vehicles allowed to proceed at this intersection?
question_zh: 这个路口允许车辆怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Go straight | B. Turn right | C. Go straight or turn left | D. Turn left
options_zh: A. 直行 | B. 向右转弯 | C. 直行或向左转弯 | D. 向左转弯
why_en: These are directional arrow signals; only the direction whose green arrow is lit is permitted, here the right-turn arrow.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，绿色箭头亮的车道允许通行，图中只有右转车道的箭头是绿色，所以只能向右转弯。

question_en: When driving straight through an intersection and encountering this signal light, how should you proceed?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路口直行遇到这种信号灯应该怎样行驶？
