options_en: A. Must not cross the stop line | B. Accelerate and go straight through | C. Turn left | D. Enter the intersection and wait
options_zh: A. 不得越过停止线 | B. 加速直行通过 | C. 左转弯行驶 | D. 进入路口等待
why_en: Stop on red, go on green; on yellow, wait, so the vehicle must not cross the stop line.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第三十八条：机动车信号灯和非机动车信号灯表示：(一)绿灯亮时，准许车辆通行，但转弯的车辆不得妨碍被放行的直行车辆、行人通行；(二)黄灯亮时，已越过停止线的车辆可以继续通行；(三)红灯亮时，禁止车辆通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. One-way street | B. Stop and yield | C. Priority road | D. Streets on both sides
options_zh: A. 单行路 | B. 停车让行 | C. 干路先行 | D. 两侧街道
why_en: The priority road sign means vehicles on the main road have the right of way.
explanation_zh: 干路指主路，一般交叉路口，行驶在干路的车辆有优先通行权，支路车辆需避让干路车辆。从支路进入干路的机动车辆在无交通警察指挥和交通信号灯的情况下要避让在干路上行驶的机动车辆，让干路上行驶的机动车辆先行，这就是“干路先行”。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Runaway truck ramp (escape lane) | B. Emergency lane | C. Shoulder | D. Sharp bend
options_zh: A. 避险车道 | B. 应急车道 | C. 路肩 | D. 急弯道
why_en: Note the wording for a runaway truck ramp printed on the sign.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示避险车道。避险车道是指：在长陡下坡路段行车道外侧，增设的供速度失控车辆驶离正线,安全减速的专用车道。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. When meeting oncoming traffic, stop and let the other vehicle go first | B. Two-way traffic section ahead | C. Vehicles prohibited on the road to the right | D. When meeting oncoming traffic, stop and let the vehicle on the right go first
options_zh: A. 会车时停车让对方车先行 | B. 前方是双向通行路段 | C. 右侧道路禁止车通行 | D. 会车时停车让右侧车先行
why_en: The red arrow is thin and the black arrow is thick; the thick black arrow has priority, so the driver must stop and yield.
explanation_zh: 会车时停车让对方车先行：表示车辆通过时，必须停车让对方车先行。设置在只有一条的双向通道的一端。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. 40-meter deceleration zone | B. Minimum speed 40 km/h | C. End of the 40 km/h speed limit | D. Maximum speed 40 km/h
options_zh: A. 40米减速行驶路段 | B. 最低时速40公里 | C. 解除时速40公里限制 | D. 最高时速40公里
why_en: Red signs are prohibitions; black-and-white signs cancel a prohibition, so this ends the 40 km/h limit.
explanation_zh: 解除时速40公里限制：表示限制速度路段结束。此标志设在限制车辆速度路段的终点。红边为限制，黑边中间加五条斜杠为解除限制。

question_en: Which of the following signs means you do NOT need to yield?
question_zh: 遇到下列哪个标志，你不需要主动让行？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Not needing to yield means the vehicle has the right of way, as shown by the priority road sign in figure 4.
explanation_zh: 图1表示停车让行；图2表示减速让行；图3表示会车让行。这三张都是禁令标志，而图4是指示标志，表示会车先行标志，所以不用主动让行。

question_en: What does this yellow road-surface marking mean?
question_zh: 路面上的黄色标记是何含义？
options_en: A. No left turn | B. No U-turn | C. No right turn | D. No going straight
options_zh: A. 禁止左转 | B. 禁止掉头 | C. 禁止右转 | D. 禁止直行
why_en: A yellow cross-shaped marking over an arrow means that movement is prohibited, here a right turn.
explanation_zh: 禁止右转，打个叉，右转是错误的。

question_en: [Image] What is the white zigzag line circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内的白色折线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Deceleration line | B. Distance-confirmation line | C. Speed-confirmation line | D. Intersection deceleration line
options_zh: A. 减速行驶线 | B. 车距确认线 | C. 车速确认线 | D. 路口减速线
why_en: Look closely: the upper-right corner of the image is labeled distance confirmation.
explanation_zh: 车距确认线，帮助更好的识别与前车的距离。仔细看图可以看出右侧有车距距离数值。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway service area | B. Expressway gas station | C. Expressway rest area | D. Expressway passenger bus station
options_zh: A. 高速公路服务区 | B. 高速公路加油站 | C. 高速公路休息区 | D. 高速公路客车站
why_en: Green signs represent expressways; this one indicates the location of a gas station.
explanation_zh: 很明显的加油机形状，图中有黑色加油机标志，此标志为高速公路加油站。

question_en: What is this road-surface marking?
question_zh: 这个路面标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. No-driving zone | B. Grid (network) markings | C. Center circle | D. Channelizing (diversion) line
options_zh: A. 禁驶区 | B. 网状线 | C. 中心圈 | D. 导流线
why_en: A center circle marking can be either round or diamond-shaped.
explanation_zh: 设置在交叉路口中心的白色圆形或菱形区域，车辆左转弯时不得压线，只能紧靠中心圈小转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of expressway terminus place name | B. Advance notice of expressway route | C. Advance notice of expressway direction | D. Advance notice of expressway place and distance
options_zh: A. 高速公路终点地名预告 | B. 高速公路行驶路线预告 | C. 高速公路行驶方向预告 | D. 高速公路地点距离预告
why_en: Green signs represent expressways; this one informs drivers of the upcoming place name and distance.
explanation_zh: 高速公路地点距离预告，告知驾驶人距离某一位置还有多少距离。

question_en: What are these two double yellow dashed lines in the middle of the road?
question_zh: 路中两条双黄色虚线是什么标线？
options_en: A. One-way lane divider | B. Crossable lane divider | C. Tidal (reversible) lane line | D. Two-way lane divider
options_zh: A. 单向分道线 | B. 可跨越分道线 | C. 潮汐车道线 | D. 双向分道线
why_en: Tidal lane lines let the direction of the lane be reversed depending on morning and evening traffic flow.
explanation_zh: “潮汐车道”是指根据早晚交通流量不同情况，对有条件的道路，试点开辟潮汐车道，通过车道灯的指示方向变化，控制主干道车道行驶方向，来调整车道数，提高车道使用效率。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Interchange: straight ahead and right turn | B. Interchange: straight ahead and left turn | C. Straight ahead and left turn | D. Straight ahead and right turn
options_zh: A. 立体交叉直行和右转弯行驶 | B. 立体交叉直行和左转弯行驶 | C. 直行和左转弯行驶 | D. 直行和右转弯行驶
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles at this interchange may go straight or turn left along the route shown.
explanation_zh: 此标志是“立体交叉直行和左转弯行驶”，表示一切车辆在立体交叉处可以直行和按图示路线左转弯行驶。通常设置在立交桥转弯出口处适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. National highway number | B. Provincial highway number | C. County road number | D. Township road number
options_zh: A. 国道编号 | B. 省道编号 | C. 县道编号 | D. 乡道编号
why_en: Red background with white 'G' is a national highway; yellow with black 'S' is provincial; white with black 'X' is county; 'Y' is township.
explanation_zh: 此标志为国道编号。国道标志红底白字G开头，省道标志黄底黑字S开头，县道标志X开头，乡道标志白底黑字Y开头。

question_en: If your vehicle is being overtaken by another vehicle and there is a vehicle following behind, what should you do?
question_zh: 驾驶的车辆正在被其他车辆超越时，若此时后方有跟随行驶的车辆，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Continue accelerating | B. Move slightly to the right to keep a safe lateral distance | C. Drive along the center of the road | D. Accelerate to the right to make way
options_zh: A. 继续加速行驶 | B. 稍向右侧行驶，保证横向安全距离 | C. 靠道路中心行驶 | D. 加速向右侧让路
why_en: Overtaking always happens from the left, so when conditions allow, move slightly right to let the overtaking vehicle pass safely.
explanation_zh: 驾驶的车辆正在被其他车辆超越时，应主动稍向右侧行驶，保证横向安全距离。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No going straight or turning left | B. Straight ahead and right lane change permitted | C. Straight ahead and left lane change permitted | D. No going straight or turning right
options_zh: A. 禁止直行和向左转弯 | B. 允许直行和向右变道 | C. 允许直行和向左变道 | D. 禁止直行和向右转弯
why_en: A red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden to go straight or turn right.
explanation_zh: 红圈是禁令标志，箭头指示直行右转，合起来就是禁止直行和向右转弯，禁止车辆直行或右转弯。

question_en: What does this yellow dashed-solid center line mean?
question_zh: 路中心黄色虚实线是何含义？
options_en: A. Crossing is prohibited on the solid-line side | B. Crossing is prohibited on the dashed-line side | C. Crossing is allowed on the solid-line side | D. Crossing is allowed on both sides
options_zh: A. 实线一侧禁止越线 | B. 虚线一侧禁止越线 | C. 实线一侧允许越线 | D. 两侧均可越线行驶
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, solid lines may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction lanes, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 黄色虚线一方允许跨线行驶，黄色实线一方不允许跨线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Parking lot | B. Scenic viewpoint | C. Rest area | D. Service area
options_zh: A. 停车场 | B. 观景台 | C. 休息区 | D. 服务区
why_en: Blue is an informational sign indicating a rest area ahead where drivers can stop and rest.
explanation_zh: 此标志是休息区，很明显的“休息区”三个字。服务区是有加油，通车，吃饭的组合标志，停车场就是一个P，图中没有加油站和吃饭的，所以它只是一个休息区。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway starting point | B. Expressway exit | C. Expressway entrance | D. Expressway end point
options_zh: A. 高速公路起点 | B. 高速公路出口 | C. 高速公路入口 | D. 高速公路终点
why_en: Note that the expressway start and end signs differ by only a single line.
explanation_zh: 此标志是高速公路起点标志，有红色斜线的是高速公路终点标志。

question_en: What signal is this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Right-turn signal | B. Slow-down signal | C. Lane-change signal | D. Pull-over signal
options_zh: A. 右转弯信号 | B. 减速慢行信号 | C. 变道信号 | D. 靠边停车信号
why_en: Memory aid: a sideways sweep of the right arm signals a lane change.
explanation_zh: 交警面向哪个方向就是在指挥哪个方向的车辆，右手向右轻轻摆动发出变道信号。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Combined straight and left-turn lane | B. No left turn and no U-turn lane | C. Combined U-turn and left-turn lane | D. Directional lane split
options_zh: A. 直行和左转合用车道 | B. 禁止左转和掉头车道 | C. 掉头和左转合用车道 | D. 分向行驶车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only make a U-turn or turn left.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，图中有左转和掉头标志，所以此标志是掉头和左转合用车道。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Detour to the left | B. One-way traffic | C. Danger ahead | D. Detour to the right
options_zh: A. 左侧绕行 | B. 单向通行 | C. 注意危险 | D. 右侧绕行
why_en: The arrow in the sign points left, matching the detour-left option.
explanation_zh: 左侧绕行：用以指示前方道路有障碍物，车辆应按照标志指示减速慢行，注意行车安全，左侧绕行通过。箭头所指方向就是行驶方向。

question_en: What does the marking circled in red mean?
question_zh: 红色圆圈内标线含义是什么？
options_en: A. Temporary stopping point | B. Large coach stopping point | C. Bus stop | D. Emergency stopping lane
options_zh: A. 临时停靠站 | B. 大客车停靠站 | C. 公交车停靠站 | D. 应急停车带
why_en: A bus stop marking is reserved exclusively for buses.
explanation_zh: “公交车”三个字很明显，此标线为公交车停靠站。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Long-term parking allowed | B. No temporary stopping | C. No long-term parking | D. No parking at all
options_zh: A. 允许长时停车 | B. 禁止临时停车 | C. 禁止长时停车 | D. 禁止停放车辆
why_en: Within the marked zone, all vehicles are prohibited from parking for an extended time.
explanation_zh: 禁止长时停车：禁止车辆长时停放，临时停放不受限制。禁止车辆停放的时间、车种和范围可用辅助标志说明。中间一个红叉是禁止停车，包含禁止长时停车和禁止临时停车，中间一个斜杠是禁止长时停车。

question_en: What does this signal light mean for a motor vehicle at an intersection?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯表示什么意思？
options_en: A. Intersection warning | B. No right turn | C. Straight ahead permitted | D. Accelerate through
options_zh: A. 路口警示 | B. 禁止右转 | C. 准许直行 | D. 加速通过
why_en: Stop on red, go on green; a flashing yellow warns drivers to proceed with caution at the intersection.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全》第二十六条：通信号灯由红灯、绿灯、黄灯组成。红灯表示禁止通行，绿灯表示准许通行，黄灯表示路口警示。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight ahead and right turn | B. Straight ahead and left turn | C. No going straight or turning right | D. Left or right turn only
options_zh: A. 直行和向右转弯 | B. 直行和向左转弯 | C. 禁止直行和向右转弯 | D. 只准向左和向右转弯
why_en: This sign means all vehicles may only go straight or turn right.
explanation_zh: 蓝色-指示标志，直行和向右转弯：表示只准一切车辆直行和向右转弯。此标志设在车辆必须直行和向右转弯的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: Which sign indicates a combined straight and right-turn lane?
question_zh: 下列哪个标志，指示车辆直行和右转合用车道？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the combined straight/right-turn lane sign; figure 2 is priority road, figure 3 is right-turn lane, figure 4 is a directional lane split.
explanation_zh: 直行和右转合用车道，位于此车道的车辆可向右转弯或直行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Warns drivers of two or more consecutive uphill sections ahead | B. Warns drivers of a steep uphill section ahead | C. Warns drivers of a steep downhill section ahead | D. Warns drivers of two or more consecutive downhill sections ahead
options_zh: A. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有两个及以上的连续上坡路段 | B. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向上的陡坡路段 | C. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有向下的陡坡路段 | D. 提醒车辆驾驶人前方有两个及以上的连续下坡路段
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign alerting drivers to consecutive downhill sections ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志为连续下坡标志，提醒驾驶人前方有两个及以上的连续下坡路段。两个箭头表示连续下坡。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No left turn | B. No entering the left lane | C. No U-turns | D. No changing to the left lane
options_zh: A. 禁止向左转弯 | B. 禁止驶入左车道 | C. 禁止车辆掉头 | D. 禁止向左变道
why_en: A red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden to turn left.
explanation_zh: 红圈禁令，箭头指示左转，合起来就是禁止向左转弯，禁止所有车辆向左通行。

question_en: What signal is this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Pull-over signal | B. Left-turn waiting signal | C. Left-turn signal | D. Right-turn signal
options_zh: A. 靠边停车信号 | B. 左转弯待转信号 | C. 左转弯信号 | D. 右转弯信号
why_en: Memory aid: right arm extended, left arm swinging indicates a left-turn signal.
explanation_zh: 与交警右手相对的方向车辆停车等待，交警左手摆动，交警面向方向的车辆左转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Caution, crosswinds | B. Wind vane | C. Tunnel entrance | D. Weather station
options_zh: A. 注意横风 | B. 风向标 | C. 隧道入口 | D. 气象台
why_en: On seeing this sign, slow down and grip the steering wheel firmly due to crosswinds.
explanation_zh: 杆上的飘带被横风吹起，是注意横风标志。此标志设在经常有很强的侧风并有必要引起注意的路段前适当位置。

question_en: What does this guide arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates a right turn ahead | B. Indicates a U-turn ahead | C. Indicates going straight ahead | D. Indicates a left lane change
options_zh: A. 指示前方右转弯 | B. 指示前方掉头 | C. 指示前方直行 | D. 指示向左变道
why_en: The arrow points right, indicating a right turn is available ahead.
explanation_zh: 箭头指向右边，指示前方右转。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Sharp left turn | B. Sharp right turn | C. Detour to the right | D. Series of bends
options_zh: A. 向左急转弯 | B. 向右急转弯 | C. 向右绕行 | D. 连续弯路
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign indicating a sharp right turn ahead.
explanation_zh: 急转弯标志：箭头向左是向左急转弯，箭头向右是向右急转弯。该标志设在右急转弯的道路前方适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Culvert | B. Canal | C. Bridge | D. Tunnel
options_zh: A. 涵洞 | B. 水渠 | C. 桥梁 | D. 隧道
why_en: This sign indicates a tunnel ahead, reminding drivers to proceed with caution.
explanation_zh: 明显是个山洞，此为隧道标志。隧道：用以提醒车辆驾驶人注意慢行。设在双向行驶并且照明不好的隧道口前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dike (embankment) road | B. Steep ascent | C. Steep descent | D. Consecutive uphill sections
options_zh: A. 堤坝路 | B. 上陡坡 | C. 下陡坡 | D. 连续上坡
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign indicating a steep downhill section ahead.
explanation_zh: 一个箭头向上是上陡坡，一个箭头向下是下陡坡。两个箭头向上是连续上坡，两个箭头向下是连续下坡。下坡速度较快，需注意速度，谨慎驾驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Indoor parking lot | B. Open-air parking lot | C. Dedicated parking lot | D. Internal (private) parking lot
options_zh: A. 室内停车场 | B. 露天停车场 | C. 专用停车场 | D. 内部停车场
why_en: A 'P' sign with an umbrella icon is indoor parking; without the umbrella it is open-air parking.
explanation_zh: 此标志是露天停车场。P字上边没有遮挡是露天停车场，P字上面有遮挡的是室内停车场。

question_en: Which sign warns drivers of a series of bends?
question_zh: 下列哪个标志提示驾驶人连续弯路？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Memory aid: one bend for a simple turn, two opposite bends for a reverse curve, three or more for a series of bends, shown in figure 2.
explanation_zh: 图1表示向左急转弯，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图2表示连续弯路，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图3表示反向弯路，警告驾驶人减速慢行；图4表示交叉路口，警告驾驶人谨慎慢行，注意横向来车。

question_en: [Image] What does the white solid horizontal line circled in the image mean?
question_zh: 图中圈内白色横实线是何含义？
options_en: A. Stop line | B. Yield line | C. Deceleration line | D. Turn-waiting line
options_zh: A. 停止线 | B. 让行线 | C. 减速线 | D. 待转线
why_en: A single solid white line is a stop line, a double solid white line is a stop-and-yield line, a double dashed white line is a slow-and-yield line.
explanation_zh: 红灯前的停止线，红灯亮时不可越线。

question_en: Which sign prohibits all vehicles from parking for a long time, while temporary stopping is not restricted?
question_zh: 下列哪个标志禁止一切车辆长时间停放，临时停车不受限制。
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Be careful to distinguish 'no parking' from 'no long-term parking,' shown in figure 4.
explanation_zh: 图1表示禁止停车；图2表示停车让行；图3表示禁止驶入；图4表示禁止长时停车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Use high beams in tunnel | B. Slow down in tunnel | C. Turn on lights in tunnel | D. Turn on width/marker lights in tunnel
options_zh: A. 隧道开远光灯 | B. 隧道减速 | C. 隧道开灯 | D. 隧道开示宽灯
why_en: This sign reminds drivers to turn on their headlights before entering the tunnel.
explanation_zh: 隧道是不允许开远光灯的，此标志是用以警告车辆驾驶人进入隧道打开前照明灯，注意行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Non-motorized vehicle parking space | B. Electric bicycle travel | C. Non-motorized vehicle parking zone | D. Non-motorized vehicle lane
options_zh: A. 非机动车停车位 | B. 电动自行车行驶 | C. 非机动车停放区 | D. 非机动车行驶
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning this road is only for non-motorized vehicles.
explanation_zh: 此标志为非机动车行驶，表示该道路只供非机动车行驶。行驶的标志是用圆圈蓝底白字表示。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Change to left lane | B. Reduction in number of lanes | C. Merge point | D. Emergency lane
options_zh: A. 向左变道 | B. 车道数变少 | C. 合流处 | D. 应急车道
why_en: Blue is an informational sign indicating the number of lanes ahead decreases; drive carefully.
explanation_zh: 此标志是车道数减少标志，三车道变成二车道，车道数变少。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Keep to the left | B. Keep to the right | C. Pass on both sides | D. No passing (closed to traffic)
options_zh: A. 左侧通行 | B. 右侧通行 | C. 两侧通行 | D. 不准通行
why_en: On red-background signs, a white pointed shape means pass on both sides, a forward slash means keep left, a backslash means keep right.
explanation_zh: 此标志是两侧通行。∧表示两侧通行，\这个方向表示右侧通，/这个方向的表示左侧通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Small-car-only lane | B. Motor-vehicle-only lane | C. Multi-occupant vehicle-only lane | D. Taxi-only lane
options_zh: A. 小型汽车专用车道 | B. 机动车专用车道 | C. 多乘员车辆专用车道 | D. 出租汽车专用车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning this lane is reserved for multi-occupant vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 此标志为多乘员车辆专用车道，比机动车专用车道标志上的小车多了2个小人，所以它是多乘员车辆专用车道。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Warning sign | B. Prohibition sign | C. Mandatory sign | D. Direction (guide) sign
options_zh: A. 警告标志 | B. 禁令标志 | C. 指示标志 | D. 指路标志
why_en: A blue sign showing a car facing forward indicates a motor-vehicle lane, which is a mandatory sign.
explanation_zh: 指示标志的颜色为蓝底、白图案；形状分为圆形、长方形和正方形。此标志是指示标志，表示该道路只供机动车行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Caution, pedestrians | B. Pedestrian crossing | C. Caution, children | D. School zone
options_zh: A. 注意行人 | B. 人行横道 | C. 注意儿童 | D. 学校区域
why_en: This sign is placed mainly near primary schools, kindergartens, and children's centers where children often cross.
explanation_zh: 如图所示：背包的儿童在奔跑，是注意儿童标志。用以警告车辆驾驶人减速慢行，注意儿童。设在小学、幼儿园、少年宫等儿童经常出入地点前适当位置。

question_en: [Image] What is the road marking circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内的路面标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. Intersection guide line | B. Stop-and-yield line | C. Slow-and-yield line | D. Crosswalk (pedestrian crossing) line
options_zh: A. 路口示意线 | B. 停车让行线 | C. 减速让行线 | D. 人行横道线
why_en: A crosswalk marking guides pedestrians to cross the road safely.
explanation_zh: 人行横道线，就是我们平常所说的斑马线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Yield to non-motorized vehicles | B. Non-motorized vehicle lane | C. No non-motorized vehicles | D. Caution, non-motorized vehicles
options_zh: A. 避让非机动车 | B. 非机动车道 | C. 禁止非机动车通行 | D. 注意非机动车
why_en: On seeing this sign, watch out for and give way to non-motorized vehicles.
explanation_zh: 黄底标志为警告标志，自行车是非机动车，此标志为注意非机动车。

question_en: How are vehicles allowed to proceed at this intersection?
question_zh: 这个路口允许车辆怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Turn left or right | B. Go straight or turn left | C. Turn left | D. Go straight or turn right
options_zh: A. 向左、向右转弯 | B. 直行或向左转弯 | C. 向左转弯 | D. 直行或向右转弯
why_en: These are directional arrow signals; only the direction whose green arrow is lit is permitted, here straight ahead and right turn.
explanation_zh: 绿色箭头亮的车道允许通行，直行和右转灯是绿色。所以在这个路口允许车辆直行或向右转弯。

question_en: What marking is formed by the white dashed line and triangular area on the road?
question_zh: 路面上白色虚线和三角地带标线组成的是什么标线？
options_en: A. Road entrance marking | B. Crossable lane divider | C. Road entrance deceleration marking | D. Road exit marking
options_zh: A. 道路入口标线 | B. 可跨越式分道线 | C. 道路入口减速线 | D. 道路出口标线
why_en: Following the arrow direction, entering from the branch road toward the main road indicates an entrance marking.
explanation_zh: 道路入口标线，白色虚线，主要用于高速公路入口引导车流使用。出口入口主要靠箭头指向区分。

question_en: What does the white dashed-line area on the far-left of the road mean?
question_zh: 道路最左侧白色虚线区域是何含义？
options_en: A. Multi-occupant vehicle-only lane | B. Small passenger car-only lane | C. Empty taxi-only lane | D. Large passenger vehicle-only lane
options_zh: A. 多乘员车辆专用车道 | B. 小型客车专用车道 | C. 未载客出租车专用车道 | D. 大型客车专用车道
why_en: This sign means the lane is reserved for multi-occupant vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 地面上写明了是“多乘员专用”。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Multiple railway tracks crossing the road | B. Guarded railway crossing | C. Unguarded railway crossing | D. Sound the horn for an extended time
options_zh: A. 多股铁路与道路相交 | B. 有人看守铁路道口 | C. 无人看守铁路道口 | D. 注意长时鸣喇叭
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign; a gate icon means guarded, a locomotive icon means unguarded.
explanation_zh: 使用栅栏表示有人看守，只有火车标志表示无人看守。此标志为无人看守铁路道口。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Pedestrian crossing | B. Student walkway | C. Children's walkway | D. Caution, pedestrians
options_zh: A. 人行横道 | B. 学生通道 | C. 儿童通道 | D. 注意行人
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign reminding drivers to yield to pedestrians at the crossing.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示该处为人行横道。注意行人是三角形黄底的；里面白色，正方形蓝底是人行横道。

question_en: What does this sign give advance notice of?
question_zh: 这个标志预告什么？
options_en: A. Advance notice of expressway service area | B. Advance notice of expressway runaway ramp | C. Advance notice of expressway bus station | D. Advance notice of expressway parking lot
options_zh: A. 高速公路服务区预告 | B. 高速公路避险处预告 | C. 高速公路客车站预告 | D. 高速公路停车场预告
why_en: A knife-and-fork icon marks a service area, a teacup icon marks a rest stop, and a bare 'P' marks a parking lot.
explanation_zh: 图中P为停车地方，上图标志为高速公路停车场预告，只提供停车服务。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Stop to take a ticket | B. Stop to pay toll | C. Stop for inspection | D. ETC lane
options_zh: A. 停车领卡 | B. 停车缴费 | C. 停车检查 | D. ETC通道
why_en: This sign is typically placed at the entrance of an expressway toll station where drivers stop to take a ticket.
explanation_zh: 很明显的“停车领卡”几个字，此标志为停车领卡，此图片表示开到窗口边停车，领卡通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No entry for vehicles | B. No long-term parking | C. Stop and yield | D. No temporary stopping
options_zh: A. 不准车辆驶入 | B. 不准长时间停车 | C. 停车让行 | D. 不准临时停车
why_en: An octagon with the character for 'stop' means stop and yield; a triangle with 'yield' means slow down and yield.
explanation_zh: 停车让行：表示车辆必须在停止线以外停车瞭望，确认安全后，才准许通行。停车让行标志在下列情况下设置：(1)与交通流量较大的干路平交的支路路口；(2)无人看守的铁路道口；(3)其他需要设置的地方。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Scenic viewpoint | B. Parking lot | C. Rest area | D. Parking space
options_zh: A. 观景台 | B. 停车场 | C. 休息区 | D. 停车位
why_en: Blue is an informational sign indicating a scenic viewpoint ahead with parking for viewing.
explanation_zh: 此标志是观景台。观景台主要设置在旅游景区的路两侧，供驾驶人停车观景和休息。图标内的P表示这个观景台是设置有停车场的观景台。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Height limit of 3.5 meters | B. Width limit of 3.5 meters | C. End of the 3.5-meter height limit | D. Following-distance limit of 3.5 meters
options_zh: A. 限制高度为3.5米 | B. 限制宽度为3.5米 | C. 解除3.5米限高 | D. 限制车距为3.5米
why_en: Black corner marks above and below indicate a height limit; the number shown is the limit value.
explanation_zh: 限制高度为3.5米：表示禁止装载高度超过标志所示数值的车辆通行。此标志设在最大允许高度受限制的地方。以图为例：装载高度不得超过3.5米。两个黑色三角在两边是限宽，在上下是限高。

question_en: What traffic sign is this?
question_zh: 这是什么交通标志？
options_en: A. Narrows on both sides | B. Narrows on the right | C. Narrows on the left | D. Bridge deck narrows
options_zh: A. 两侧变窄 | B. 右侧变窄 | C. 左侧变窄 | D. 桥面变窄
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign showing the road narrowing on the right; drive carefully.
explanation_zh: 右侧变窄：右侧变窄，警告车辆驾驶人注意前方右侧车行道或路面狭窄情况，遇有来车应减速避让。

question_en: What does this road marking mean?
question_zh: 这个路面标记是何含义？
options_en: A. Minimum speed limit of 100 km/h | B. Average speed of 100 km/h | C. End of the 100 km/h speed limit | D. Maximum speed limit of 100 km/h
options_zh: A. 最低限速为100公里/小时 | B. 平均速度为100公里/小时 | C. 解除100公里/小时限速 | D. 最高限速为100公里/小时
why_en: Check the number's color: yellow indicates a maximum speed limit, white indicates a minimum.
explanation_zh: 黄色是最高速度限制，不能超过规定的时速。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. One-way street to the left | B. One-way street to the right | C. One-way street straight ahead | D. Yield when turning left
options_zh: A. 向左单行路 | B. 向右单行路 | C. 直行单行路 | D. 左转让行
why_en: A rectangular blue sign is a one-way street sign; the arrow shows the one-way direction, here to the left.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示该道路为单向行驶，已进入车辆应依标志指示方向行车，图中为向左。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Expressway public phone | B. Expressway police-report phone | C. Expressway emergency phone | D. Expressway rescue phone
options_zh: A. 高速公路公用电话 | B. 高速公路报警电话 | C. 高速公路紧急电话 | D. 高速公路救援电话
why_en: Green signs represent expressways; a plain emergency phone sign has no text, while a rescue phone sign shows text plus a number.
explanation_zh: 一个电话加上救援二字，此标志表示高速公路救援电话。另外，救援电话1212请牢记。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Place and distance advance notice | B. Crossroads advance notice | C. Lane information advance notice | D. Road fork advance notice
options_zh: A. 地点和距离预告 | B. 十字交叉路口预告 | C. 分道信息预告 | D. 道路分岔处预告
why_en: Blue is an informational sign notifying drivers of the crossroads intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志为十字交叉路口预告，路很明显的组成一个“十”字。

question_en: [Image] What are the two white dashed lines circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内两条白色虚线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Small-vehicle turning line | B. U-turn guide line | C. Left-turn waiting-area line | D. Intersection stop line
options_zh: A. 小型车转弯线 | B. 掉头引导线 | C. 左弯待转区线 | D. 交叉路停车线
why_en: When the through-traffic light is green, left-turning vehicles may enter the left-turn waiting area; not when both signals are red.
explanation_zh: 此标线为左弯待转区线。直行灯变绿后，要左转的可以行驶进白色虚线内，等灯变成左转时就可以通行了。当直行、左转弯信号灯都是红灯时，车辆是不可以进入左转弯转区的。

question_en: What does this yellow filled road marking mean?
question_zh: 路面上的黄色填充标线是何含义？
options_en: A. Approaching a moving obstacle marking | B. Moving away from a narrow road marking | C. Approaching an obstacle marking | D. Approaching a narrow road marking
options_zh: A. 接近移动障碍物标线 | B. 远离狭窄路面标线 | C. 接近障碍物标线 | D. 接近狭窄路面标线
why_en: This marking warns drivers of an obstacle ahead; proceed with caution.
explanation_zh: 双黄线就是警告注意越界，“打叉的物体”就是不可移动障碍物。

question_en: What does this guide arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates going straight or changing to the left lane | B. Indicates going straight or turning left | C. Indicates going straight or making a U-turn | D. Indicates turning left or making a U-turn
options_zh: A. 指示前方可直行或向左变道 | B. 指示前方可直行或左转 | C. 指示前方可直行或掉头 | D. 指示前方可左转或掉头
why_en: The arrow combines a left-turn and U-turn shape, indicating both maneuvers are allowed ahead.
explanation_zh: 位于此车道的车辆掉头或左转均可。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Caution, interactive road | B. Caution, divided (separated) road | C. At-grade intersection | D. Roundabout (at-grade circular intersection)
options_zh: A. 注意交互式道路 | B. 注意分离式道路 | C. 平面交叉路口 | D. 环行平面交叉
why_en: Two arrows, one left and one right, split down the middle, mean caution for a divided roadway.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示注意分离式道路。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方平面交叉的被交道路是分离式道路。

question_en: [Image] What is the triangular filled area circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内三角填充区域是什么标线？
options_en: A. Grid (network) markings | B. Stop line | C. Deceleration line | D. Channelizing (diversion) line
options_zh: A. 网状线 | B. 停车线 | C. 减速线 | D. 导流线
why_en: This channelizing line is usually placed at complex intersections, interchange ramps, or other special locations.
explanation_zh: 导流线的主要形式为一个或几个根据路口地形设置的白色V形线或斜纹线区域，表示车辆必须按照规定路线行驶，不得压线或越线行驶。

question_en: Which category of sign is this?
question_zh: 这属于哪一种标志？
options_en: A. Work-zone sign | B. Notice sign | C. Expressway sign | D. Tourist area sign
options_zh: A. 作业区标志 | B. 告示标志 | C. 高速公路标志 | D. 旅游区标志
why_en: Tourist area signs are usually placed along the road sections leading to scenic areas.
explanation_zh: 旅游区标志指示旅游区的距离、方向以及该旅游区的一些旅游项目。题中从左至右依次为旅游区方向标志，旅游区距离标志，索道。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Directional lane split | B. Right-turn lane | C. U-turn lane | D. Left-turn lane
options_zh: A. 分向车道 | B. 右转车道 | C. 掉头车道 | D. 左转车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only turn left.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志为左转车道。图中向左，表示只准一切车辆向左转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Low-lying (dip in) road surface | B. Hump bridge | C. Uneven road surface | D. Raised road surface
options_zh: A. 路面低洼 | B. 驼峰桥 | C. 路面不平 | D. 路面高突
why_en: Memory aid: two bumps mean uneven, a dip down means low-lying, a bump up means raised.
explanation_zh: 凹凸有致，路面不平标志。一个坡是高突，一个坑是低洼，一个凸中间有空间是驼峰桥，两个凸肯定是不平。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Construction zone | B. Heavy traffic section | C. Slow down | D. Congested section
options_zh: A. 施工路段 | B. 车多路段 | C. 慢行 | D. 拥堵路段
why_en: The character for 'slow' instructs drivers to reduce speed.
explanation_zh: 黄色警告标志已经写明了“慢”，表示慢行。用以提醒车辆驾驶人减速慢行。此标志设在前方需要减速慢行的路段以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No U-turn at intersection | B. No changing to left or right lane | C. No going straight | D. No turning left or right
options_zh: A. 禁止在路口掉头 | B. 禁止向左向右变道 | C. 禁止车辆直行 | D. 禁止向左向右转弯
why_en: A red circle is a prohibition sign meaning all vehicles are forbidden to turn either left or right.
explanation_zh: 红圈禁令，箭头指示左转和右转，合起来就是禁止向左向右转弯，禁止一切车辆向左向右转弯。

question_en: Which of the following signs means all vehicles and pedestrians are prohibited from passing?
question_zh: 以下交通标志中，表示禁止一切车辆和行人通行的是？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: A red cross means no stopping, a blank circle means no traffic at all as in figure 1, a white bar means no driving.
explanation_zh: 图1表示禁止通行；图2表示禁止驶入；图3表示禁止机动车驶入；图4表示禁止直行。

question_en: What traffic sign is this?
question_zh: 这是什么交通标志？
options_en: A. Slippery road section | B. Sharp bend | C. Reverse curve | D. Series of bends
options_zh: A. 易滑路段 | B. 急转弯路 | C. 反向弯路 | D. 连续弯路
why_en: Memory aid: one bend is sharp, two opposite bends form a reverse curve, three or more form a series of bends.
explanation_zh: 如上图所示，是连续弯路。可以和斜着的“N”反向弯路区分记忆。连续弯路弯道更多。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of expressway toll station | B. Advance notice of expressway service area | C. Advance notice of expressway runaway ramp | D. Advance notice of expressway bus station
options_zh: A. 高速公路收费站预告 | B. 高速公路服务区预告 | C. 高速公路避险处预告 | D. 高速公路客车站预告
why_en: A knife-and-fork icon marks a service area, a teacup icon marks a rest stop, and a bare 'P' marks a parking lot.
explanation_zh: 停车场、加油站、维修厂以及用餐场所，此标志列出各种服务的图片，因此本题为高速公路服务区预告。

question_en: When a driver sees this sign, why must they slow down?
question_zh: 当驾驶员看到以下标志时，需减速慢行，是因为什么？
options_en: A. The carriageway or road surface narrows ahead | B. There is a bend ahead | C. Traffic volume is heavy ahead | D. There is a narrow bridge ahead
options_zh: A. 前方车行道或路面变窄 | B. 前方有弯道 | C. 前方车流量较大 | D. 前方有窄桥
why_en: Yellow is a warning sign alerting drivers that the carriageway narrows on the right ahead.
explanation_zh: 图中是警告标志，警告车辆驾驶人注意前方车行道或路面变窄。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Park on the right side of the road | B. Right turn only | C. Downhill section on the right | D. Keep to the right side of the road
options_zh: A. 靠道路右侧停车 | B. 只准向右转弯 | C. 右侧是下坡路段 | D. 靠右侧道路行驶
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles must keep to the right side of the road.
explanation_zh: 靠右侧道路行驶：表示只准一切车辆靠右侧道路行驶。此标志设在车辆必须靠右侧行驶的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Intersection | B. Caution, traffic signal ahead | C. Caution, pedestrians | D. Pedestrian crossing signal
options_zh: A. 交叉路口 | B. 注意信号灯 | C. 注意行人 | D. 人行横道灯
why_en: The yellow sign shows a traffic light icon, indicating a signal-controlled intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 注意信号灯：用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方路段设有信号灯，应依信号灯指示行车。避免出现事故。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Landslide section | B. Construction zone | C. Factory ahead | D. Road blockage
options_zh: A. 塌方路段 | B. 施工路段 | C. 前方工厂 | D. 道路堵塞
why_en: When passing through a construction zone, drive with extra caution.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示施工路段，用以告示前方道路施工，车辆应减速慢行或绕道行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. End of no-borrowing-lane restriction | B. End of no-lane-change restriction | C. Lane change permitted | D. End of no-overtaking restriction
options_zh: A. 解除禁止借道 | B. 解除禁止变道 | C. 准许变道行驶 | D. 解除禁止超车
why_en: A red circle is a prohibition sign; black-and-white cancels a prohibition, here lifting the no-overtaking ban.
explanation_zh: 解除禁止超车：表示禁止超车路段结束。此标志设在禁止超车的终点。红色是禁止超车，黑色是解除禁止超车。

question_en: [Image] What is the white semicircular marking circled in the image?
question_zh: 图中圈内的白色半圆状标记是什么标线？
options_en: A. Deceleration line | B. Speed-confirmation line | C. Distance-confirmation line | D. Intersection deceleration line
options_zh: A. 减速行驶线 | B. 车速确认线 | C. 车距确认线 | D. 路口减速线
why_en: Look closely: the upper part of the image is labeled distance confirmation.
explanation_zh: 车距确认线，因为此处路面为凸起状态，车轮压过此处会发出尖锐的声音，并有震动，提醒驾驶员注意横向车距，与路肩保持安全的行车距离。

question_en: What does this yellow dashed line on the curb mean?
question_zh: 路缘石上的黄色虚线是何含义？
options_en: A. No temporary stopping | B. No boarding or alighting | C. No long-term parking | D. No loading or unloading
options_zh: A. 禁止临时停车 | B. 禁止上下人员 | C. 禁止长时停车 | D. 禁止装卸货物
why_en: A yellow dashed curb line means no long-term parking though temporary stopping is allowed; a solid line means no stopping at all.
explanation_zh: 路边的黄色虚线表示禁止长时停车，实线禁止停车。

question_en: What signal is this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Pull-over signal | B. Slow-down signal | C. Stop signal | D. Right-turn signal
options_zh: A. 靠边停车信号 | B. 减速慢行信号 | C. 停止信号 | D. 右转弯信号
why_en: Memory aid: left arm extended, right arm swinging indicates a right-turn signal.
explanation_zh: 交警面向哪个方向就是在指挥哪个方向的车辆，此图交警右手在摆动，交警面向方向的车辆右转弯。

question_en: What is this white dashed line in the middle of the road?
question_zh: 路中白色虚线是什么标线？
options_en: A. Center line prohibiting crossing into oncoming lanes | B. Center line restricting crossing into oncoming lanes | C. Crossable same-direction lane center line | D. One-way lane divider center line
options_zh: A. 禁止跨越对向车道中心线 | B. 限制跨越对向车道中心线 | C. 可跨越同向车道中心线 | D. 单向行驶车道分界中心线
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, solid lines may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction lanes, yellow dashed lines separate opposing traffic.
explanation_zh: 白色表示同向两车道之间的标线，虚线可跨越超车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. National highway number | B. Provincial highway number | C. County road number | D. Township road number
options_zh: A. 国道编号 | B. 省道编号 | C. 县道编号 | D. 乡道编号
why_en: Red background with white 'G' is a national highway; yellow with black 'S' is provincial; white with black 'X' is county; 'Y' is township.
explanation_zh: 此标志为乡道编号。乡道标志白底黑字Y开头，国道标志红底白字G开头，省道标志黄底黑字S开头，县道标志X开头。

question_en: Which sign means priority road?
question_zh: 以下哪个标志，表示干路先行？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: A thick arrow crossed by a bar is the priority road sign, shown in figure 4.
explanation_zh: 图1表示单行路（直行）；图2表示直行；图3表示直行车道；图4表示优先通行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Dike (embankment) road | B. Cliffside road | C. Slippery road | D. Road alongside water
options_zh: A. 堤坝路 | B. 临崖路 | C. 易滑路 | D. 傍水路
why_en: A yellow sign showing an embankment with water is the dike road warning sign.
explanation_zh: 左边是堤坝右边是水，堤坝路标志，提醒驾驶人注意安全行车。用来提醒车辆驾驶人小心驾驶，设在沿水库、湖泊、河流等堤坝道路以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Combined straight and left-turn lane | B. Combined straight and U-turn lane | C. Straight and right-turn lane | D. Directional lane split
options_zh: A. 直行和左转合用车道 | B. 直行和掉头合用车道 | C. 直行和右转车道 | D. 分向行驶车道
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning vehicles in this lane may only go straight or turn left.
explanation_zh: 有两条虚线的是车道，此标志是直行和左转合用车道，表示只准一切车辆直行和向左转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of expressway end | B. Advance notice of expressway entrance | C. Advance notice of expressway start | D. Advance notice of expressway exit
options_zh: A. 高速公路终点预告 | B. 高速公路入口预告 | C. 高速公路起点预告 | D. 高速公路出口预告
why_en: Green signs represent expressways; this one shows the expressway entrance is 2 kilometers ahead.
explanation_zh: 绿底的是高速公路指路标志，明显的“入口”二字，此标志为高速公路入口预告。

question_en: What lighting should be used when driving on this sharply curved road?
question_zh: 在这种急弯道路上行车，应该使用什么灯光？
options_en: A. Low beams | B. High beams | C. Alternate between high and low beams | D. Hazard warning flashers
options_zh: A. 近光灯 | B. 远光灯 | C. 交替使用远近光灯 | D. 危险报警闪光灯
why_en: At night on a sharp bend, sight distance is limited, so alternating high and low beams warns oncoming traffic of your presence.
explanation_zh: 根据《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十九条，机动车在夜间通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道或者没有交通信号灯控制的路口时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。机动车驶近急弯、坡道顶端等影响安全视距的路段以及超车或者遇有紧急情况时，应当减速慢行，并鸣喇叭示意。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Straight-ahead lane | B. One-way street | C. Turn left | D. No going straight
options_zh: A. 直行车道 | B. 单行路 | C. 向左转弯 | D. 禁止直行
why_en: This sign means all vehicles may only turn left.
explanation_zh: 蓝色-指示，向左转弯：表示只准一切车辆向左转弯。此标志设在车辆必须向左转弯的路口以前适当位置。

question_en: What does this white rectangular marked-off area mean?
question_zh: 这种白色矩形标线框含义是什么？
options_en: A. Long-term parking space | B. Time-limited parking space | C. Dedicated parking space | D. Free parking space
options_zh: A. 长时停车位 | B. 限时停车位 | C. 专用停车位 | D. 免费停车位
why_en: A time-limited parking space allows vehicles to park only within a specified time window.
explanation_zh: 限时停车位，有虚线、有时间，很容易和其他的区分记忆。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of next expressway exit | B. Advance notice of expressway exit on the right | C. Advance notice of expressway destination | D. Advance notice of expressway exit on the left
options_zh: A. 高速公路下一出口预告 | B. 高速公路右侧出口预告 | C. 高速公路目的地预告 | D. 高速公路左侧出口预告
why_en: This sign informs drivers which destinations can be reached via the exit on the right.
explanation_zh: 高速公路右侧出口预告，告知驾驶人右侧出口可以到达的位置。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. T-junction | B. Y-junction | C. Crossroads (four-way intersection) | D. Roundabout
options_zh: A. T型交叉路口 | B. Y型交叉路口 | C. 十字交叉路口 | D. 环行交叉路口
why_en: A yellow sign showing a cross shape is the crossroads warning sign.
explanation_zh: 警告标志，十字交叉路口：除了基本形十字路口外，还有部分变异的十字路口，如：五路交叉路口、变形十字路口、变形五路交叉路口等。五路以上的路口均按十字路口对待。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Advance notice of roundabout | B. Advance notice of crossroads | C. Advance notice of interchange | D. Advance notice of Y-junction
options_zh: A. 环行交叉路口预告 | B. 十字交叉路口预告 | C. 互通立体交叉预告 | D. Y型交叉路口预告
why_en: Blue is an informational sign notifying drivers of the roundabout intersection ahead.
explanation_zh: 此标志为环行交叉路口预告。环行交叉路口有个缺口，互通式的并且全连的。

question_en: Which category of marking does a double solid yellow center line belong to?
question_zh: 路中心的双黄实线属于哪一类标线？
options_en: A. Mandatory marking | B. Auxiliary marking | C. Warning sign | D. Prohibition marking
options_zh: A. 指示标线 | B. 辅助标线 | C. 警告标志 | D. 禁止标线
why_en: Solid lines at the road center are always prohibition markings, forbidding vehicles to cross.
explanation_zh: 双黄线、单黄线、单实线均为禁止标线。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No entry | B. No passing (closed to traffic) | C. Slow down | D. Timed entry only
options_zh: A. 禁止驶入 | B. 禁止通行 | C. 减速行驶 | D. 限时进入
why_en: Inside a red circle: a red cross means no stopping, a blank circle means closed to all traffic, a white bar means no driving.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示禁止通行，禁止一切车辆和行人通行。

question_en: What does this guide arrow mean?
question_zh: 这个导向箭头是何含义？
options_en: A. Indicates turning right or making a U-turn | B. Indicates going straight or turning right | C. Indicates going straight or changing to the right lane | D. Indicates going straight or making a U-turn
options_zh: A. 指示向右转弯或掉头 | B. 指示直行或右转弯 | C. 指示直行或向右变道 | D. 指示直行或掉头
why_en: The arrow points both forward and to the right, indicating the vehicle may go straight or turn right.
explanation_zh: 此标线指示直行或右转弯。

question_en: What signal is this traffic police hand gesture?
question_zh: 这一组交通警察手势是什么信号？
options_en: A. Left-turn signal | B. Stop signal | C. Right-turn signal | D. Pull-over signal
options_zh: A. 左转弯信号 | B. 停止信号 | C. 右转弯信号 | D. 靠边停车信号
why_en: Memory aid: raising the left arm above shoulder height signals a stop.
explanation_zh: 左手高举过肩，举手朝向前方，无其他动作时是停止信号。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No small vehicles allowed | B. Motor vehicles (drive) | C. Small vehicles only | D. Small vehicles prohibited
options_zh: A. 禁止小型车行驶 | B. 机动车行驶 | C. 只准小型车行驶 | D. 不准小型车通行
why_en: Blue is a mandatory sign meaning this road is for motor vehicles only.
explanation_zh: 正脸是机动车，侧身是小型客车。此标志是机动车行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Tourist area category | B. Tourist area distance | C. Tourist area direction | D. Tourist area symbol
options_zh: A. 旅游区类别 | B. 旅游区距离 | C. 旅游区方向 | D. 旅游区符号
why_en: A brown sign showing the scenic area's name plus a directional arrow is a tourist area direction sign.
explanation_zh: 箭头指向右侧，此标志是旅游区方向。箭头指向水平方向才是旅游区标志。

question_en: You must not overtake when passing through a narrow road or narrow bridge.
question_zh: 通过窄路、窄桥时，不得超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking is prohibited on narrow roads and narrow bridges.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第四十三条，同车道行驶的机动车，后车应当与前车保持足以采取紧急制动措施的安全距离。有下列情形之一的，不得超车：（一）前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车的；（二）与对面来车有会车可能的；（三）前车为执行紧急任务的警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车的；（四）行经铁路道口、交叉路口、窄桥、弯道、陡坡、隧道、人行横道、市区交通流量大的路段等没有超车条件的。

question_en: At night, if an oncoming vehicle does not switch off its high beams, you may flash your lights to alert it while slowing down, moving right, or stopping.
question_zh: 夜间会车时，若对方车辆不关闭远光灯，可变换灯光提示对向车辆，同时减速靠右侧行驶或停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams must not be used when meeting oncoming traffic at night.
explanation_zh: 夜间安全驾驶知识中第三条就有：“夜间会车应当在距对方来车150米以外改用近光灯，若对方车辆不关闭远光灯，可连续变换灯光提示对向车辆。当遇对面来车仍不关闭远光灯时，应及时减速靠右侧行驶或停车让行。”

question_en: When driving uphill in mountainous terrain, downshift promptly, accurately, and quickly to avoid lugging the engine, which causes insufficient power.
question_zh: 车辆在山区上坡路驾驶，减挡要及时、准确、迅速，避免拖挡行驶导致发动机动力不足。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Before driving uphill, observe the road condition and slope length, then shift to a lower gear.
explanation_zh: 上坡前要减挡，避免因动力不足脱挡或者熄火。

question_en: When crossing a railway crossing, use a low gear to pass safely and do not shift gears midway, to avoid stalling the engine.
question_zh: 车辆通过铁路道口时，应用低速挡安全通过，中途不得换挡，以避免发动机熄火。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Shifting gears midway can easily cause the engine to stall.
explanation_zh: 通过铁路道口中途换挡容易熄火，如果火车开过来就危险了。

question_en: When driving a motor vehicle on an expressway, if visibility is less than 200 meters, the speed must not exceed 60 km/h.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，能见度小于200米时，车速不得超过每小时60公里。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Under the tiered expressway low-visibility rules, when visibility drops below 200 meters the speed limit is 60 km/h.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第八十一条：机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件时，应当遵守下列规定：能见度小于200米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯和前后位灯，车速不得超过每小时60公里，与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离。

question_en: [Image] What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. 50 meters to an unguarded railway crossing | B. 50 meters to a guarded railway crossing | C. 100 meters to an unguarded railway crossing | D. 100 meters to a guarded railway crossing
options_zh: A. 距无人看守铁路道口50米 | B. 距有人看守铁路道口50米 | C. 距无人看守铁路道口100米 | D. 距有人看守铁路道口100米
why_en: A train icon means the crossing is unguarded, and each diagonal slash represents 50 meters, so two slashes equal 100 meters.
explanation_zh: 黄色警告标志中栅栏表示有人看守，只有火车表示无人看守。警告标志下面的长方形，一条红杠杠代表50米，两条100米...依此类推。此标志为距无人看守铁路道口100米。

question_en: [Image] What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Oncoming traffic goes first | B. Stop and yield | C. One-way road | D. This direction has priority when meeting oncoming traffic
options_zh: A. 对向先行 | B. 停车让行 | C. 单行路 | D. 会车先行
why_en: One red and one white arrow means this direction has priority; one black and one red arrow means yield to oncoming traffic.
explanation_zh: 会车先行，表示双向车辆在会车时享有优先通行权利。谁宽谁先行，你的箭头比他大就会车先行，你的比他小就是会车让行。

question_en: When encountering diversion traffic control on an expressway, you may stay on the expressway and pull over to wait for the control to end before continuing.
question_zh: 在高速公路上遇分流交通管制时，可不驶出高速公路，就地靠边停靠等待管制结束后继续前行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Stopping on an expressway without cause is not permitted.
explanation_zh: 高速公路的分流交通管制就是指在高速公路上遇到紧急情况后，将后续来车在匝道口进行管制通行，避免再次生事故和交通拥堵，亦或是有紧急交通勤务警卫，需要提前封闭道路，故提前分流车辆。

question_en: [Image] What do the white markings on the road surface mean?
question_zh: 路面上的白色标线是何含义？
options_en: A. Transverse deceleration marking | B. Road construction warning marking | C. Longitudinal deceleration marking | D. Lane reduction warning marking
options_zh: A. 车行道横向减速标线 | B. 道路施工提示标线 | C. 车行道纵向减速标线 | D. 车道变少提示标线
why_en: These markings are meant to remind drivers to slow down.
explanation_zh: 车行道横向减速标线，用在弯路、坡路、隧道洞口前、长下坡路段及其他需要减速的车道前或道路中间的机动车行车道内。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle A has the right of way.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车具有优先通过权。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight-through traffic, and turns yield to straight-through traffic.
explanation_zh: 三个先行原则：转弯的机动车让直行的车辆先行；右方道路来车先行；右转弯车让左转弯车先行。如图所示，B车是左转弯，A车是右转弯，B车先行。

question_en: While reversing, drive slowly, watch both sides and the rear of the vehicle, and be ready to stop at any time.
question_zh: 倒车过程中要缓慢行驶，注意观察车辆两侧和后方的情况，随时做好停车准备。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving puts safety first.
explanation_zh: 相同车道上前面是没车，车都是从后面来的。另外题目中并没有说不要看前面，只是说注意观察两侧和后方的情况。

question_en: When meeting oncoming traffic on a road with a marked center line, maintain a safe speed and do not cross the line.
question_zh: 在划有道路中心线的道路上会车时，应做到保持安全车速、不越线行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When meeting oncoming vehicles, keep a safe distance and slow down.
explanation_zh: 会车时要放慢车速，临近交会时条件不良，更应控制车速，不能盲目交会，必要时应该先停车，以达到两车顺利交会的目的。

question_en: Resting your left arm on the door window for long periods, or gripping the gearshift lever with your right hand for long periods, while driving is a bad driving habit.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆时，长时间左臂搭在车门窗上，或者长时间右手抓住变速器操纵杆，是一种驾驶陋习。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Driving safety should be prioritized over such careless habits.
explanation_zh: 这是一种陋习，这样久了，会导致血脉不通，手臂麻木，容易出事。

question_en: [Image] Making or answering phone calls while driving a motor vehicle can easily lead to traffic accidents.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车接打电话容易导致发生交通事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Using a phone while driving is illegal and carries a 2-point penalty.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车接打电话会分散驾驶员的注意力，容易导致发生交通事故。

question_en: [Image] When overtaking a vehicle on your right, you should pass as quickly as possible to minimize the time spent driving alongside it.
question_zh: 如图所示，当您超越右侧车辆时，应该尽快超越，减少并行时间。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: You must not drive alongside another vehicle for a long time while overtaking.
explanation_zh: 超车时，应尽快超越，减少并行时间，驶出安全距离后驶回原车道。

question_en: When leaving an expressway, a vehicle should slow down via the deceleration lane before entering the ramp.
question_zh: 车辆驶离高速公路时，应当经减速车道减速后进入匝道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The exit sequence is: normal lane, deceleration lane, ramp, expressway exit.
explanation_zh: 匝道：立交桥和高架路上下两条道路相连接的路段，也指高速公路与邻近的辅路相连接的路段。高架路的匝道，进口路和出口路是分开的，只能顺行，不准掉头，车辆错过了下匝道，就不能从上匝道下路，只能从下一个下匝道下路。立交桥的匝道，也是按照设定的标志行驶，谁也不能各行其是高速公路出口的匝道一般限速每小时60公里以下，弯道限速每小时40公里以下。而在高速公路上行驶时的车速远高于这两个数字，因此应当先减速再进入匝道。

question_en: When a driver realizes a tire has blown out while driving, they should keep control of the steering and apply emergency braking to force the vehicle to stop quickly.
question_zh: 行车中当驾驶人意识到车辆爆胎时，应在控制住方向的情况下采取紧急制动，迫使车辆迅速停住。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Instead, grip the wheel firmly, keep going straight, use engine braking to slow gradually, then brake gently to a stop at the roadside.
explanation_zh: 车辆爆胎后，应先控制方向，保持直线行驶，然后利用发动机制动，缓慢减速停车。不能采取紧急制动。

question_en: In dense fog with low visibility, turning on the high beams will improve visibility.
question_zh: 浓雾天气能见度低，开启远光灯会提高能见度。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In dense fog, drivers should use fog lights and hazard warning flashers, not high beams.
explanation_zh: 不能开启远光灯，因浓雾会反射灯光。雾天行车应开启雾灯和危险报警闪光灯，不是远光。

question_en: When changing lanes, turn on the turn signal and quickly move into the adjacent lane.
question_zh: 变更车道时，应开启转向灯，迅速驶入侧方车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.
explanation_zh: 注意迅速两字，驶入前先观察后慢慢变道。变更车道除了提前开启转向灯，还应观察周边交通情况，在保证安全的情况下驶入要变更的车道。

question_en: If a traffic violation occurs while yielding to a special-purpose vehicle and is caught by a traffic camera, you may appeal to the traffic management department for reconsideration.
question_zh: 因避让特种车辆而发生违法行为，被电子警察拍到时，可向交管部门复议。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Violations that occur while yielding to special-purpose vehicles can be appealed for reconsideration.
explanation_zh: 避让特种车辆而发生违法行为可向交管部门复议，不用担心做好事还受罚了。

question_en: When driving, if a person with a disability affects passage, you should proactively slow down and yield.
question_zh: 行车中遇残疾人影响通行时，应主动减速礼让。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in every situation.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。看到关于避让题目，都遵循避让礼让的原则。

question_en: Emergency braking on icy or snowy roads easily causes skidding, so drive slowly and use engine braking to decelerate.
question_zh: 车辆在冰雪路面紧急制动易产生侧滑，应低速行驶，可利用发动机制动进行减速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Engine braking means slowing down by downshifting to a lower gear.
explanation_zh: 冰雪路面很滑，不能紧急制动，应降低车速，充分利用发动机制动。发动机制动：行车（挂上排档，不是空档）中，油门一收，便产生发动机制动！原理：主要靠（停止供油）发动机的压缩力而制止车辆的前进。行车制动：通过刹车踏板，把人体的力量，由总泵至分泵加上助力器的作用，迫使刹车片与刹车盘或刹车毂磨擦至车辆停止前进。

question_en: [Image] What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Border defense inspection | B. No entry | C. Customs inspection | D. Stop for inspection
options_zh: A. 边防检查 | B. 禁止通行 | C. 海关检查 | D. 停车检查
why_en: A black bar inside a red circle plus the word 'inspection' means you must stop for an inspection.
explanation_zh: 停车检查：表示机动车必须停车接受检查。此标志设在关卡将近处，以便要求车辆接受检查或缴费等手续。标志中可加注说明检查事项。

question_en: Vehicles must not reverse on an expressway ramp.
question_zh: 车辆不得在高速公路匝道上倒车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Reversing is prohibited on expressways.
explanation_zh: 规定：驶入确定匝道后，迅速提高车速，但不得超过规定速度，在匝道上，不准超车、掉头、停车、和倒车。

question_en: When driving in fog, if you hear an oncoming vehicle sound its horn, you should also sound your horn in response to alert it.
question_zh: 雾天行车，听到对方鸣喇叭，也应该鸣喇叭回应，以提示对方车辆。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In fog, sounding the horn is a way for vehicles to alert each other.
explanation_zh: 雾天视线不佳，无法观察周围车况，要充分利用喇叭提示对方。

question_en: When driving on mountain roads, to save fuel, you may coast in neutral downhill and use the foot brake to control speed.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在山路行驶时，为了减少油耗，下坡时可以空挡滑行，并使用行车制动器控制速度。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Coasting in neutral downhill is not allowed.
explanation_zh: 下坡时用空档滑行容易烧坏变速器，非常危险，属于交通陋习。

question_en: A qualified driver is shown not only by skilled technique, but more importantly by good driving habits and moral character.
question_zh: 一个合格的驾驶人，不仅表现在技术的娴熟上，更重要的是应该具有良好的驾驶行为习惯和道德修养。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: An excellent driver combines strong skill with high ethical standards.
explanation_zh: 娴熟的技术固然重要，但没有良好的驾驶习惯和道德修养，同样会破坏正常的交通秩序。

question_en: When a driver realizes a tire has blown out, they should keep control of the steering, gently press the brake pedal to slow the vehicle gradually, and bring it smoothly to a stop at the roadside.
question_zh: 行车中当驾驶人意识到爆胎时，应在控制住方向的情况下，轻踏制动踏板，使车辆缓慢减速，逐渐平稳地停靠于路边。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Avoid emergency braking or sharp steering, as these can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 爆胎和意识到爆胎时，首先要做的就是控制住方向，然后缓慢减速，平稳停车。

question_en: The three principles of cautious driving are concentration, careful observation, and early prevention.
question_zh: 谨慎驾驶的三原则是集中注意力、仔细观察和提前预防。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Remember the three principles of cautious driving.
explanation_zh: 谨慎驾驶的三原则是集中注意力、仔细观察和提前预防。一定要牢记哦。

question_en: When driving down a long slope, downshift to make full use of engine braking.
question_zh: 车辆下长坡时要减挡行驶，以充分利用发动机的制动作用。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Prolonged use of the brakes on a long downhill raises brake pad temperature and reduces braking effectiveness.
explanation_zh: 意思是，下坡要低挡低速行驶，把车速放在较低的范围内，称之为减挡行驶。变速箱高档位高速持续运转中，迅速降低变速箱的档位转速，使变速箱的低档位转速对车辆本身的惯性高速产生抑制，从而产生短时间内的所谓发动机制动(变速箱制动)。

question_en: [Image] What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Distance to tunnel exit | B. Distance to tunnel entrance | C. Following distance inside the tunnel | D. Total tunnel length
options_zh: A. 隧道出口距离 | B. 隧道入口距离 | C. 隧道跟车距离 | D. 隧道总长度
why_en: The blue sign is an informational sign showing how far ahead the tunnel exit is.
explanation_zh: 隧道出口距离标志，设在长度超过3000米的特长隧道内，从距离隧道出口2000米处开始每500米设置一块，直至隧道出口。

question_en: If an oncoming vehicle suddenly forces an overtake and occupies your lane, you may refuse to yield and force it to give way instead.
question_zh: 行车中突遇对向车辆强行超车，占据自己车道时，可不予避让，迫使对方让路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Even if the other driver acts uncivilly, you should not respond in kind.
explanation_zh: 行车要始终记得安全文明驾驶，对方要超车，那就让让。

question_en: When driving at night, a driver's sight distance shortens, affecting observation, and having to concentrate intensely also makes fatigue more likely.
question_zh: 夜间行车，驾驶人视距变短，影响观察，同时注意力高度集中，易产生疲劳。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Extra caution is needed when driving at night.
explanation_zh: 夜间光线不好，视距变短。为了观察路况，注意力需高度集中，容易产生疲劳。

question_en: [Image] It is wrong to hang or place items on the front windshield that obstruct the driver's view while driving.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车时，前风窗玻璃处悬挂放置干扰视线的物品是错误的。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Blocking the view impairs safe driving.
explanation_zh: 悬挂物品干扰开车视线，增大了行车危险，容易引发交通事故。

question_en: When approaching a sharp bend, slow down and keep to the right to avoid colliding with an oncoming vehicle that crosses the centerline.
question_zh: 车辆行至急转弯处时，应减速并靠右侧行驶，防止与越过弯道中心线的对方车辆相撞。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When meeting oncoming traffic at a sharp bend, slow down and stay to the right.
explanation_zh: 通过急弯靠右行驶，给对向来车留出足够的行车空间，慢行能在遇到突发状况时有足够的反应时间。

question_en: [Image] What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Two-way traffic | B. Divided road | C. Tidal (reversible) lane | D. Slow down and yield
options_zh: A. 双向交通 | B. 分离式道路 | C. 潮汐车道 | D. 减速让行
why_en: A yellow warning sign with up-and-down arrows is the two-way traffic warning sign.
explanation_zh: 双向箭头表示双向交通，提醒驾驶人注意对向来车。设在由双向分离行驶，因某种原因出现临时性或永久性的不分离双向行驶的路段，或单向行驶进入双向行驶的路段以前适当位置。

question_en: Braking on muddy roads can easily cause the wheels to skid or the rear to swing out, leading to traffic accidents.
question_zh: 在泥泞路上制动时，车轮易发生侧滑或甩尾，导致交通事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Muddy road surfaces have low traction, so drive through them cautiously.
explanation_zh: 泥泞道路软滑，摩擦系数低，车轮易发生侧滑或甩尾，引发交通事故。

question_en: When overtaking on the road, keep as much lateral distance as possible, and if necessary you may cross a solid line to overtake.
question_zh: 在道路上超车时，应尽量加大横向距离，必要时可越实线超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.
explanation_zh: 实线不能跨越，本题描述错误。

question_en: [Image] As shown, if a vehicle on the right changes lanes in this situation, slow down, keep a safe gap, and be ready to yield.
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种情况下遇右侧车辆变更车道，应减速保持安全间距，注意避让。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving means giving way courteously.
explanation_zh: 安全行车，礼貌让行。

question_en: [Image] As shown, in a traffic accident at this roundabout intersection, vehicle A should bear full responsibility.
question_zh: 如图所示，在环岛交叉路口发生的交通事故中，应由A车负全部责任。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A vehicle entering a roundabout must not interfere with vehicles already circulating inside it.
explanation_zh: 按照规定，驶入环岛的车辆不能影响环岛内车辆的正常通行。因此A车应让B车先行，而此时事故发生，A车应负全责。

question_en: [Image] As shown, in this situation you may make a U-turn as long as there is no traffic behind or oncoming.
question_zh: 如图所示，这种情况下只要后方、对向无来车，可以掉头。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，地面是实线，不允许跨越压线行驶，当然不允许掉头。

question_en: If a driver notices a tire is losing air and moves the vehicle off the main lane, they should avoid emergency braking to prevent a rollover or a rear-end collision from a following vehicle braking too late.
question_zh: 驾驶人发现轮胎漏气，将车辆驶离主车道时，不要采用紧急制动，以免造成翻车或后车采取制动不及时导致追尾事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: To avoid emergency braking, press the brake pedal gently to slow down gradually while leaving the main lane.
explanation_zh: 轮胎漏气时不能采取紧急制动，容易造成翻车。应控制住方向，慢慢停车。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle A wants to make a U-turn ahead, so it may change lanes here into the left lane to prepare for the turn.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车要在前方掉头行驶，可以在此处变换车道，进入左侧车道准备掉头。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，前方是实线区，不可以变换车道。

question_en: After the green light comes on at an intersection, if a non-motor vehicle cuts in and drives ahead, the vehicle need not yield.
question_zh: 车辆在交叉路口绿灯亮后，遇非机动车抢道行驶时，可以不让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must always give way to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，文明行车。

question_en: After a tire blowout, before regaining control of the vehicle's speed, the driver should not risk using the foot brake to stop, to avoid the vehicle swinging sideways and creating a greater hazard.
question_zh: 车辆发生爆胎后，驾驶人在尚未控制住车速前，不要冒险使用行车制动器停车，以避免车辆横甩发生更大的险情。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: During a blowout, grip the wheel firmly, keep going straight, use engine braking to slow gradually, then brake gently to a stop.
explanation_zh: 行车制动=制动踏板=脚刹，爆胎后，驾驶人在尚未控制住车速的时候，是不能急踩刹车的，要不然会横甩或者翻车，甚至与后面来车追尾。正确的做法应该是紧握方向盘，控制方向，极力保持直线行驶，利用发动机制动，减档或抢档减速度，轻踏制动踏板缓慢减速，平稳靠边停车。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle B has the right of way.
question_zh: 如图所示，B车具有优先通过权。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight-through traffic, and turns yield to straight-through traffic.
explanation_zh: 右转让左转，转弯让直行。如图所示，A车直行而B车右转，明显是A车先行，B车避让。

question_en: When a motor vehicle is inside a roundabout and another vehicle forces its way in, it may refuse to yield as long as it has the right of way.
question_zh: 机动车在环形路口内行驶，遇有其他车辆强行驶入时，只要有优先权就可以不避让。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Even if the other driver acts uncivilly, you should not respond in kind.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，文明行车。能让就尽量让行。看到关于避让题目，都遵循避让礼让的原则。

question_en: When driving on an expressway with visibility below 200 meters, keep a distance of over 100 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，能见度小于200米时，与同车道前车应保持100米以上的距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Mnemonic for expressway low-visibility rules: 261, 145, 520 (exit).
explanation_zh: 能见度小于200米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯和前后位灯，车速不得超过每小时60公里，与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离；能见度小于100米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯、前后位灯和危险报警闪光灯，车速不得超过每小时40公里，与同车道前车保持50米以上的距离；能见度小于50米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯、前后位灯和危险报警闪光灯，车速不得超过每小时20公里，并从最近的出口尽快驶离高速公路。

question_en: At night, when passing through an area with no street lights or poor lighting, switch from low beams to high beams, but a following vehicle traveling the same direction must not use high beams.
question_zh: 夜间通过没有路灯或路灯照明不良时，应将近光灯转换为远光灯，但同向行驶的后车不得使用远光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: At night, following distances are short, so a following vehicle's high beams would blind the driver ahead.
explanation_zh: 通过没有路灯或路灯照明不良的路段（非路口）时可以开启远光灯，但是前方有车或行人时，为了不影响他人视线，应关闭远光，改用近光。

question_en: The Road Traffic Safety Law Implementing Regulations state that the maximum expressway speed must not exceed 120 km/h. Therefore, driving on an expressway is lawful as long as the speed does not exceed 120 km/h.
question_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》规定，高速公路上最高时速不得超过120公里。因此在高速公路上行驶只要时速不超过120公里就不违法。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The maximum expressway speed is 120 km/h, but the minimum speed must not be below 60 km/h.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》规定，高速公路最低速度60公里，最高速度120公里。题中只说了不超过120公里，没说不能低于60公里，所以描述错误。

question_en: Outside the designated hours for a dedicated lane, other vehicles may drive in that lane.
question_zh: 专用车道规定的专用使用时间之外，其他车辆可以进入专用车道行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: During the designated hours, only the specified vehicles may use the dedicated lane.
explanation_zh: 专用车道规定的专用使用时间是专供专用车辆行驶的，其他的时间，可供其他车辆行驶。

question_en: At night, a driver's ability to observe things is clearly worse than during the day, and sight distance is shorter.
question_zh: 夜间驾驶人对事物的观察能力明显比白天差，视距变短。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive slowly at night.
explanation_zh: 此题说的意思是，在白天开车的时候由于光线比较充足，所以观察事物的范围比较广，观察事物的视线距离相对也就比较大，而在晚上受到光线暗的局限，相对观察事物的距离也就受到局限，所以视距比较短，而并不是说人本身的观察有问题，所以此题是正确的!

question_en: When driving on an expressway and encountering dense fog that blocks visibility, you should immediately brake hard to stop.
question_zh: 行驶在高速公路上遇大雾视线受阻时，应当立即紧急制动停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Sudden emergency braking is not allowed on expressways.
explanation_zh: 大雾天气视线不佳，紧急制动容易发生追尾事故，要逐渐减速停车。

question_en: Vehicles may stop on an expressway ramp.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路匝道上可以停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Stopping is prohibited on expressways.
explanation_zh: 高速公路匝道禁止停车、掉头、倒车等行为。

question_en: When police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and engineering rescue vehicles are on emergency duty, delaying or obstructing them can lead to serious consequences, so other vehicles and pedestrians should proactively yield.
question_zh: 警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车执行紧急任务时，耽误或影响其通行可能会导致严重后果，所以其他车辆和行人应当主动让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Vehicles must proactively give way to special-purpose vehicles on emergency duty.
explanation_zh: 警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车执行紧急任务时，耽误或影响其通行可能会导致严重后果，所以其他车辆和行人应当主动让行。

question_en: Before pulling away, a driver should observe the traffic conditions around the vehicle and start moving only after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 车辆起步前，驾驶人应对车辆周围交通情况进行观察，确认安全时再开始起步。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving puts safety first.
explanation_zh: 观察周围是起步前准备工作。这道题里的话并没有错，观察周围只是起步前准备工作的一部分，并没有说是不用打转向灯的。

question_en: [Image] As shown, in this situation the motor vehicle must stop and yield.
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种情况下，驾驶机动车要停车让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in every situation.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，人行横道正有行人通行，要停车让行。

question_en: When a vehicle drives on an expressway at 100 km/h, keeping over 100 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane is a safe distance.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路以每小时100公里的速度行驶时，距同车道前车100米以上为安全距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Expressway rule: above 100 km/h keep over 100 m; below 100 km/h keep over 50 m.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第八十条：机动车在高速公路上行驶，车速超过每小时100公里时，应当与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离，车速低于每小时100公里时，与同车道前车距离可以适当缩短，但最小距离不得少于50米。

question_en: When turning, a vehicle should stay on the right side of the road and not encroach on the opposing lane, following the rule: wide arc for a left turn, tight arc for a right turn.
question_zh: 车辆转弯时应沿道路右侧行驶，不要侵占对方的车道，做到“左转转大弯，右转转小弯”。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The rule is: wide arc for left turns, tight arc for right turns.
explanation_zh: 左转转大弯，但当心身后非机动车。右转转小弯，当心对面右行驶和身后的车。

question_en: When driving uphill, observe the road conditions and slope length in advance, and downshift promptly to keep the vehicle powered enough.
question_zh: 车辆上坡行驶，要提前观察路况、坡道长度，及时减挡使车辆保持充足的动力。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Climbing in too high a gear can easily cause the engine to stall and the vehicle to roll back.
explanation_zh: 提前观察路况可以增加行车时的预见性，及时减档保持充足的动力才能顺利上坡。高挡属于快速挡，而低挡却用于起步或者作有重力的运动而使用，上坡本然就形成一种重力，需要足够的马力才可以行驶，所以需要将挡位降低才可以，如果使用高挡，很可能导致功率不够形成熄火，甚至溜车!

question_en: When changing lanes, you only need to turn on the turn signal before quickly steering into the target lane.
question_zh: 变更车道时只需开启转向灯，便可迅速转向驶入相应的行车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.
explanation_zh: 不仅要提前开启转向灯，还应观察周边情况，判断有无变更车道的条件，在保持安全距离的情况下，驶入要变更的车道。

question_en: If a driver observes no traffic approaching from behind, it is reasonable to change lanes without using the turn signal.
question_zh: 驾驶人在观察后方无来车的情况下，未开转向灯就变更车道也是合理的。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Any change in driving state must be signaled to alert other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，安全第一。要严格按照变道步骤来。

question_en: After yielding to let a special-purpose vehicle pass smoothly, a vehicle should return in an orderly way to its original lane and continue driving, and should not tailgate the special-purpose vehicle to avoid an accident.
question_zh: 避让特种车辆使其顺利通过后，车辆应有序回到原车道继续行驶，不要尾随特种车辆，以免发生交通事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Vehicles must yield to special-purpose vehicles on duty.
explanation_zh: 特种车辆本身车速较快，而且由于其特殊性，驾驶路线与常规车辆也不同。如果跟随特种车会十分危险，因此避让特种车后，要有序回到原车道继续行驶。

question_en: Overtaking is not allowed when crossing a railway crossing.
question_zh: 通过铁路道口时，不得超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking is prohibited at railway crossings.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第四十三条，同车道行驶的机动车，后车应当与前车保持足以采取紧急制动措施的安全距离。有下列情形之一的，不得超车：（一）前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车的；（二）与对面来车有会车可能的；（三）前车为执行紧急任务的警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车的；（四）行经铁路道口、交叉路口、窄桥、弯道、陡坡、隧道、人行横道、市区交通流量大的路段等没有超车条件的。

question_en: In complex weather such as wind, rain, snow, or fog, if the vehicle ahead is going slowly, turn on the headlights and sound the horn continuously to quickly overtake it.
question_zh: 风、雨、雪、雾等复杂气象条件，遇前车速度较低时，应开启前照灯，连续鸣喇叭迅速超越。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking must only be done when it is safe.
explanation_zh: 风、雨、雪、雾等复杂气象条件需减速行驶，不得超车。

question_en: A vehicle may make full use of coasting in neutral when driving downhill.
question_zh: 车辆在下坡行驶时，可充分利用空挡滑行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Coasting in neutral downhill is not allowed.
explanation_zh: 危险动作，下坡时，不准熄火或用空挡。如果下坡空档滑行，只靠刹车来控制车速，遇到连续下坡的时候可能会造成刹车负担过重，刹车片过热而失灵。

question_en: Before changing lanes, a driver should observe carefully in order to judge whether the conditions for a lane change are met.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车变更车道前应仔细观察，目的是判断有无变更车道的条件。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.
explanation_zh: 变更车道需提前开启转向灯，观察周围环境确认安全后再驶入相应的车道，不得妨碍其他车辆正常行驶。本题是强调仔细观察，没说不开转向灯。

question_en: When passing through an intersection at night with no traffic signal, you must not switch between high and low beams.
question_zh: 夜间通过无交通信号灯控制的交叉路口时，不得变换远、近光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drivers should flash between high and low beams to warn other traffic at unsignalized intersections at night.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第五十九条：机动车在夜间通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道或者没有交通信号灯控制的路口时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。

question_en: When driving on icy or snowy roads, you must reduce speed and increase the safety distance.
question_zh: 在冰雪路面上行车，必须降低车速、加大安全距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slow down and keep a safe distance when driving on icy or snowy roads.
explanation_zh: 冰雪路面很滑，减低车速、加大安全距离有利于安全行车。

question_en: When driving down a long slope, using inertia to coast can reduce fuel consumption and should be encouraged.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车下长坡时，利用惯性滑行可以减少燃油消耗，值得提倡。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Coasting in neutral using inertia is a bad driving habit.
explanation_zh: 利用惯性滑行虽然会减少燃油消耗，但此举是危险动作，下坡时，不准熄火或用空挡利用惯性滑行。如果下坡滑行，只靠刹车来控制车速，遇到连续下坡的时候可能会造成刹车负担过重，刹车片过热而失灵。正确的做法是：在下长坡道路行驶，挂入低速档利用发动机的牵阻作用可以减少制动器的负担和减少制动次数，防止制动过热引起制动力热衰减；在冰雪、泥泞的路面上行驶，应用发动机牵阻制动可以防止侧滑。

question_en: Before starting off at night, you should first turn on the low beams.
question_zh: 夜间起步前，应当先开启近光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When starting off at night, turn on the low beams first to observe the surroundings.
explanation_zh: 开启近光，能更好的观察周围环境，有利于安全行车。

question_en: While driving, if you notice a pedestrian suddenly crossing the road, you should quickly slow down and yield.
question_zh: 行车中，发现行人突然横过道路时，应迅速减速避让。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in every situation.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。碰到行人的一定避让，减速，甚至停车。

question_en: [Image] As shown, in this situation vehicle A may change lanes to the left.
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种情况下，A车可以向左变更车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The safety conditions are not met, so the lane change should be abandoned.
explanation_zh: 左边有车，不具备变更车道的条件，不能向左变更车道。

question_en: When changing lanes on an expressway, turn on the turn signal in advance, observe conditions, and merge into the target lane only after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 在高速公路变更车道时，应提前开启转向灯，观察情况，确认安全后，驶入需要变更的车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.
explanation_zh: 变更车道时需要提前开启转向灯提醒后车，然后观察周围交通环境，确认安全后再驶入要变更的车道。

question_en: Before merging into traffic flow from another road while driving, pay attention to vehicles to the side and rear.
question_zh: 行车中从其他道路汇入车流前，应注意观察侧后方车辆的动态。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving puts safety first.
explanation_zh: 行车中从其他道路线汇入车流前，应注意观察侧后方车辆的动态，后侧方是同向来车。

question_en: If you anticipate meeting an oncoming vehicle during an overtake, you should accelerate early to complete the overtake.
question_zh: 预计在超车过程中与对面来车有会车可能时，应提前加速超越。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If the conditions for overtaking are not met, the overtake should be abandoned decisively.
explanation_zh: 预计在超车过程中与对面来车有会车可能时，应当放弃超车。若加速超越，可能引起不必要的事故。

question_en: When a vehicle will be parked for a long time, a parking lot should be used.
question_zh: 车辆长时间停放时，应选择停车场停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Temporary parking must not obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 长时停车应选择停车场。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle A enters the left lane at this point because lane changes are not allowed once inside the solid-line zone.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车在此时进入左侧车道是因为进入实线区不得变更车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，A车正处在白色虚线区，这个时候可以变更车道。如果这个时候不变更车道，到了实线区就不可以变更车道了，实线是不能跨越的。

question_en: If a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway, the warning triangle may be placed in another lane to get help from other vehicles.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上车辆发生故障时，为获得其他车辆的帮助，可将警告标志放置在其他车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The warning sign should be placed in the same lane where the breakdown occurred.
explanation_zh: 应在本车道放置警告标志，且放置距离为：高速公路是150米以外，道路是50-100米；且只能同车道摆放。

question_en: When an intersection situation is complicated, follow the principle: better to wait three minutes than rush one second.
question_zh: 遇到路口情况复杂时，应做到“宁停三分，不抢一秒”。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Better to wait three minutes than rush one second.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: Besides walking unpredictably and changing direction often, another feature of pedestrians in traffic is that they tend to gather and watch.
question_zh: 行人参与道路交通的特点除了行走随意性大、方向多变以外，还喜欢聚集、围观。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The main feature of pedestrians is that their movement is highly unpredictable and direction changes frequently.
explanation_zh: 行人参与道路交通的特点是行走随意性大、方向多变，聚集、围观等。但是如果问主要特点则是行走随意性大、方向多变。

question_en: During prolonged rain, mountain roads may develop loose shoulders and slope collapses, so drivers should keep to the firm road surface in the middle and avoid driving near the edge.
question_zh: 连续降雨天气，山区公路可能会出现路肩疏松和堤坡坍塌现象，行车时应选择道路中间坚实的路面，避免靠近路边行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On mountain roads, drive on the firm surface in the middle as much as possible.
explanation_zh: 疏松和堤坡坍塌现象是极有可能的。为了安全，应该在道路中间行车，除非必要，不要在路边行驶。

question_en: When changing lanes, turn on the turn signal in advance, observe carefully, keep a safe distance, and move into the target lane.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆变更车道时，应提前开启转向灯，注意观察，保持安全距离，驶入要变更的车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.
explanation_zh: 变更车道时提前开启转向灯提醒后车，然后观察有无变更车道的条件，再保持安全距离，驶入要变更的车道。

question_en: When passing a sharp-bend section, overtaking is allowed if there is little traffic.
question_zh: 通过急转弯路段时，在车辆较少的情况下可以超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking is prohibited on sharp bends.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第四十三条，同车道行驶的机动车，后车应当与前车保持足以采取紧急制动措施的安全距离。有下列情形之一的，不得超车：（一）前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车的；（二）与对面来车有会车可能的；（三）前车为执行紧急任务的警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车的；（四）行经铁路道口、交叉路口、窄桥、弯道、陡坡、隧道、人行横道、市区交通流量大的路段等没有超车条件的。

question_en: Smoking while driving has no effect on safe driving.
question_zh: 驾驶人一边驾车，一边吸烟对安全行车无影响。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety comes first while driving; you cannot divide your attention.
explanation_zh: 驾驶车辆吸烟不仅对车上乘客有害，烟雾也会使驾驶员视线迷糊，对安全行车是有影响的。

question_en: If a small passenger car on a flat expressway suddenly feels bumpy, quickly reduce speed to prevent a tire blowout.
question_zh: 小型客车行驶在平坦的高速公路上，突然有颠簸感觉时，应迅速降低车速，防止爆胎。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: 'Quickly' here means reacting promptly to slow down, not slamming on the brakes to stop.
explanation_zh: 本题描述是正确的。道路本身是平坦的，突然有颠簸感，可能是车辆出现轮胎漏气问题，要迅速反应，及时减速，防止爆胎，不要紧急制动，找到合适的地点停车检查，以免造成翻车或因后车反应不及时导致追尾。

question_en: When passing through a flooded road section, drive cautiously and slowly, and do not coast in neutral.
question_zh: 通过漫水路时要谨慎慢行，不得空挡滑行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Coasting in neutral is a bad habit and is never allowed under any circumstances.
explanation_zh: 机动车行经漫水桥路段时，应当停车察明水情，确认安全后，低速通过，不得空挡滑行。

question_en: When a vehicle passes through a curve on a mountain road, it should slow down, sound the horn, and keep to the right.
question_zh: 车辆在通过山区道路弯道时，要做到“减速、鸣喇叭、靠右行”。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slow down when driving on mountain roads.
explanation_zh: “减速、鸣喇叭、靠右行”是安全文明的驾驶行为。通过弯道时，大家都知道要减速，而在山区道路，由于前方状况很难了解，因此，若要经过弯道，应当鸣号告知其他车辆你要通过弯道了，靠右行是为了避免在弯道时遇到对向来车，若不靠右行驶，很可能会与来车发生碰撞。

question_en: When driving at night, avoid overtaking as much as possible; if overtaking is really necessary, flash between high and low beams to signal the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 夜间行车，要尽量避免超车，确需超车时，可变换远近光灯向前车示意。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Signal the vehicle ahead before overtaking.
explanation_zh: 只要在确保安全和不违规的情况下都可以超车。变换远近灯光是为了提醒前方车辆的注意，虽然只是一个动作，但对于保证安全来说却是很重要的。

question_en: If you notice a door is not properly closed while driving, close it promptly, otherwise sharp movements such as turning could throw a passenger or cargo out of the vehicle.
question_zh: 行驶过程中发现车门未关好，应及时关闭车门，否则车辆在转弯等激烈运动过程中会造成人员或货物被甩到车外。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Check carefully before driving to make sure every door is properly closed.
explanation_zh: 行车过程中，车门要关紧，否则会增加行车风险。

question_en: When driving a vehicle on the road, you should drive safely at the prescribed speed.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆在道路上行驶时，应当按照规定的速度安全行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive safely and avoid speeding.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，按规定行驶。

question_en: [Image] As shown, on this type of road, the main reason to drive in the middle of the road is that it allows faster travel.
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种道路上行驶，应在道路中间通行的主要原因是在道路中间通行速度快。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On roads without a center line, drive in the middle; on roads with a center line, drive on your side.
explanation_zh: 机动车在中间通行是为了给行人和非机动车足够的通行空间。

question_en: [Image] As shown, when a motor vehicle encounters this situation, vehicle A should be careful to yield.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到这种情况时，A车应当注意避让。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A road maintenance vehicle at work, as long as it does not block other traffic, is not restricted by traffic signs or markings.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第五十四条明确规定：道路养护车辆、工程作业车进行作业时，在不影响过往车辆通行的前提下，其行驶路线和方向不受交通标志、标线限制，过往车辆和人员应当注意避让。

question_en: When a vehicle reaches a muddy or heaved (frost-boil) road section, it should stop and observe, then pass slowly through a flat, firm section.
question_zh: 车辆行至泥泞或翻浆路段时，应停车观察，选择平整、坚实的路段缓慢通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Stop and observe first when the road conditions ahead are unclear.
explanation_zh: 泥泞翻浆路段行车容易发生侧滑，停车观察，降低车速，应选择平整、坚实的路段缓慢通过。

question_en: Once a vehicle on an expressway ramp accelerates to over 60 km/h, it may merge directly into the driving lane.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路匝道提速到每小时60公里以上时，可直接驶入行车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The entry sequence is: expressway entrance, ramp, acceleration lane, normal driving lane.
explanation_zh: 错误的关键在于“匝道”和“直接”，正确做法是应该先打开左转向灯驶入加速车道，将车道提到60公里每小时以上，再在不妨碍已在高速公路内的机动车正常行驶的情况下驶入车道。

question_en: When a following vehicle wants to overtake, if conditions allow, slow down and move right to make way, giving the following vehicle room to overtake.
question_zh: 遇后车超车时，在条件许可的情况下应减速靠右让路，是为了给后车留出超车空间。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When a following vehicle signals to overtake, slow down and move right if conditions allow.
explanation_zh: 遇后车超车，可减速靠右避让。安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When passing through dangerous mountain sections, especially areas prone to landslides or mudslides, drive cautiously and avoid stopping.
question_zh: 通过山区危险路段，尤其是通过经常发生塌方、泥石流的山区地段，应谨慎驾驶，避免停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive cautiously; safety comes first.
explanation_zh: 为了安全着想，应尽量避免停车，以免遇到泥石流遇险。不是说不能停车，只是避免！

question_en: If a tire suddenly blows out while driving, the driver must not panic and slam the brake pedal; instead, downshift quickly and use engine braking to slow the vehicle.
