question_zh: 行车中当车辆突然爆胎时，驾驶人切忌慌乱中急踏制动踏板，尽量采用“抢挡”的方法，利用发动机制动使车辆减速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Emergency braking during a sudden blowout can easily cause a rollover.
explanation_zh: 爆胎和意识到爆胎时，首先要做的就是控制住方向，然后缓慢减速，平稳停车。不能急踏制动踏板，应充分利用发动机制动。由于车胎爆胎，紧急制动会侧滑。所以只能用抢挡，用发动机制动。

question_en: When driving down a long slope, relying on the foot brake alone can easily cause the brakes to fail.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车下长坡时，仅靠行车制动器制动，容易引起行车制动器失灵。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On a long downhill, use engine braking (control speed by shifting to a lower gear) for safety.
explanation_zh: 汽车制动分为三种：1、行车制动，就是脚下的制动踏板，控制四轮；2、驻车制动，就是手刹车，停车时防止前滑后溜；3、发动机制动，也就是抢档，用于刹车失灵，在行车制动失灵时用，一级一级减档，从高到底，利用发动机变速箱的原理使车速降下来。下长坡时，驾驶员长时间使用行车制动器，易造成制动器热衰退，汽车的制动效能变差。

question_en: When driving on icy or snowy roads, the reflection of light off the snow can easily dazzle the driver and cause illusions.
question_zh: 冰雪道路行车，由于积雪对光线的反射，极易造成驾驶人目眩而产生错觉。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slow down when driving on icy or snowy roads.
explanation_zh: 积雪是白色，反射的光线很强，容易造成驾驶人目眩。

question_en: When driving down a long slope, coasting in neutral can make it difficult to shift back into gear.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车下长坡时，空挡滑行会导致再次挂挡困难。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Coasting in neutral downhill is not allowed.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车下长坡时，空挡滑行会导致再次挂挡困难。

question_en: When driving at night, if an oncoming vehicle has not switched off its high beams, slow down to prevent an accident in case a pedestrian crosses where the two beams meet.
question_zh: 夜间行车，遇对面来车未关闭远光灯时，应减速行驶，以防两车灯光的交汇处有行人通过时发生事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams must not be used when meeting oncoming traffic at night.
explanation_zh: 远光会影响视线，容易引发危险，为了安全，减速慢行。

question_en: When driving on an expressway, a driver may judge their speed purely by feel.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路行驶时，可以仅凭感觉确认车速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Driving requires caution; you cannot rely on feel alone.
explanation_zh: 感觉不一定准确，还是要看时速表的。

question_en: When following another vehicle on the road, the following distance is not important; matching the speed of the vehicle ahead is enough to prevent a rear-end collision.
question_zh: 在道路上跟车行驶时，跟车距离不是主要的，只须保持与前车相等的速度，即可防止发生追尾事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Keeping a sufficient safety distance is what effectively prevents rear-end collisions.
explanation_zh: 不保持安全跟车距离，前方遇紧急情况急刹车，后方会来不及反应，造成追尾。

question_en: [Image] As shown, when encountering this situation while driving, vehicle A may sound the horn continuously to ask the road maintenance vehicle to stop spraying water.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶过程中遇到这种情况时，A车可以长鸣喇叭提醒道路养护车辆暂停喷水。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A road maintenance vehicle at work, as long as it does not block other traffic, is not restricted by traffic signs or markings.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第五十四条明确规定：道路养护车辆、工程作业车进行作业时，在不影响过往车辆通行的前提下，其行驶路线和方向不受交通标志、标线限制，过往车辆和人员应当注意避让。

question_en: Female drivers wearing high heels while driving is not conducive to safe driving.
question_zh: 女驾驶人穿高跟鞋驾驶车辆，不利于安全行车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Try to avoid wearing high heels while driving.
explanation_zh: 穿高跟鞋踏制动踏板危险，不利于安全行车。

question_en: Before entering an intersection, reduce speed, observe carefully, and confirm it is safe.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆进入交叉路口前，应降低行驶速度，注意观察，确认安全。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Intersections have complex conditions, so drive cautiously.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，减速慢行。

question_en: When driving downhill, control speed appropriately and make full use of engine braking.
question_zh: 车辆下坡行驶，要适当控制车速，充分利用发动机进行制动。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Prolonged use of the brakes on a long downhill raises brake pad temperature and reduces braking effectiveness.
explanation_zh: 下坡时不能空挡滑行，应充分利用发动机制动。防止下坡时刹车发生打滑，所以应该利用发动机制动。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle A should slow down appropriately in this situation.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车在这种情况下应适当减速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Keeping a sufficient distance from other vehicles helps ensure safe driving.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，A车在B车后，B车开启了右转向灯，减速右转，紧跟B车的A车需要减速，以保持安全距离。

question_en: Motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles, and pedestrians travel in separate lanes in order to standardize traffic order and improve traffic efficiency.
question_zh: 机动车、非机动车和行人实行分道行驶，是为了规范交通秩序，提高通行效率。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Pedestrians use the sidewalk, vehicles use the roadway.
explanation_zh: 分道行驶，才能保证交通井然有序，从而提高效率。

question_en: When driving at night and needing to overtake, flashing between high and low beams is meant to signal the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 夜间行车，需要超车时，变换远近光灯示意是为了提示前车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Signal the vehicle ahead before overtaking.
explanation_zh: 变换远近光灯提示前车我方要超车，有利于安全行驶。

question_en: At night, a driver's field of view is limited and it is hard to observe traffic beyond the area lit by the headlights, so speed should be reduced.
question_zh: 夜间行车，驾驶人的视野受限，很难观察到灯光照射区域以外的交通情况，因此要减速行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slow down when driving at night.
explanation_zh: 晚上开车的时候受到光线暗的局限，相对观察事物的距离也就受到局限，所以视距比较短，很难观察到灯光照射区域以外的交通情况。为了安全考虑，减速行驶是必须的。

question_en: Overpasses are generally one-way, so vehicles do not need to slow down.
question_zh: 立交桥上一般都是单向行驶，车辆不必减速行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: You should slow down whenever it is required, regardless of whether the road is one-way.
explanation_zh: 立交桥上车多、路窄、弯多，应减速行驶

question_en: When a vehicle reaches an intersection, a left-turning vehicle may enter the left-turn waiting area at any time.
question_zh: 车辆行至交叉路口时，左转弯车辆在任何时段都可以进入左弯待转区。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When both the straight-ahead and left-turn signals are red, left-turning vehicles may not enter the waiting area.
explanation_zh: 左转弯车辆只有在直行车道绿灯亮起时才能进入左转弯待转车道。

question_en: Overtaking is not allowed when passing through a tunnel.
question_zh: 通过隧道时，不得超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking is prohibited in tunnels.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第四十三条，同车道行驶的机动车，后车应当与前车保持足以采取紧急制动措施的安全距离。有下列情形之一的，不得超车：（一）前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车的；（二）与对面来车有会车可能的；（三）前车为执行紧急任务的警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车的；（四）行经铁路道口、交叉路口、窄桥、弯道、陡坡、隧道、人行横道、市区交通流量大的路段等没有超车条件的。

question_en: If a rear tire blows out, the tail of the vehicle will swing unstably; the driver should grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands, keep the vehicle going straight, and slow down to a stop.
question_zh: 车辆后轮胎爆裂，车尾会摇摆不定，驾驶人应双手紧握转向盘，控制车辆保持直线行驶，减速停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: With a rear blowout, the first priority is to keep the steering under control.
explanation_zh: 爆胎后，首先要控制住方向，保持直线行驶，再减速停车。因为如果突然爆胎，瞬间靠右，会导致与后方来车相撞，所以只能先保持直线行驶，再减速停车。

question_en: If a motor vehicle breaks down or is in an accident and cannot drive normally, the hazard warning flashers should be turned on immediately.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车发生故障或事故不能正常行驶时，应立即打开危险报警闪光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In case of a breakdown, warn following traffic promptly.
explanation_zh: 第一时间打开危险报警闪光灯，警示其他车辆，是正确的。

question_en: After pulling away from the roadside, a vehicle should speed up quickly and turn sharply left into the normal traffic lane.
question_zh: 车辆在路边起步后应尽快提速，并向左迅速转向驶入正常行驶道路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Before pulling away, observe the surroundings first and confirm it is safe.
explanation_zh: 需要先观察，安全才能开过去，不是一起步就迅速转入正常行驶道行驶，万一后面有车是很危险的，所以“迅速”是错的。

question_en: On rainy days the road is slippery and braking distance increases, so try to use emergency braking to slow down while driving.
question_zh: 雨天路面湿滑，车辆制动距离增大，行车中尽量使用紧急制动减速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In rain, avoid emergency braking; instead use engine braking by downshifting to slow down.
explanation_zh: 因为路面比较滑，如果紧急制动（急刹车），容易造成车辆翻车，要用发动机制动。

question_en: When driving in snow, follow existing tire tracks on sections where they are present.
question_zh: 雪天行车中，在有车辙的路段应循车辙行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Tire tracks show that other vehicles have already passed, making them a relatively safer path.
explanation_zh: 有车辙的路段证明有车通行过，说明是可以通行的安全路段，应循车辙行驶。

question_en: After entering a mountain road, pay special attention to 'continuous bends' signs, proactively yield to vehicles and pedestrians, and slow down and sound the horn in advance as needed.
question_zh: 车辆进入山区道路后，要特别注意“连续转弯”标志，并主动避让车辆及行人，适时减速和提前鸣喇叭。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slow down when driving on mountain roads.
explanation_zh: 山区本来就是有山的地势，自然就会有坡度，以及拐弯，连续的弯路，容易影响行车的视线，所以要注意“连续转弯”的标志，以防在转弯处突然出现对向来车，为了安全，当然要适时减速和提前鸣喇叭，以提醒车辆与行人。

question_en: When merging into traffic, turn on the turn signal in advance, keep driving straight, check left and right through the mirrors, and merge only after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆汇入车流时，应提前开启转向灯，保持直线行驶，通过后视镜观察左右情况，确认安全后汇入合流。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Merging into traffic must not disrupt vehicles that are already driving normally.
explanation_zh: 在汇入车流是先开转向灯的，是为了提示后面的车避让留下进入车流的空隙，保持直行一段，因为是汇入合流，要确认好车与车横向空隙就要用后视镜看左右了。

question_en: When a motor vehicle encounters blocked traffic ahead on an expressway, it should queue in order behind the vehicle ahead and immediately turn on the hazard warning flashers to prevent a rear-end collision.
question_zh: 机动车在高速公路上遇前方交通受阻时，应当跟随前车顺序排队，并立即开启危险报警闪光灯，防止追尾。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: During expressway congestion, do not cut in randomly or use the emergency lane.
explanation_zh: 危险报警闪光灯，通常称为双闪，是一种提醒其他车辆与行人注意本车发生了特殊情况的信号灯。提醒后车请减速慢行，谨防追尾。

question_en: If a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway and can be moved into the emergency lane, only the hazard warning flashers need to be turned on, and whether to place the warning triangle can be decided based on traffic flow.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上车辆发生故障时，若车辆可以移动至应急车道内，只需开启危险报警闪光灯，警告标志可根据交通流情况选择是否放置。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Expressway breakdown procedure: turn on hazard flashers, move the vehicle, place the warning triangle and evacuate occupants, call for help, then wait for rescue.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上车辆发生故障时，若车辆可以移动至应急车道内，应开启危险报警闪光灯，放置警告标志。

question_en: If a driver has an urgent matter, they may make or take handheld phone calls while driving.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇紧急事务，可以边开车边接打手持电话。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Using a phone while driving is unsafe, illegal, and carries a 3-point penalty.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全违法行为记分管理办法》规定：驾驶机动车有拨打、接听手持电话等妨碍安全驾驶的行为的，一次记3分。

question_en: When overtaking, if a safe gap with the vehicle being overtaken cannot be guaranteed, the overtake should be abandoned voluntarily.
question_zh: 超车时，如果无法保证与被超车辆的安全间距，应主动放弃超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If safe overtaking conditions are not met, the overtake should be abandoned.
explanation_zh: 无法保证与被超车辆的安全间距，也就是没有超车条件，这时应主动放弃超车。

question_en: [Image] As shown, vehicle A has the right of way.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车具有优先通过权。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight-through traffic, and turns yield to straight-through traffic.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，A车是直行，B车是左转。转弯让直行，A车享有优先通过权。

question_en: Vehicles may change lanes frequently while driving on an expressway.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路上行车，可以频繁地变更车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Frequent lane changes are not allowed on any road.
explanation_zh: 频繁变更车道是种陋习，而且容易引发交通事故。

question_en: Vehicles must not make a U-turn on an expressway ramp.
question_zh: 车辆不得在高速公路匝道上掉头。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: U-turns are prohibited on expressways.
explanation_zh: 规定：驶入确定匝道后，迅速提高车速，但不得超过规定速度，在匝道上，不准超车、掉头、停车、和倒车。

question_en: If a front tire blows out while driving and the vehicle starts to swerve, the driver should grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands and try hard to keep the vehicle going straight.
question_zh: 行车中当车辆前轮爆胎已发生转向时，驾驶人应双手紧握转向盘，尽力控制车辆直线行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: With a front blowout, grip the wheel firmly the moment it happens.
explanation_zh: 行车中当车辆前轮爆胎已发生转向时：第一步：驾驶人应双手紧握转向盘，尽力控制车辆转回原行驶路线。为什么要这么做?如果不控制方向，很容易翻车，如果急刹车，也很容易翻车。第二步：随后开始减速打起右转向灯，然后靠右最终使车停在路肩上。

question_en: [Image] As shown, in this foggy condition, when passing through an intersection you must turn on lights, sound the horn, and speed up to avoid causing traffic congestion.
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种雾天情况下，通过交叉路口时必须开灯、鸣喇叭，加速通过，以免造成交通拥堵。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In fog, turn on fog lights and slow down, rather than speeding up.
explanation_zh: 雾天行驶，应减速，不应该加速。

question_en: If you feel tired while driving on an expressway, you should stop immediately to rest.
question_zh: 在高速公路上行驶感觉疲劳时，应立即停车休息。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Stopping arbitrarily on an expressway is not allowed.
explanation_zh: 在高速公路应在休息区或者服务区停车休息。不能随意停车休息。

question_en: When driving through a flooded road, shift into a high gear and pass through quickly.
question_zh: 漫水道路行车时，应挂高速挡，快速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When passing a flooded road, stop to check the water conditions and only proceed once it is confirmed safe.
explanation_zh: 不应该挂高速挡，应选用低速挡，以保证汽车有足够的驱动力；入水时应平稳，以防溅起的水花落入电器设备，造成电器短路；发动机中速运转，保持车速，中途不得停车、换挡和急转转向盘。

question_en: While making a U-turn, strictly control speed, carefully observe the road ahead and behind, and only move forward or reverse after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 掉头过程中，应严格控制车速，仔细观察道路前后方情况，确认安全后方可前进或倒车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A U-turn must not affect vehicles driving normally.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，安全第一。

question_en: A flashing warning signal light is a continuously flashing yellow light, whose purpose is to alert vehicles and pedestrians to pass through quickly.
question_zh: 闪光警告信号灯为持续闪烁的黄灯，其作用是提示车辆、行人需要快速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A flashing yellow light warns drivers to be cautious; it does not mean they should pass through quickly.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁提示行人车辆注意，确认安全后通过，快速通过是不对的。

question_en: When driving in heavy rain, you should control your speed to avoid the danger caused by hydroplaning.
question_zh: 在大雨天行车，为避免发生“水滑”而造成危险，要控制速度行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Hydroplaning happens when driving fast on water-covered roads in rain, which is dangerous for driving.
explanation_zh: 为了安全，雨天减速行驶。

question_en: Vehicles should drive on the right shoulder of the expressway.
question_zh: 车辆应靠高速公路右侧的路肩上行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Except in emergencies, driving on the right shoulder of an expressway is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 右侧路肩是供车辆出现紧急状况时停车的，不可在此行车。

question_en: It is illegal for a driver to use a handheld phone while driving.
question_zh: 驾驶人一边驾车，一边打手持电话是违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This violates the Road Traffic Safety Law, which makes it illegal.
explanation_zh: 一边驾车一边打电话违反《道路交通安全法》，属于违法行为。

question_en: What should a driver do when approaching a crosswalk?
question_zh: 车辆驶近人行横道时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up and pass through | B. Stop immediately | C. Slow down first, watch for pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, and proceed only after confirming it is safe | D. Honk the horn to signal pedestrians to yield
options_zh: A. 加速通过 | B. 立即停车 | C. 先减速注意观察行人、非机动车动态，确认安全后再通过 | D. 鸣喇叭示意行人让道
why_en: Pedestrians move unpredictably, so drivers must slow down and watch carefully before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，安全第一。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when driving through this road section, you should slow down to avoid a traffic accident caused by glare.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车行经该路段时，应减速慢行，避免因眩目导致的交通事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The light difference between the inside and outside of a tunnel requires adjustment, so drivers should slow down.
explanation_zh: 该路段为隧道出口，驾驶机动车行经该路段时，应减速慢行，避免因光线突然变化，阳光眩目导致的交通事故。

question_en: When driving in fog, honking the horn often can draw the attention of other drivers; if you hear another vehicle honk, you should also honk in response.
question_zh: 雾天行车多使用喇叭可引起对方注意；听到对方车辆鸣喇叭，也应鸣喇叭回应。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In foggy weather, honking the horn helps drivers alert each other.
explanation_zh: 雾天视线不佳，喇叭可当做一种信号和其他车辆交流，有利于安全行车。

question_en: When passing through school zones and residential areas, drivers should watch for signs and markings, drive at low speed, and not honk the horn.
question_zh: 车辆通过学校和小区应注意观察标志标线，低速行驶，不要鸣喇叭。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Driving through school and residential areas must not disturb students' studies or residents' daily life.
explanation_zh: 学校区域和居民区通常禁止鸣笛，减少噪音，以免影响居民生活和学生学习。同时，这些地方人流量大，要时时留意交通状况，减速慢行。

question_en: What should a driver do when following another vehicle on a mountain road?
question_zh: 车辆在山区道路跟车行驶时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Appropriately increase the safety distance | B. Follow closely behind the vehicle ahead | C. Appropriately reduce the safety distance | D. Look for opportunities to overtake whenever possible
options_zh: A. 适当加大安全距离 | B. 紧随前车之后 | C. 适当减小安全距离 | D. 尽可能寻找超车机会
why_en: Keeping a sufficient safety distance helps ensure safe driving.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，保持安全距离。

question_en: When a bicycle ahead is obstructing traffic, you may honk to alert it and speed up to go around it.
question_zh: 行车中前方遇自行车影响通行时，可鸣喇叭提示，加速绕行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drivers may honk moderately but should slow down, not speed up, when passing a bicycle.
explanation_zh: 题目说“自行车影响通行”说明前方交通状况不佳，这时应减速慢行。

question_en: What lights should be used when driving at night through a road section with good lighting conditions?
question_zh: 夜间车辆通过照明条件良好的路段时，应使用什么灯？
options_en: A. Fog lights | B. Low beam headlights | C. High beam headlights | D. Hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 雾灯 | B. 近光灯 | C. 远光灯 | D. 危险报警闪光灯
why_en: High beams must not be used on well-lit roads at night; low beams should be used instead.
explanation_zh: 照明条件良好，开启近光就够了。远光会影响前车和前面行人的视线，容易引发危险。

question_en: When meeting oncoming traffic on a narrow road section, drivers should follow the three courtesies: slow down first, yield first, and stop first.
question_zh: 在狭窄的路段会车时，应做到礼让三先：先慢、先让、先停。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving requires yielding politely to other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 文明行车，礼貌让行。

question_en: Drivers should drive courteously and yield politely, avoiding reckless driving, risky driving, angry driving, and driving while unfit.
question_zh: 行车中要文明驾驶，礼让行车，做到不开英雄车、冒险车、赌气车和带病车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving means never racing or arguing with other drivers on the road.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What is the main effect of the nighttime road environment on safe driving?
question_zh: 夜间道路环境对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. Low visibility, making it hard to observe traffic conditions | B. The road surface is complex and changeable | C. The driver's physical stamina declines | D. The driver is prone to impulsiveness and hallucinations
options_zh: A. 能见度低、不利于观察道路交通情况 | B. 路面复杂多变 | C. 驾驶人体力下降 | D. 驾驶人易产生冲动、幻觉
why_en: At night low visibility makes it hard to observe the road, so lights must be used correctly to signal other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 夜间行车视线差，在没有照明的路段，驾驶人视线普遍受到影响，不能清楚看到前方事物，或者不能看清和判断前方事物的距离，尤其是在会车的情况下，由于受对向车辆灯光的影响，会产生视觉的盲点，导致看不清或看不见事物，夜间特大道路交通事故明显高于白天。

question_en: When driving through a crosswalk, drivers should take care to yield to pedestrians.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆通过人行横道线时，应注意礼让行人。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When overtaking and the vehicle ahead does not slow down to let you pass, you should abandon the overtake, slow down appropriately, and keep a safe distance from the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车超车时，前方车辆不减速让路，应停止超车并适当减速，与前方车辆保持安全距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Forcing an overtake easily causes traffic accidents.
explanation_zh: 不让超车，就别超了，安全第一。

question_en: When overtaking and the vehicle being overtaken does not slow down to let you pass, you should quickly speed up to complete the overtake.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车超车时，被超越车辆未减速让路，应迅速提速超越前方车辆完成超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Forcing an overtake like this easily causes traffic accidents, so the attempt should be abandoned instead.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车超车时，被超越车辆未减速让路，应停止超车。

question_en: A front tire blowout is quite dangerous: the vehicle will immediately veer toward the side of the burst tire, directly affecting the driver's control of the steering wheel.
question_zh: 车辆前轮胎爆裂，危险较大，方向会立刻向爆胎车轮一侧跑偏，直接影响驾驶人对转向盘的控制。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: With a front tire blowout, the driver must grip the steering wheel firmly right away to control direction.
explanation_zh: 爆胎后，车辆整体平衡会受到影响，会向爆胎的一边跑偏，直接影响到驾驶人对转向盘的控制。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when driving through a crosswalk with no pedestrians crossing, there is no need to slow down.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到没有行人通过的人行横道时不用减速慢行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving requires slowing down at crosswalks regardless, in case pedestrians appear.
explanation_zh: 遇到人行横道必须减速行驶，即使没有行人。

question_en: What should you do when meeting an oncoming vehicle that has difficulty passing and needs to borrow part of your lane?
question_zh: 会车中遇到对方来车行进有困难需借道时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Do not encroach on the other lane and drive normally | B. Signal the other vehicle to stop and yield | C. Keep to the right and speed up | D. Yield as much as possible to let the other vehicle go first
options_zh: A. 不侵占对方道路，正常行驶 | B. 示意对方停车让行 | C. 靠右侧加速行驶 | D. 尽量礼让对方先行
why_en: Courteous driving means yielding politely to vehicles in difficulty.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: Why is making a U-turn on a crosswalk prohibited?
question_zh: 人行横道上禁止掉头的原因是什么？
options_en: A. Vehicles are prohibited from crosswalks | B. The section has surveillance equipment | C. To avoid obstructing pedestrians' normal passage | D. Parking is prohibited on crosswalks
options_zh: A. 人行横道禁止车辆通行 | B. 路段有监控设备 | C. 避免妨碍行人正常通行 | D. 人行横道禁止停车
why_en: Courteous driving must not obstruct pedestrians' normal passage.
explanation_zh: 在人行横道上掉头，很有可能撞到行人，不安全。

question_en: Vehicles must not overtake while descending a steep slope on a mountain road.
question_zh: 车辆在山区道路行车下陡坡时，不得超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking while descending a steep slope easily causes traffic accidents.
explanation_zh: 行经繁华路段、交叉路口、铁路道口、人行横道、急弯路、宽度不足4米的窄路或者窄桥、陡坡、隧道或者容易发生危险的路段，不得超车。

question_en: If you accidentally drive past your exit on an expressway, what should you do?
question_zh: 高速公路上行车，如果因疏忽驶过出口，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Stop immediately | B. Make a U-turn on the spot | C. Reverse back on the spot | D. Continue driving forward and look for the next exit
options_zh: A. 立即停车 | B. 在原地掉头 | C. 在原地倒车驶回 | D. 继续向前行驶，寻找下一个出口
why_en: Reversing and making U-turns are prohibited on expressways.
explanation_zh: 高速公路行车不可掉头、不可倒车，错过出口，只能继续行驶，寻找下个出口。

question_en: When driving on icy or snowy roads, vehicle stability decreases, and accelerating too abruptly can easily cause the wheels to spin or slip.
question_zh: 在冰雪道路上行车时，车辆的稳定性降低，加速过急时车轮极易空转或溜滑。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Icy and snowy roads easily cause skidding or loss of steering control, so drivers must be cautious.
explanation_zh: 轮胎与地面的摩擦系数降低，轮胎不易附着在地面上，只要一加速，就极易空转或溜滑。

question_en: When an expressway is blocked due to an accident, vehicles may drive on the right emergency lane or shoulder.
question_zh: 高速公路因发生事故造成堵塞时，可在右侧紧急停车带或路肩行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Except in emergencies, the emergency lane and right shoulder of an expressway must not be used for driving.
explanation_zh: 右侧紧急停车带和路肩是供车辆出现紧急状况停车的，不能占用紧急停车带行驶。

question_en: When changing to the right lane, drivers should turn on the right turn signal in advance, observe carefully, and merge into the target lane only when it is safe.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆向右变更车道时，应提前开启右转向灯，注意观察，在确保安全的情况下，驶入要变更的车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Lane changes require signaling in advance, checking behind, and ensuring a safe distance before merging.
explanation_zh: 变更车道时提前开启转向灯提醒后车，然后观察有无变更车道的条件，再保持安全距离，驶入要变更的车道。

question_en: When following another vehicle at night, the following vehicle may use high beams.
question_zh: 夜间尾随前车行驶时，后车可以使用远光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Using high beams while following closely at night blinds the driver ahead, so low beams should be used instead.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十八条：机动车在夜间没有路灯、照明不良或者遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度情况下行驶时，应当开启前照灯、示廓灯和后位灯，但同方向行驶的后车与前车近距离行驶时，不得使用远光灯。机动车雾天行驶应当开启雾灯和危险报警闪光灯。

question_en: When passing through mountain sections prone to landslides or mudslides, avoid stopping.
question_zh: 通过经常发生塌方、泥石流的山区地段，避免停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive cautiously and put safety first in landslide-prone areas.
explanation_zh: 为了安全着想，应尽量避免停车，以免遇到泥石流遇险。

question_en: When pedestrians commit a traffic safety violation, vehicles may refuse to yield to them.
question_zh: 当行人出现交通安全违法行为时，车辆可以不给行人让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians regardless of their violations.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When changing lanes, you only need to turn on the signal and quickly steer into the target lane, so as not to obstruct vehicles already in that lane.
question_zh: 变更车道时只需开启转向灯，并迅速转向驶入相应的车道，以不妨碍同车道机动车正常行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Lane changes require signaling early, checking behind, and confirming a safe distance, not just steering in quickly.
explanation_zh: 变更车道需提前开启转向灯，观察周围环境确认安全后再驶入相应的车道，不得妨碍其他车辆正常行驶。

question_en: When driving slowly on a congested road and another vehicle forces its way into your lane, what should you do?
question_zh: 车辆在拥挤路段低速行驶时，遇其他车辆强行插队，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk a warning and refuse to let it in | B. Speed up and follow closely behind the vehicle ahead to block it | C. Yield proactively to ensure safe driving | D. Squeeze against the cutting vehicle to force it to leave
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭警告，不得进入 | B. 加速行驶，紧跟前车，不让其进入 | C. 主动礼让，确保行车安全 | D. 挤靠“加塞”车辆，逼其离开
why_en: Courteous driving means yielding politely rather than blocking or forcing other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When driving on a main road and approaching a junction with a side road, what should you do to prevent colliding with a vehicle suddenly entering from the side road?
question_zh: 车辆在主干道上行驶，驶近主支干道交汇处时，为防止与从支路突然驶入的车辆相撞，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Maintain normal speed | B. Slow down in advance, observe, and drive cautiously | C. Honk and pass quickly | D. Speed up in advance to pass through
options_zh: A. 保持正常速度行驶 | B. 提前减速、观察，谨慎驾驶 | C. 鸣喇叭，迅速通过 | D. 提前加速通过
why_en: Drivers must constantly watch surrounding conditions to avoid accidents at junctions.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，安全第一。

question_en: While driving, motor vehicle drivers should keep a safe distance from the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 在行驶过程中，机动车驾驶人要注意与前车保持安全距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving puts safety first, which requires a safe following distance.
explanation_zh: 安全行车，保持安全距离。

question_en: After entering the ramp, quickly increase your speed to above 60 km/h.
question_zh: 车辆驶入匝道后，迅速将车速提高到每小时60公里以上。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Entering an expressway follows the sequence entrance, ramp, acceleration lane, then normal lane; speed should build up gradually, not on the ramp.
explanation_zh: 应该是从匝道进入高速公路加速车道，在加速车道里迅速将车速提高到每小时60公里以上。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when passing vehicle A which is stopped before the crosswalk, vehicle B should slow down and be ready to stop and yield.
question_zh: 如图所示，当越过停在人行横道前的A车时，B车应当减速，准备停车让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians who may be hidden by the stopped vehicle.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，B车前方是人行横道，应当减速行驶，当B车越过A车后，若有行人通过，必要时停车让行。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when a motor vehicle drives on this type of road, why does it travel in the middle of the road?
question_zh: 如图所示，机动车在这种道路上行驶，在道路中间通行的原因是什么？
options_en: A. To leave enough space for non-motor vehicles and pedestrians on both sides | B. Visibility is better in the middle of the road | C. Driving in the middle is faster | D. To prevent the vehicle from running off the road
options_zh: A. 给两侧的非机动车和行人留有充足的通行空间 | B. 在道路中间通行视线好 | C. 在道路中间通行速度快 | D. 防止车辆冲出路外
why_en: With no lane markings, drivers should stay in the middle to leave room for non-motor vehicles and pedestrians at the sides.
explanation_zh: 图中是没有中心线的道路，在中间行驶是为了给两侧的非机动车和行人留出充足的通行空间。

question_en: When reversing on a normal road and you notice a passing vehicle, what should you do?
question_zh: 在一般道路倒车时，若发现有过往车辆通过，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk to signal | B. Stop proactively to yield | C. Speed up while reversing | D. Continue reversing
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭示意 | B. 主动停车避让 | C. 加速倒车 | D. 继续倒车
why_en: Reversing must not interfere with vehicles driving normally, so the driver should stop and yield.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When a front tire blowout has already caused the vehicle to veer, the driver should not overcorrect; once direction is under control, how should the vehicle be slowed gradually?
question_zh: 前轮胎爆裂已出现转向时，驾驶人不要过度矫正，在控制住方向的情况下，应怎样做，使车辆缓慢减速？
options_en: A. Apply emergency braking | B. Use the parking brake | C. Gently press the brake pedal | D. Quickly stomp on the brake pedal
options_zh: A. 采取紧急制动 | B. 使用驻车制动 | C. 轻踏制动踏板 | D. 迅速踏下制动踏板
why_en: With a front tire blowout, braking too hard can cause the vehicle to roll over, so the brake should be pressed gently.
explanation_zh: 爆胎时不能迅速减速，需慢慢减速。采取紧急制动是踩脚刹，使用驻车制动是拉手刹，迅速踏下制动踏板也是踩脚刹，都是属于迅速减速，危险。

question_en: What should be noted when driving on icy or snowy roads?
question_zh: 冰雪路行车时应注意什么？
options_en: A. Braking distance increases | B. Anti-skid capability increases | C. Road surface traction increases | D. Braking performance is unchanged
options_zh: A. 制动距离延长 | B. 抗滑能力变大 | C. 路面附着力增大 | D. 制动性能没有变化
why_en: Icy and snowy roads increase braking distance and the risk of skidding, so drivers should slow down and increase following distance.
explanation_zh: 车辆在冰雪路面上行驶，因汽车轮胎与路面的摩擦系数减小、附着力大大降低，所以遇有冰雪路面，车辆在行驶中最重要的是车辆制动问题，要采取点刹、并和前后车保持车距离。遇情况紧急制动时，制动距离会大大延长。

question_en: What should you do when you encounter children while driving?
question_zh: 行车中遇儿童时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down, and stop to yield if necessary | B. Honk continuously to hurry them | C. Quickly pass from one side | D. Speed up and go around
options_zh: A. 减速慢行，必要时停车避让 | B. 长鸣喇叭催促 | C. 迅速从一侧通过 | D. 加速绕行
why_en: Courteous driving puts safety first around children.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What should you do when a non-motor vehicle cuts in front while driving?
question_zh: 行车中，遇非机动车抢行时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up and pass | B. Honk a warning | C. Slow down and yield | D. Suddenly accelerate as it approaches
options_zh: A. 加速通过 | B. 鸣喇叭警告 | C. 减速让行 | D. 临近时突然加速
why_en: Courteous driving means slowing down and yielding for the sake of safety.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What should you do when overtaking a bicycle traveling in the same direction?
question_zh: 行车中超越同向行驶的自行车时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Let the bicycle go first | B. Watch its movement carefully, slow down, and leave a sufficient safety distance | C. Honk continuously to make it yield | D. Honk continuously and speed up to overtake
options_zh: A. 让自行车先行 | B. 注意观察动态，减速慢行，留有足够的安全距离 | C. 连续鸣喇叭提醒其让路 | D. 持续鸣喇叭并加速超越
why_en: Slow down and keep a sufficient safety distance when overtaking a bicycle.
explanation_zh: 题目中是“行车中超越”，指行车途中要超越自行车，所以需要注意观察动态，减速行驶，留有足够安全距离后再超车。“让自行车先行”是不超车，与题目内容不符。

question_en: What lights should be turned on before entering a two-way tunnel?
question_zh: 车辆驶入双向行驶隧道前，应开启什么灯？
options_en: A. Hazard warning lights | B. High beam headlights | C. Fog lights | D. Clearance lights or low beam headlights
options_zh: A. 危险报警闪光灯 | B. 远光灯 | C. 雾灯 | D. 示廓灯或近光灯
why_en: High beams must not be used when meeting oncoming vehicles in a tunnel; use clearance lights or low beams instead.
explanation_zh: 车辆进入双向行驶隧道，一般都应该开启近光灯，而不要开启远光灯。若是隧道本身没有灯光的，可以变换灯光行驶，但是会车前要换成近光灯。

question_en: When passing a vehicle parked on the right, what should you do to guard against it suddenly pulling out or opening a door?
question_zh: 行车中超越右侧停放的车辆时，为预防其突然起步或开启车门，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Leave a lateral safety distance and slow down | B. Maintain normal speed | C. Honk continuously | D. Speed up and pass
options_zh: A. 预留出横向安全距离，减速行驶 | B. 保持正常速度行驶 | C. 长鸣喇叭 | D. 加速通过
why_en: Whether overtaking or being overtaken, a sufficient lateral safety distance must always be kept.
explanation_zh: 留出安全距离、并减速，万一右侧车辆启动也有足够的空间和时间避让。

question_en: When a motor vehicle is being overtaken by another vehicle, what is the purpose of it slowing down and moving to the right?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车正在被其他车辆超车时，被超车辆减速靠右侧行驶的目的是什么？
options_en: A. To give the overtaking vehicle enough space to pass | B. So it can stop at any time | C. To avoid pedestrians and non-motor vehicles | D. None of the above is correct
options_zh: A. 给该车让出足够的超车空间 | B. 以便随时停车 | C. 避让行人与非机动车 | D. 以上选项都不正确
why_en: Overtaking is done from the left, so the overtaken vehicle should slow down and move right to allow enough space.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，文明礼让。

question_en: When going down a long slope, besides brake braking, what other effective method helps control speed?
question_zh: 下长坡时，控制车速除了刹车制动以外还有什么有效的辅助方法？
options_en: A. Shift into neutral and coast | B. Use engine braking | C. Press the clutch and coast | D. Turn off the engine and coast
options_zh: A. 挂入空挡滑行 | B. 利用发动机制动 | C. 踏下离合器滑行 | D. 关闭发动机熄火滑行
why_en: Using the brakes continuously on a long slope raises brake temperature and reduces braking effectiveness, so engine braking should also be used.
explanation_zh: 下坡路段禁止空挡滑行和熄火滑行，除了刹车制动，还可利用发动机制动。发动机制动就是挂低档，让车利用低档位的惯性制动，你可以试一下，你在3挡的速度，直接挂1挡，记住不要踩刹车，直接挂档，你看效果如何，车身会震一下，速度下降的很快。

question_en: What should a driver do when passing over a water-covered road surface?
question_zh: 驾驶人在行车中经过积水路面时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down | B. Pass at normal speed | C. Coast through in neutral | D. Speed up and pass
options_zh: A. 减速慢行 | B. 保持正常车速通过 | C. 空挡滑行通过 | D. 加速通过
why_en: Road sections with potential hazards should be passed at low speed.
explanation_zh: 积水路面应低速通过。

question_en: When vehicles ahead are stopped in a queue or moving slowly, is it correct to force your way through?
question_zh: 遇到前方车辆停车排队或者缓慢行驶时，强行穿插，以下说法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Allowed, because it lets you get through the congested area quickly | B. Allowed, because it saves fuel | C. Prohibited, because it wastes fuel | D. Prohibited, because it disrupts traffic flow and worsens congestion
options_zh: A. 允许，因为可以快速地通过拥堵区 | B. 允许，因为可以省油 | C. 禁止，因为这样不利于省油 | D. 禁止，因为这样扰乱车流，加重拥堵
why_en: Forcing through disrupts traffic flow and worsens congestion, so it is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 强行穿插，会扰乱车流，加重拥堵，是不文明的表现，应该禁止。

question_en: When entering an expressway toll gate, which entrance should you choose?
question_zh: 驶入高速公路的收费口时，应选择怎样的入口？
options_en: A. One with many vehicles | B. One with a red light on | C. One with a green light on | D. One that is temporarily out of service
options_zh: A. 车辆多 | B. 红灯亮 | C. 绿灯亮 | D. 暂停服务
why_en: A red light means stop and a green light means proceed, so choose a lane with a green light.
explanation_zh: 绿灯是表示收费站正常运行的，所以应该选择在绿灯那边。

question_en: What should you do when an oncoming vehicle is driving in your lane?
question_zh: 行车中遇到对向来车占道行驶，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Drive close to the center of the road | B. Yield proactively to the other vehicle | C. Flash the headlights to warn it | D. Force it to move to the right
options_zh: A. 紧靠道路中心行驶 | B. 主动给对方让行 | C. 用大灯警示对方 | D. 逼对方靠右行驶
why_en: Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still drive courteously and yield.
explanation_zh: 记住文明驾驶，礼貌让行。不开赌气车，安全第一。

question_en: What lights should be turned on when a vehicle stops temporarily in the rain?
question_zh: 车辆在雨天临时停车时，应开启什么灯？
options_en: A. Front and rear fog lights | B. Hazard warning lights | C. Headlights | D. Reverse lights
options_zh: A. 前后雾灯 | B. 危险报警闪光灯 | C. 前大灯 | D. 倒车灯
why_en: A temporary stop must alert vehicles behind to avoid accidents, so hazard lights should be used.
explanation_zh: 下雨天开车视线不清，因此要临时停车，应当开启危险报警闪光灯，提醒其他车辆注意。

question_en: When a vehicle breaks down on an expressway, which of the following handling methods is incorrect?
question_zh: 在高速公路上驾驶机动车，车辆发生故障后的处置方法，以下说法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Turn on the hazard warning lights, and at night also turn on the clearance lights and rear position lights | B. Place a warning sign more than 150 meters behind the vehicle | C. Passengers should get out and help push the broken-down vehicle onto the emergency lane | D. Everyone should leave the vehicle, call for help, and wait in a safe place beyond the emergency lane or guardrail
options_zh: A. 打开危险报警闪光灯，夜间还应开启示廓灯、后位灯 | B. 在车后150米以外设置安全警告标志 | C. 车内乘员应下车辅助将故障车辆推移到紧急停车带上 | D. 所有人员需离开故障车辆，在紧急停车带或护栏以外安全位置报警并等候救援
why_en: Pushing a vehicle on the expressway is dangerous, so this is the incorrect method; safety must come first.
explanation_zh: 车辆在高速公路发生故障，要开启危险报警闪光灯，在车身后150米以外设置警告标志，疏散车内人员到右侧路肩或紧急停车带，立即报警等待救援，千万不可自行推车。

question_en: When a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway and needs to stop for repairs, what is the correct order of the following steps: (1) place warning signs, move passengers to a safe place, and call for help promptly; (2) turn on the hazard warning lights; (3) move the vehicle to a position that does not obstruct traffic; (4) wait for rescue?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路发生故障，需要停车排除故障时，以下做法先后顺序正确的是？ ①放置警告标志，转移乘车人员至安全处，迅速报警②开启危险报警闪光灯③将车辆移至不妨碍交通的位置④等待救援
options_zh: A. ④③①② | B. ①②③④ | C. ③②①④ | D. ②③①④
why_en: The correct order is: turn on hazard lights, move the vehicle, place warning signs and call for help, then wait for rescue.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路发生故障，需要停车排除故障时，应当进行如下顺序的操作：开启危险报警闪光灯；将车辆移至不妨碍交通的位置；放置警告标志，转移乘车人员至安全处，迅速报警；等待救援。

question_en: What is the main effect of fog on safe driving?
question_zh: 雾天对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. The engine easily stalls | B. Skidding easily occurs | C. Driving resistance increases | D. Low visibility, unclear line of sight
options_zh: A. 发动机易熄火 | B. 易发生侧滑 | C. 行驶阻力增大 | D. 能见度低，视线不清
why_en: Fog greatly reduces visibility, so fog lights should be used when driving in it.
explanation_zh: 大雾天气眼前白蒙蒙一片，明显是能见度低，视线不清。

question_en: When driving in heavy rain and the wipers cannot clear the rain fast enough, what should you do?
question_zh: 在暴雨天气驾车，刮水器无法刮净雨水时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down | B. Concentrate and drive cautiously | C. Slow down and pull over immediately | D. Drive at normal speed
options_zh: A. 减速行驶 | B. 集中注意力谨慎驾驶 | C. 立即减速靠边停车 | D. 以正常速度行驶
why_en: When the road cannot be seen clearly, driving should stop and the vehicle should pull over.
explanation_zh: 刮水器无法刮净雨水，肯定看不清路况，这时勉强行车容易引发危险。最安全的做法是立刻靠边停车，并开启危险报警闪光灯，等雨变小再继续行驶。

question_en: When driving on an expressway, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 机动车在高速公路行驶，下列做法正确的是？
options_en: A. Except in emergencies, driving or stopping in the emergency lane is prohibited | B. Overtaking or stopping in the deceleration or acceleration lane is allowed | C. Stopping to load or unload cargo in the emergency lane is allowed | D. Stopping on the shoulder to pick up or drop off passengers is allowed
options_zh: A. 非紧急情况时不得在应急车道行驶或者停车 | B. 可在减速车道或加速车道上超车、停车 | C. 可在紧急停车带停车装卸货物 | D. 可在路肩停车上下人员
why_en: Stopping at will on an expressway is prohibited except for genuine emergencies in the emergency lane.
explanation_zh: 应急车道是供出现紧急情况是使用的。

question_en: What should you do when driving through an unguarded railway crossing?
question_zh: 驾驶车辆通过无人看守的铁路道口时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down and pass | B. Pass at a constant speed | C. Stop, look, then proceed | D. Speed up and pass
options_zh: A. 减速通过 | B. 匀速通过 | C. 一停、二看、三通过 | D. 加速通过
why_en: Remember: stop, look, then proceed, when crossing an unguarded railway crossing.
explanation_zh: 一停，是停在未到铁道前，不是停在铁路上。二看，是在铁道前观察是否有火车要经过。三通过，才是安全通过。

question_en: When a vehicle at an intersection encounters a turning vehicle cutting in, what should you do?
question_zh: 车辆行至交叉路口，遇有转弯的车辆抢行，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up to pass first | B. Honk and pass first | C. Stop and yield | D. Maintain normal speed
options_zh: A. 提高车速抢先通过 | B. 鸣喇叭抢先通过 | C. 停车避让 | D. 保持正常车速行驶
why_en: Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still yield and drive courteously.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when vehicles are queuing on a congested road section and another vehicle forces its way in, what is the correct response?
question_zh: 如图所示，车辆在拥挤路段排队行驶时，遇到其他车辆强行穿插行驶，以下说法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Quickly turn left to avoid it | B. Quickly speed up to block it from cutting in | C. Slow down or stop to yield | D. Honk continuously as a warning
options_zh: A. 迅速左转躲避 | B. 迅速提高车速不让其穿插 | C. 减速或停车让行 | D. 持续鸣喇叭警告
why_en: Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still slow down or stop to yield.
explanation_zh: 安全行车，礼貌让行。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, how should you drive when passing through the intersection in this situation?
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种情况下通过路口，应该怎么行驶？
options_en: A. Rush through ahead of the pedestrians | B. Speed up and pass | C. Slow down or stop to yield to pedestrians | D. Drive on the left side
options_zh: A. 赶在行人前通过 | B. 加速通过 | C. 减速或停车避让行人 | D. 靠左侧行驶
why_en: Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，蓝色汽车旁边正有个人准备过马路，此时应减速或停车避让行人。

question_en: When entering an expressway from the acceleration lane, which of the following is incorrect?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车由加速车道进入高速公路行驶，以下做法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Accelerate in the acceleration lane while turning on the left turn signal | B. Closely watch traffic flow in the left lane and check the mirrors for conditions behind | C. Fully use the length of the acceleration lane to speed up, then merge smoothly after confirming it is safe | D. After accelerating fully in the acceleration lane, merge directly into the leftmost lane
options_zh: A. 在加速车道上加速，同时要开启左转向灯 | B. 密切注意左侧行车道的车流状态，同时用后视镜观察后方的情况 | C. 充分利用加速车道的长度加速，确认安全后，平顺地进入行车道 | D. 经加速车道充分加速后，可直接驶入最左侧车道
why_en: Lane changes require signaling in advance and observing traffic flow; merging directly into the leftmost lane skips proper step-by-step observation.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第七十八条：高速公路应当标明车道的行驶速度，最高车速不得超过每小时120公里，最低车速不得低于每小时60公里。在高速公路上行驶的小型载客汽车最高车速不得超过每小时120公里，其他机动车不得超过每小时100公里，摩托车不得超过每小时80公里。同方向有2条车道的，左侧车道的最低车速为每小时100公里；同方向有3条以上车道的，最左侧车道的最低车速为每小时110公里，中间车道的最低车速为每小时90公里。因此，驾车进入高速公路后，不能直接驶入最左车道，要循序渐进。

question_en: What should you do when driving to a sharp bend in the road?
question_zh: 驾驶车辆行至道路急转弯处，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Brake hard and pass at low speed | B. Drive on the outer side of the curve | C. Slow down fully and keep to the right | D. Use the opposite lane
options_zh: A. 急剧制动低速通过 | B. 靠弯道外侧行驶 | C. 充分减速并靠右侧行驶 | D. 借对向车道行驶
why_en: Courteous driving puts safety first: slow down fully and keep to the right at sharp bends.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，减速慢行。

question_en: When encountering a slow-moving water sprinkler truck ahead, which of the following is incorrect?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇到前方低速行驶的洒水车作业时，以下做法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Watch out and give way | B. If the sprinkler truck has a direction arrow, change lanes as indicated once it is safe | C. If the sprinkler truck has no direction arrow, choose a suitable lane to change into once it is safe | D. Speed up urgently to pass the sprinkler truck
options_zh: A. 注意避让 | B. 若洒水车有指示箭头，在确保安全的情况下按箭头指示方向变更车道 | C. 若洒水车无指示箭头，在确保安全的情况下选择合适的车道变更 | D. 通过洒水车时应急加速通过
why_en: Drivers should watch out and give way to a slow-moving sprinkler truck, not speed up to pass it.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车遇到前方低速行驶的洒水车作业时，需要注意避让；若洒水车有指示箭头，在确保安全的情况下按箭头指示方向变更车道；若洒水车无指示箭头，在确保安全的情况下选择合适的车道变更。

question_en: What lights should be turned on promptly when driving in fog?
question_zh: 雾天行车时，应及时开启什么灯？
options_en: A. Reverse lights | B. Low beam headlights | C. High beam headlights | D. Fog lights
options_zh: A. 倒车灯 | B. 近光灯 | C. 远光灯 | D. 雾灯
why_en: Fog lights should be turned on in fog, along with slowing down.
explanation_zh: 雾天行车应开启雾灯，遇到大雾要同时开危险报警闪光灯。

question_en: When you need to borrow a lane to go around an obstacle ahead, but an oncoming vehicle has already approached the obstacle, what should you do?
question_zh: 行车中需要借道绕过前方障碍物，但对向来车已接近障碍物时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up to pass first | B. Honk to signal the oncoming vehicle to yield | C. Quickly occupy the lane to force the oncoming vehicle to stop and yield | D. Slow down or stop, and let the oncoming vehicle pass first
options_zh: A. 加速提前抢过 | B. 鸣喇叭示意对向车辆让道 | C. 迅速占用车道，迫使对向来车停车让道 | D. 降低速度或停车，让对向来车优先通行
why_en: The side with the obstacle should yield to the side without one, unless it has already entered the obstacle section first.
explanation_zh: 请注意看题干“对向来车已接近障碍物时”，对方的车更接近障碍物，文明礼让，对向来车优先通行。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, in which of the following situations is overtaking allowed?
question_zh: 如图所示，以下哪种情况可以超车？
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed but a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction lanes and yellow dashed lines separate opposing lanes.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，能够超车的必须满足两个条件：一是必须在虚线的一侧，而是对向没有来车。满足这两个条件的就只有51a了。

question_en: When preparing to pull away after a temporary roadside stop, what should you do first?
question_zh: 车辆临时靠边停车后准备起步时，应先怎样做？
options_en: A. Accelerate to pull away | B. Honk the horn | C. Observe surrounding traffic conditions | D. Increase engine RPM
options_zh: A. 加油起步 | B. 鸣喇叭 | C. 观察周围交通情况 | D. 提高发动机转速
why_en: Before pulling away, observe surrounding traffic and confirm it is safe first.
explanation_zh: 起步前应先观察周围交通情况，确保安全再起步。先观察，后喇叭。

question_en: While driving at night, how does the headlight beam change when a curve appears ahead?
question_zh: 夜间行车中，前方出现弯道时，灯光照射会发生怎样的变化？
options_en: A. The distance stays the same | B. It changes from high to low | C. It leaves the road surface | D. It shifts from the middle of the road to the side
options_zh: A. 距离不变 | B. 由高变低 | C. 离开路面 | D. 由路中移到路侧
why_en: As the vehicle enters a curve at night, the headlight beam shifts from the middle of the road to the side.
explanation_zh: 夜间开灯驾驶对道路与地形的判断方法:（1）如果发现行驶时汽车灯光的照射距离在由远变近，前方路况可能是：进入一侧有山体或屏障的弯道、到达坡道的低谷地段、驶近或驶入上坡道。（2）如果发现行驶时灯光的照射距离在由近变远，前方路况可能是：弯道变为直路、进入下坡道、缓下坡变为陡下坡或由下坡道驶入平路。（3）若行驶中发现灯光离开了路面，前方路况可能是：急转弯、路面有大坑或到达坡顶。（4）当灯光由路中间移向路侧，前方路况可能是：一般弯道或连续弯道，当是连续弯道时灯光会随之从道路的一侧移到另一侧。

question_en: What can result from using the service brake continuously on a long downhill slope?
question_zh: 下长坡连续使用行车制动会导致什么？
options_en: A. It shortens the engine's lifespan | B. It increases the driver's workload | C. It easily causes the vehicle to overturn | D. It raises brake temperature and sharply reduces braking effectiveness
options_zh: A. 会缩短发动机寿命 | B. 增加驾驶人的劳动强度 | C. 容易造成车辆倾翻 | D. 会使制动器温度升高而使制动效果急剧下降
why_en: Continuous braking overheats the brakes and reduces effectiveness, so engine braking via downshifting should also be used.
explanation_zh: 持续用刹车，会造成刹车片发热，从而制动力减小，严重的会丧失制动能力，所以下长坡要用低挡，用发动机制动。

question_en: What is the main effect of rain on safe driving?
question_zh: 雨天对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. Electrical equipment easily gets damp and short-circuits | B. The road surface is slippery and visibility is obstructed | C. The engine easily stalls | D. Driving resistance increases
options_zh: A. 电器设备易受潮短路 | B. 路面湿滑，视线受阻 | C. 发动机易熄火 | D. 行驶阻力增大
why_en: Rain makes the road slippery and reduces visibility, so drivers must slow down and be cautious.
explanation_zh: （一）、雨水影响视线，要开适度的雨刮频次；（二）、空气潮湿容易在车的前档内表面形成雾气，要注意除雾；（三）、雨天路面易打滑，要保持安全的低速；（四）、特殊情况下，紧急制动时，务必保持方向稳定，防止侧翻；（五）、雨水易形成路面沟、洞表面积水，易造成驾驶员判断失误，谨慎避开。

question_en: What should you do when driving on a water-covered road with pedestrians on both sides?
question_zh: 当驾驶车辆行经两侧有行人且有积水的路面时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up and pass | B. Drive normally | C. Slow down | D. Honk continuously
options_zh: A. 加速通过 | B. 正常行驶 | C. 减速慢行 | D. 连续鸣喇叭
why_en: Courteous driving must not affect pedestrians' normal passage, so drivers should slow down.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，减速慢行。减速可以防止溅水，按喇叭有提醒的作用，但不能防止溅水。

question_en: When overtaking on a mountain road, how should you do it?
question_zh: 在山区道路超车时，应怎样超越？
options_en: A. Seize any opportunity as much as possible | B. Choose a wide, gentle uphill section | C. Choose a long downhill section | D. Choose a gentle downhill section
options_zh: A. 抓住任何机会尽量 | B. 选择宽阔的缓上坡路段 | C. 选择较长的下坡路 | D. 选择较缓的下坡路
why_en: Overtaking on a downhill section should be avoided as it easily causes accidents; a wide, gentle uphill section should be chosen instead.
explanation_zh: 下坡不允许超车，超车选择宽阔的缓上坡路段比较安全。上坡有阻力，不易滑车，也不易撞车，所以上坡宽阔地可以超车。

question_en: What is the main effect of muddy roads on safe driving?
question_zh: 泥泞道路对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. Driving resistance decreases | B. The wheels easily spin and skid | C. Visibility is low and blurry | D. Road surface traction increases
options_zh: A. 行驶阻力变小 | B. 车轮极易滑转和侧滑 | C. 能见度低，视野模糊 | D. 路面附着力增大
why_en: Muddy roads have low traction, easily causing the wheels to spin and skid, so drivers must be cautious.
explanation_zh: 泥泞路面特别松软和粘稠，车辆行驶阻力大，附着力小，车轮极易空转打滑，发生侧滑。

question_en: What should you do while another vehicle is overtaking you?
question_zh: 驾驶的车辆正在被其他车辆超越时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Drive close to the center of the road | B. Speed up to make way | C. Continue accelerating | D. Slow down and keep to the right
options_zh: A. 靠道路中心行驶 | B. 加速让路 | C. 继续加速行驶 | D. 减速，靠右侧行驶
why_en: When being overtaken, a driver should slow down and keep right to leave a sufficient safety distance.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When a motor vehicle enters a sharp bend, the top of a slope, or another section with poor sight distance, why should the driver slow down and honk?
question_zh: 机动车驶进急弯、坡道顶端等影响安全视距的路段时，减速慢行并鸣喇叭示意是为了什么？
options_en: A. To alert oncoming road users that a vehicle is approaching | B. To signal the vehicle ahead that the vehicle behind is about to overtake | C. To test whether the horn works properly | D. To avoid insufficient power at the top of the slope
options_zh: A. 提示对向交通参与者我方有来车 | B. 提示前车后方车辆准备超车 | C. 测试喇叭是否能正常使用 | D. 避免行至坡道顶端车辆动力不足
why_en: This alerts oncoming road users in advance, which is essential for safety at low-visibility sections.
explanation_zh: 急弯、坡道环境复杂，视距短，无法很好地观察对向交通情况，这时需鸣喇叭提示对向交通参与者我方有来车。

question_en: What is the main effect of mountain roads on safe driving?
question_zh: 山区道路对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. There are few road signs | B. Traffic conditions are simple | C. Long slopes and sharp bends with insufficient sight distance | D. Traffic density is high
options_zh: A. 道路标志少 | B. 交通情况单一 | C. 坡长弯急，视距不足 | D. 车流密度大
why_en: Mountain roads have long slopes, sharp bends, and insufficient sight distance, making accidents more likely than on flat roads.
explanation_zh: 山区道路的特点是：坡多、路窄、急弯多，不像平原地区视线开阔。最关键的一点是山区道路行驶时不容易掌握周围情况，也就是所谓视距不足。

question_en: When tire pressure is too low, high-speed driving causes the tire to deform in waves and heat up, leading to what?
question_zh: 轮胎气压过低时，高速行驶轮胎会出现波浪变形温度升高而导致什么？
options_en: A. Unstable pressure | B. Even lower pressure | C. Increased driving resistance | D. A tire blowout
options_zh: A. 气压不稳 | B. 气压更低 | C. 行驶阻力增大 | D. 爆胎
why_en: Both excessively high and low tire pressure can lead to a tire blowout.
explanation_zh: 轮胎气不足，就会造成轮胎与地面的摩擦范围增大，所以会使温度升高，从而爆胎。压力过低和过高都会导致爆胎。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, why is overtaking not allowed in this situation?
question_zh: 如图所示，在这种情况下不能够超车的原因是什么？
options_en: A. The vehicle ahead is overtaking | B. My vehicle's speed is insufficient to overtake the vehicle ahead | C. The vehicle ahead is going too fast | D. The centerline is a yellow line
options_zh: A. 前车正在超车 | B. 我方车速不足以超越前车 | C. 前车速度过快 | D. 路中心线为黄线
why_en: Overtaking can only be done from the left, and since the vehicle ahead is already overtaking, forcing past it would easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，前面蓝色的车正在超车，这个时候不能超车。

question_en: Why should a driver carefully observe traffic in the right lane before changing to it?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车向右变更车道前应仔细观察右侧车道车流情况的原因是什么？
options_en: A. To prepare to stop quickly | B. To prepare to rush ahead | C. To judge whether the conditions for a lane change are met | D. To change lanes quickly
options_zh: A. 准备迅速停车 | B. 准备抢行 | C. 判断有无变更车道的条件 | D. 迅速变更车道
why_en: A lane change must not affect other vehicles driving normally, so conditions must be judged first.
explanation_zh: 有变更车道条件，确认安全，才能变道。

question_en: When driving at night, in which of the following sections is overtaking acceptable?
question_zh: 夜间行车，可选择下列哪个地段超车？
options_en: A. Intersections | B. Curves and steep slopes | C. Wide roads with little traffic | D. Narrow roads and narrow bridges
options_zh: A. 交叉路口 | B. 弯道陡坡 | C. 路宽车少 | D. 窄路窄桥
why_en: Overtaking at night should generally be avoided, but a wide road with little traffic is the acceptable choice when necessary.
explanation_zh: 夜间行车，尽量避免超车。必须超车，就选择路宽车少的路段。

question_en: What should you do when a vehicle behind signals a request to overtake?
question_zh: 行车中遇到后方车辆要求超车时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down promptly, then move right after observing to yield | B. Maintain the original speed | C. Speed up while keeping right | D. Refuse to yield
options_zh: A. 及时减速、观察后靠右行驶让行 | B. 保持原有车速行驶 | C. 靠右侧加速行驶 | D. 不让行
why_en: Overtaking is always done from the left, so the vehicle ahead should slow down and move right to yield if conditions allow.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。基于安全和和谐的因素，所以要及时减速让行。

question_en: When you notice the road ahead is congested, what is the correct thing to do?
question_zh: 发现前方道路堵塞，正确的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Continue weaving through traffic | B. Overtake vehicles one by one whenever there is a gap | C. Honk to signal vehicles ahead to move faster | D. Stop and wait in order
options_zh: A. 继续穿插绕行 | B. 选择空当逐车超越 | C. 鸣喇叭示意前方车辆快速行驶 | D. 按顺序停车等候
why_en: Once traffic is already congested, drivers should not add to it, but stop and wait in order.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: A driver's ability to observe objects at night is clearly worse than in daytime; how does sight distance change?
question_zh: 夜间驾驶人对物体的观察明显比白天差，视距会有什么变化？
options_en: A. It becomes longer | B. It becomes shorter | C. It stays the same | D. It changes with no pattern
options_zh: A. 变长 | B. 变短 | C. 不变 | D. 无规律
why_en: At night, distant objects are less clear than in daytime, so sight distance becomes shorter.
explanation_zh: 夜晚，在路上行车，由于车灯作用，看到的是黑色背景中的亮色物体，所以亮色物体偏大，而眼睛依旧以近大远小的感觉判断，故视距减小。

question_en: When approaching an intersection without a crosswalk and you notice a pedestrian crossing the road, what should you do?
question_zh: 驶近没有人行横道的交叉路口时，发现有人横穿道路，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down or stop to yield | B. Honk to signal the pedestrian to give way | C. Immediately change lanes to go around the pedestrian | D. Rush through ahead of the pedestrian
options_zh: A. 减速或停车让行 | B. 鸣喇叭示意其让道 | C. 立即变道绕过行人 | D. 抢在行人之前通过
why_en: In any situation, motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What is the main characteristic of pedestrians participating in road traffic?
question_zh: 行人参与道路交通的主要特点是什么？
options_en: A. Slow movement | B. Tendency to gather and watch | C. Highly unpredictable walking behavior and frequent direction changes | D. All of the above
options_zh: A. 行动迟缓 | B. 喜欢聚集、围观 | C. 行走随意性大，方向多变 | D. 全部都是
why_en: Pedestrians' movements are highly unpredictable, so drivers must watch carefully and yield.
explanation_zh: 行动迟缓，是行人中某部分人的特点。喜欢聚集和围观不属于交通形式。因此排除这两个选项，“全部都是”此选项也随之排除。“行走随意性大，方向多变”对驾车不利，该选项最为准确。

question_en: What should you do when encountering a line of students crossing the road while driving?
question_zh: 行车中遇列队横过道路的学生时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up in advance to pass first | B. Stop and yield | C. Reduce speed and pass slowly | D. Honk continuously to hurry them
options_zh: A. 提前加速抢行 | B. 停车让行 | C. 降低车速、缓慢通过 | D. 连续鸣喇叭催促
why_en: Courteous driving puts safety first, so drivers should stop and yield to students crossing the road.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。注意，题中说的是列队，所以减速是不够的，必须停车。

question_en: When visibility is too low in dense or extremely heavy fog and driving becomes difficult, what should you do?
question_zh: 遇有浓雾或特大雾天能见度过低，行车困难时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Turn on the headlights and continue driving | B. Turn on the clearance lights and fog lights, and keep to the right | C. Turn on the hazard warning lights and continue driving | D. Turn on the hazard warning lights and fog lights, and stop at a safe location
options_zh: A. 开启前照灯，继续行驶 | B. 开启示廓灯、雾灯，靠右行驶 | C. 开启危险报警闪光灯，继续行驶 | D. 开启危险报警闪光灯和雾灯，选择安全地点停车
why_en: When driving poses a serious safety hazard, the vehicle should stop at a safe location with hazard and fog lights on.
explanation_zh: 行车困难，就不要勉强行车。开启危险报警闪光灯和雾灯，选择安全地点停车最安全。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, in which of the following situations is overtaking allowed?
question_zh: 如图所示，以下哪种情况可以超车？
why_en: A dashed line may be crossed but a solid line may not; white dashed lines separate same-direction lanes and yellow dashed lines separate opposing lanes.
explanation_zh: 这种情况超车要符合两个条件：虚线一侧，对向无来车。符合条件是50c。

question_en: When the chosen meeting position before passing an oncoming vehicle is not ideal, what should you do?
question_zh: 会车前选择的交会位置不理想时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down, pass at low speed, or stop to yield | B. Move left into the other lane and make the oncoming vehicle slow down and yield | C. Turn on the headlights to signal the oncoming vehicle to stop and yield | D. Speed up to reach an ideal position
options_zh: A. 减速、低速会车或停车让行 | B. 向左占道，让对方减速让行 | C. 打开前照灯，示意对方停车让行 | D. 加速选择理想位置
why_en: Courteous meeting of oncoming traffic puts safety first: slow down, pass slowly, or stop to yield.
explanation_zh: 发现交会位置不理想时，应减速或停车让行，以寻找下一个理想会车位置。

question_en: On a 4-lane (same direction) expressway, which lane should vehicles traveling faster than 110 km/h use?
question_zh: 在同向4车道高速公路上行车，车速高于每小时110公里的车辆应在哪条车道上行驶？
options_en: A. The leftmost lane | B. The second lane | C. The rightmost lane | D. The third lane
options_zh: A. 最左侧 | B. 第二条 | C. 最右侧 | D. 第三条
why_en: On a 4-lane expressway, the minimum speed limits from left to right are 110, 90, 90, and 60 km/h, so faster vehicles use the leftmost lane.
explanation_zh: 同向四车道左到右最低限速依次为：110、90、90、60。

question_en: When a vehicle must stop on an expressway due to a breakdown, how many meters behind the vehicle should the warning sign be placed?
question_zh: 车辆因故障必须在高速公路停车时，应在车后方多少米以外设置故障警告标志？
why_en: Warning signs should be placed 50 to 100 meters away on ordinary roads, and more than 150 meters away on expressways.
explanation_zh: 普通道路50, 100米，高速公路150米。

question_en: When a vehicle with the right of way at an intersection encounters another vehicle cutting in, what should you do?
question_zh: 车辆在交叉路口有优先通行权的，遇有车辆抢行时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Rush through | B. Speed up in advance to pass | C. Slow down to avoid it, and stop to yield if necessary | D. Drive normally according to right-of-way rules without yielding
options_zh: A. 抢行通过 | B. 提前加速通过 | C. 减速避让，必要时停车让行 | D. 按优先权规定正常行驶不予避让
why_en: Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still slow down and yield if needed.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When approaching a bus stopped at a station, what should you do to guard against the bus suddenly pulling out or a pedestrian darting out in front of it?
question_zh: 车辆驶近停在车站的公交车辆时，为预防公交车突然起步或行人从车前穿出，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down, keep a sufficient distance, and be ready to stop at any time | B. Maintain normal speed | C. Honk as a reminder and speed up to pass | D. Be ready for emergency braking at any time
options_zh: A. 减速，保持足够间距，随时准备停车 | B. 保持正常车速行驶 | C. 鸣喇叭提醒，加速通过 | D. 随时准备紧急制动
why_en: Courteous driving puts safety first near buses, requiring reduced speed and sufficient distance.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What lights should be turned on when a vehicle stops temporarily on a snowy day?
question_zh: 车辆在雪天临时停车时，应开启什么灯？
options_en: A. Front and rear fog lights | B. Reverse lights | C. Headlights | D. Hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 前后雾灯 | B. 倒车灯 | C. 前大灯 | D. 危险报警闪光灯
why_en: A temporary stop requires signaling vehicles behind with hazard warning lights.
explanation_zh: 下雪天开车危险，因此要临时停车，应当开启危险报警闪光灯，提醒其他车辆注意。

question_en: Before entering a curve on a mountain road with no oncoming traffic, what should you do?
question_zh: 山区道路车辆进入弯道前，在对面没有来车的情况下，应怎样做？
options_en: A. May drive on the outer side of the curve | B. May briefly use the opposite lane | C. May speed up and take a tangent line through the curve | D. Should slow down, honk, and keep to the right
options_zh: A. 可靠弯道外侧行驶 | B. 可短时间借用对方的车道 | C. 可加速沿弯道切线方向通过 | D. 应“减速、鸣喇叭、靠右行”
why_en: Safe driving requires slowing down, honking, and keeping to the right when entering a curve.
explanation_zh: 题目是驶入弯道前，必须鸣笛，因为不确定是否有车辆，减速是必须的，避免有车相撞。通过弯道，减速、鸣喇叭、靠右行，是最安全的做法。

question_en: What should you do when driving at night and an oncoming bicycle approaches?
question_zh: 夜间驾驶车辆遇自行车对向驶来时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Continuously switch between high and low beams | B. Honk continuously | C. Use low beams and slow down or stop to yield | D. Use high beams
options_zh: A. 连续变换远、近光灯 | B. 不断鸣喇叭 | C. 使用近光灯，减速或停车避让 | D. 使用远光灯
why_en: Using high beams or switching between beams blinds the oncoming cyclist, so low beams and slowing down are required instead.
explanation_zh: 安全第一。使用远光灯会使对方看不清，变换远近光灯也是一样，不断鸣喇叭会使对方产生抵触情绪，结果适得其反。

question_en: When changing lanes before an intersection, how should you merge into the target lane?
question_zh: 驾驶车辆在交叉路口前变更车道时，应怎样驶入要变更的车道？
options_en: A. Within the solid-line zone before the intersection as needed | B. Into the solid-line zone at the intersection | C. Within the dashed-line zone, following the guide arrows | D. Before the stop line at the intersection
options_zh: A. 在路口前实线区内根据需要 | B. 进入路口实线区内 | C. 在虚线区按导向箭头指示 | D. 在路口停止线前
why_en: Lane changes are allowed only in the dashed-line zone following the guide arrows; a solid line must not be crossed.
explanation_zh: 实线不可跨线行驶，应该在虚线区按导向箭头指示变更车道。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, when a through-traffic vehicle encounters a blocked intersection ahead, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 如图所示，直行车辆遇到前方路口堵塞，以下说法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Follow other vehicles into the intersection | B. Continue driving only after the road ahead clears and the light is green | C. May drive directly into the intersection and wait there | D. May proceed whenever the light is green
options_zh: A. 等其他机动车进入路口时跟随行驶 | B. 等前方道路疏通后，且信号灯为绿灯时方可继续行驶 | C. 可以直接驶入路口内等候通行 | D. 只有信号灯为绿灯，就可以通行
why_en: Stopping is prohibited on crosswalks and yellow grid markings, so the vehicle must wait outside the intersection until the road clears and the light turns green.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第五十三条：机动车遇有前方交叉路口交通阻塞时，应当依次停在路口以外等候，不得进入路口。

question_en: [Image] As shown in the figure, why should you abandon an overtaking maneuver when an oncoming vehicle appears?
question_zh: 如图所示，在超车过程中，遇对向有车来时要放弃超车的原因是什么？
options_en: A. The oncoming vehicle is going too fast | B. My vehicle accelerates too slowly | C. Continuing the overtake could easily cause a scrape or collision with the oncoming vehicle | D. The vehicle ahead is going too fast
options_zh: A. 对向来车车速太快 | B. 我方车辆提速太慢 | C. 如继续超车，易与对面机动车发生刮擦、相撞 | D. 前车车速太快
why_en: Overtaking requires being on the dashed-line side with no oncoming traffic; if a vehicle appears, continuing risks a collision and the overtake must be abandoned.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，对向车道有来车，前方车辆左侧没有足够的安全距离，应放弃超车，避免与对面车辆发生刮擦、相撞。

question_en: When another vehicle suddenly forces an overtake and occupies your lane, what is the correct response?
question_zh: 行车中突遇对方车辆强行超车，占据自己车道，正确的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Speed up | B. Slow down as much as possible to avoid it, even stopping if needed | C. Maintain the original speed | D. Block its way
options_zh: A. 加速行驶 | B. 尽可能减速避让、直至停车 | C. 保持原车速行驶 | D. 挡住其去路
why_en: Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still slow down to avoid a collision, even stopping if necessary.
explanation_zh: 行车要记得安全文明驾驶。后方要超车，我们就让让吧。“宁停三分，不抢一秒”。

question_en: When the vehicle behind signals to overtake, what should you do as long as conditions allow yielding?
question_zh: 遇后车发出超车信号后，只要具备让超条件应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up while keeping to the right | B. Proactively slow down and move to the right | C. Speed up while leaving appropriate space | D. Slow down quickly or brake urgently
options_zh: A. 靠道路右侧加速行驶 | B. 主动减速并靠右侧行驶 | C. 让出适当空间加速行驶 | D. 迅速减速或紧急制动
why_en: When being overtaken, a driver should slow down and move right to leave a sufficient safety distance.
explanation_zh: 文明驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When driving on an expressway in fog, rain, snow, sandstorms, hail, or other low-visibility weather, and visibility drops below 50 meters, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件时，能见度在50米以下时，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Speed up to leave the expressway | B. Stop and wait in the emergency lane | C. May continue driving, but not faster than 40 km/h | D. Exit the expressway as soon as possible from the nearest exit at no more than 20 km/h
options_zh: A. 加速驶离高速公路 | B. 在应急车道上停车等待 | C. 可以继续行驶，但车速不得超过每小时40公里 | D. 以不超过每小时20公里的车速从最近的出口尽快驶离高速公路
why_en: Below 50 meters of visibility, drivers must leave the expressway via the nearest exit at no more than 20 km/h.
explanation_zh: 机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件时，能见度小于50米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯、前后位灯和危险报警闪光灯，车速不得超过每小时20公里，并从最近的出口尽快驶离高速公路。

question_en: When the light for your lane is green but pedestrians are still crossing the crosswalk ahead, what should you do?
question_zh: 行驶车道绿灯亮时，但车辆前方人行横道仍有行人行走，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Start moving and pass through directly | B. Start moving and go around behind the pedestrians | C. Start moving and go around in front of the pedestrians | D. Wait until the pedestrians have crossed before starting
options_zh: A. 直接起步通过 | B. 起步后从行人后方绕过 | C. 起步后从行人前方绕过 | D. 等行人通过后再起步
why_en: In any situation, motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians, even with a green light.
explanation_zh: 以人为本，安全第一，礼让行人。

question_en: Why should you honk frequently when driving in heavy fog?
question_zh: 大雾天行车，多鸣喇叭是为了什么？
options_en: A. To prepare to overtake the vehicle ahead | B. To draw the attention of other drivers and avoid danger | C. To urge the vehicle ahead to yield | D. To urge the vehicle ahead to speed up and avoid a rear-end collision
options_zh: A. 准备超越前车 | B. 引起对方注意，避免发生危险 | C. 催促前车让行 | D. 催促前车提速，避免发生追尾。
why_en: In fog, honking helps drivers alert each other and avoid danger.
explanation_zh: 大雾天气能见度低，鸣喇叭是为了提醒对方，这边有车，这样能避免发生事故。

question_en: When overtaking and the vehicle ahead neither slows down nor yields, what should you do?
question_zh: 驾驶人在超车时，前方车辆不减速、不让道，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk continuously and speed up to overtake | B. Speed up and continue overtaking | C. Stop the overtake | D. Follow closely and wait for another chance to overtake
options_zh: A. 连续鸣喇叭加速超越 | B. 加速继续超越 | C. 停止继续超车 | D. 紧跟其后，伺机再超
why_en: Forcing an overtake easily causes traffic accidents, so the attempt should be abandoned.
explanation_zh: 前方不让道，说明不具备超车条件，停止超车是最安全的做法。

question_en: What is the main effect of icy or snowy roads on safe driving?
question_zh: 冰雪道路对安全行车的主要影响是什么？
options_en: A. Electrical equipment easily gets damp and short-circuits | B. Visibility decreases and the view becomes blurry | C. Driving resistance increases | D. Poor braking performance and steering easily veers off course
options_zh: A. 电器设备易受潮短路 | B. 能见度降低，视野模糊 | C. 行驶阻力增大 | D. 制动性能差，方向易跑偏
why_en: Icy and snowy roads cause poor braking and easy loss of steering control, so drivers must be cautious.
explanation_zh: 先看清题目，题目问的是“冰雪道路”。冰雪路面很滑，车辆在上面行驶制动性能差，方向易跑偏。因汽车轮胎与路面的摩擦系数减小、附着力大大降低，汽车驱动轮很容易打滑或空转，尤其是上坡、起步、停车时还会出现后溜车的现象;车辆在行驶中如果突然加速或减速，很容易造成侧滑及方向跑偏现象;遇情况紧急制动时，制动距离会大大延长。

question_en: After slowing down and downshifting before a railway crossing, what should you do once inside the crossing?
question_zh: 驾驶车辆驶入铁路道口前减速降挡，进入道口后应怎样做？
options_en: A. Do not change gears | B. May change gears | C. May shift to a higher gear | D. Stop to observe
options_zh: A. 不能变换挡位 | B. 可以变换挡位 | C. 可换为高挡 | D. 停车观察
why_en: Changing gears inside the crossing risks stalling the engine, which is very dangerous there.
explanation_zh: 进入铁道路口后不能变换挡位，换挡容易熄火。

question_en: How should you pass an oncoming vehicle on a mountain road?
question_zh: 在山区道路遇对向来车时，应怎样会车？
options_en: A. Stay close to the center of the road | B. Do not slow down | C. Speed up | D. Slow down or stop to yield
options_zh: A. 紧靠道路中心 | B. 不减速 | C. 加速 | D. 减速或停车让行
why_en: Courteous driving means slowing down or stopping to yield to oncoming vehicles.
explanation_zh: 山区道路比较复杂，容易出事故，为了安全，会车时要减速或者停车让行。

question_en: When driving on an expressway in rain or snow, drivers must slow down and keep a safe distance; which of the following is NOT a correct reason for this?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上遇到雨雪天气时，需要降低车速、保持安全距离的原因，以下说法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Visibility decreases, making it hard to spot vehicles ahead in time | B. Braking distance increases in such weather | C. It provides a sufficient safety margin for safe driving | D. It reduces the damage that severe weather causes to the vehicle
options_zh: A. 能见度下降，驾驶人难以及时发现前方车辆 | B. 此类天气条件下的道路上，车辆的制动距离变长 | C. 为车辆安全行驶提供足够的安全距离 | D. 降低恶劣天气对车辆造成的损害
why_en: The real reasons are reduced visibility and longer braking distance, not preventing weather damage to the vehicle, which is the incorrect option.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上遇到雨雪天气时能见度下降，驾驶人难以及时发现前方车辆，在此类天气条件下的道路上，车辆的制动距离变长，需要降低车速，为车辆安全行驶提供足够的安全距离。

question_en: When driving in rain and encountering pedestrians walking on the road with umbrellas or raincoats, what should you do?
question_zh: 雨天行车，遇撑雨伞和穿雨衣的行人在公路上行走时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk continuously to signal them to give way | B. Speed up and go around | C. Honk in advance and slow down appropriately | D. Drive at normal speed
options_zh: A. 持续鸣喇叭示意其让道 | B. 加速绕行 | C. 提前鸣喇叭，并适当降低车速 | D. 以正常速度行驶
why_en: Courteous driving must not affect pedestrians' normal passage, so honk in advance and slow down.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，减速慢行。遇到撑雨伞和穿雨衣的行人会使视线受阻碍，所以要鸣喇叭，雨天路滑所以要减速。

question_en: After wading through water, a vehicle should keep driving at low speed; how should the brake pedal be operated to restore braking effectiveness?
question_zh: 车辆涉水后，应保持低速行驶，怎样操作制动踏板，以恢复制动效果？
options_en: A. Continuously press hard | B. Intermittently press hard | C. Continuously press lightly | D. Intermittently press lightly
options_zh: A. 持续重踏 | B. 间断重踏 | C. 持续轻踏 | D. 间断轻踏
why_en: Continuous or hard pressing may cause the engine to stall, so the brakes should be tapped intermittently and lightly.
explanation_zh: 间断轻踏，给刹车片一些温度可以蒸发一些水，恢复制动。

question_en: Answering phone calls while driving easily causes accidents; which of the following is NOT a correct reason for this?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车时接打电话容易引发事故，以下原因错误的是什么?
options_en: A. Holding the wheel with one hand reduces vehicle control | B. The driver becomes distracted and cannot judge danger promptly | C. The phone signal interferes with the car's electronic systems | D. The driver observes road conditions inadequately, easily causing operational errors
options_zh: A. 单手握方向盘，对机动车控制力下降 | B. 驾驶人注意力不集中，不能及时判断危险 | C. 电话的信号会对汽车电子设备的运行造成干扰 | D. 驾驶人对路况观察不到位，容易导致操作失误
why_en: Phone signal interference with electronics is not a real hazard; the other three factors are what actually cause accidents.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车时接打电话容易引发事故，主要是因为接电话时单手握方向盘，对机动车控制力下降；驾驶人注意力不集中，不能及时判断危险；驾驶人对路况观察不到位，容易导致操作失误。

question_en: What should you do when driving on a water-covered road with non-motor vehicles on both sides?
question_zh: 当驾驶车辆行经两侧有非机动车行驶且有积水的路面时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Slow down | B. Drive normally | C. Speed up and pass | D. Honk continuously
options_zh: A. 减速慢行 | B. 正常行驶 | C. 加速通过 | D. 连续鸣喇叭
why_en: Courteous driving must not affect others' normal passage, so drivers should slow down.
explanation_zh: 安全文明，减速慢行。减速可以防止溅水，按喇叭有提醒的作用，但不能防止溅水。

question_en: After entering the acceleration lane of an expressway, how quickly should you raise your speed above what value, in km/h?
question_zh: 驾驶车辆进入高速公路加速车道后，应尽快将车速提高到每小时多少公里以上？
why_en: The minimum speed on an expressway is 60 km/h and the maximum is 120 km/h.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车进入高速公路，应该尽快在加速车道将车速提到60km/h以上，再进入主车道行驶。因为高速公路加速车道最低行驶速度60公里每小时。

question_en: What should you do when a motor vehicle makes a temporary stop at the roadside?
question_zh: 机动车在道路边临时停车时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Must not park facing the wrong way or side by side with another vehicle | B. May park anywhere convenient | C. May park facing the wrong way | D. May park side by side with another vehicle
options_zh: A. 不得逆向或并列停放 | B. 只要出去方便，可随意停放 | C. 可逆向停放 | D. 可并列停放
why_en: Temporary parking must not obstruct other vehicles and pedestrians, so parking facing the wrong way or side by side is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 在路边临时停车时应遵循“不影响正常交通”的原则，因此除了要靠路边之外，还要尽可能留出空间便于其他车辆通行。

question_en: While driving, if a road maintenance vehicle approaches from the wrong direction in your lane, what is the correct response?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车行驶过程中，遇道路养护车辆从本车道逆向驶来时，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Move aside, slow down, or stop to yield | B. Continue driving in the same lane | C. Use the non-motor vehicle lane | D. Honk to signal it to yield
options_zh: A. 靠边减速或停车让行 | B. 在原车道继续行驶 | C. 占用非机动车道行驶 | D. 鸣喇叭示意其让道
why_en: Road maintenance vehicles at work are not bound by traffic signs and markings, so other drivers should move aside, slow down, or stop to yield.
explanation_zh: 道路养护车辆有优先权，一定要让行，且要注意正确答案中有“靠边”二字。

question_en: After rain, roads are slippery; what can easily result from emergency braking while driving?
question_zh: 下雨后路面湿滑，车辆行驶中紧急制动时，容易导致什么？
options_en: A. Causing the engine to stall | B. Not being noticed by other drivers | C. A collision due to blurred vision | D. Skidding and causing a traffic accident
options_zh: A. 引起发动机熄火 | B. 不被其他车辆驾驶人发现 | C. 因视线模糊而撞车 | D. 发生侧滑、引发交通事故
why_en: Emergency braking on wet roads easily causes skidding and accidents, so drivers should be cautious and avoid it.
explanation_zh: 下雨时路面湿滑，轮胎与路面之间的滑动摩擦系数小，相应的摩擦力也要变小。所以紧急制动时，汽车轮胎停止滚动，而向前滑动。或者说滑动摩擦力不能有效减慢汽车速度导致汽车还要向前滑出很大段距离。因此下雨路滑，宜减速行驶。

question_en: What should you do when a non-motor vehicle ahead is about to go around a parked vehicle?
question_zh: 行车中遇有非机动车准备绕过停放的车辆时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk to signal it to yield | B. Let it go first | C. Follow closely and honk | D. Speed up and go around it
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭示意其让道 | B. 让其先行 | C. 紧随其后鸣喇叭 | D. 加速绕过
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: What should you do when you notice congestion on the road ahead?
question_zh: 行车中发现前方道路拥堵时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Look for a chance to overtake the vehicle ahead | B. Weave through gaps between vehicles | C. Slow down, stop, and queue in order | D. Honk to hurry others
options_zh: A. 寻找机会超越前车 | B. 从车辆空间穿插通过 | C. 减速停车，依次排队等候 | D. 鸣喇叭催促
why_en: Once traffic is already congested, drivers should not add to it, but slow down and queue in order.
explanation_zh: 减速停车依次排队，文明驾驶。

question_en: When driving on an icy or snowy mountain road and the vehicle ahead is climbing a slope, what should the following vehicle do?
question_zh: 在山区冰雪道路上行车，遇有前车正在爬坡时，后车应怎样做？
options_en: A. Stop at a suitable location and wait until the vehicle ahead has passed before climbing | B. Quickly overtake the vehicle ahead | C. Climb the slope at low speed | D. Follow closely behind while climbing
options_zh: A. 选择适当地点停车，等前车通过后再爬坡 | B. 迅速超越前车 | C. 低速爬坡 | D. 紧随其后爬坡
why_en: On icy or snowy roads, following closely while climbing a slope should be avoided; wait for the vehicle ahead to pass first.
explanation_zh: 冰雪路面很滑，正在爬坡的车可能会后溜，最安全的做法是选择安全地点停车，等前车通过后再爬坡。

question_en: What should you do when driving over an uneven road surface?
question_zh: 车辆通过凹凸路面时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Rely on momentum and rush through | B. Shift into neutral and coast through | C. Pass through at the original speed | D. Pass through slowly, steadily, and at low speed
options_zh: A. 依靠惯性加速冲过 | B. 挂空挡滑行驶过 | C. 保持原速通过 | D. 低速缓慢平稳通过
why_en: Not slowing down can damage the tires, and the bumpy surface can also affect safe driving.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，减速慢行。凹凸不平的路面减速慢行不仅对车有好处而且不会因颠簸影响驾驶。

question_en: Why does the rule require using low beams within 150 meters when meeting an oncoming vehicle at night?
question_zh: 夜间会车规定150米以内使用近光灯的原因是什么？
options_en: A. So the two vehicles can alert each other | B. Using high beams would blind the other driver, easily causing danger | C. To alert vehicles behind | D. It is just a habitual driving action
options_zh: A. 两车之间相互提示 | B. 使用远光灯会造成驾驶人出现眩目，易引发危险 | C. 提示后方车辆 | D. 驾驶人的操作习惯行为
why_en: High beams would blind the oncoming driver and create danger, so low beams must be used within 150 meters.
explanation_zh: 常识题。远光会影响前车视线，会车时不得开远光。

question_en: On an expressway with complete signs and markings, drivers should follow the lane and speed rules set by what?
question_zh: 在标志、标线齐全的高速公路上行车，应当按照什么规定的车道和车速行驶？
options_en: A. Signs or markings | B. The Road Traffic Safety Law | C. The vehicle owner's manual | D. Local regulations
options_zh: A. 标志或标线 | B. 《道路交通安全法》 | C. 车辆说明书 | D. 地方法规
why_en: When signs and markings are complete, drivers should follow them.
explanation_zh: 这个题有前提，前提是在“在标志、标线齐全的高速公路上行车”。根据规定，在标志、标线齐全的路段，按标志、标线行驶。

question_en: What should you do when an ambulance rescuing injured people approaches from the wrong direction in your lane?
question_zh: 行车中遇抢救伤员的救护车从本车道逆向驶来时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Move aside, slow down, or stop to yield | B. Use another lane | C. Speed up and change lanes to avoid it | D. Continue driving in the same lane
options_zh: A. 靠边减速或停车让行 | B. 占用其他车道行驶 | C. 加速变更车道避让 | D. 在原车道内继续行驶
why_en: Drivers must proactively yield to special vehicles performing emergency duties, such as an ambulance.
explanation_zh: 遇到正在执行任务的特种车辆，应当予以让行。

question_en: Why should the turn signal remain on throughout a turn at an intersection?
question_zh: 路口转弯过程中，持续开启转向灯，主要原因是因为什么？
options_en: A. To let other drivers know you are overtaking | B. Turning off the signal before completing the turn would damage the vehicle | C. To let other drivers know you are turning | D. Turning off the signal before completing the turn is just a habitual action
options_zh: A. 让其他驾驶人知道您在超车 | B. 完成转弯动作前，关闭转向灯会对车辆造成损害 | C. 让其他驾驶人知道您正在转弯 | D. 完成转弯动作前，关闭转向灯是习惯动作
why_en: The turn signal must stay on throughout the turn so other drivers know you are turning, and be switched off only after completing it.
explanation_zh: 转向灯一般就是起提示其他车辆的作用。

question_en: When driving on a narrow mountain road and the vehicle on the mountainside does not yield, what should you do?
question_zh: 车辆在较窄的山路上行驶时，如果靠山体的一方不让行，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Honk to urge it to yield | B. Maintain normal speed | C. Slow down or stop in advance to yield | D. Move left into the other lane and pass cautiously
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭催其让行 | B. 保持正常车速行驶 | C. 提前减速或停车避让 | D. 向左占道，谨慎驶过
why_en: On a narrow mountain road, the vehicle in the relatively safer position should yield first, so this vehicle should slow down or stop.
explanation_zh: 安全驾驶，礼貌让行。

question_en: When driving on an expressway in fog, rain, snow, sandstorms, hail, or other low-visibility weather with visibility below 100 meters, what is the maximum allowed speed, and what minimum distance must be kept from the vehicle ahead in the same lane?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件下，能见度在100米以下时，车速不得超过每小时多少公里，与同车道前车至少保持多少米的距离？
why_en: Below 100 meters of visibility, speed must not exceed 40 km/h and following distance must be at least 50 meters.
explanation_zh: 能见度小于200米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯和前后位灯，车速不得超过每小时60公里，与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离；能见度小于100米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯、前后位灯和危险报警闪光灯，车速不得超过每小时40公里，与同车道前车保持50米以上的距离；能见度小于50米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯、前后位灯和危险报警闪光灯，车速不得超过每小时20公里，并从最近的出口尽快驶离高速公路。

question_en: Why is a flooded road surface dangerous and hard to pass safely?
question_zh: 水淹路面影响行车安全，不易通行的原因是什么？
options_en: A. Hidden potholes and raised surfaces cannot be seen | B. Road surface traction increases | C. Visibility is low and blurry | D. Sunlight reflection blocks the view
options_zh: A. 无法观察到暗坑和凸起的路面 | B. 路面附着力增大 | C. 能见度低，视野模糊 | D. 日光反射阻挡视线
why_en: On a flooded road, hidden potholes and bumps cannot be seen, so drivers should stop to check the water conditions before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 水把路给淹了，看不到路面情况，这个是很危险的；有些没有窨井盖，有些有大石头凸起，都看不到。

question_en: When the lanes ahead merge and traffic is moving slowly, what should you do to ensure safety and order?
question_zh: 遇前方路段车道减少，车辆行驶缓慢，为了保证安全有序应该怎么做？
