options_en: A. Take turns merging one by one | B. Use the opposite lane to pass quickly | C. Speed up and overtake the vehicle ahead on either side | D. Cut into the queue of vehicles ahead
options_zh: A. 依次交替通行 | B. 借对向车道迅速通过 | C. 加速从前车左右超越 | D. 穿插到前方排队车辆中通过
why_en: Taking turns merging one by one prevents further road congestion.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十三条：机动车在车道减少的路口、路段，遇有前方机动车停车排队等候或者缓慢行驶的，应当每车道一辆依次交替驶入车道减少后的路口、路段。

question_en: Which of the following is an incorrect way to avoid a tire blowout?
question_zh: 避免爆胎的错误的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Lowering tire pressure | B. Regularly checking the tires | C. Promptly removing foreign objects from the tire grooves | D. Replacing tires that are cracked or severely damaged
options_zh: A. 降低轮胎气压 | B. 定期检查轮胎 | C. 及时清理轮胎沟槽里的异物 | D. 更换掉有裂纹或有很深损伤的轮胎
why_en: Regular checks, prompt cleaning, and replacing damaged tires effectively prevent blowouts; lowering tire pressure does not.
explanation_zh: 轮胎缺气行驶是爆胎的祸根。车辆的缺气（轮胎胎压低于标准胎压）行驶时，随着胎压的下降，轮胎与地面的摩擦成倍增加，胎温急剧升高，轮胎变软，强度急剧下降。这种情况下，如果车辆高速行驶，就可能导致爆胎。如果车辆低速行驶，也会伤胎，而且潜伏期长，隐蔽性大，更有危害性，为以后高速行车时埋下爆胎隐患，所以降低轮胎气压是错误的做法。

question_en: When overtaking via the left lane and unable to maintain a safe lateral distance from the vehicle ahead traveling normally, what should you do?
question_zh: 进入左侧道路超车，无法保证与正常行驶前车的横向安全间距时，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Overtake cautiously | B. Give up overtaking | C. Drive alongside for a distance before overtaking | D. Accelerate to overtake
options_zh: A. 谨慎超越 | B. 放弃超车 | C. 并行一段距离后再超越 | D. 加速超越
why_en: Without safe overtaking conditions, you should give up overtaking.
explanation_zh: 没有超车条件，放弃超车是最安全的行为。

question_en: When a driver sees a "watch for children" sign while driving, what should they do?
question_zh: 驾驶人行车中看到注意儿童标志的时候，应怎样做？
options_en: A. Speed up | B. Take a detour | C. Maintain normal speed | D. Carefully choose driving speed
options_zh: A. 加速行驶 | B. 绕道行驶 | C. 保持正常车速行驶 | D. 谨慎选择行车速度
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 看到注意儿童标志的时候说明附近可能是幼儿园等地方，要谨慎选择行车速度以免撞到小孩子。

question_en: When the light is green at a congested intersection, what should a vehicle do?
question_zh: 在堵车的交叉路口绿灯亮时，车辆应怎样做？
options_en: A. May enter the intersection directly | B. Must not enter the intersection | C. May use the oncoming lane to pass through | D. Enter the intersection if safety is ensured
options_zh: A. 可直接驶入交叉路口 | B. 不能驶入交叉路口 | C. 可借对向车道通过路口 | D. 在保证安全的情况下驶入交叉路口
why_en: If it is already congested, do not add to the jam.
explanation_zh: 前方堵车，这时进入交叉路口只能更堵。

question_en: [Image] For the white car on the left in the picture, to ensure safety in this situation, speed should be appropriately reduced.
question_zh: 图中左侧白色轿车，在这种情况下为了保证安全，应适当降低车速。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive courteously and do not speed.
explanation_zh: 限速标志指示该路段限速60公里/小时，而速度仪表显示当前时速已在60公里/小时，为了避免超速，所以应该适当减速。

question_en: Which statement is correct about driving a motor vehicle down a steep slope?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车下陡坡时，以下说法正确的是？
options_en: A. May turn off the engine | B. May use neutral but must not turn off the engine | C. May use neutral | D. Neutral or turning off the engine is not allowed
options_zh: A. 可以熄火 | B. 可以空挡但不准熄火 | C. 可以空挡 | D. 不准空挡或熄火
why_en: Coasting in neutral downhill can cause loss of control and brake failure.
explanation_zh: 空挡会让车失去发动机制动能力，熄火会让刹车和转向失灵。

question_en: While braking on a slippery road, if the vehicle veers off course, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 湿滑路面制动过程中，发现车辆偏离方向，以下做法正确的是？
options_en: A. Repeatedly tap and release the brake pedal lightly | B. Press the brake pedal hard | C. Do not press the brake pedal | D. Press the brake pedal arbitrarily
options_zh: A. 连续轻踩轻放制动踏板 | B. 用力踩制动踏板 | C. 不要踩制动踏板 | D. 任意踩制动踏板
why_en: On slippery roads, braking hard cannot brake normally and may cause skidding and loss of control.
explanation_zh: 这个情况下，立即踏制动踏板容易引起侧翻。如后轮一直被刹住的情况下，不松开踏板，汽车会出现甩尾现象；如前轮一直被刹住的情况下不松开踏板，汽车会出现方向失去控制。正确的做法是先握紧方向盘，不要紧急踩刹车。

question_en: When driving on this type of uphill section, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 行驶至这种上坡路段时，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Shift to a lower gear and press the accelerator | B. Shift to a lower gear and release the accelerator | C. Shift to a higher gear and press the accelerator | D. Shift to a higher gear and release the accelerator
options_zh: A. 换低挡位，踏加速踏板 | B. 换低挡位，松开加速踏板 | C. 换高挡位，踏加速踏板 | D. 换高挡位，松开加速踏板
why_en: A lower gear gives the engine more pulling power, and pressing the accelerator maintains uphill speed and prevents rolling back.
explanation_zh: 图片中这样的陡坡，挂低挡是为了获得更多的发动机牵引力，如果松开加速踏板，会导致发动机失去动力造成车辆溜坡。

question_en: Which of the following can help you avoid being rear-ended by another vehicle?
question_zh: 下面哪种做法能帮助您避免被其他车辆从后方追撞？
options_en: A. Keep the turn signal on at all times | B. Turn on the corresponding turn signal in advance before turning | C. Keep the hazard lights on at all times | D. Honk the horn before turning
options_zh: A. 在任何时候都打开转向灯 | B. 在转弯前提前打开相应的转向灯 | C. 一直打开双闪 | D. 转弯前鸣笛示意
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 其它三个选项，都不能给其它车辆明确的信号提示。

question_en: While driving at night, when meeting an oncoming vehicle, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 夜间行驶，与对向车道车辆交会时，以下做法正确的是？
options_en: A. Keep using high beams | B. Keep switching back and forth between high and low beams | C. Switch to low beams | D. Turn off the lights
options_zh: A. 保持使用远光灯 | B. 远光灯与近光灯之间不断来回切换 | C. 切换为近光灯 | D. 关闭灯光
why_en: High beams must not be used when meeting oncoming traffic at night.
explanation_zh: 打开远光灯或者近光灯不断来回切换，容易影响对面司机的视线。关闭灯光，对面的司机就看不到你了。

question_en: Neutral gear is prohibited on long downhill slopes. Which of the following reasons is incorrect?
question_zh: 长下坡禁止挂空挡，下列原因错误的是？
options_en: A. Using a low gear on a long downhill helps control speed with engine braking | B. To avoid danger from brake failure | C. If coasting in neutral on a long downhill causes excessive speed, it becomes hard to shift into a low gear to control speed | D. Using neutral downhill tends to increase fuel consumption
options_zh: A. 长下坡挂低速挡可以借助发动机控制车速 | B. 避免因刹车失灵发生危险 | C. 长下坡空挡滑行导致车速过高时，难以抢挂低速档控制车速 | D. 下坡挂空挡，油耗容易增多
why_en: Coasting downhill in neutral can cause loss of control and brake failure; engine braking should be used to control speed.
explanation_zh: 因为长下坡空挡滑行时，一旦遇到突发情况紧急制动，没有发动机的制动作用不仅制动效果不好，而且容易使车辆失去平衡发生侧滑，甚至出现制动失效、转向失灵等极端情况，很容易引发严重的交通事故。空挡滑行不但不省油，会伤车，而且还不安全。请注意，题目问原因错误的，因此选油耗增多。

question_en: When a vehicle needs to be towed due to breakdown or other reasons, which statement is correct?
question_zh: 车辆因故障等原因需被牵引时，以下说法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Both the towing and towed vehicles should turn on hazard lights | B. All vehicles should yield | C. Both vehicles should drive as fast as possible | D. Not subject to traffic signal restrictions
options_zh: A. 前后车均应打开报警灯 | B. 所有车辆都应让行 | C. 两车尽量快速行驶 | D. 不受交通信号限制
why_en: When towing, both the front and rear vehicles should have their hazard lights on.
explanation_zh: 打开报警灯是必须的，而且被牵引的机动车除驾驶人外不得载人，不得拖带挂车。

question_en: If you are driving on a bumpy road section, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 假如你驾车行驶在颠簸路段时，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Hold the accelerator steady | B. Shift to a low gear and slowly ease off the accelerator | C. Shift to a high gear and slowly ease off the accelerator | D. Shift to a low gear and press the accelerator fully
options_zh: A. 稳住加速踏板 | B. 挂低挡档位缓抬加速踏板 | C. 挂高挡位缓抬加速踏板 | D. 挂低挡位踏满加速踏板
why_en: Drive slowly and cautiously over bumpy road sections.
explanation_zh: 缓抬加速踏板是为了低速平稳通过颠簸路段，让车辆怠速前进；挂低挡是为了获得更多的发动机牵引力。

question_en: In foggy weather, you may honk the horn frequently to urge the vehicle ahead to speed up and avoid a rear-end collision.
question_zh: 雾天行车可多鸣喇叭催促前车提速，避免发生追尾。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Honking is meant as a warning, not to urge others on.
explanation_zh: 大雾天气能见度低，鸣喇叭是为了提醒对方，这边有车，这样能避免发生事故。

question_en: [Image] Can the motor vehicle shown in the picture enter and drive on the expressway?
question_zh: 驾驶图中这辆机动车能否进入高速公路行驶？
options_en: A. It may enter if accompanied by a driver holding a license for this vehicle type providing guidance | B. It may enter through the toll booth with permission from toll staff | C. It is allowed to enter accompanied by a driver who has held a license for this vehicle type for over 3 years | D. A driver who holds a license permitting this vehicle type may drive in independently
options_zh: A. 有取得该车型驾驶证驾驶人随车指导可以进入 | B. 在高速公路收费人员许可的前提下通过收费口进入 | C. 在持该车型驾驶证3年以上驾驶人陪同下允许进入 | D. 取得准驾该车型驾驶证的驾驶人可以独立驾驶进入
why_en: A probationary driver may not drive alone on an expressway.
explanation_zh: 实习期上高速公路，要有取得持该车型驾驶证3年以上驾驶人陪同允许进入。

question_en: [Image] In the weather shown in the picture, due to low visibility, high beams need to be turned on to alert oncoming vehicles.
question_zh: 在图中所示的这种天气行车，由于能见度较低，需要开启远光灯告知对向来车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Using high beams will impair the vision of oncoming drivers and can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 因为雨天视线受阻，所以雨天与车辆近距离行驶时不能使用远光灯，应当开启前照灯、示廓灯和后位灯。

question_en: If a motor vehicle breaks down on an ordinary road and cannot be moved, hazard warning lights should be turned on in advance and a warning sign placed 50 to 100 meters behind the vehicle.
question_zh: 机动车在一般道路上发生故障，难以移动时，应提前开启危险报警闪光灯并在车后50-100米设置警告标志。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Warning sign placement: 50-100 meters on ordinary roads, beyond 150 meters on expressways.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第六十条：
机动车在道路上发生故障或者发生交通事故，妨碍交通又难以移动的，应当按照规定开启危险报警闪光灯并在车后50米至100米处设置警告标志，夜间还应当同时开启示廓灯和后位灯。扩展提示：高速公路上要在车后150米外设置警告标志。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates that the maximum speed on the road ahead is limited to below 50 km/h.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方道路的最高车速限制在每小时50公里以下。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A blue background with white figures indicates minimum speed; a red circle with white background indicates maximum speed.
explanation_zh: 指示标志，最低限速50公里每小时。

question_en: On a narrow mountain road without a center line, the side closer to the hillside should yield to the side away from the hillside.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在没有道路中心线的狭窄山路，靠山体的一方要让不靠山体的一方先行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The relatively safer side should yield to the relatively more dangerous side.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第四十八条：在没有中心隔离设施或者没有中心线的道路上，在狭窄的山路，不靠山体的一方先行。

question_en: The minimum speed for driving in this lane is 120 km/h.
question_zh: 在这条车道行驶的最低车速是120公里。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A blue background with white figures indicates minimum speed; a red circle with white background indicates maximum speed.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第七十八条：
高速公路应当标明车道的行驶速度，最高车速不得超过每小时120公里，最低车速不得低于每小时60公里。
在高速公路上行驶的小型载客汽车最高车速不得超过每小时120公里，其他机动车不得超过每小时100公里，摩托车不得超过每小时80公里。
同方向有2条车道的，左侧车道的最低车速为每小时100公里。
同方向有3条以上车道的，最左侧车道的最低车速为每小时110公里，中间车道的最低车速为每小时90公里。道路限速标志标明的车速与上述车道行驶车速的规定不一致的，按照道路限速标志标明的车速行驶。
我们可以清楚的看出图中的车在同方向车道的左车道，所以最低车速为每小时100公里。

question_en: When driving on an expressway under weather conditions with visibility below 200 meters, the maximum speed must not exceed 60 km/h, and the distance from the vehicle ahead must be kept above 100 meters.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路遇到能见度低于200米的气象条件时，最高车速不能超过60公里/小时，与前车距离要保持100米以上。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Standard rule: visibility under 200m caps speed at 60 km/h and requires a following distance over 100 meters.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第八十一条：
机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件时，应当遵守下列规定：能见度小于200米时，开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯和前后位灯，车速不得超过每小时60公里，与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离。

question_en: On a city road with only one lane per direction, the maximum speed for a motor vehicle must not exceed 70 km/h.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在同方向只有1条机动车道的城市道路，最高速度不能超过每小时70公里。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Without a center line, city road speed is capped at 30 km/h, not 70 km/h.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第四十五条：在没有限速标志、标线的道路上，机动车不得超过下列最高行驶速度：(一)没有道路中心线的道路，城市道路为每小时30公里，公路为每小时40公里；(二)同方向只有1条机动车道的道路，城市道路为每小时50公里，公路为每小时70公里。

question_en: At night, when meeting an oncoming vehicle on a road without a center line, at what distance should you switch to low beams?
question_zh: 夜间在没有中心线的道路上会车，距离对向车辆多少米改用近光灯？
options_en: A. Within 50 meters | B. Within 100 meters | C. Beyond 150 meters | D. Do not use low beams
options_zh: A. 50米内 | B. 100米以内 | C. 150米以外 | D. 不开近光灯
why_en: High beams are too intense; at close range they impair the oncoming driver's vision and can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第四十八条：在没有中心隔离设施或者没有中心线的道路上，夜间会车应当在距相对方向来车150米以外改用近光灯，在窄路、窄桥与非机动车会车时应当使用近光灯。

question_en: When driving through a section with heavy traffic, you may overtake at any time as long as the light is not red.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在经过交通流量大的路段，只要不是红灯就可以随时超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking must only be done when it is safe.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第四十三条：同车道行驶的机动车，后车应当与前车保持足以采取紧急制动措施的安全距离。有下列情形之一的，不得超车：（一）前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车的；（二）与对面来车有会车可能的；（三）前车为执行紧急任务的警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车的；（四）行经铁路道口、交叉路口、窄桥、弯道、陡坡、隧道、人行横道、市区交通流量大的路段等没有超车条件的。

question_en: [Image] When following the vehicle ahead in the expressway lane shown in the picture, the minimum following distance must not be less than 100 meters.
question_zh: 在图中所示的高速公路行车道跟随前车行驶时，最小的跟车距离不得少于100米。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On expressways, when speed exceeds 100 km/h, the safe following distance must not be less than 100 meters.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第八十条：机动车在高速公路上行驶，车速超过每小时100公里时，应当与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离，车速低于每小时100公里时，与同车道前车距离可以适当缩短，但最小距离不得少于50米。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Honk to tell pedestrians to stop crossing the intersection | B. You may slowly pass between the two pedestrians at low speed | C. Drive around in front of the pedestrians to pass through the intersection | D. Stop before the stop line and wait for the pedestrians to pass
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭告知行人停止通过路口 | B. 可以从两个行人中间低速缓慢穿过 | C. 从行人的前方绕行通过路口 | D. 在停止线以外停车等待行人通过
why_en: In any situation, motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 驶近一个设有信号灯路口，遇到行人，应在停止线以外停车等待行人通过。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the scene shown in the picture, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情景，怎么做是正确的？
options_en: A. Flash high and low beams to urge the school bus to leave | B. Use the left lane to overtake the school bus | C. Stop behind the school bus and wait | D. Honk the horn to urge the school bus to leave
options_zh: A. 变换远近光灯催促校车离开 | B. 借左侧车道超越校车 | C. 停在校车后面等待 | D. 鸣喇叭催促校车离开
why_en: When driving in the same lane, if a school bus ahead is stopped, following vehicles should stop and wait.
explanation_zh: 校车在道路上停靠时，与校车同一车道的后方及相邻机动车道上的车辆就得停车等待，其他车道上的机动车也应减速通过。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. If you have already crossed the stop line, you may accelerate and turn right | B. You may turn right directly without considering the vehicle on the left | C. You may turn right as long as it does not affect the vehicle on the left going straight | D. Wait for the vehicle on the left going straight to pass before turning right
options_zh: A. 如果已经越过停止线就可以加速向右转弯 | B. 不用考虑左侧车辆直接向右转弯 | C. 只要不影响左侧车辆直行就可以右转弯 | D. 等待左侧车辆直行通过后再向右转弯
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight traffic, and turning traffic yields to through traffic.
explanation_zh: 车辆行驶过程中，转弯车辆让行直行车辆。右转让左转，左转让直行。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, where the vehicle ahead has stopped and is waiting, how should our vehicle proceed?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示前方车辆停车等待的情形，我方车应如何行驶？
options_en: A. Cut in and stop in front of the blue passenger car | B. Stop and wait behind the blue passenger car in order | C. Drive straight forward until you can no longer proceed | D. Honk the horn to urge the blue passenger car to move forward
options_zh: A. 穿插到蓝色小型客车前停车 | B. 依次在蓝色小型客车后停车等待 | C. 向前直行至不能继续行驶为止 | D. 鸣喇叭催促蓝色小型客车前移
why_en: The more congested it is, the more important it is to queue in order.
explanation_zh: 车辆拥堵的路段，应该要依次排队等候。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Stop and let the pedestrians pass first | B. Honk the horn repeatedly to alert pedestrians | C. Slow down and pass through cautiously | D. Accelerate and pass in front of the pedestrians
options_zh: A. 停车让行人先通过 | B. 连续鸣喇叭告知行人 | C. 减速缓慢行驶通过 | D. 加速从行人的前方通过
why_en: In any situation, motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 道路上安全第一，机动车应该礼让行人。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. If you have already crossed the stop line, you may accelerate and turn left | B. You may turn left directly without considering the oncoming vehicle | C. You may turn left as long as it does not affect the vehicle on the left going straight | D. Wait for the oncoming vehicle going straight to pass before turning left
options_zh: A. 如果已经越过停止线就可以加速向左转弯 | B. 不用考虑对面车辆直接向左转弯 | C. 只要不影响左侧车辆直行就可以左转弯 | D. 等待对面车辆直行通过后再向左转弯
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight traffic, and turning traffic yields to through traffic.
explanation_zh: 车辆行驶过程中，转弯车辆让行直行车辆。右转让左转，左转让直行。

question_en: When driving in this kind of environment, how should you use your lights?
question_zh: 在这种环境中行车，应该怎样使用灯光？
options_en: A. Alternate between high and low beams | B. Turn on low beams | C. Turn off the headlights | D. Turn on high beams
options_zh: A. 变换远近光灯 | B. 开启近光灯 | C. 关闭前照灯 | D. 开启远光灯
why_en: On well-lit road sections, using high beams impairs the vision of drivers ahead and oncoming, easily causing accidents.
explanation_zh: 夜间车辆通过有路灯的路段时使用近光灯。

question_en: [Image] As shown, when a vehicle ahead is entering the side road from the main road, what is correct?
question_zh: 如图所示，前方有车辆从主路进入辅路时，怎么做是正确的？
options_en: A. You may accelerate through as long as it does not affect vehicles exiting the main road | B. Honk to tell the vehicle entering the side road to stop and yield | C. Vehicles on the side road have the right of way and need not slow down | D. Slow down or stop to let the vehicle exiting the main road enter the side road first
options_zh: A. 只要不影响主路驶出的车辆正常行驶就可加速通过 | B. 鸣喇叭告知进入辅路的车辆停车让行 | C. 在辅路行驶的车辆有优先通行权，不用减速行驶 | D. 减速或停车让主路驶出的车辆先进入辅路
why_en: Vehicles on the main road have the right of way.
explanation_zh: 根据道路交通安全法，辅路车应当让主路车先行。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Go around behind the first pedestrian and turn right | B. Accelerate and turn right in front of the first pedestrian | C. Honk to make the pedestrians stop, then turn right | D. Wait until both pedestrians have crossed the intersection before turning right
options_zh: A. 绕到第一个行人的后方向右转弯 | B. 加速在第一个行人的前方向右转弯 | C. 鸣喇叭让行人停止通过后向右转弯 | D. 等待两个行人都通过路口再右转弯
why_en: In any situation, motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中人行横道有行人，等待两个行人都通过路口再右转弯。

question_en: The vehicle ahead has turned on its turn signal. What does this indicate it is about to do?
question_zh: 前方车辆开启转向灯表示要如何行驶？
options_en: A. Prepare to go straight through the intersection | B. Prepare to stop at the intersection | C. Prepare to turn left | D. Prepare to turn right
options_zh: A. 准备直行通过路口 | B. 准备在路口停车 | C. 准备向左转弯 | D. 准备向右转弯
why_en: A right-side signal light means turning right; a left-side signal light means turning left.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中看到车辆打开右转向灯，准备向右转弯。

question_en: The vehicle ahead has turned on its turn signal. What does this indicate it is about to do?
question_zh: 前方车辆开启转向灯表示要如何行驶？
options_en: A. Overtake the vehicle ahead | B. Prepare to change lanes to the left | C. Prepare to turn left | D. There is an obstacle ahead
options_zh: A. 超越前方车辆 | B. 准备向左变道 | C. 准备向左转弯 | D. 前方有障碍物
why_en: A right-side signal light means turning right; a left-side signal light means turning left.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中看到车辆开启左转向灯，准备向左变道。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Honk to alert the pedestrians and non-motor vehicles on both sides | B. You may accelerate through as long as no pedestrians are crossing | C. If there is not time to slow down, pass through at normal speed | D. Slow down early, observe, and confirm it is safe before proceeding
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭告知两边的行人和非机动车 | B. 只要没有行人横过就可以加速通过 | C. 如果来不及减速就直接按常速通过 | D. 提前减速观察确认是否能安全通过
why_en: A flashing yellow light warns passing vehicles to look carefully and confirm safety before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁是提示减速注意行人车辆，待确认安全后通过。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the signal light shown lit but the barrier not yet lowered, how should you proceed?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示信号灯亮着，但栏杆还没落下，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. Continue driving as long as the barrier has not lowered | B. If you have already passed the crossing's stop line, you may rush through | C. Stop before the crossing's stop line and wait | D. If no train is seen approaching, you may accelerate across the crossing
options_zh: A. 只要栏杆还没落下就继续行驶 | B. 如果已过道口停止线，就可以急速通过 | C. 在道口的停止线以外停车等待 | D. 如果没有看到列车驶来，可以加速横过道口
why_en: A red light means stop, safety first.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，驶近一个设有信号灯和栏杆的铁路道口，遇到图中所示信号灯亮着，但栏杆还没落下，应在道口的停止线以外停车等待。

question_en: When following another vehicle into a flooded road section, what is correct?
question_zh: 跟车进入漫水路段时，怎么样是正确的？
options_en: A. Follow closely behind the vehicle ahead, driving along its tracks | B. If the vehicle ahead is too slow, you may honk to signal it | C. If the following distance feels too close, you may stop and wait | D. Increase the distance from the vehicle ahead and follow cautiously at low speed
options_zh: A. 紧跟前车，沿前车留下的痕迹行驶 | B. 如果前车车速太慢，可适当鸣喇叭示意 | C. 如果感到跟车距离太近，可停车等待 | D. 增加与前车的距离，谨慎跟车慢行
why_en: When passing through a flooded section, stop to check the water conditions and confirm safety before proceeding slowly.
explanation_zh: 通过漫水路面时，因为道路视线受阻，应当谨慎慢行。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should our vehicle proceed?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，我方车辆应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. You may turn right as long as it does not affect the oncoming vehicle turning left | B. You may turn right directly without considering the oncoming vehicle | C. Wait for the oncoming vehicle to turn left before turning right | D. If you have already crossed the stop line, you may accelerate and turn right
options_zh: A. 只要不影响对面车辆左转就可以向右转弯 | B. 不用考虑对面车辆直接向右转弯 | C. 等待对面车辆向左转后再向右转弯 | D. 如果已经越过停止线就可以加速向右转弯
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight traffic, and turning traffic yields to through traffic.
explanation_zh: 车辆行驶中右转车辆让行左转车辆，左转让直行。

question_en: [Image] If you want to overtake the slow-moving car ahead shown in the picture, what is correct?
question_zh: 如果想超越前方图中这辆慢速度行驶的小汽车，怎样做是正确的？
options_en: A. Overtake directly from the left side of the vehicle ahead | B. Honk the horn repeatedly to alert the vehicle ahead | C. Overtake from the right side when conditions permit | D. Turn on the left signal and wait to be allowed to overtake
options_zh: A. 从前车左侧直接超越 | B. 连续鸣喇叭提示前车 | C. 在条件具备时从右侧超越 | D. 开启左转向灯等待让超
why_en: Turn on the signal in advance to alert the vehicle ahead, then overtake once conditions allow.
explanation_zh: 安全行车切记，超车前需要开启左转向灯，并观察前后车车速，待合适的时机实施超车。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates there is a Y-shaped intersection ahead, with cross traffic merging.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方道路有Y形交叉路口，会有横向来车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A yellow sign is a warning sign, alerting the driver to merging traffic ahead.
explanation_zh: 警示标志，图中Y形路口说明前方路口左侧会有车辆汇入。

question_en: [Image] Seeing the traffic light shown flashing continuously means a motor vehicle may accelerate through.
question_zh: 看到图中所示道路信号灯不断闪烁时，表示机动车可以加速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: "Accelerate through" is incorrect; you should pass at low speed.
explanation_zh: 黄灯闪烁提示车辆注意减速，确认安全后缓慢通过，遇到此类黄灯时，需减速慢行。且机动车不能加速通过。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates that only going straight is allowed at the intersection ahead.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方路口只允许直行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Since neither left nor right turns are allowed, only going straight is permitted.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志，前方路段不允许左转或者右转，左右方向箭头被禁止，只能直行。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates that all vehicles are simply prohibited from entering the road section ahead.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方路段只禁止一切车辆驶入。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Within the red circle: a red cross means no stopping, blank means no entry, a single white bar means no driving through.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志，表示此路段禁止一切车辆和行人进入。

question_en: Seeing this signal light lit at an intersection, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 在路口看到这种信号灯亮时，怎样做是正确的？
options_en: A. Turn on low beams to tell through-traffic to stop and yield | B. Turn on the turn signal to prompt through-traffic to slow down and yield | C. Turn left directly in front of through-traffic as quickly as possible | D. Must not obstruct through-traffic that has the right of way
options_zh: A. 开启近光灯告知直行车辆停车让行 | B. 开启转向灯提示直行车辆减速让行 | C. 尽快从直行车前方直接向左转弯 | D. 不能妨碍被放行的直行车辆通行
why_en: Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight traffic, and turning traffic yields to through traffic.
explanation_zh: 图中我们的车是左转，不能妨碍被放行的直行车辆通行。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates that the road section ahead is prone to rear-end collisions.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方路段是易发生车辆追尾的路段。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A yellow sign is a warning sign, alerting the driver that the section ahead is accident-prone.
explanation_zh: 警示标志，提示此路段为事故多发路段。

question_en: [Image] Encountering a continuously flashing yellow light at an intersection like the one shown, what does this indicate?
question_zh: 在路口遇到图中这种黄灯不断闪烁时，说明什么情况？
options_en: A. All vehicles are prohibited from passing through the intersection | B. Traffic signal control at the intersection is temporarily lifted | C. Traffic control at the intersection requires clearing | D. A traffic accident has occurred at the intersection
options_zh: A. 路口禁止一切车辆通行 | B. 路口交通信号暂时解除 | C. 路口交通管制需要清空 | D. 路口发生道路交通事故
why_en: A continuously flashing yellow light means drivers should proceed cautiously, observe surroundings, and confirm safety before passing.
explanation_zh: 在路口遇到这种图中这种黄灯不断闪烁时，说明路口交通信号暂时解除，提示行人车辆注意，确认安全后通过，主要是起警示作用的。

question_en: Seeing this signal light lit at an intersection, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 在路口看到路口这种信号灯亮时，怎样做是正确的？
options_en: A. Accelerate through the intersection if safety is ensured | B. Stop before the intersection's stop line and wait for the next green light | C. Must not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way, and may not turn right | D. May go straight through as long as it does not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way
options_zh: A. 在确保通行安全的情况下加速通过路口 | B. 停在路口停止线以外等待下一个绿灯信号 | C. 不妨碍被放行车辆、行人通行也不能右转弯 | D. 不妨碍被放行车辆、行人通行可以直行通过
why_en: Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中信号灯黄灯，已过停止线的车辆可以继续通行。车身未过停止线，在路口停止线以外等待下一个绿灯信号。

question_en: [Image] Encountering a road section with lane signal lights like this, which lane should you choose?
question_zh: 遇到图中这种有车道信号灯的路段，应该选择哪条车道行驶？
options_en: A. Choose the left lane | B. Choose the middle lane | C. Choose any lane | D. Choose the right lane
options_zh: A. 选择左侧车道行驶 | B. 选择中间车道行驶 | C. 选择任一车道行驶 | D. 选择右侧车道行驶
why_en: Only the lane with a green arrow lit is open for passage.
explanation_zh: 箭头灯中绿灯都指向中间车道，明显应该选择中间车道。

question_en: This sign indicates two-way traffic ahead.
question_zh: 这个标志表示前方注意双向行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A tidal lane is a reversible lane whose direction of travel is adjusted according to morning and evening traffic flow.
explanation_zh: 此标志为注意潮汐车道。用以警告车辆驾驶人注意前方为潮汐车道。“潮汐车道”是指根据早晚交通流量不同情况，对有条件的道路，试点开辟潮汐车道，通过车道灯的指示方向变化，控制主干道车道行驶方向，来调整车道数。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the sign shown, how should you park?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示标志，如何停车？
options_en: A. No stopping anywhere on this road section | B. You may stop anywhere without a no-stopping line marking | C. Choose a safe location in front of the sign to stop | D. Choose a roadside spot that does not obstruct traffic to park
options_zh: A. 在这段道路上的任何地方都不能停车 | B. 只要没有禁止停车标线的路段都能停车 | C. 选择在标志前方安全的位置停车 | D. 选择在路边不妨碍通行的地方停放
why_en: A red cross means no stopping, blank means no entry, and a single white bar means no driving through.
explanation_zh: 注意图中右侧的禁令标志，此路段禁止停车。

question_en: [Image] While driving on an expressway, if the vehicle shown is unable to continue, where should the hazard warning sign be placed?
question_zh: 在高速公路行驶，遇到图中所示的车辆无法继续行驶，应怎样放置危险警告标志？
options_en: A. Place the warning sign 50 meters behind the vehicle | B. Place the warning sign 50 to 100 meters behind the vehicle | C. Place the warning sign beyond 150 meters behind the vehicle | D. Place the warning sign at an appropriate location based on road traffic conditions
options_zh: A. 在车后50米处放置警告标志 | B. 在车后50米至100米处放置警告标志 | C. 在车后150米以外放置警告标志 | D. 根据道路交通情况在适当位置放置警告标志
why_en: Warning sign placement: 50-100 meters on ordinary roads, beyond 150 meters on expressways.
explanation_zh: 高速公路上设置警告标志应当在150米以外，同时按照规定开启危险报警闪光灯。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates a roundabout ahead, and U-turns are allowed at the intersection ahead.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方有环形交叉路口，前方路口可以掉头行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A yellow sign is a warning sign, alerting the driver to a roundabout ahead.
explanation_zh: 警示标志，前方是环形交叉路口，是可以掉头的。

question_en: Seeing this signal light lit at an intersection, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 看到路口这种信号灯亮时，怎样做是正确的？
options_en: A. You may turn right as long as it does not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way | B. You may go straight as long as it does not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way | C. You may turn left as long as it does not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way | D. You may proceed as long as it does not obstruct vehicles or pedestrians with the right of way
options_zh: A. 在不妨碍放行车辆、行人的情况下，可以右转 | B. 在不妨碍放行车辆、行人的情况下，可以直行 | C. 在不妨碍放行车辆、行人的情况下，可以左转 | D. 在不妨碍放行车辆、行人的情况下，可以通行
why_en: When safe, right turns are not restricted by a circular red light.
explanation_zh: 绿灯表示可以直行，左转或右转的车辆可以在不妨碍其他车辆、非机动车、行人通行的情况下可以通行。红灯时，如果不妨碍其他车辆行人通行的情况下，可以右转。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. You may stop to load or unload cargo | B. You may stop to let a passenger get out | C. You may make a brief stop to wait for a companion | D. No stopping, whether brief or long-term, is permitted
options_zh: A. 可以停下来装卸货物 | B. 可以停下来让同行的人下车 | C. 可以临时停车等待同行的人 | D. 不准临时或长时间停、放
why_en: Within the red circle: a red cross means no stopping, blank means no entry, a single white bar means no driving through.
explanation_zh: 图中标志表示，不准临时或长时停、放。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the scene shown in the picture, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情景，怎么做是正确的？
options_en: A. Change to the middle lane in advance to overtake | B. Honk moderately and overtake from the left at low speed | C. Change to the left lane in advance to overtake | D. Stop behind the school bus and use light signals to urge it on
options_zh: A. 提前变更到中间车道超越 | B. 适当鸣喇叭低速从左侧超越 | C. 提前变更到左侧车道超越 | D. 停在校车后方使用灯光催促
why_en: When passing a stopped school bus, following traffic in the same lane should slow down or wait, changing lanes in advance if possible before overtaking.
explanation_zh: 校车在同方向有两条以上的机动车道的道路上停靠时，校车停靠车道后方和相邻机动车道上的机动车应当停车等待，其他机动车道上的机动车应当减速通过。此路三条车道，可以提前变更到最左侧车道。

question_en: When driving at 60 km/h on an expressway with visibility below 200 meters, what is the safe distance from the vehicle ahead in the same lane?
question_zh: 在能见度小于200米的高速公路上以60km/h速度行驶时，与同车道前车安全距离是多少？
options_en: A. Keep a distance numerically equal to the speed value | B. Keep a safe distance of no less than 50 meters | C. Keep a distance within 100 meters | D. Keep a distance of more than 100 meters
options_zh: A. 保持与车速相同数据的距离 | B. 保持不小于50米的安全距离 | C. 保持在100米以内的距离 | D. 保持在100米以上的距离
why_en: Standard rule for expressway visibility under 200m: speed capped at 60 km/h with a following distance over 100 meters.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇见能见度气象条件时，能见度在200米以下，车速不得超过每小时60公里，与同车道前车至少保持100米以上的距离。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates a sharp right turn on the road ahead.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方道路是向右急转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: For sharp-turn warning signs, an arrow pointing left indicates a sharp left turn.
explanation_zh: 警示标志，图中标志表示前方路口向左急转弯。

question_en: [Image] This sign indicates that within the marked zone ahead, all vehicles are prohibited from long-term parking, but temporary stopping is not restricted.
question_zh: 图中这个标志提示前方路段在限定的范围内，禁止一切车辆长时间停放，临时停车不受限制。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: No-parking signs prohibit both brief stopping and long-term parking.
explanation_zh: 禁令标志，表示此路段禁止停车，包括临时和长时间停车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. You may drive directly into this section | B. You must slow down before entering this section | C. There may be oncoming vehicles | D. Entry into the road section ahead is prohibited
options_zh: A. 可直接驶入此路段 | B. 进入此路段要减速 | C. 对面可能会有来车 | D. 不准驶入前方路段
why_en: Within the red circle: a red cross means no stopping, blank means no entry, a single white bar means no driving through.
explanation_zh: 禁止标志，表示前方路段禁止车辆驶入。

question_en: [Image] On the road section shown with lane signal lights, judge which vehicle is driving in the correct lane.
question_zh: 在图中所示有车道信号灯的路段，请判断哪辆机动车行驶的车道是正确的？
options_en: A. Car A | B. Car C | C. Car D | D. Car B
options_zh: A. A车 | B. C车 | C. D车 | D. B车
why_en: Only the lane with a green arrow lit is open for passage.
explanation_zh: 箭头灯都显示所有车辆要在中间车道行驶，图中只有车辆C是正确的。

question_en: [Image] Seeing the sign shown, how should you drive?
question_zh: 看到图中标志时，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. If there are no vehicles or pedestrians at the intersection, you may accelerate through | B. As long as it does not affect other vehicles passing, you may slow down and pass | C. Stop at the intersection, look left, and once safety is confirmed, pass quickly | D. Slow down and observe at the intersection, and proceed once safety is confirmed
options_zh: A. 路口没有车辆和行人，可以加速通过 | B. 不影响其他车辆通过，可以减速通过 | C. 在路口停车后向左转头观察，确认安全后，快速通过 | D. 在路口减速观察，确认安全后通过
why_en: Slow down at pedestrian crossings, safety first.
explanation_zh: 1、请注意图中右前方有减速让行标志。表示车辆驾驶员必须减速慢行，观察干路行车情况，在确保干道车辆优先的前提下，认为安全时方可继续行驶。 2、其次，图中路口并无信号灯，因此并无红灯亮起强制要求我方车辆停车。 3、综上，正确的做法是在路口减速观察，确认安全后通过。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Mandatory sign | B. Prohibition sign | C. Guide sign | D. Warning sign
options_zh: A. 指示标志 | B. 禁令标志 | C. 指路标志 | D. 警告标志
why_en: Traffic signs are classified by color: yellow (warning), red (prohibition), blue (mandatory).
explanation_zh: 黄色-警示、红色-禁令、蓝色-指示指路、黑色-辅助。

question_en: [Image] Approaching the railway crossing shown, what is the correct action?
question_zh: 驶近图中所示的铁路道口，怎样做才是正确的？
options_en: A. When passing a railway crossing, follow "first look, second slow down, third pass" | B. As long as the red signal light at the crossing is not on, you may accelerate through | C. If no railway staff are directing, it means you may pass quickly | D. If no train is seen approaching, you may cross the crossing quickly
options_zh: A. 通过铁道路口要做到“一看、二慢、三通过” | B. 只要路口的红色信号灯不亮，就可以加速通过 | C. 没有看到铁路管理人员指挥，说明可以迅速通过 | D. 如果没有看到列车驶来，可以快速横过道口
why_en: Follow the rule: first look, second slow down, third pass.
explanation_zh: 通过铁路道口要做到“一看、二慢、三通过”，安全第一。

question_en: If you feel tired while driving on an expressway, you may pull over to the side and rest as long as it does not affect vehicles behind.
question_zh: 在高速公路上行驶感觉疲劳时，只要不影响后方车辆行驶，可以靠边停车休息。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If you feel tired while driving, you should stop at the nearest rest area or service area.
explanation_zh: 在高速公路应在休息区或者服务区停车休息。不能随意停车休息。

question_en: A main characteristic of pedestrians in road traffic is that they like to gather together and watch.
question_zh: 行人参与道路交通的主要特点是行人喜欢在一起聚集、围观。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Liking to gather is only a trait of some individual pedestrians, not a main characteristic.
explanation_zh: 喜欢聚集和围观不属于交通形式。行走随意性大，方向多变，对驾车不利，才是行人参与交通的主要特点。

question_en: [Image] When overtaking in the situation shown, you should turn on the left signal in advance, honk repeatedly, or flash high beams to urge the vehicle ahead to yield.
question_zh: 图中所示的情形超车时，要提前开启左转向灯，连续鸣喇叭或开启远光灯提示，催促前车让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams must not be used and the horn must not be sounded repeatedly when overtaking.
explanation_zh: 会车、超车都不能开远光灯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No right turn at the intersection ahead | B. No left turn at the intersection ahead | C. No going straight at the intersection ahead | D. A crossroads intersection is ahead
options_zh: A. 前方路口不能右转 | B. 前方路口不能左转 | C. 前方路口不能直行 | D. 前方是十字路口
why_en: The left side is blocked; with no route there, that direction cannot be taken.
explanation_zh: 右侧丁字路口，此标志设在进入T字路口以前的位置。

question_en: Judge what this hand signal is.
question_zh: 请判断一下，这是什么手势？
options_en: A. Signal prohibiting vehicles ahead from proceeding | B. Signal permitting vehicles on the right going straight to pass | C. Signal permitting vehicles to turn left | D. Signal permitting vehicles on the right to turn right
options_zh: A. 不准前方车辆通行手势 | B. 准许右方直行车辆通过手势 | C. 准许车辆左转弯手势 | D. 准许右方车辆右转弯手势
why_en: Memory aid: raising the left hand above the shoulder means stop.
explanation_zh: 交警的手高举过头，表示不准前方车辆通行手势。

question_en: Judge what this hand signal is.
question_zh: 请判断一下，这是什么手势？
options_en: A. Signal prohibiting vehicles ahead from proceeding | B. Signal permitting vehicles on the right going straight to pass | C. Signal permitting vehicles to turn left | D. Signal permitting vehicles to turn right
options_zh: A. 不准前方车辆通行手势 | B. 准许右方直行车辆通过手势 | C. 准许车辆左转弯手势 | D. 准许车辆右转弯手势
why_en: Memory aid: left hand extended out, right hand waving to signal a right turn.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，交警的手表示准许右方车辆右转弯手势。

question_en: [Image] Encountering this situation, which driving action is correct?
question_zh: 遇到图中这种情况，哪种驾驶行为是正确的？
options_en: A. Make a U-turn at the intersection | B. Turn right through the intersection | C. Go straight through the intersection | D. Turn left through the intersection
options_zh: A. 在路口掉头行驶 | B. 向右转弯通过路口 | C. 直行通过路口 | D. 向左转弯通过路口
why_en: When a green arrow light is on, traffic may proceed in the direction the arrow points.
explanation_zh: 图中右转绿灯亮，表示可以右转弯。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Stop and yield before entering the intersection ahead | B. Slow down and yield before entering the intersection ahead | C. Watch carefully before entering the intersection ahead | D. Watch for vehicles before entering the intersection ahead
options_zh: A. 进入前方路口要停车让行 | B. 进入前方路口要减速让行 | C. 进入前方路口要注意观察 | D. 进入前方路口要注意车辆
why_en: An octagonal sign with the character for "stop" means stop and yield; a triangular sign with the character for "yield" means slow down and yield.
explanation_zh: 这个标志是禁令标志，提示前方减速让行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Guide sign | B. Mandatory sign | C. Warning sign | D. Prohibition sign
options_zh: A. 指路标志 | B. 指示标志 | C. 警告标志 | D. 禁令标志
why_en: Traffic signs are classified by color: yellow (warning), red (prohibition), blue (mandatory).
explanation_zh: 指示标志的颜色为蓝底、白图案；形状分为圆形、长方形和正方形。此标志是指示标志，标志该道路只供机动车行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Warning sign | B. Prohibition sign | C. Guide sign | D. Mandatory sign
options_zh: A. 警告标志 | B. 禁令标志 | C. 指路标志 | D. 指示标志
why_en: Traffic signs are classified by color: yellow (warning), red (prohibition), blue (mandatory).
explanation_zh: 黄色底色的都是警告标志，图中表示驾驶者需要注意前方有十字路口。

question_en: Judge what this hand signal is.
question_zh: 请判断一下，这是什么手势？
options_en: A. Signal prohibiting vehicles ahead from proceeding | B. Signal permitting vehicles on the right going straight to pass | C. Signal permitting vehicles to turn left | D. Signal permitting vehicles on the right to turn right
options_zh: A. 不准前方车辆通行手势 | B. 准许右方直行车辆通过手势 | C. 准许车辆左转弯手势 | D. 准许右方车辆右转弯手势
why_en: Memory aid: right hand extended out, left hand waving to signal a left turn.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，交警的手表示准许车辆左转弯手势。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. A crossroads intersection is ahead | B. No right turn at the intersection ahead | C. No going straight at the intersection ahead | D. No left turn at the intersection ahead
options_zh: A. 前方是十字路口 | B. 前方路口不能右转 | C. 前方路口不能直行 | D. 前方路口不能左转
why_en: A T-junction cannot be gone straight through; only turns are possible.
explanation_zh: T字形路口表示前方路段只有向左右方向岔路，不可直行。

question_en: [Image] When driving at night and encountering the intersection shown, high beams should be used regardless of whether vehicles or pedestrians are crossing.
question_zh: 夜间行车遇到图中所示的交叉路口，不管有没有车辆和行人横过路口，都要开启远光灯提示。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams must not be used when passing through an intersection at night.
explanation_zh: 相关规定，夜间行车在通过交叉路口时，应在距路口50到100米处减速，并将远光灯变为近光灯，同时开启转向灯示意前进方向。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. You have the right of way | B. Only proceeding straight is permitted | C. This is a one-way road section | D. Continuing straight is not permitted
options_zh: A. 可以优先通行 | B. 只准继续直行 | C. 处于单行路段 | D. 不可继续直行
why_en: A straight arrow in a rectangle indicates a one-way road; a straight arrow in a circle means straight ahead only.
explanation_zh: 此标志表示一切车辆只准直行。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Watch for vehicles before entering the intersection ahead | B. Stop and observe before entering the intersection ahead | C. Accelerate through the intersection ahead | D. Slow down before entering the intersection ahead
options_zh: A. 进入前方路口要注意车辆 | B. 进入前方路口要停车观察 | C. 进入前方路口要加速通过 | D. 进入前方路口要减速慢行
why_en: An octagonal sign with the character for "stop" means stop and yield; a triangular sign with the character for "yield" means slow down and yield.
explanation_zh: 图中标志表示前方停车观察。

question_en: When a driver realizes a tire has blown out while driving, which of the following is an incorrect action?
question_zh: 行车中当驾驶人意识到车辆爆胎时，下列错误的做法是？
options_en: A. Emergency braking | B. Lightly press the brake pedal | C. Decelerate slowly | D. Control the steering
options_zh: A. 紧急制动 | B. 轻踏制动踏板 | C. 缓慢减速 | D. 控制方向
why_en: With a sudden blowout, grip the wheel firmly, keep it straight, use engine braking to slow gradually, then brake lightly and pull over slowly.
explanation_zh: 爆胎和意识到爆胎时，首先要做的就是控制方向，然后缓慢减速，平稳停车。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Prohibition sign | B. Guide sign | C. Warning sign | D. Mandatory sign
options_zh: A. 禁令标志 | B. 指路标志 | C. 警告标志 | D. 指示标志
why_en: Distinction: a mandatory sign has only a symbol, while a guide sign has text on it.
explanation_zh: 指路标志指示市镇村的境界、目的地的方向和距离、高速公路出入口、著名地点所在等，用以传递道路方向，地点，距离信息。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. No going straight at the intersection ahead | B. A crossroads intersection is ahead | C. No right turn at the intersection ahead | D. No left turn at the intersection ahead
options_zh: A. 前方路口不能直行 | B. 前方是十字路口 | C. 前方路口不能右转 | D. 前方路口不能左转
why_en: The right side is blocked; with no route there, that direction cannot be taken.
explanation_zh: 图中标志表示前方路口可以直行或左转，不能右转。

question_en: [Image] When overtaking in the environment shown, first flash high and low beams to notify the vehicle ahead, and once it yields, turn on high beams to overtake.
question_zh: 在图中这种环境超车时，要先变换远近光灯告知前车，待前车让行后，开启远光灯超越。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking should be done with low beams; high beams must not be used.
explanation_zh: 根据道路交通安全法规，应开启近光灯超越。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Yield to the oncoming vehicle when meeting | B. Has the right of way when meeting oncoming traffic | C. The oncoming vehicle should stop and yield | D. A road section ahead is difficult for meeting oncoming traffic
options_zh: A. 会车时让对向车先行 | B. 会车时有优先通行权 | C. 会车对方应停车让行 | D. 前方是会车困难路段
why_en: Whichever side has the thicker arrow goes first.
explanation_zh: 图中右边标志红色，表示要让对向先行

question_en: When driving in heavy rain, if the wipers cannot clear the rain sufficiently, it is enough to just slow down gradually.
question_zh: 在暴雨天气驾车，刮水器无法刮净雨水时，只要慢慢减速行驶就可以。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Always remember: safety comes first.
explanation_zh: 刮水器无法刮净雨水，肯定看不清路况，最安全的做法是立刻靠边停车，并开启危险报警闪光灯，等雨小了再继续行驶。

question_en: What does this sign mean?
question_zh: 这个标志是何含义？
options_en: A. Only left turns allowed at the intersection ahead | B. A T-junction is ahead | C. Only right turns allowed at the intersection ahead | D. Only going straight is allowed at the intersection ahead
options_zh: A. 前方路口只能左转 | B. 前方是T型叉路口 | C. 前方路口只能右转 | D. 前方路口只能直行
why_en: Since neither left nor right turns are allowed, only going straight is permitted.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中标志禁止向左向右转弯，只能直行。

question_en: Judge what this hand signal is.
question_zh: 请判断一下，这是什么手势？
options_en: A. Signal prohibiting vehicles ahead from proceeding | B. Signal permitting vehicles on the right going straight to pass | C. Signal permitting vehicles to turn left | D. Signal permitting vehicles on the right to turn right
options_zh: A. 不准前方车辆通行手势 | B. 准许右方直行车辆通过手势 | C. 准许车辆左转弯手势 | D. 准许右方车辆右转弯手势
why_en: Memory aid: both hands extended out, right hand waving for straight-ahead traffic.
explanation_zh: 两手伸直的意思是直行，手向右摆，意思是向右方直行的车辆可以通过。

question_en: [Image] When going straight at an intersection and seeing the signal light shown, you should accelerate through the intersection as quickly as possible and must not stop and wait.
question_zh: 在路口直行看到图中所示信号灯亮时，要尽快加速通过路口，不得停车等待。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.
explanation_zh: 黄灯亮时，已越过停止线的车辆可以继续通行。车身在安全线里边的，请停车等待。

question_en: [Image] Encountering a road section with lane signal lights like this, you should choose the right or left lane.
question_zh: 遇到图中这种有车道信号灯的路段，应该选择右侧或者左侧车道行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The middle lane shows a red cross, indicating it is closed to traffic.
explanation_zh: 中间车道是红灯，禁止行驶；左右两侧车道绿灯，可通行。

question_en: [Image] If overtaking is needed in the situation shown, you may use the bus lane to overtake as long as it does not affect the bus's normal operation.
question_zh: 如果遇到图中这种情况需要超车时，可以在不影响公交车正常行驶的前提下借公交车道超越。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking must only be done from the left side.
explanation_zh: 超车只能从左侧超车，并且车道内已经注明“公交车专用车道”则此车道为公交车专用，其他车辆一般情况下不准占用。仅当发生事故、正常道路封闭有标示注明允许借用或者交警指示等特殊情况允许借道行驶。

question_en: [Image] In the situation shown, the accident was caused because the vehicle on the left reversed without giving way to a vehicle driving normally, and the vehicle on the right did not stop and wait when it saw the vehicle ahead making a U-turn.
question_zh: 图中所示的情形中，造成事故的责任是左侧车辆倒车没有避让正常行驶的车辆，右侧车辆看到前车掉头时没有停车等待。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 掉头时应注意避让前后来车，正常行驶时遇到前车掉头也应注意避让，做到文明礼让，安全行车。

question_en: [Image] When following another vehicle on the road shown, why should a greater following distance be kept?
question_zh: 在图中所示的道路跟车行驶时，为什么要保持较大的跟车距离？
options_en: A. Water depth cannot be judged accurately | B. Standing water on the road affects distance judgment | C. The driver ahead's reactions become slower | D. Splashed water will impair visibility
options_zh: A. 不能正确判断水的深度 | B. 路面积水会影响对距离的判断 | C. 前车驾驶人的反应会变得迟钝 | D. 溅起来的水会影响视线
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中的道路跟车行驶时，应要减速慢行，保持较大的跟车距离，因为溅起来的水会影响视线。

question_en: [Image] Before meeting an oncoming vehicle in an environment like this, you should first alternate high and low beams with the oncoming vehicle to observe the road ahead, and both vehicles should turn off their headlights when meeting.
question_zh: 在图中这种环境下会车前，要先与对面来车交替变换远、近光灯观察前方道路情况，会车时两车都要关闭前大灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: At night, when meeting oncoming traffic, switch from high to low beams once within 150 meters.
explanation_zh: 图中是夜间在照明不良的路段会车，应交替使用远近光灯示意，在150米以外远光灯换近光灯，不能全部关闭前大灯。

question_en: [Image] At the railway crossing shown, if no train is seen approaching, you should accelerate to cross.
question_zh: 在图中所示的铁路道口，如果没有看到列车驶来就要加速通过道口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: "Accelerate through" is incorrect.
explanation_zh: 根据交通安全法，驾驶车辆通过无人看守的铁路道口时候，需要做到一停、二看、三通过。

question_en: [Image] Encountering the situation shown in the picture, how should you drive?
question_zh: 遇到图中所示的情况，应怎样行驶？
options_en: A. You may use the right emergency lane to drive | B. Follow the vehicle ahead while maintaining a safe distance | C. Follow closely behind the green passenger car in the left lane | D. Honk the horn or flash the high and low beams to urge others on
options_zh: A. 可以借右侧应急车道行驶 | B. 与前车保持安全距离跟车行驶 | C. 紧跟左侧车道绿色小客车行驶 | D. 鸣喇叭或变换远近光灯催促
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 如图所示，图中跟车行驶，应与前车保持安全距离行驶。

question_en: [Image] Going straight at an intersection and seeing the situation shown, you should stop before the stop line and wait for the oncoming through-traffic to pass before starting again.
question_zh: 在路口直行看到图中这种情况，要在停止线以外停车，等待对面直行车通过后再起步。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.
explanation_zh: 图中为绿灯，可以直行，不用等待对面直行车通过后再起步。

question_en: [Image] Approaching the road section shown, you may accelerate through as long as there are no vehicles or pedestrians crossing on the crosswalk.
question_zh: 驶近图中所示的路段时，只要没有车辆和行人在人行横道上通过，就可以加速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: You should slow down when passing a pedestrian crosswalk.
explanation_zh: 通过人行横道，要减速慢行。

question_en: [Image] Approaching the intersection shown, you must stop and then start again to pass through the intersection.
question_zh: 驶近一个图中所示的路口时，必须先停车再重新起步通过路口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: After stopping, you must confirm safety before starting to pass through.
explanation_zh: 右侧标志表示停车让行，车辆必须在停止线以外停车观察，确认安全后，才可以通行。

question_en: [Image] Approaching the railway crossing shown, you may accelerate through as long as the barrier has not been lowered.
question_zh: 驶近一个图中所示的铁路道口时，只要看到栏杆还没放下来，就可以加速通过道口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A red light means stop; you must not accelerate through.
explanation_zh: 注意图中是红灯，红灯停。安全通过铁路道口要减速减档。

question_en: [Image] Seeing the signal light shown flashing continuously at an intersection, you should slow down or stop to look, and proceed once safety is confirmed.
question_zh: 在路口看到图中所示信号灯不断闪烁时，要减速或停车瞭望，确认安全后通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Distinction: a steady yellow light means wait, while a continuously flashing yellow light means confirm safety before proceeding.
explanation_zh: 此处注意黄灯亮和黄灯闪烁的区别。路口黄灯持续闪烁，警示驾驶人要注意瞭望，确认安全通过。

question_en: [Image] The lane chosen by the red motor vehicle in the picture is correct.
question_zh: 图中这辆红色机动车选择的行车道是正确的。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The middle lane shows a green arrow light, indicating it is open for passage.
explanation_zh: 左右两侧车道红色交叉灯表示禁行，因此红色机动车不可以在该车道行驶。

question_en: [Image] Turning right at an intersection and seeing the signal light shown lit, you should stop before the stop line and wait for the green light before turning right.
question_zh: 在路口右转弯看到图中信号灯亮时，要在停止线以外停车，等待绿灯亮后再向右转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: When safe, right turns are not restricted by a circular red light.
explanation_zh: 圆形信号灯，绿灯表示可以直行，左转或右转的车辆可以在不妨碍其他车辆、非机动车、行人通行的情况下可以通行。红灯时，如果不妨碍其他车辆行人通行的情况下，可以右转。

question_en: [Image] Encountering a flooded road section as shown, you should slow down early and cautiously enter the water area at low speed; while driving through the flooded section, you must drive slowly, and stopping midway through the water is prohibited.
question_zh: 遇到一个图中所示的漫水路段时，要提前减速，谨慎慢行进入水区，在涉水路段行驶，一定要低速缓慢行驶，涉水途中禁止停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The statement only mentions slowing down early, without stopping to check the water first, which is incorrect.
explanation_zh: 机动车行经漫水桥路段时，应当停车察明水情，确认安全后，低速通过。

question_en: [Image] The lane the blue compact car in the picture is driving in is the slow lane.
question_zh: 图中这辆蓝色小型汽车行驶的车道是慢速车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The leftmost lane is the fast lane, and the rightmost lane is the slow lane.
explanation_zh: 行驶车道在最左侧的是最快速车道。

question_en: [Image] On a city road, if overtaking is needed in the situation shown, you may directly turn on the right signal and use the bus lane.
question_zh: 在城市道路上，遇到图中情况需要超车时，可以直接开启右转向灯，借公交车道行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking must only be done from the left side; forcing an overtake elsewhere can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 车辆行驶途中即使专用车道无车辆行驶，也不可因超车占用专用车道。

question_en: What principle must be followed when driving a motor vehicle?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车，必须遵循什么原则？
options_en: A. Drive on the left | B. Drive on the right | C. Drive in the inner lane | D. Drive in the middle
options_zh: A. 左侧通行 | B. 右侧通行 | C. 内测通行 | D. 中间通行
why_en: Drive on the right, overtake from the left.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》规定：机动车、非机动车实行右侧通行。只是我国机动车、非机动车在道路上行驶时应遵循的基本通行原则。

question_en: When a motor vehicle drives on a snow- and ice-covered mountain road, safety measures such as installing anti-skid chains should be taken on the ___?
question_zh: 机动车在山区冰雪覆盖的道路上行驶，应当采取在___上安装防滑链等安全措施？
options_en: A. Drive wheels | B. Non-drive wheels | C. Spare tire | D. Both drive and non-drive wheels
options_zh: A. 驱动轮 | B. 被动轮 | C. 备胎 | D. 驱动轮和被动轮
why_en: On snow and ice, speed must not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh:
《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》：机动车在未划设中心线和划分机动车道与非机动车道的道路上行驶，遇弯道时应当减速、靠右通行。
机动车在山区冰雪覆盖的道路上行驶，应当采取在驱动轮上安装防滑链等安全防范措施。

question_en: Conducting routine safety education for drivers is an important means of strengthening ____ awareness and improving safety and civility.
question_zh: 对驾驶人开展日常安全教育是增强____意识，提高安全文明素质的重要手段。
options_en: A. Drivers' social responsibility | B. Civility and courtesy | C. Gains and losses | D. Prioritizing transport development
options_zh: A. 驾驶人社会责任 | B. 文明礼貌 | C. 得与失 | D. 优先发展交通
why_en: A driver who values safe driving is being responsible to both themselves and society.
explanation_zh: 增强驾驶人安全文明意识，对驾驶人开展日常教育是增强驾驶人社会责任意识、提高安全文明素质的重要手段。

question_en: Safe and civil driving is an essential quality every motor vehicle driver must have.
question_zh: 安全文明行车是机动车驾驶人必备的驾驶素质。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 根据《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第二十二条：机动车驾驶人应当遵守道路交通安全法律、法规的规定，按照操作规范安全驾驶、文明驾驶。

question_en: When overtaking inside a tunnel, you should turn on the left signal in advance.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在隧道中超车时，应该提前开启左转向灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking, stopping, U-turns, and reversing are all prohibited inside tunnels.
explanation_zh: 根据《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》的规定，行经繁华路段、交叉路口、铁道路口、人行横道、急弯路、宽度不足4米的窄路或者窄桥、陡坡、隧道或者容易发生危险的路段，不得超车。

question_en: If a special vehicle performing an emergency task is behind you, you may temporarily use an unoccupied non-motor vehicle lane to yield.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇到后方有执行紧急任务的特种车辆时，可以临时使用无人通行的非机动车道让行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: You should proactively yield to special vehicles performing emergency tasks.
explanation_zh: 后方有执行紧急任务的特种车辆时，临时借用无人通行的非机动车道让行是可以的。

question_en: When driving in snow, you should turn on low beams and fog lights to indicate your vehicle's position to others.
question_zh: 雪天行车时，应开启近光灯和雾灯告知其他车辆本车位置。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In snow with reduced visibility, low beams should be turned on to alert other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 下雪视线受阻，车容易被雪覆盖，要开近光灯提醒前后车注意。雪天不是雾天，不用开雾灯。

question_en: When meeting oncoming traffic on a narrow mountain road, the side against the hillside has a wider view, so it should let the side away from the hillside go first.
question_zh: 在狭窄的山路会车，靠山体的一方视野宽阔，所以要让不靠山体的一方优先行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On a narrow mountain road, the relatively more dangerous side has the right of way.
explanation_zh: “让不靠山体的一方优先行驶”是正确的，但不是因为“靠山体的一方视野宽阔”，而是因为“靠山体的一方相对安全”。如果发生意外或者天气、道路情况过差，靠山体外侧的车辆更容易出现坠崖等特殊事故。

question_en: When visibility is impaired by rain, turning on high beams will improve visibility.
question_zh: 雨天行车视线受阻，开启远光灯会提高能见度。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams refracted by rain will impair the driver's own vision.
explanation_zh: 由于光在水中会发生折射现象，开启远光灯不仅不能提高视野，返回会因光线的折射导致视野模糊。因此雨天慎用远光灯。

question_en: When driving out of an underground parking garage, you should follow the direction of the guide arrows and must not drive against them.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车驶出地下车库时，应按照导向箭头的方向行驶，不得逆行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Visibility in underground garages is limited, so driving arbitrarily can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 出地下车库，应该按照导向箭头行驶，如果逆行很容易和对向车发生事故。

question_en: [Image] As shown, when a motor vehicle encounters this signal light lit at an intersection, it should proceed only after confirming safety.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯亮时，应当确认安全后通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.
explanation_zh: 信号灯是绿灯，对面有来车未开启转向灯，确认不是左转弯，不影响自己直行，可以安全通过。

question_en: When making a temporary roadside stop, a motor vehicle may park side by side with another temporarily.
question_zh: 机动车在道路边临时停车时，可以暂时并列停放。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Temporary stopping must not obstruct other road users.
explanation_zh: 在路边临时停车时应遵循“不影响正常交通”的原则，因此除了要靠路边之外，还要尽可能留出空间便于其他车辆通行。

question_en: Driving at 70 km/h on an expressway with no speed limit sign and three lanes in the same direction, which lane should you use?
question_zh: 以70公里/小时的速度在没有限速标志的同向3车道的高速公路上行驶，应该走哪个车道？
options_en: A. The leftmost lane | B. The middle lane | C. The rightmost lane | D. Any of the above
options_zh: A. 最左侧车道 | B. 中间车道 | C. 最右侧车道 | D. 以上均可
why_en: With two lanes in the same direction, the left lane's minimum speed is 100 km/h.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第七十八条：同方向有2条车道的，左侧车道的最低车速为每小时100公里；同方向有3条以上车道的，最左侧车道的最低车速为每小时110公里，中间车道的最低车速为每小时90公里。道路限速标志标明的车速与上述车道行驶车速的规定不一致的，按照道路限速标志标明的车速行驶。

question_en: [Image] As shown, if car A wants to turn left, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 如图所示，A车若想左转，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Go straight through and choose a new route | B. Turn left from the straight-only lane | C. Change directly into the left-turn lane | D. Turn right and choose a new route
options_zh: A. 直行通过，重新选择行驶路线 | B. 从直行车道左转 | C. 直接变更到左转车道 | D. 向右转弯，重新选择行驶路线
why_en: A straight-only lane cannot be used to turn.
explanation_zh: A车所在车道是直行车道，如需左转弯，只能在左转弯车道进行转弯。目前已错过转弯机会，应当直行通过后，重新选择行驶路线。

question_en: When driving on an expressway, you should avoid driving alongside other vehicles for extended periods as much as possible.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶时，应尽可能避免与其他车辆长时间并行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive courteously, safety first.
explanation_zh: 长时间与其他车辆并排行驶，是一件非常危险的事情，特别是在车速较快的情况下，邻道车辆发生突发情况，很容易引发事故以及被事故所波及。

question_en: Before entering a railway crossing, a vehicle should slow down and downshift; gear changes are allowed after entering the crossing.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆驶入铁路道口前应减速降挡，进入道口后可以变换挡位。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Slowing down and downshifting must be completed before entering the railway crossing.
explanation_zh: 进入铁道路口后不能变换挡位，换挡容易熄火。

question_en: When traffic lights, traffic signs, or road markings conflict with a traffic police officer's directions, how should you proceed?
question_zh: 遇到交通信号灯、交通标志或交通标线与交通警察的指挥不一致时，应如何行驶?
options_en: A. Follow the traffic light | B. Follow the traffic police officer's directions | C. Follow the traffic sign | D. Follow the road marking
options_zh: A. 按交通信号灯行驶 | B. 按交通警察指挥行驶 | C. 按交通标志行驶 | D. 按交通标线行驶
why_en: A traffic police officer's hand signal takes priority over all other traffic signals.
explanation_zh: 首先优先按照交通警察指示行驶。其次没有交警在的前提下服从交通标志或交通标线，最后才是交通信号。

question_en: [Image] As shown, a motor vehicle may not turn left in this situation.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车在这种情况下不可以左转弯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.
explanation_zh: 图中左转信号灯是绿灯，不管对向车是直行还是右转，我们可以左转；如果对向车是直行，我们必须让对向车辆先行；如果对向车是右转，他必须让我们先行。

question_en: When driving at night through sharp curves, slopes, humpback bridges, or pedestrian crossings, you should alternate high and low beams to signal.
question_zh: 夜间驾驶机动车通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive slowly and cautiously at night.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十九条：机动车在夜间通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道或者没有交通信号灯控制的路口时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。

question_en: When encountering slow-moving traffic ahead on an expressway, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上遇前方车流缓行时，以下做法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. Follow the flow of traffic while keeping a safe distance | B. Drive into the emergency lane | C. You may reverse | D. Stop immediately
options_zh: A. 跟随车流行驶，保持安全车距 | B. 进入应急车道行驶 | C. 可以倒车 | D. 立即停车
why_en: Traffic congestion is even more reason not to force your way through.
explanation_zh: 高速路车流很慢说明前方发生状况，一定不要超车，要跟随车流，保持安全车距行驶。

question_en: [Image] As shown, car A's action is correct.
question_zh: 如图所示，A车的行为是正确的。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A dashed line permits lane changes; a solid line must not be crossed.
explanation_zh: 由图可知A车想进入减速车道，只能提前从虚线处进入，但是已经错过路口，只能继续行驶，在下一个路口进入，不得压实线行驶。

question_en: [Image] As shown, after exiting the ramp lane, a motor vehicle may drive directly into the through lane.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车驶出车道后可以直接驶入行车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The process for entering an expressway is: entrance, ramp, acceleration lane, then the normal travel lane.
explanation_zh: 机动车进入高速后，必须经过加速车道加速后。打开左转向灯，确认后方无车辆通过后再进入行车道。

question_en: At night, when passing through an intersection with no or poor streetlighting, a following vehicle driving close behind a vehicle ahead in the same direction may use high beams to alert the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 夜间通过没有路灯或路灯照明不良的路口，同方向行驶的后车与前车近距离行驶时，可以使用远光灯提醒前车注意。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Low beams should be used when following closely at night.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十八条：
机动车在夜间没有路灯、照明不良或者遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度情况下行驶时，应当开启前照灯、示廓灯和后位灯，但同方向行驶的后车与前车近距离行驶时，不得使用远光灯。

question_en: [Image] As shown, when a motor vehicle encounters this situation, it should slow down while continuously honking to remind pedestrians to check the road conditions.
question_zh: 如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到这种情况，要减速慢行，同时持续鸣喇叭提醒行人查看路况。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Continuous honking can startle pedestrians into crossing erratically, leading to accidents.
explanation_zh: 行驶中，遇低头看手机或打电话等不集中精力观察路口的行人时，一定要提前鸣喇叭提示，并减速慢行。不得持续鸣喇叭，防止临近鸣喇叭使其慌不择路，出现危险。

question_en: When a vehicle drives on an expressway at a speed below 100 km/h, the minimum safe following distance from the vehicle ahead in the same lane is 100 meters or more.
question_zh: 车辆在高速公路以低于每小时100公里的速度行驶时，距同车道前车最低保持100米以上为安全距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Expressway rule: above 100 km/h requires a following distance over 100 meters; below 100 km/h requires over 50 meters.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第八十条：
机动车在高速公路上行驶，车速超过每小时100公里时，应当与同车道前车保持100米以上的距离，车速低于每小时100公里时，与同车道前车距离可以适当缩短，但最小距离不得少于50米。

question_en: When driving a motor vehicle in the slow lane on a road with two or more lanes in the same direction, if you need to pass the vehicle ahead in the same lane, you may pass via the fast lane.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在同方向划有2条以上机动车道的慢速车道内行驶，需要超越同车道行驶的前车时，可以通过快速车道进行超越。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking must be done from the left side, so passing via the fast lane on the left is correct.
explanation_zh: 根据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第四十四条 在道路同方向划有2条以上机动车道的，左侧为快速车道，右侧为慢速车道。在快速车道行驶的机动车应当按照快速车道规定的速度行驶，未达到快速车道规定的行驶速度的，应当在慢速车道行驶。摩托车应当在最右侧车道行驶。有交通标志标明行驶速度的，按照标明的行驶速度行驶。慢速车道内的机动车超越前车时，可以借用快速车道行驶。

question_en: Parking a motor vehicle within 50 meters of a construction section is prohibited.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车距离施工路段50米内禁止停放车辆。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The rule bars parking within 30m of a bus stop and within 50m of intersections or construction zones.
explanation_zh:
根据《道路安全法实施条例》第六十三条，机动车在道路上临时停车应当遵守下列规定：
（1）在设有禁停标志、标线的路段，在机动车道与非机动车道、人行道之间设有隔离设施的路段以及人行横道、施工地段，不得停车；
（2）交叉路口、铁路道口、急转弯、宽度不足4米的窄路、桥梁、陡坡、隧道以及距离上述地点50米以内的路段，不得停车；
（3）公共汽车站、急救站、加油站、消防栓或者消防队（站）门前以及距离上述地点30米以内的路段，除使用上述设施的以外，不得停车；
（4）车辆停稳前不得开车门和上下人员，开关车门不得妨碍其他车辆和行人通行；
（5）路边停车应当紧靠道路右侧，机动车驾驶人不得离车，上下人员或者装卸物品后，立即驶离；
（6）城市公共汽车不得在站点以外的路段停车上下乘客。

question_en: Warning markings function to make road users aware of special conditions on the road, raising alertness and preparing them for responsive precautions.
question_zh: 警告标线的作用是促使道路使用者了解道路上的特殊情况，提高警觉准备应变防范措施。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Warning markings exist precisely to alert road users to hazards.
explanation_zh: 警告标线是促使机动车驾驶人和行人了解道路变化的情况，提高警觉，准确防范，及时采取应变措施的标线。

question_en: A blue parking space marking indicates a paid parking space.
question_zh: 停车位标线为蓝色表示收费停车位。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: White markings indicate paid parking, blue indicates free parking, and yellow indicates reserved parking.
explanation_zh: 颜色为白色的泊位，表示此停车位为收费停车位，多位于人行道及退缩线上，适用于交投公司停车收费管理；颜色为黄色的泊位，表示此停车位为专属停车位，适用于承租的车位或有关单位申请设置的，供办公、方便群众车辆停放的车位；颜色为蓝色的泊位，表示此停车位为免费停车位，适用于政府部门办公场地周边规划的泊位。

question_en: When using a flexible tow-link device, what distance should be kept between the towing vehicle and the towed vehicle?
question_zh: 使用软连接牵引装置时，牵引车与被牵引车之间应当保持多远距离？
options_en: A. Less than 0.5 meters | B. Less than 4 meters | C. More than 4 meters but less than 10 meters | D. More than 10 meters
options_zh: A. 小于0.5米 | B. 小于4米 | C. 大于4米小于10米 | D. 大于10米
why_en: Chinese traffic rules require the gap between vehicles joined by a flexible tow connector to be 4 to 10 meters.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第六十一条 牵引故障机动车应当遵守下列规定：（一）被牵引的机动车除驾驶人外不得载人，不得拖带挂车；（二）被牵引的机动车宽度不得大于牵引机动车的宽度；（三）使用软连接牵引装置时，牵引车与被牵引车之间的距离应当大于4米小于10米；

question_en: When pulling over to park a motor vehicle on the road, how should lights be used?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在路上靠边停车，应如何使用灯光？
options_en: A. Alternate between high and low beams | B. No need to turn on any lights | C. Turn on the hazard warning lights | D. Turn on the right turn signal in advance
options_zh: A. 变换使用远、近光灯 | B. 不用开启灯光 | C. 开启危险报警闪光灯 | D. 提前开启右转向灯
why_en: Pulling over requires the right turn signal; U-turns and overtaking require the left turn signal.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十七条规定，机动车应当按照下列规定使用转向灯：（一）向左转弯、向左变更车道、准备超车、驶离停车地点或者掉头时，应当提前开启左转向灯；（二）向右转弯、向右变更车道、超车完毕驶回原车道、靠路边停车时，应当提前开启右转向灯。

question_en: For failing to use lights as required while driving a motor vehicle, how many demerit points are given per violation?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车不按规定使用灯光的，将被一次记多少分？
options_en: A. 1 point | B. 9 points | C. 3 points | D. 6 points
options_zh: A. 1分 | B. 9分 | C. 3分 | D. 6分
why_en: Improper light use, marking/line violations, missed inspection, and no seatbelt each carry a 1-point penalty.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全违法行为记分管理办法》规定，机动车驾驶人有下列交通违法行为之一，一次记1分：
（一）驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上行驶超过规定时速百分之十以上未达到百分之二十的；
（二）驾驶机动车不按规定会车，或者在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上不按规定倒车、掉头的；
（三）驾驶机动车不按规定使用灯光的；
（四）驾驶机动车违反禁令标志、禁止标线指示的；
（五）驾驶机动车载货长度、宽度、高度超过规定的；
（六）驾驶载货汽车载物超过最大允许总质量未达到百分之三十的；
（七）驾驶未按规定定期进行安全技术检验的公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车上道路行驶的；
（八）驾驶擅自改变已登记的结构、构造或者特征的载货汽车上道路行驶的；
（九）驾驶机动车在道路上行驶时，机动车驾驶人未按规定系安全带的；
（十）驾驶摩托车，不戴安全头盔的。

question_en: When starting to drive at night on a road section with street lighting, high beams should be used.
question_zh: 夜间驾驶机动车在有路灯照明的路段起步，应开启远光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams may only be used where lighting is poor and no vehicles are ahead or approaching.
explanation_zh: 夜间驾驶机动车在有路灯照明的路段起步，应开启近光灯和左转向灯。

question_en: Regarding the use of turn signals while driving, which statement is correct?
question_zh: 关于驾驶机动车时转向灯的使用，以下说法正确的是什么？
options_en: A. The turn signal may be skipped when returning to the original lane after overtaking | B. The turn signal is not needed when pulling away from a parked position | C. The right turn signal should be turned on in advance when pulling over to park | D. The turn signal may be skipped when changing lanes
options_zh: A. 超车完毕驶回原车道时可不开转向灯 | B. 驶离停车地点时不必开启转向灯 | C. 靠边停车时应提前开启右转向灯 | D. 准备变更车道时可以不开转向灯
why_en: Turn signals must be used in advance for pulling over, changing lanes, finishing an overtake, and pulling away from a stop.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十七条：机动车应当按照下列规定使用转向灯：(一)向左转弯、向左变更车道、准备超车、驶离停车地点或者掉头时，应当提前开启左转向灯；(二)向右转弯、向右变更车道、超车完毕驶回原车道、靠路边停车时，应当提前开启右转向灯。

question_en: In which of the following driving situations is a turn signal required? (1) preparing to overtake (2) turning at an intersection (3) pulling over to park (4) changing lanes
question_zh: 下列驾驶情形中，需要使用转向灯的是？①准备超车②路口转弯③靠边停车④变更车道
options_zh: A. 只有① | B. 只有①② | C. 只有①②③ | D. ①②③④
why_en: Any change in driving state must be signaled to other vehicles in time.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十七条：机动车应当按照下列规定使用转向灯：(一)向左转弯、向左变更车道、准备超车、驶离停车地点或者掉头时，应当提前开启左转向灯；(二)向右转弯、向右变更车道、超车完毕驶回原车道、靠路边停车时，应当提前开启右转向灯。

question_en: How should lights be used when driving through a crosswalk at night?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在夜间通过人行横道时怎样使用灯光？
options_en: A. Alternate between high and low beams | B. Turn on the fog lights | C. Turn on the high beams | D. Turn off the headlights
options_zh: A. 变换远、近光灯 | B. 开启雾灯 | C. 开启远光灯 | D. 关闭前大灯
why_en: Alternating high and low beams signals pedestrians at a crosswalk at night.
explanation_zh:
《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十九条 ：机动车在夜间通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道或者没有交通信号灯控制的路口时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。

机动车驶近急弯、坡道顶端等影响安全视距的路段以及超车或者遇有紧急情况时，应当减速慢行，并鸣喇叭示意。

question_en: At a signal-controlled intersection, when the through signal is green and the left-turn signal is red, a vehicle may enter the left-turn waiting area to wait.
question_zh: 在有信号灯的交叉路口，直行是绿灯，左转是红灯时，车辆可以进入左转待转区等待。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Entering the left-turn waiting area is allowed only while the through signal is green.
explanation_zh: 直行信号是红色，禁止跨越停止线，不可以直接进入左转弯待转区；直行信号灯为绿色同时左转信号灯为红色，可以进入左转待转区等候；当左转变绿灯，车辆可以左转。

question_en: On narrow mountain slopes, when vehicles meet, the downhill vehicle has the right of way because downhill speed is harder to control and more dangerous.
question_zh: 山区狭窄坡路会车时，下坡的车辆先行，因为下坡速度不好控制更加危险。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On a narrow slope, the uphill vehicle has the right of way, not the downhill one.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第四十八条第三款规定：在狭窄的坡路，上坡的一方先行；但下坡的一方已行至中途而上坡的一方未上坡时，下坡的一方先行。

question_en: What light should be turned on when a motor vehicle enters an expressway from a ramp?
question_zh: 机动车从匝道驶入高速公路，应当开启什么灯？
options_en: A. Left turn signal | B. Right turn signal | C. Hazard warning lights | D. Headlights
options_zh: A. 左转向灯 | B. 右转向灯 | C. 危险报警闪光灯 | D. 前照灯
why_en: Merging is a leftward lane change, so the left turn signal must be used in advance.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法实施条例》第七十九条：机动车从匝道驶入高速公路，应当开启左转向灯，在不妨碍已在高速公路内的机动车正常行驶的情况下驶入车道。机动车驶离高速公路时，应当开启右转向灯，驶入减速车道，降低车速后驶离。

question_en: A tidal lane is a variable lane whose direction of travel is adjusted according to morning and evening traffic flow.
question_zh: 潮汐车道是可变车道，会根据早晚车流量，调整车道行驶方向。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Tidal lanes are designed specifically to handle morning and evening traffic peaks.
explanation_zh: 潮汐车道就是可变车道，城市内部根据早晚交通流量不同情况，对有条件的道路设置一个或多个车辆行驶方向规定随不同时段变化的车道。

question_en: Which of the following signs indicates a dip (low-lying road surface) ahead?
question_zh: 下面哪个标志表示注意路面低洼？
options_en: A. Figure ① | B. Figure ② | C. Figure ③ | D. Figure ④
options_zh: A. 图① | B. 图② | C. 图③ | D. 图④
why_en: Memory aid: a downward curve marks a dip or low point, an upward curve marks a hump.
explanation_zh: 图①中间凸起像个桥是驼峰桥，图②两个凸起是路面不平，图③中间一个凸起是路面高凸。图④中间向下凹，是路面低洼。

question_en: Traffic police hand signals carry the strongest legal authority among all traffic signals (signal lights, signs, markings, etc.).
question_zh: 交通警察手势信号是所有交通信号(信号灯、标志、标线等)当中法律效力最强的一种信号。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Police hand signals take precedence over all other traffic signals.
explanation_zh: 交通警察的指挥是一种特殊的交通信号，也是一种动态的、灵活的交通引导方式，它可以根据道路交通实际情况,灵活地引导、指挥交通，保障道路交通安全、畅通。交通警察的指挥具有优先权。

question_en: When driving at night and the light turns green at an intersection, if pedestrians are still crossing the crosswalk, high beams should be used to hurry them along.
question_zh: 夜间驾驶机动车在路口遇前方绿灯亮起时，如果人行横道上仍有行人通过，应开启远光灯催促其尽快通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians under all circumstances.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第四十七条：机动车行经人行横道时，应当减速行驶；遇行人正在通过人行横道，应当停车让行。

question_en: Which of the following signs indicates an uneven road surface ahead?
question_zh: 下面哪个标志表示注意路面不平？
options_en: A. Figure ① | B. Figure ② | C. Figure ③ | D. Figure ④
options_zh: A. 图① | B. 图② | C. 图③ | D. 图④
why_en: Memory aid: a downward curve marks a dip, an upward curve marks a hump; this sign shows uneven bumps.
explanation_zh: 图①中间凸起像个桥是驼峰桥，图②两个凸起是路面不平，图③中间一个凸起是路面高凸。图④中间向下凹，是路面低洼。

question_en: Which of the following signs indicates a hump (camelback) bridge ahead?
question_zh: 下面哪个标志表示注意驼峰桥？
options_en: A. Figure ① | B. Figure ② | C. Figure ③ | D. Figure ④
options_zh: A. 图① | B. 图② | C. 图③ | D. 图④
why_en: Memory aid: the hump-shaped sign with a bridge outline indicates a camelback bridge.
explanation_zh: 图①中间凸起像个桥是驼峰桥，图②两个凸起是路面不平，图③中间一个凸起是路面高凸。图④中间向下凹，是路面低洼。

question_en: Before entering a two-way tunnel, high beams should be turned on.
question_zh: 车辆驶入双向行驶隧道前，要开启远光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: High beams blind oncoming drivers in a tunnel and can easily cause an accident.
explanation_zh: 车辆进入双向行驶隧道，一般都应该开启近光灯，而不要开启远光灯。若是隧道本身没有灯光的，可以变换灯光行驶，但是会车前要换成近光灯。

question_en: When waiting at an intersection with no traffic lights, it is acceptable to temporarily use the opposing lane to avoid causing worse congestion.
question_zh: 在没有交通信号灯的路口遇停车等待时，可以临时占用对面车道，以免造成更大的拥堵。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Occupying the opposing lane at a congested intersection can make the congestion even worse.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第四十五条： 机动车遇有前方车辆停车排队等候或者缓慢行驶时，不得借道超车或者占用对面车道，不得穿插等候的车辆。在车道减少的路段、路口，或者在没有交通信号灯、交通标志、交通标线或者交通警察指挥的交叉路口遇到停车排队等候或者缓慢行驶时，机动车应当依次交替通行。

question_en: Prohibition markings function to inform road users of special rules such as mandatory compliance, prohibitions, and restrictions.
question_zh: 禁止标线的作用是告知道路使用者道路交通的遵行、禁止、限制等特殊规定。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This is the defined function of prohibition markings under traffic regulations.
explanation_zh: 道路交通禁止标线，是指由标划于路面的各种线条、箭头、文字以及立体标记、突起路标和路边线轮廓标记等构成的交通信号设施。用于告知道路使用者道路交通的遵行、禁止、限制等特殊规定。

question_en: Work-zone signs function to announce road closures, detours, and similar conditions.
question_zh: 作业区标志的作用是通告道路交通阻断、绕行等情况。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Work-zone signs direct drivers to detour as indicated by the sign.
explanation_zh: 作业区标志的作用是通告道路交通阻断、绕行等情况。用于作业区的标志为警告、禁令、指示及指路标志。

question_en: If a vehicle breaks down or is in an accident on an expressway, the driver should pull the car to the side, evacuate people, and call for help immediately, to avoid a secondary accident.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在高速公路上发生车辆故障或事故时，应做到“车靠边、人撤离、即报警”，避免发生二次事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Expressway breakdown procedure: hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, place a warning triangle, evacuate people, then call for help.
explanation_zh: 车辆在高速公路上发生事故或故障后，车辆能移动的，应迅速将车辆移至右侧的应急车道，打开危险报警闪光灯并在150米处放置警告标志；发生事故后，无论车辆能否移动，驾乘人员不要留在车内，也不要在高速公路上逗留，应迅速转移至护栏外等安全地带；驾乘人员撤离到安全地带后，立即拨打110报警电话报警。

question_en: What color is the parking line marking for a free parking space?
question_zh: 免费停车位的停车标线是什么颜色?
options_en: A. White | B. Blue | C. Yellow | D. Red
options_zh: A. 白色 | B. 蓝色 | C. 黄色 | D. 红色
why_en: White markings indicate paid parking, blue indicates free parking, and yellow indicates reserved parking.
explanation_zh: 颜色为白色的泊位，表示此停车位为收费停车位，多位于人行道及退缩线上，适用于交投公司停车收费管理；颜色为黄色的泊位，表示此停车位为专属停车位，适用于承租的车位或有关单位申请设置的，供办公、方便群众车辆停放的车位；颜色为蓝色的泊位，表示此停车位为免费停车位，适用于政府部门办公场地周边规划的泊位。

question_en: When changing lanes, once the turn signal is switched on in advance, the lane change can be made immediately.
question_zh: 变更车道时，提前打开转向灯后，就可以立即变更车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Lane changes require signaling, checking behind, and confirming a safe gap before actually moving over.
explanation_zh: 变更车道时需要提前开启转向灯提醒后车，然后观察周围交通环境，确认安全后再驶入要变更的车道。題目说立即，沒有观察确认安全，所以错误。

question_en: How should lights be used when a motor vehicle finishes overtaking and returns to its original lane?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车完成超车、驶回原车道时，应该怎样使用灯光?
options_en: A. Turn on the left turn signal | B. Turn on the right turn signal | C. Turn on the low beams | D. Turn on the hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 开启左转向灯 | B. 开启右转向灯 | C. 开启近光灯 | D. 开启危险报警闪光灯
why_en: Overtaking is done from the left, so returning to the original lane on the right requires the right turn signal.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十七条规定，机动车应当按照下列规定使用转向灯：
(一)向左转弯、向左变更车道、准备超车、驶离停车地点或者掉头时，应当提前开启左转向灯；
(二)向右转弯、向右变更车道、超车完毕驶回原车道、靠路边停车时，应当提前开启右转向灯。

question_en: Which of the following distances is NOT included in stopping sight distance?
question_zh: 停车视距不包括以下哪个距离？
options_en: A. Starting distance | B. Reaction distance | C. Braking distance | D. Safety distance
options_zh: A. 启动距离 | B. 反应距离 | C. 制动距离 | D. 安全距离
why_en: Stopping sight distance runs from spotting an obstacle to fully stopping, which excludes the starting distance.
explanation_zh: 停车视距指的是同一车道上，车辆行驶时遇到前方障碍物而必须采取制动停车时所需要最短行车距离。停车视距由反应距离、制动距离和安全距离三个方面组成。反应距离是指当驾驶人员发现前方的障碍物，经过判断决定采取制动措施的那一瞬间到制动器真正开始起作用的那一瞬间汽车所行驶的距离。制动距离是指汽车从制动生效到汽车完全停住，这段时间内所走的距离。安全距离是汽车完全停止后与障碍物间应保持的最小安全距离。

question_en: Warning signs alert drivers that there is danger ahead and that they must proceed with caution.
question_zh: 警告标志是警告机动车驾驶人前方有危险，需谨慎通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Yellow-plate signs are, by definition, warning signs.
explanation_zh: 警告标志的颜色为黄底、黑边、黑图形；形状为等边三角形或矩形。个别标志除外。警告标志的设置是为了警示驾驶人、行人前方有危险，道路使用者行车需谨慎通过。

question_en: When intending to change lanes while driving, the turn signal should be switched on in advance and the lane change made smoothly only once safety is confirmed.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，欲变更车道时，应提前开启转向灯，在确认安全的前提下，平稳变更车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Lane changes must only be carried out once safety has been confirmed.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，如果要变更车道，应提前开启转向灯，在确认安全的前提下，平稳变更车道。

question_en: If symptoms such as fainting, nausea, weakness, or hallucinations that affect safe driving occur, the driver must not continue driving, to avoid a traffic accident.
question_zh: 出现晕厥、恶心、乏力、幻象等影响安全驾驶的现象时，驾驶人不能继续驾驶机动车，避免发生交通事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety always comes first when driving.
explanation_zh: 出现晕厥、恶心、乏力、幻象等影响安全驾驶的现象时，不能继续驾驶，以免发生交通事故，造成严重的事故伤害。

question_en: How should lights be used when preparing to exit a roundabout?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车准备驶离环岛时，应如何使用灯光？
options_en: A. Turn on the left turn signal in advance | B. No signal is needed | C. Turn on the hazard warning lights | D. Turn on the right turn signal in advance
options_zh: A. 提前开启左转向灯 | B. 不用指示灯提示 | C. 开启危险报警闪光灯 | D. 提前开启右转向灯
why_en: No signal is needed entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal is required when exiting.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第五十七条规定，机动车应当按照下列规定使用转向灯：(一)向左转弯、向左变更车道、准备超车、驶离停车地点或者掉头时，应当提前开启左转向灯；(二)向右转弯、向右变更车道、超车完毕驶回原车道、靠路边停车时，应当提前开启右转向灯。车辆进入环岛的时候不需要开指示灯，驶出环岛的时候，要开右转向灯。

question_en: When passing a crosswalk at a school gate, it is fine to accelerate through as long as no pedestrians are crossing.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车通过学校门口的人行横道，只要没有行人经过，就可以加速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Accelerating through a crosswalk is never correct, even without pedestrians present.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车通过学校门口的人行横道，要及时减速，注意观察，做好随时停车的准备，预防突然有学生横穿马路。

question_en: When reversing a motor vehicle, the driver must clearly check the situation behind the car and confirm it is safe before reversing.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车倒车时，应当察明车后情况，确认安全后倒车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Reversing has blind spots, so drivers must observe surroundings carefully and yield to passing vehicles.
explanation_zh: 《实施条例》第五十条：机动车倒车时，应当察明车后情况，确认安全后倒车。不得在铁路道口、交叉路口、单行路、桥梁、急弯、陡坡或者隧道中倒车。

question_en: When meeting oncoming traffic on a congested road, the lateral distance between the two vehicles does not need attention.
