options_en: A. Front fog light on | B. Rear fog light on | C. Low beam headlight on | D. High beam headlight on
options_zh: A. 前雾灯打开 | B. 后雾灯打开 | C. 前照灯近光打开 | D. 前照灯远光打开
why_en: The front fog light indicator is green and points left; the rear fog light indicator is yellow and points right.
explanation_zh: 前雾灯绿色光朝左，后雾灯黄色光朝右。

question_en: [Image] Which warning light in the picture indicates a charging circuit malfunction?
question_zh: 图中哪个报警灯亮，提示充电电路异常或故障？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the fuel indicator, Figure 2 is the brake system fault symbol, Figure 3 is the ABS indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1为燃油指示灯；图2为手刹指示灯；图3为ABS指示灯；图4为电瓶指示灯。有正负极＋－标志的，就表示有电嘛。

question_en: What does this position of the rotary switch control?
question_zh: 旋转开关这一挡控制机动车哪个部位？
options_en: A. Left and right turn signals | B. Low beam | C. Front and rear fog lights | D. High beam
options_zh: A. 左右转向灯 | B. 近光灯 | C. 前后雾灯 | D. 远光灯
why_en: The light on the left is the front fog light and the light on the right is the rear fog light.
explanation_zh: 此处为雾灯的控制。顺便回忆一下，哪个控制前雾灯，哪个控制后雾灯。下边的控制前雾灯，上边的控制后雾灯。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮时表示什么？
options_en: A. Low beam headlight on | B. Front fog light on | C. High beam headlight on | D. Rear fog light on
options_zh: A. 已开启前照灯近光 | B. 已开启前雾灯 | C. 已开启前照灯远光 | D. 已开启后雾灯
why_en: Blue parallel lines indicate the high beam; green slanted lines indicate the low beam.
explanation_zh: 光束直射，蓝色向左是远光。

question_en: While driving, which of the following lights coming on indicates a fault in the brake system?
question_zh: 行车中下列哪个灯亮，提示驾驶人车辆制动系统出现异常？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the fuel indicator, Figure 2 is the water temperature indicator, Figure 4 is the engine check light.
explanation_zh: 图1是燃油指示灯；图2是水温指示灯；图3是手刹指示灯；图4是发动机自检灯。车辆制动系统出现异常自然是与手刹有关啦。

question_en: Which of the following shows the correct way to wear a seatbelt?
question_zh: 以下安全带系法正确的是？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: The seatbelt should run from shoulder to waist, crossing from the right hip to the left hip.
explanation_zh: 容易选错的是图四，如果安全带位置过低，低于肩部，就起不到最基本安全保障作用。而滑落至肩膀，还可能会限制住身体，影响方向盘的操作。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, it warns that the right door is not closed.
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮，提示右侧车门未关闭。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This light coming on reminds the driver to close all doors properly before setting off, not specifically the right door.
explanation_zh: 很明显是左侧车门未关闭。

question_en: What does this gauge indicate?
question_zh: 这个仪表是何含义？
options_en: A. Ammeter | B. Pressure gauge | C. Water temperature gauge | D. Fuel gauge
options_zh: A. 电流表 | B. 压力表 | C. 水温表 | D. 燃油表
why_en: A thermometer measures water temperature, showing the engine's coolant temperature.
explanation_zh: 上面有个温度计，是水温表，表示发动机水温。

question_en: [Image] While driving, what does this dashboard indicator lighting up mean?
question_zh: 行车中仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Engine temperature too low | B. Engine temperature too high | C. Engine cooling system fault | D. Engine lubrication system fault
options_zh: A. 发动机温度过低 | B. 发动机温度过高 | C. 发动机冷却系故障 | D. 发动机润滑系故障
why_en: High engine temperature may be caused by insufficient coolant.
explanation_zh: 此标志亮起说明发动机水温过高，可能是冷却液不足引起的。

question_en: What is this pedal?
question_zh: 这是什么踏板？
options_en: A. Accelerator pedal | B. Clutch pedal | C. Brake pedal | D. Parking brake
options_zh: A. 加速踏板 | B. 离合器踏板 | C. 制动踏板 | D. 驻车制动器
why_en: In a manual-transmission vehicle, the three foot pedals from left to right are clutch, brake, and accelerator.
explanation_zh: 手动挡车辆脚下三个踏板，左边是离合踏板，中间是制动踏板，右边是加速踏板。图中的标志是制动踏板。

question_en: What is this control device?
question_zh: 这是什么操纵装置？
options_en: A. Defroster switch | B. Turn signal switch | C. Headlight switch | D. Wiper switch
options_zh: A. 除雾器开关 | B. 转向灯开关 | C. 前照灯开关 | D. 刮水器开关
why_en: A fan shape represents the front windshield and a rectangle represents the rear window.
explanation_zh: 那些弯曲的箭头代表雾气。扩展：上面的按钮是前挡风除雾，下面的按钮是后挡风除雾。

question_en: [Image] What device does this switch symbol control?
question_zh: （如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？
options_en: A. Rear window defroster or demister | B. Front windshield wiper and washer | C. Rear window wiper and washer | D. Front windshield defroster or demister
options_zh: A. 后风窗玻璃除霜或除雾 | B. 前风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器 | C. 后风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器 | D. 前风窗玻璃除霜或除雾
why_en: A fan shape represents the front windshield and a rectangle represents the rear window.
explanation_zh: 前风窗是扇形，后风窗是矩形。后风窗上有弧虚线，是后风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the vehicle is using its high beams?
question_zh: 下列哪个指示灯亮表示车辆在使用远光灯？
why_en: The high beam produces a straight, level beam of light.
explanation_zh: 10a：车灯总开关；10b：前后雾灯；10c：驻车制动器处于制动状态；10d：远光灯。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard stays lit, it indicates a fault in the engine control system.
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）一直亮，表示发动机控制系统故障。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This light staying on indicates a fault in the engine control system.
explanation_zh: 发动机控制系统故障，此标志亮起。

question_en: What does this gauge indicate?
question_zh: 这个仪表是何含义？
options_en: A. Tachometer | B. Speedometer | C. Trip odometer | D. Fuel consumption per 100 km gauge
options_zh: A. 发动机转速表 | B. 行驶速度表 | C. 区间里程表 | D. 百公里油耗表
why_en: The number the needle points to, multiplied by one thousand, gives the current engine RPM.
explanation_zh: 上面有转速单位：x1000r/min，指针指示的数字乘以一千就是当时的转速。

question_en: What does this switch control on the vehicle?
question_zh: 这个开关控制机动车哪个部位？
options_en: A. Windshield demister | B. Windshield wiper | C. Hazard warning lights | D. Lighting and signal devices
options_zh: A. 风窗玻璃除雾器 | B. 风窗玻璃刮水器 | C. 危险报警闪光灯 | D. 照明、信号装置
why_en: Lights on the left, wipers on the right: the lever on the right side of the steering wheel controls the wipers.
explanation_zh: 这个控制风窗玻璃刮水器。风窗玻璃除雾器和危险报警闪光灯都是按钮形式的，照明、信号装置在方向盘左侧。

question_en: [Image] What device does this switch symbol control?
question_zh: （如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？
options_en: A. Child safety lock | B. Both side windows | C. Power doors | D. Door lock and unlock
options_zh: A. 儿童安全锁 | B. 两侧车窗玻璃 | C. 电动车门 | D. 车门锁住开锁
why_en: A key is used to lock and unlock things.
explanation_zh: 一把钥匙放在车门中间，表示车门锁住开锁标志。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Both side doors open | B. Trunk open | C. Engine hood open | D. Fuel filler cap open
options_zh: A. 两侧车门开启 | B. 行李舱开启 | C. 发动机舱开启 | D. 燃油箱盖开启
why_en: This light coming on reminds the driver to close the doors properly before setting off.
explanation_zh: 该指示灯用来显示车辆各车门状况，任意车门未关上，或者未关好，该指示灯都有点亮相应的车门指示灯，提示车主车门未关好，当车门关闭或者关好时，相应车门指示灯熄灭。此图显示是两侧车门未关。

question_en: What is this pedal?
question_zh: 这是什么踏板？
options_en: A. Accelerator pedal | B. Clutch pedal | C. Brake pedal | D. Parking brake
options_zh: A. 加速踏板 | B. 离合器踏板 | C. 制动踏板 | D. 驻车制动器
why_en: In a manual-transmission vehicle, the three foot pedals from left to right are clutch, brake, and accelerator.
explanation_zh: 左边是离合踏板，中间是制动踏板，右边是加速踏板。图中的是离合踏板。

question_en: What role does the ABS system play during emergency braking?
question_zh: 机动车在紧急制动时ABS系统会起到什么作用？
options_en: A. Cutting off power output | B. Automatically controlling steering | C. Reducing braking inertia | D. Preventing wheel lock-up
options_zh: A. 切断动力输出 | B. 自动控制方向 | C. 减轻制动惯性 | D. 防止车轮抱死
why_en: ABS stands for anti-lock braking system, which prevents wheel lock-up and keeps the front wheels steerable, avoiding skidding.
explanation_zh: ABS中文译为“防抱死刹车系统”，它是一种具有防滑、防锁死等优点的安全刹车控制系统。可以避免在紧急刹车时方向失控及车轮侧滑，使车轮在刹车时不被锁死，轮胎不在一个点上与地面摩擦，加大摩擦力，使刹车效率达到90％以上。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. ABS fault | B. Parking brake released | C. Airbag fault | D. Service brake system fault
options_zh: A. 防抱死制动系统故障 | B. 驻车制动器处于解除状态 | C. 安全气囊处于故障状态 | D. 行车制动系统故障
why_en: ABS stands for anti-lock braking system, so this light indicates an ABS fault.
explanation_zh: 防抱死制动系统出现故障标志，出现此标志，应停车检查防抱死系统。

question_en: [Image] What device does this switch symbol control?
question_zh: （如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？
options_en: A. Front windshield wiper | B. Rear window defroster | C. Rear window wiper | D. Front windshield defroster
options_zh: A. 前风窗玻璃刮水器 | B. 后风窗玻璃除霜 | C. 后风窗玻璃刮水器 | D. 前风窗玻璃除霜
why_en: A fan shape represents the front windshield and a rectangle represents the rear window.
explanation_zh: 此为前风窗玻璃刮水器。关于如何区分前风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器和后风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器，你只需记住一点半弧形的图标是前风窗，四四方方的图标就是后风窗。

question_en: What is the main purpose of the seatbelt in a collision?
question_zh: 机动车发生碰撞时座椅安全带主要作用是什么？
options_en: A. Reducing injury to occupants | B. Protecting occupants' waist | C. Protecting occupants' neck | D. Protecting occupants' chest
options_zh: A. 减轻驾乘人员伤害 | B. 保护驾乘人员腰部 | C. 保护驾乘人员颈部 | D. 保护驾乘人员胸部
why_en: For safety, the seatbelt must always be fastened before driving.
explanation_zh: 安全带在紧急情况下，可迅速拉紧，把人束缚在座椅上，防止人因惯性摔出去，减轻驾乘人员伤害。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮时表示什么？
options_en: A. High beam headlight on | B. Front fog light on | C. Rear fog light on | D. Low beam headlight on
options_zh: A. 已开启前照灯远光 | B. 已开启前雾灯 | C. 已开启后雾灯 | D. 已开启前照灯近光
why_en: Blue parallel lines indicate the high beam; green slanted lines indicate the low beam.
explanation_zh: 近光光束向下绿色在左边。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard stays lit, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）一直亮表示什么？
options_en: A. ABS fault | B. Airbag fault | C. Airbag is deploying | D. Seatbelt not fastened
options_zh: A. 防抱死制动系统故障 | B. 安全气囊处于故障状态 | C. 安全气囊处于工作状态 | D. 安全带没有系好
why_en: This light stays on only when the airbag system has a fault.
explanation_zh: 圆球表示安全气囊，黄色表示处于故障状态。

question_en: What is this control device?
question_zh: 这是什么操纵装置？
options_en: A. Combined light and signal switch | B. Reverse light switch | C. Wiper switch | D. Hazard warning light switch
options_zh: A. 灯光、信号组合开关 | B. 倒车灯开关 | C. 刮水器开关 | D. 危险报警闪光灯开关
why_en: Lights on the left, wipers on the right: the lever on the left side of the steering wheel controls lights and signals.
explanation_zh: 这个装置是灯光、信号组合开关，在方向盘左侧。

question_en: What does this gauge indicate?
question_zh: 这个仪表是何含义？
options_en: A. Ammeter | B. Pressure gauge | C. Water temperature gauge | D. Fuel gauge
options_zh: A. 电流表 | B. 压力表 | C. 水温表 | D. 燃油表
why_en: Blue indicates a full tank, red indicates the fuel is low.
explanation_zh: 里面有个加油机器，是燃油表。蓝色区域为油量充足，红色表示油量不足油箱的一半。

question_en: What is this control device?
question_zh: 这是什么操纵装置？
options_en: A. Light switch | B. Air conditioning switch | C. Ignition switch | D. Wiper switch
options_zh: A. 灯光开关 | B. 空调开关 | C. 点火开关 | D. 雨刷开关
why_en: You need to insert the key before you can ignite the engine.
explanation_zh: 图中为点火开关，点火开关4个档位的功能是：LOCK：切断电源，锁定方向盘；ACC：接通附件电源（比如收音机等附件）ON：接通除起动机外的全车全部电源；START：接通起动机电源，起动发动机。

question_en: What is this pedal?
question_zh: 这是什么踏板？
options_en: A. Accelerator pedal | B. Clutch pedal | C. Brake pedal | D. Parking brake
options_zh: A. 加速踏板 | B. 离合器踏板 | C. 制动踏板 | D. 驻车制动器
why_en: In a manual-transmission vehicle, the three foot pedals from left to right are clutch, brake, and accelerator.
explanation_zh: 左边是离合踏板，中间是制动踏板，右边是加速踏板。图中的标志是加速踏板。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the engine temperature is too high?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，表示发动机温度过高？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the oil indicator, Figure 3 is the ABS indicator, Figure 4 is the fuel indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1表示机油指示灯；图2表示水温指示灯，此灯常亮说明温度过高；图3是ABS指示灯；图4是燃油指示灯。

question_en: What must the front airbag work together with to be fully effective?
question_zh: 正面安全气囊与什么配合才能充分发挥保护作用？
options_en: A. Seatbelt | B. Anti-lock braking system | C. Headrest | D. Safety glass
options_zh: A. 座椅安全带 | B. 防抱死制动系统 | C. 座椅安全头枕 | D. 安全玻璃
why_en: Without a fastened seatbelt, airbag deployment can cause more severe head and neck injuries.
explanation_zh: 研究表明，假设气囊加安全带是100%安全的话，安全带的作用是70%，气囊的作用是30%。

question_en: In a rear-end collision, what part of the driver's body does the headrest effectively protect?
question_zh: 安全头枕在发生追尾事故时，能有效保护驾驶人的什么部位？
options_en: A. Waist | B. Chest | C. Neck | D. Head
options_zh: A. 腰部 | B. 胸部 | C. 颈部 | D. 头部
why_en: The top of the headrest should be level with the driver's head, centered behind the back of the head.
explanation_zh: 发生追尾时，因为有头枕，脖子不会因为冲击力过大而扭伤或者伤及颈椎。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Hazard warning lights on | B. Headlights on | C. Front and rear position lights on | D. Front and rear fog lights on
options_zh: A. 危险报警闪光灯开启 | B. 前照灯开启 | C. 前后位置灯开启 | D. 前后雾灯开启
why_en: The position light is the vehicle's clearance or side marker light.
explanation_zh: 仪表盘此标志亮表示前后位置灯开启。位置灯就是车辆示宽灯，对称的绿色标志。也许有人会觉得像雾灯，但是记住了，雾灯的光是3条平行线还有一条贯穿平行线的斜线。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the anti-lock braking system (ABS) has a fault?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，表示防抱死制动系统出现故障？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the oil indicator, Figure 2 is the fog light, Figure 4 is the water temperature indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1表示机油指示灯；图2表示前雾灯显示；图3是ABS指示灯，ABS就是防抱死系统的简称；图4是水温指示灯。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Interior air recirculation | B. Floor and face vents | C. Fresh air intake | D. Side and floor vents
options_zh: A. 空气内循环 | B. 地板及迎面出风 | C. 空气外循环 | D. 侧面及地板出风
why_en: The direction the arrow points to is where the air flows out.
explanation_zh: 直吹人脸表示迎面出风，垂直向下表示吹地板，因此该标志是地板及迎面出风。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on reminds the driver that the seatbelt buckle is not fastened?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，提醒驾驶人安全带插头未插入锁扣？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 2 is the water temperature indicator, Figure 3 is the ABS indicator, Figure 4 is the fuel indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1表示安全带插头未插入锁扣；图2是水温指示灯；图3是ABS指示灯；图4是燃油指示灯。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Interior air recirculation | B. Fresh air intake | C. Face-level air vents | D. Windshield defrost
options_zh: A. 空气内循环 | B. 空气外循环 | C. 迎面吹风 | D. 风窗玻璃除霜
why_en: If air only circulates within the cabin that is interior recirculation; this icon shows outside air entering, which is fresh air intake.
explanation_zh: 箭头从外面进来，是空气外循环。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Front fog light on | B. Rear fog light on | C. Low beam headlight on | D. High beam headlight on
options_zh: A. 前雾灯打开 | B. 后雾灯打开 | C. 前照灯近光打开 | D. 前照灯远光打开
why_en: The front fog light indicator is green and points left; the rear fog light indicator is yellow and points right.
explanation_zh: 前雾灯绿色光朝左，后雾灯黄色光朝右。

question_en: Which warning light coming on indicates an engine control system malfunction?
question_zh: 哪个报警灯亮，提示发动机控制系统异常或故障？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the fuel indicator, Figure 2 is the airbag indicator, Figure 4 is the water temperature indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1为燃油指示灯；图2为气囊指示灯；图3为发动机自检灯；图4为水温指示灯。

question_en: Which of the following gauges is the water temperature gauge?
question_zh: 以下哪个仪表表示水温表？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the tachometer, Figure 2 is the speedometer and odometer, Figure 4 is the fuel gauge.
explanation_zh: 水温表上有个温度标志。

question_en: What is this control device?
question_zh: 这是什么操纵装置？
options_en: A. Defroster switch | B. Turn signal switch | C. Headlight switch | D. Wiper switch
options_zh: A. 除雾器开关 | B. 转向灯开关 | C. 前照灯开关 | D. 刮水器开关
why_en: Lights on the left, wipers on the right: the lever on the right side of the steering wheel controls the wipers.
explanation_zh: 这个操纵杆装置为刮水器开关，位于方向盘右侧。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the vehicle is using its low beams?
question_zh: 下列哪个指示灯亮表示车辆在使用近光灯。
options_zh: A. 9a | B. 9b | C. 9c | D. 9d
why_en: The low beam shines toward the ground, with the light angled downward.
explanation_zh: 9a：示廓灯；9b：前后雾灯；9c：近光灯；9d：制动系统出现异常或者故障。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Left turn signal flashing | B. Right turn signal flashing | C. Front and rear position lights on | D. Front and rear clearance lights on
options_zh: A. 左转向指示灯闪烁 | B. 右转向指示灯闪烁 | C. 车前后位置灯亮起 | D. 车前后示宽灯亮起
why_en: Whichever side's arrow lights up indicates that side's turn signal.
explanation_zh: 该指示灯是右转向指示灯。通常为熄灭状态。当车主点亮转向灯时，该指示灯会同时点亮右转向指示灯，转向灯熄灭后，该指示灯自动熄灭。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Interior air recirculation | B. Side vents | C. Fresh air intake | D. Face-level vents
options_zh: A. 空气内循环 | B. 侧面出风 | C. 空气外循环 | D. 迎面出风
why_en: The direction the arrow points to is where the air flows out.
explanation_zh: 这道题图片上只有吹向人的箭头，所以是迎面出风。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Face-level vents | B. Fresh air intake | C. Interior air recirculation | D. Windshield defrost
options_zh: A. 迎面出风 | B. 空气外循环 | C. 空气内循环 | D. 风窗玻璃除霜
why_en: If the arrow points from outside the car to inside, that is fresh air intake; this icon shows air recirculating within the cabin.
explanation_zh: 箭头在车内循环，是空气内循环。当箭头是从车外进来的时，是空气外循环。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the fuel tank has reached its lowest level?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，表示油箱内燃油已到最低液面？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the oil indicator, Figure 2 is the front fog light, Figure 3 is the ABS indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1表示发动机机油压力过低；图2表示前雾灯显示；图3是ABS指示灯；图4表示燃油指示灯，有个加油站里的加油机的标志。

question_en: Which of the following gauges is the fuel gauge?
question_zh: 以下哪个仪表表示燃油表？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 1 is the tachometer, Figure 2 is the speedometer and odometer, Figure 3 is the water temperature gauge.
explanation_zh: 燃油表上有个加油站里的加油机的标志。

question_en: [Image] What does this dashboard symbol mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）这个符号表示什么？
options_en: A. One side door open | B. Trunk open | C. Engine hood open | D. Fuel filler cap open
options_zh: A. 一侧车门开启 | B. 行李舱开启 | C. 发动机舱开启 | D. 燃油箱盖开启
why_en: The engine compartment is at the front and the trunk is at the rear, so this icon indicates the trunk is open.
explanation_zh: 一般车型，前盖为发动机舱，后边为行李舱。

question_en: What part of the vehicle does lifting this switch control?
question_zh: 提拉这个开关控制机动车哪个部位？
options_en: A. Reverse light | B. Left and right turn signals | C. Clearance lights | D. Hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 倒车灯 | B. 左右转向灯 | C. 示廓灯 | D. 报警闪光灯
why_en: Lifting it up turns on the right turn signal; pulling it down turns on the left turn signal.
explanation_zh: 此开关控制左右转向灯。顺便回忆一下转向灯操作：上右下左。

question_en: What does this gauge indicate?
question_zh: 这个仪表是何含义？
options_en: A. Fuel consumption per 100 km gauge | B. Speedometer and odometer | C. Tachometer | D. Maximum speed gauge
options_zh: A. 百公里油耗表 | B. 速度和里程表 | C. 发动机转速表 | D. 最高时速值表
why_en: Pay attention to the units shown on the gauge.
explanation_zh: 题目中仪表盘有KM/h和KM，所以显示的是汽车的速度和里程表。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Front and rear position lights on | B. Right turn signal flashing | C. Left turn signal flashing | D. Front and rear clearance lights on
options_zh: A. 车前后位置灯亮起 | B. 右转向指示灯闪烁 | C. 左转向指示灯闪烁 | D. 车前后示宽灯亮起
why_en: Whichever side's arrow lights up indicates that side's turn signal.
explanation_zh: 该指示灯是左转向指示灯。通常为熄灭状态。当车主点亮转向灯时，该指示灯会同时点亮左转向指示灯，转向灯熄灭后，该指示灯自动熄灭。

question_en: [Image] What device does this switch symbol control?
question_zh: （如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？
options_en: A. Rear window defroster or demister | B. Front windshield wiper and washer | C. Rear window wiper and washer | D. Front windshield defroster or demister
options_zh: A. 后风窗玻璃除霜或除雾 | B. 前风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器 | C. 后风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器 | D. 前风窗玻璃除霜或除雾
why_en: A fan shape represents the front windshield and a rectangle represents the rear window.
explanation_zh: 前风窗是扇形，后风窗是矩形。前风窗上有弧虚线，是前风窗玻璃刮水器及洗涤器。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Seatbelt not fastened | B. Seatbelt fault | C. Seatbelt fastened | D. Seatbelt too loose
options_zh: A. 没有系好安全带 | B. 安全带出现故障 | C. 已经系好安全带 | D. 安全带系得过松
why_en: The icon shows a diagonal strap across a person, representing an unfastened seatbelt.
explanation_zh: 此标志像驾驶员系着安全带，当此标志为红色时，表示安全带未系好。

question_en: [Image] After the engine starts, what does this dashboard indicator lighting up mean?
question_zh: 发动机起动后仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Engine oil pressure too high | B. Main oil gallery blocked | C. Engine oil pressure too low | D. Crankcase gas leak
options_zh: A. 发动机机油压力过高 | B. 发动机主油道堵塞 | C. 发动机机油压力过低 | D. 发动机曲轴箱漏气
why_en: This light coming on means the engine's oil pressure is too low and needs servicing.
explanation_zh: 像茶壶一样的就是机油的标志，各位记住就是啦。该指示灯用来显示发动机内机油的压力状况。打开钥匙门，车辆开始自检时，指示灯点亮，启动后熄灭。该指示灯常亮，说明该车发动机机油压力低于规定标准，需要维修。

question_en: Under what circumstances does ABS deliver the maximum braking effectiveness?
question_zh: 防抱死制动系统（ABS）在什么情况下可以最大限度发挥制动器效能？
options_en: A. Intermittent braking | B. Continuous braking | C. Gently pressing the brake pedal | D. Emergency braking
options_zh: A. 间歇制动 | B. 持续制动 | C. 缓踏制动踏板 | D. 紧急制动
why_en: ABS prevents wheel lock-up and keeps the front wheels steerable, avoiding skidding, especially during emergency braking.
explanation_zh: 机动车紧急制动时，防抱死制动系统在提供最大制动力的同时能使车前轮保持转向能力。ABS是防抱死系统，就是保证在紧急制动时车轮不会抱死，也就是紧急制动时保持转向能力。ABS防抱死系统是一种具有防滑、防锁死等优点的安全刹车控制系统。没有安装ABS系统的车，在遇到紧急情况时，来不及分布缓刹，只能一脚踩死。这时车轮容易抱死，加之车辆冲刺惯性，便可能发生侧滑、跑偏、方向不受控制等危险状况。而装有ABS的车，当车轮即将到达下一个锁死点时，刹车在一秒内可作用60-120次，相当于不停地刹车、放松，即相当于机械的“点刹”。因此，可以避免在紧急刹车时方向失控及车轮侧滑，使车轮在刹车时不被锁死，轮胎不在一个点上与地面摩擦，加大摩擦力，使刹车效率达到90%以上。

question_en: In which of the following situations can the hazard warning lights be used?
question_zh: 危险报警闪光灯可用于下列什么场合？
options_en: A. When following another vehicle on the road | B. When encountering road congestion | C. When the vehicle breaks down and stops | D. When leading a following vehicle
options_zh: A. 在道路上跟车行驶时 | B. 遇到道路拥堵时 | C. 机动车发生故障停车时 | D. 引领后车行驶时
why_en: Hazard warning lights must be turned on manually, typically when the vehicle breaks down and stops.
explanation_zh: 机动车发生故障停车时，需要开启危险报警闪光灯。危险报警闪光灯是一种提醒其他车辆与行人注意本车发生了特殊情况的信号灯。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the engine oil pressure is too low?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，表示发动机机油压力过低？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 2 is the front fog light, Figure 3 is the ABS indicator, Figure 4 is the water temperature indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1是机油指示灯，表示发动机机油压力过低；图2表示前雾灯显示；图3是ABS指示灯；图4表示水温指示灯。

question_en: Which of the following gauges is the tachometer?
question_zh: 以下哪个仪表表示发动机转速表？
options_en: A. Figure 1 | B. Figure 2 | C. Figure 3 | D. Figure 4
options_zh: A. 图1 | B. 图2 | C. 图3 | D. 图4
why_en: Figure 2 is the speedometer and odometer, Figure 3 is the water temperature gauge, Figure 4 is the fuel gauge.
explanation_zh: 转速表刻度不会超过两位数。

question_en: While driving, the water temperature warning light comes on. Which of the following could be the cause?
question_zh: 行车中水温报警灯亮，下列可能是其原因的是？
options_en: A. Lack of lubricating oil | B. Indicator light damaged | C. Lack of coolant | D. Too much coolant
options_zh: A. 缺少润滑油 | B. 指示灯损坏 | C. 缺少冷却液 | D. 冷却液过多
why_en: Insufficient coolant should be topped up promptly.
explanation_zh: 冷却液过少才会导致发动机水温过高。

question_en: What is this control device?
question_zh: 这是什么操纵装置？
options_en: A. Throttle lever | B. Parking brake lever | C. Gearshift lever | D. Clutch lever
options_zh: A. 节气门操纵杆 | B. 驻车制动器操纵杆 | C. 变速器操纵杆 | D. 离合器操纵杆
why_en: The gearshift lever has gear positions and is used to accelerate, decelerate, or reverse; shifting gears changes the speed range.
explanation_zh: 此黑色柄顶端有相应的档位1-5档以及R档，所以是变速器操纵杆。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, what does it mean?
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮表示什么？
options_en: A. Service brake system fault | B. Parking brake engaged | C. ABS fault | D. Parking brake released
options_zh: A. 行车制动系统出现故障 | B. 驻车制动器处于制动状态 | C. 防抱死制动系统出现故障 | D. 驻车制动器处于解除状态
why_en: Inside the circle, P means the parking brake is engaged with no fault, while the exclamation mark indicates a brake system malfunction.
explanation_zh: 圆圈里面是“P” 表示驻车制动器处于制动状态，车辆没有发生故障。 里面是“！” 表示制动系统异常或故障。

question_en: [Image] What device does this switch symbol control?
question_zh: （如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？
options_en: A. Child safety lock | B. Both side windows | C. Power doors | D. Door lock and unlock
options_zh: A. 儿童安全锁 | B. 两侧车窗玻璃 | C. 电动车门 | D. 车门锁住开锁
why_en: A child shown protected inside a circle indicates this is used to protect children.
explanation_zh: 小孩被保护在圈里，是儿童安全锁标志。

question_en: When drivers and passengers get out of a vehicle, they should open the door with the hand farther from the door and turn their head to check traffic to the side and rear, to avoid obstructing others.
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人及乘车人下车时，用远离车门一侧的手开门，转头观察车辆侧方和后方通行状况，避免妨碍他人通行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Confirm it is safe before opening the door and getting out.
explanation_zh: 下车时应确认周边情况，确认安全后再开门下车，不得妨碍他人。

question_en: Before driving, the headrest height should be adjusted so it aligns with the driver's cervical spine.
question_zh: 在驾驶机动车前，需调整安全头枕的高度，使头枕正对驾驶人的颈椎。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The headrest should be adjusted to align with the back of the head, not the cervical spine.
explanation_zh: 座椅上安全头枕的主要作用是汽车被追尾时，有效保护驾驶人和乘车人的颈椎。调整安全头枕高度时，保持头枕中心与后脑中心平齐，才能发挥保护作用。

question_en: Which of the following indicator lights coming on means the engine temperature is too high or coolant is too low?
question_zh: 以下哪个指示灯亮时，表示当前汽车发动机温度过高或冷却液过少？
options_en: A. Figure ① | B. Figure ② | C. Figure ③ | D. Figure ④
options_zh: A. 图① | B. 图② | C. 图③ | D. 图④
why_en: Figure ① is the water temperature gauge, Figure ③ is the ABS indicator, Figure ④ is the fuel indicator.
explanation_zh: 图1表示安全带插头未插入锁扣；图2是水温指示灯；图3是ABS指示灯；图4是燃油指示灯。因此图②指示灯亮时，表示发动机温度过高或冷却液过少。

question_en: Before getting into the driver's seat, the driver should first observe the surroundings and confirm it is safe before getting in.
question_zh: 驾驶人在进入驾驶室前，首先要观察机动车周围情况，确认安全后再上车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Before getting in, walk counter-clockwise around the vehicle to check it.
explanation_zh: 注意“进入驾驶室前”，也就是上车前。上车前，要从驾驶室车门外开始，逆时针绕车一周，检查车辆及周边情况，查看车底，车后有无异常情况，如玩耍的小孩，确认安全后再上车。

question_en: When driving in a straight line, the faster the speed, the more steering input should be applied, and the faster the steering wheel should be turned.
question_zh: 直线行驶时，车速越快，转向盘操作量应越多，转动转向盘的速度也应越快。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: At higher speeds, oversteering can cause a rollover; steering inputs should be smaller and more gradual, then promptly straightened.
explanation_zh: 直线行驶注意事项：1.直线行驶时，操纵转向盘应以左手为主，右手为辅，而且要坚持“及时回正，少转少回”的原则；如果感觉偏离了行驶路线，应该尽早调整转向盘进行修正。2.直线行驶时，转向盘的操作量应与汽车行驶速度成反比。车速越快，转向盘操作量应越小，转动转向盘的速度也应越慢。3.选择正确的行驶位置，行驶时应该在车道正中央行驶。4.行驶在直线路段，试着找靠右侧、左侧、中间行驶的感觉，以便选择合适的行驶位置。

question_en: When driving a motor vehicle on the road, rear-seat passengers do not need to wear seatbelts.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车上路行驶，后排乘车人可不系安全带。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: All occupants, including rear passengers, should wear seatbelts, and children need a dedicated child safety seat.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第五十一条：机动车行驶时，驾驶人、乘坐人员应当按规定使用安全带，摩托车驾驶人及乘坐人员应当按规定戴安全头盔。

question_en: Before setting off, the driver should remind passengers to fasten their seatbelts and close the doors properly.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车起步前，应提醒乘车人系好安全带，并关好车门。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving puts safety first.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第五十一条：机动车行驶时，驾驶人、乘坐人员应当按规定使用安全带，摩托车驾驶人及乘坐人员应当按规定戴安全头盔。

question_en: When starting the vehicle, if the warning light on the dashboard keeps flashing, it warns the driver the vehicle may have a fault, and the driver should stop promptly to fix it.
question_zh: 机动车启动时，如果仪表上的报警灯持续闪烁，提醒驾驶人车辆可能存在故障，应及时停车排除故障。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If there is a fault, you should stop as soon as possible to inspect and repair it.
explanation_zh: 机动车启动后，如果仪表上有报警灯持续闪烁，驾驶人应意识到车辆某个零部件可能存在故障，此时应停止启动，及时排除故障。

question_en: How should a driver perform a walk-around check before getting into the vehicle?
question_zh: 上车前，驾驶人应该如何进行绕车检查？
options_en: A. Walk clockwise around the vehicle | B. Walk counter-clockwise around the vehicle | C. Walk around in either direction | D. Get in directly without checking
options_zh: A. 顺时针绕车一周 | B. 逆时针绕车一周 | C. 任意方向绕车一周 | D. 可直接上车
why_en: A pre-drive safety check is essential for safe driving.
explanation_zh: 行车前，驾驶人要对发动机舱、车辆外部主要部件进行安全检查，确保车辆安全技术状况良好。上车前，再从驾驶室车门处开始，沿逆时针方向绕车一周，观察车辆周围情况，特别要留意车底、车后的情况（可能有宠物或玩耍的小孩），确认安全后按照规范动作上车。

question_en: Before driving on the road, check whether the vehicle's condition meets safety and technical requirements; a vehicle with safety hazards such as fuel leaks must not be driven on the road.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车上路行驶前，应检查车况是否符合安全技术要求，不得驾驶存在燃油泄漏等安全隐患的机动车上道路行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Vehicles with safety hazards are not permitted to be driven on the road.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法》第二十一条：
驾驶人驾驶机动车上道路行驶前，应当对机动车的安全技术性能进行认真检查；不得驾驶安全设施不全或者机件不符合技术标准等具有安全隐患的机动车。

question_en: A vehicle's dedicated spare tire can be used as a regular tire for long-term use.
question_zh: 汽车的专用备胎可作为正常轮胎长期使用。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A spare tire is only for temporary emergency use and should be driven on at reduced speed.
explanation_zh: 注意“专用备胎”，说明是专门用来作为备用轮胎的，因此不能当做正常轮胎长期使用。所以本题选择错误。

question_en: [Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, it means the low beam headlights are on.
question_zh: 机动车仪表板上（如图所示）亮时表示已开启近光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Blue parallel lines indicate the high beam; green slanted lines indicate the low beam.
explanation_zh: 绿色光线在左边，有纵向线的是前雾灯，没有纵向线的是近光灯。图中没有纵向线，是近光灯。

question_en: What is the correct way to operate the accelerator pedal?
question_zh: 关于操纵加速踏板，以下正确的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Press gently, release abruptly | B. Press hard, release slowly | C. Press gently, release slowly | D. Press hard, release abruptly
options_zh: A. 轻踏、猛抬 | B. 重踏、缓抬 | C. 轻踏、缓抬 | D. 重踏、猛抬
why_en: Suddenly slamming or abruptly releasing the accelerator pedal is unsafe.
explanation_zh: 操纵加速踏板时，要靠脚的感觉操作，不要用眼睛看踏板；操纵时要“轻踏、缓抬”，切忌忽抬忽踩。

question_en: What is the correct way to check the engine oil?
question_zh: 检查机动车机油时，以下正确的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Park on level ground and check before starting the engine | B. Park on level ground and check while idling | C. No need to park on level ground, check before starting | D. No need to park on level ground, check while idling
options_zh: A. 停在平坦的地方，在启动前检查 | B. 停在平坦的地方，在怠速状态下检查 | C. 无需停在平坦的地方，在启动前检查 | D. 无需停在平坦的地方，在怠速状态下检查
why_en: Park on level ground and check before starting the engine; pull out the dipstick and confirm the oil level is between MAX and MIN.
explanation_zh:
检查机动车机油，应将车辆停在平坦的地方，在发动机启动前进行检查。

检查方式：拔出机油尺查看，机油高度要在上限（MAX）和下限（MIN）之间。

question_en: When a vehicle is on the road, children in the car should use a child safety seat.
question_zh: 机动车上路行驶时，车上儿童应该使用儿童安全座椅。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Children under 12 years old are not allowed to ride in the front seat.
explanation_zh: 车辆前排不应乘坐未满12周岁的儿童，当车辆后排乘载儿童时，应使用专门的儿童安全座椅或坐垫。不同年龄阶段的儿童使用安全座椅的方法不同。

question_en: The main cause of brake pull is uneven distribution of braking force between the left and right wheels.
question_zh: 制动跑偏的主要原因是左右车轮制动力分配不均匀。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Brake pull can lead to serious accidents, so it requires extra caution.
explanation_zh: 车辆直线行驶时，在转向盘固定不动的条件下，制动过程中车辆自动向左或向右偏驶的现象称为制动跑偏。制动跑偏的主要原因是左右车轮制动力分配不均匀。汽车制动时跑偏会使其驶入对向车道或驶出路外、滑下山坡造成严重交通事故。

question_en: Continuous use of the service brake on a long downhill will shorten the engine's service life.
question_zh: 下长坡连续使用行车制动器，会缩短发动机的使用寿命。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Continuous service brake use on a long downhill shortens brake, not engine, life; engine braking should be used instead.
explanation_zh: 下长坡时，车速会因为惯性而越来越快，连续使用行车制动，主要后果是会使得制动器温度升高而使制动效果急剧下降，题干说的缩短发动机使用寿命描述错误。控制车速最有效的方法是使用低速挡行驶，充分利用发动机制动减速。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the adaptive cruise control system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，自适应巡航系统的英文缩写是什么?
options_en: A. EBD | B. ACC | C. ABS | D. GPS
options_zh: A. EBD | B. ACC | C. ABS | D. GPS
why_en: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) automatically maintains a set speed or a safe following distance from the vehicle ahead.
explanation_zh: 自适应巡航 (ACC）是一项舒适性的辅助驾驶功能。如果车辆前方畅通，自适应巡航(ACC)将保持设定的最大巡航速度向前行驶。如果检测到前方有车辆，自适应巡航 (ACC） 将根据需要降低车速，与前车保持基于选定时间的距离，直到达到合适的巡航速度。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the lane departure warning system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车道偏离预警系统的英文缩写是什么?
options_en: A. EBD | B. ACC | C. LDW | D. GPS
options_zh: A. EBD | B. ACC | C. LDW | D. GPS
why_en: LDW (Lane Departure Warning) alerts the driver to help reduce accidents caused by unintentional lane departure.
explanation_zh: LDW车道偏离预警系统是一种通过报警的方式辅助驾驶员减少汽车因车道偏离而发生交通事故的系统。

question_en: Regarding driving electric vehicles, which of the following statements is incorrect?
question_zh: 关于驾驶电动汽车，以下错误的说法是什么？
options_en: A. Flammable or explosive items must not be placed in the vehicle while charging | B. Check the remaining battery level before setting off | C. The vehicle should carry an ordinary fire extinguisher | D. Charge promptly when the battery is low
options_zh: A. 充电时不得在车上放置易燃易爆物品 | B. 出车前，应确认剩余电量 | C. 车辆应配备普通灭火器 | D. 电量不足时要及时充电
why_en: Electric vehicles should carry a dedicated onboard fire extinguisher, not an ordinary one.
explanation_zh: 在为电动汽车充电时要规范充电，不得在车上放置易燃易爆物品；出车前要查看车辆剩余电量，电量不足时及时充电，保证能够满足此次出行距离；车辆应配备专用的车载灭火器。

question_en: In winter, the battery should be preheated before charging an electric vehicle.
question_zh: 冬季在为电动汽车充电之前，要提前预热电池。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In winter, the battery cells are warmed to a suitable temperature before charging begins, so preheating beforehand is necessary.
explanation_zh: 冬季温度较低，充电时电池会先给电池电芯加热，当电池电芯达到一定温度后，才会开始给车辆充电。因此冬季在为电动汽车充电之前，要提前预热电池。

question_en: Before setting off in an electric vehicle, the remaining battery level must be checked.
question_zh: 驾驶电动汽车在出行前，必须要检查剩余电量。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Checking the remaining battery level beforehand ensures it is sufficient for the trip.
explanation_zh: 在为电动汽车充电时要规范充电，不得在车上放置易燃易爆物品；出车前要查看车辆剩余电量，电量不足时及时充电保证能够满足此次出行距离；车辆应配备专用的车载灭火器。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for vehicle navigation?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆导航的英文缩写是什么?
options_en: A. ACC | B. ETC | C. LDW | D. GPS
options_zh: A. ACC | B. ETC | C. LDW | D. GPS
why_en: ACC is adaptive cruise control, ETC is electronic toll collection, LDW is lane departure warning, and GPS is the vehicle navigation system.
explanation_zh: ACC表示自适应巡航控制系统；ETC表示电子不停车收费（电子收费）；LDW表示车道偏离预警系统；GPS表示车辆导航系统。

question_en: If an electric vehicle catches fire, it is enough to report the location; there is no need to report the vehicle's brand and model.
question_zh: 驾驶电动汽车发生起火，报警时告知起火地点即可，不用告知起火车辆的品牌和型号。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Reporting the vehicle's brand and model helps rescuers know its battery type, capacity, and voltage for an effective response.
explanation_zh: 一旦新能源汽车着火，在报警时一定要告知起火汽车的品牌和型号，让救援人员能够迅速了解该车的动力电池种类和容量，以及车辆最高电压、高压线路走向等，以便救援人员迅速采取对应的救援措施。

question_en: Attention should be paid to maintaining electric vehicles; if a fault requires repair, a professional repair shop or technician should be chosen.
question_zh: 应注意电动汽车的保养，电动汽车出现故障需要维修时，应选择专业的维修机构或者人员。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Electric vehicles differ internally from fuel vehicles, so repairs should only be done by qualified professionals, not by the driver disassembling parts.
explanation_zh: 新能源车的内部结构与传统燃油车不同，驾驶人发现电动汽车发生故障，不能擅自拆卸装置，应选择专业的维修人员或者机构进行维修。

question_en: When driving an electric vehicle, try to avoid roads with standing water during rainy weather.
question_zh: 驾驶电动汽车上路，尽量避免在雨天积水路段行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Deep water can cause electrical leakage or motor water ingress in electric vehicles, risking fire.
explanation_zh: 夏季多雨季节尽量避免积水过深的道路，电动汽车涉水，容易出现漏电或者电机进水的情况，进而导致起火等危险。

question_en: Before driving a pure electric vehicle, make sure the battery is sufficiently charged, plan a suitable route in advance, and know the locations of charging stations or charging piles along the way.
question_zh: 驾驶纯电动汽车出行前，应确保电池电量充足，提前规划合适的路线，了解途中充电站或者充电桩的位置。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Since the battery is the main power source, checking the charge level and planning charging stops in advance prevents running out of power midway.
explanation_zh: 纯电动汽车的主要动力来源是电池，因此在出行前一定要查看剩余电量，确保出行电量充足，并了解途中的充电桩或者充电站位置，做到有备无患，以免途中发生电量不足导致无法行驶的情况。

question_en: In hot weather, avoid leaving an electric vehicle exposed to prolonged direct sunlight outdoors.
question_zh: 高温炎热天气，电动汽车出行时要避免在户外长时间暴晒。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Prolonged sun exposure raises internal battery pressure, causing water loss, reduced activity, and faster plate aging.
explanation_zh: 新能源汽车如果长时间在阳光下暴晒会温度过高的环境会使蓄电池内部压力增加而使电池失水，引发电池活性下降，加速极板老化；而如果长时间在寒冷环境停止的话，将会对续航能力产生急剧下滑的影响，并且对电池组性能会产生不利影响。

question_en: When driving an electric vehicle, it is fine to brake frequently.
question_zh: 驾驶电动汽车行驶时，可以频繁使用刹车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Frequent braking means frequent starts, causing frequent high-current battery discharge that shortens battery life.
explanation_zh: 频繁的刹车必然伴随着频繁的启动，会导致电池频繁地大电流放电，大电流放电对其寿命具有负面影响。

question_en: Electric vehicles should be charged using compliant charging equipment, with an appropriate charging duration, following standard charging practices.
question_zh: 为电动汽车充电应使用符合规定的充电设备，掌握适当的充电时长，规范充电。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overcharging, over-discharging, or undercharging all shorten battery life, so charging time and frequency should match actual conditions.
explanation_zh: 新能源汽车切忌过度充电、过度放电和充电不足，这些都会缩短电瓶寿命。在使用过程中，应根据实际车辆情况来决定充电时间及频率，如果电量表指示灯亮起应尽快充电，否则导致电瓶过度放电会影响寿命。并且充电时间不宜过长，否则会形成过度充电，使电瓶发热。

question_en: Electric vehicles are quiet at low speed, so on roads with many pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, a light horn tap can be used when necessary to alert them to an approaching vehicle.
question_zh: 电动汽车在低速行驶状态下声音较小，遇到行人和非机动车较多的路段，必要时可轻鸣喇叭提示，以防非机动车和行人未注意靠近的车辆。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Electric vehicles are very quiet at low speed, so a light horn tap is appropriate where pedestrians and non-motor vehicles are common.
explanation_zh: 电动汽车具有零排放、低噪音、加速性能好、怠速零能耗等特点。电动汽车在低速行驶状态下声音很小，在行人和非机动车多的地方要适当鸣喇叭提醒。

question_en: If an electric vehicle catches fire, cut off the power immediately; if the fire becomes too large to control, move away from the vehicle and call for help right away.
question_zh: 电动汽车发生起火，应立即切断电源，火势较大无法控制时，要远离车辆，立即报警。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Battery fires are dangerous: cut power immediately if possible, and if the fire cannot be controlled, retreat and call the emergency number.
explanation_zh: 电动汽车的电池着火非常危险，如果火势刚起，在能够断电的情况下，一定要立马断电 。火势较大没办法控制时，要立即远离车辆并拨打报警电话。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the vehicle traction control system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆牵引力控制系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. BSD | B. ESP | C. LCA | D. TCS/ASR/TRC
options_zh: A. BSD | B. ESP | C. LCA | D. TCS/ASR/TRC
why_en: TCS/ASR/TRC (Traction Control System) is the standard abbreviation for traction control.
explanation_zh: 牵引力控制系统TractionControlSystem，简称TCS，也称为ASR或TRC。它的作用是使汽车在各种行驶状况下都能获得最佳的牵引力。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the automatic emergency braking assist system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆自动刹车辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. FCW | B. AEB | C. BSD | D. ACC
options_zh: A. FCW | B. AEB | C. BSD | D. ACC
why_en: AEB (Autonomous Emergency Braking) is the standard abbreviation for the automatic braking assist system.
explanation_zh: AEB（AutonomousEmergencyBraking）自动紧急制动系统，能够使得车辆在行驶时自动监测车辆前方有车辆、障碍物或者行人的距离小于安全距离，有可能发生碰撞时，就会自动采取不同程度的制动以至于完全刹停。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the vehicle blind spot monitoring system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆盲点监测系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. ACC | B. BSD | C. AEB | D. FCW
options_zh: A. ACC | B. BSD | C. AEB | D. FCW
why_en: BSD (Blind Spot Detection) is the standard abbreviation for blind spot monitoring.
explanation_zh: BSD盲区监测英文全称BlindSpotDetection，简称BSD或盲区监测系统。通过毫米波雷达在车辆行驶时对车辆后方两侧盲区进行探测，如果有其他车辆进入盲区范围内，会在后视镜或者指定位置对司机进行灯光提示和蜂鸣器报警，从而告知司机何时并线的最好时机，大幅降低因并线发生交通事故。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the forward collision warning system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，前方防碰撞预警系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. EBD | B. BAR | C. TSR | D. FCW
options_zh: A. EBD | B. BAR | C. TSR | D. FCW
why_en: FCW (Forward Collision Warning) uses radar to monitor the vehicle ahead and warns the driver of potential collisions.
explanation_zh: 前方碰撞预警系统（FCW），是通过雷达系统来时刻监测前方车辆，判断本车与前车之间的距离、方位及相对速度，当存在潜在碰撞危险时对驾驶者进行警告。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the automatic lane change assist system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆自动变道辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. ACC | B. ALC | C. TCS | D. AEB
options_zh: A. ACC | B. ALC | C. TCS | D. AEB
why_en: ALC (Auto Lane Change) is the standard abbreviation for the automatic lane-change assist system.
explanation_zh: ALC（AutoLaneChange）是车辆提供的一种辅助驾驶系统。系统开启后，如果后方车辆超车，本车左右后视镜上会有安全警示灯，个别车辆方向盘会有轻微震动，提醒司机注意后方车辆。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the traffic sign recognition system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆交通标志识别系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. TSR | B. AEB | C. TRC | D. ACC
options_zh: A. TSR | B. AEB | C. TRC | D. ACC
why_en: TSR (Traffic Sign Recognition) is the standard abbreviation for the traffic sign recognition system.
explanation_zh: 汽车安全系统的交通标志识别系统，英文翻译为：TrafficSignRecogni-tion，简称TSR，是利用前置摄像头结合模式，可以识别常见的交通标志《限速、停车、掉头等）。这一功能会提醒驾驶员注意前面的交通标志，以便驾驶员遵守这些标志。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the emergency brake assist system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆紧急制动辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. LCA | B. EBA | C. FCW | D. ALC
options_zh: A. LCA | B. EBA | C. FCW | D. ALC
why_en: EBA (Emergency Brake Assist) is the standard abbreviation for the emergency braking assist system.
explanation_zh: Electronic Brake Assist ，简称EBA，译为电子控制制动辅助系统，是汽车紧急制动辅助系统的一种。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for real-time traffic information?
question_zh: 以下选项中，实时交通信息的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. TMC | B. LDW | C. EBA | D. LCA
options_zh: A. TMC | B. LDW | C. EBA | D. LCA
why_en: TMC (Traffic Message Channel) is the standard abbreviation for real-time traffic information.
explanation_zh: TMC是交通信息频道（TrafficMessageChannel）的简称。它是通过RDS方式发送实时交通信息和天气状况的一种开放式数据应用。借助于具有TMC功能的导航系统，数据信息可以被接收并解码，然后以用户语言或可视化的方式将和当前旅行路线相关的信息展现给驾驶者。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the electronic stability control system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车身电子稳定控制系统的英文缩写是什么?
options_en: A. ESP | B. ESC | C. ACC | D. LDW
options_zh: A. ESP | B. ESC | C. ACC | D. LDW
why_en: ESP (Electronic Stability Program) is the standard abbreviation for the electronic stability control system.
explanation_zh: 车身电子稳定系统（ESP），是对旨在提升车辆的操控表现的同时、有效地防止汽车达到其动态极限时失控的系统或程序的通称。电子稳定程序能提升车辆的安全性和操控性。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the cruise control system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，定速巡航系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. ACC | B. CCS | C. ABS | D. FCW
options_zh: A. ACC | B. CCS | C. ABS | D. FCW
why_en: CCS (Cruise Control System) is the standard abbreviation for fixed-speed cruise control.
explanation_zh: 定速巡航系统（英语：Cruise Control System），是安装在汽车中能够自动控制车辆行驶速度的装置。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the electronic brake-force distribution system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆电子制动力分配系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. BAR | B. TSR | C. EBD | D. LCA
options_zh: A. BAR | B. TSR | C. EBD | D. LCA
why_en: EBD (Electronic Brakeforce Distribution) is the standard abbreviation for the brake-force distribution system.
explanation_zh: EBD是电子制动力分配系统（ElectricBrakeforceDistribution），是ABS的新发展，它是在ABS原有的基础上发展而来的系统。它可以在制动时控制制动力在各轮间的分配，更好的利用车轮的附着系数，不仅提高了汽车制动的稳定性和操纵性，而且使各个车轮能够获得更好的制动性能，缩短制动距离，提高安全性。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the blind spot assist system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆盲点辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. BSD | B. BSA | C. AEB | D. FCW
options_zh: A. BSD | B. BSA | C. AEB | D. FCW
why_en: BSA (Blind Spot Assist) uses short-range radar to monitor the rear and sides of the vehicle, extending the function of the mirrors.
explanation_zh: 盲点辅助系统（Blind Spot Assist），主动式盲点辅助系统是利用近距离雷达监测车辆后部以及侧面区域环境的一种技术，其实质作用是拓展后视镜的功能。

question_en: Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the adaptive front-lighting (cornering headlight) system?
question_zh: 以下选项中，车辆随动转向前照灯系统的英文缩写是什么？
options_en: A. AFS | B. ACC | C. LCA | D. ALC
options_zh: A. AFS | B. ACC | C. LCA | D. ALC
why_en: AFS (Adaptive Front-Lighting System) dynamically adjusts headlights based on steering angle and speed to improve visibility when turning.
explanation_zh: 自适应前大灯系统 AFS（Adaptive Front-Lighting System），能够根据汽车方向盘角度、车辆偏转率和行驶速度，不断对大灯进行动态调节，适应当前的转向角，保持灯光方向与汽车的当前行驶方向一致，以确保对前方道路提供最佳照明，并对驾驶员提供最佳可见度，从而显著增强了黑暗中驾驶的安全性。

question_en: After the vehicle has come to a stop, which of the following devices should be used to prevent it from rolling?
question_zh: 车辆停稳后，为了避免车辆溜动，应当使用以下哪个装置？
options_en: A. Gear shift lever | B. Throttle control lever | C. Clutch lever | D. Parking brake lever
options_zh: A. 变速器操纵杆 | B. 节气门操纵杆 | C. 离合器操纵杆 | D. 驻车制动器操作杆
why_en: Engaging the parking brake (handbrake) after stopping prevents the vehicle from rolling.
explanation_zh: 驻车制动器，也就是我们常说的手刹，主要作用就是锁止车辆，防止车辆出现移动的情况。一般在车辆停稳之后使用，拉起手刹，防止车辆出现溜车，特别是车辆停在一些有坡度的位置的时候，尤其重要。手刹也会在一些特殊的情况下使用，比如紧急情况下的车辆制动，车辆漂移表演中的制动，依靠手刹来实现车辆的制动。

question_en: Regarding precautions for connecting or disconnecting an electric vehicle's charging plug, which of the following statements is correct?
question_zh: 电动汽车连接或者断开充电插座的注意事项，以下正确的说法是什么？
options_en: A. The plug may be disconnected by pulling the charging cable | B. The vehicle may be charged using the household electrical circuit | C. Do not connect or disconnect the plug with wet hands | D. The edge of the plug may be touched while connecting or disconnecting it
options_zh: A. 可通过拉动充电电缆断开插头 | B. 可通过家用电路系统给车辆充电 | C. 不要用湿手操作连接或断开插头 | D. 连接或断开插头时可触摸插头边缘
why_en: Never pull the cable to unplug it and never handle the plug with wet hands, as this risks electric shock.
explanation_zh: 连接或断开充电插座时要注意不能通过拉动充电电缆断开插头，好比电器断电拔的是插头而不是扯电线，也不能用沾有水的湿手去操作插头，容易有触电危险。

question_en: Regarding the energy recovery (regenerative braking) function of electric vehicles, which of the following statements is incorrect?
question_zh: 关于电动汽车的能量回收功能，以下不正确的说法是什么？
options_en: A. It saves electricity | B. It saves brake pads | C. It improves braking effect | D. It can be used as the vehicle's brake
options_zh: A. 可以省电 | B. 可以节省刹车片 | C. 可以提高刹车效果 | D. 可以当制动使用
why_en: Regenerative braking can slow the vehicle but cannot achieve an immediate full stop, so it cannot replace the brakes.
explanation_zh: 电动车的能量回收功能能够把一部分车速转换成电池电量，所以会相对省电；驾驶经验丰富的驾驶员可以合理地利用动能回收来减速，减少刹车的次数，从而节省刹车片；在刹车的同时，动能回收也在起作用，相当于加强了刹车效果。能量回收功能虽然可以减速，但是不能当成制动使用，不能达到立即停车的效果。

question_en: If an injured person cannot get out of the vehicle on their own, try to move them out of the vehicle while avoiding further injury.
question_zh: 受伤者在车内无法自行下车时，可设法将其从车内移出，尽量避免二次受伤。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Leaving the injured person inside the vehicle can easily lead to secondary injury.
explanation_zh: 伤者无法自行下车，就说明伤者行动不便，这时应设法将其移出，以免汽车发生突发状况，造成第二次伤害。

question_en: After a traffic accident causes a harmful gas leak, rescuers entering the scene to help the injured must wear a respirator or cover their nose and mouth with a wet towel.
question_zh: 因交通事故造成有害气体泄漏后，进入现场抢救伤员时，抢救人员须佩戴空气呼吸器或用湿毛巾捂住口鼻。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Rescuers must protect themselves first before they can help the injured.
explanation_zh: 《职业道德与安全行车知识》说明：因交通事故造成有害气体泄漏后，进入现场抢救伤员时，抢救人员须佩戴空气呼吸器或用湿毛巾捂住口鼻。因此本题是正确的。

question_en: After a motor vehicle traffic accident, check for fuel leaks or ruptured lines to prevent further accidents.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车发生交通事故后，应注意是否有燃油泄漏、管路破裂的情况，避免意外情况出现。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety of life comes first in all situations.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车发生交通事故后，如题中所述，应该注意是否有燃油泄漏、管路破裂的情况，避免意外情况出现。

question_en: At a traffic accident scene, if there is a leak of toxic or hazardous substances, people must be evacuated immediately and the incident reported to police right away.
question_zh: 在交通事故现场，一旦遇到有毒有害物质泄漏，一定要第一时间疏散人员，并立即报警。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Evacuation and reporting to police must be done without delay.
explanation_zh: 《职业道德与安全行车知识》说明：在交通事故现场，一旦遇到有毒有害物质泄漏，一定要第一时间疏散人员，并立即报警。

question_en: Before rescuing an unconscious injured person, check their breathing first.
question_zh: 抢救昏迷失去知觉的伤员要在抢救前先检查呼吸。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Life comes first: confirm vital signs before taking further action.
explanation_zh: 检查呼吸的目的是为了了解伤员的生命体征，这是必须要先确认的。

question_en: When using digital pressure to stop arterial bleeding, where should the thumb press relative to the wound?
question_zh: 采用指压止血法为动脉出血伤员止血时，拇指压住伤口的什么位置？
options_en: A. The artery proximal to the heart (near side) | B. The artery below the blood vessel | C. The artery distal from the heart (far side) | D. The middle of the blood vessel
options_zh: A. 近心端动脉 | B. 血管下方动脉 | C. 远心端动脉 | D. 血管中部
why_en: Arterial blood flows from the heart, so pressure should be applied on the side closer to the heart.
explanation_zh: 近心端就是靠近心脏方向的一端。动脉血管中血液的流动依靠心脏搏动来完成，如果动脉血管出血，压迫近心端血管就可以降低心脏对血液的传递，达到减少出血的目的。因此选择“近心端动脉”。

question_en: In an emergency, bleeding should first be controlled using the pressure method, then switched to another method as needed based on the bleeding.
question_zh: 在紧急情况下为伤员止血时，须先用压迫法止血后再根据出血情况改用其他止血法。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: For arterial bleeding, press the side near the heart; for venous bleeding, press the side away from the heart.
explanation_zh: 一般小动脉和静脉出血可用加压包扎止血法，较大的动脉出血，应用止血带止血。但在紧急情况下，须先用压迫法止血，然后再根据出血情况改用其它止血法。指压止血法可以在较大的动脉出血后，用拇指压住出血的血管上方(近心端)，使血管被压闭住，中断血液。

question_en: When treating a burn victim whose wound has already blistered, what can be used to cover and protect the blister?
question_zh: 救助烧伤伤员时，当伤口已经起泡的情况下，可用什么覆盖在水泡上进行保护？
options_en: A. Handkerchief | B. Scarf | C. Plastic bag or plastic wrap | D. Tissue paper
options_zh: A. 手帕 | B. 围巾 | C. 塑料袋或保鲜膜 | D. 卫生纸
why_en: Blistered wounds should be covered with something that blocks contamination and will not stick to the skin.
explanation_zh: 如果烧伤较严重时，可用保鲜膜或干净塑料袋轻轻盖住伤口。这能保持伤口清洁，避免感染。保鲜膜或干净塑料袋是理想的覆盖物。因为它不易粘在伤口上，并可保持空气不接触皮肤表面，从而缓解疼痛。

question_en: When helping an injured person in shock from heavy blood loss, keep them warm.
question_zh: 救助失血过多出现休克的伤员要采取保暖措施。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Rescuers must constantly monitor the injured person's condition and respond accordingly.
explanation_zh: 失血过多+休克的伤员。注意是休克，休克的意思是血压下降，口渴，体温下降，意识模糊，皮肤发白，尿量减少的一种状态。所以要采取保暖措施。

question_en: What is the first step in helping a victim of harmful gas poisoning?
question_zh: 救助有害气体中毒伤员，首先采取的措施是什么？
options_en: A. Keep them warm | B. Move the victim to a place with fresh air | C. Perform artificial respiration | D. Perform chest compressions
options_zh: A. 采取保暖措施 | B. 将伤员转移到有新鲜空气的地方 | C. 进行人工呼吸 | D. 进行胸外心脏按压
why_en: As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should first be moved outdoors to fresh air.
explanation_zh:
题目说明是“有害气体中毒伤员”，而空气新鲜的地方可以让人体的呼吸管道起畅通的作用。
因此应将这类伤员转移到有新鲜空气的地方，让伤员呼吸新鲜空气，减少有害气体的伤害，再采取其他措施。

question_en: If a motor vehicle catches fire while driving, get out of the vehicle quickly to avoid respiratory injury or suffocation.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车遇车辆出现燃烧现象，应迅速离开车内，避免对呼吸道造成伤害或发生窒息。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Once the vehicle is on fire, occupants must move away from it immediately.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车遇车辆出现燃烧现象，应迅速离开车内，以免对呼吸道造成伤害或发生窒息。因此题目是正确的。

question_en: When rescuing a bleeding injured person, what should be done first?
question_zh: 抢救失血伤员时，要先采取什么措施？
options_en: A. Observe | B. Bandage | C. Stop the bleeding | D. Ask questions
options_zh: A. 观察 | B. 包扎 | C. 止血 | D. 询问
why_en: For blood loss, bleeding must be stopped before bandaging.
explanation_zh: 既然是失血伤员，首先要做的当然是止血。

question_en: If the injured person has a fracture of the thigh, lower leg, or spine, generally do not move them casually.
question_zh: 伤员大腿、小腿和脊椎骨折时，一般不要随便移动伤者。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Fractures are not visible to the eye, so avoid touching or moving the injured area whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 骨折是肉眼看不到的，随意移动可能会造成第二次伤害。脊椎骨折被移动很有可能将导致高位截瘫。所以一般不要移动伤者，待医护人员到后再行处理。

question_en: If a fracture site is bleeding, first stop the bleeding and bandage the wound, then splint the limb.
question_zh: 伤员骨折处出血时，首先要对伤口进行止血和包扎，再固定肢体。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Stop the bleeding and bandage first, then immobilize the limb.
explanation_zh: 伤员骨折处出血时，应先止血和消毒，然后再固定。

question_en: When moving a person with a spinal fracture, never support them to walk; a soft stretcher may be used to transport them.
question_zh: 移动脊柱骨折的伤员，切勿扶持伤者走动，可用软担架运送。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A spinal fracture patient's spine must be kept immobilized; a soft stretcher does not provide adequate stabilization.
explanation_zh: 注意是“软担架”，可能会给大家造成误解，脊柱骨折意味着柔软的脊髓面临机械损伤（哪怕是非常微小的震动），所以必须保持脊柱固定（软担架根本不能规避机械损伤），而软担架运送脊柱骨折的伤员会造成第二次伤害。

question_en: A burn victim who is thirsty should only drink plain water.
question_zh: 烧伤伤员口渴时，只能喝白开水。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Burn victims may drink lightly salted water to replenish fluids, not only plain water.
explanation_zh:
烧伤伤员可以喝淡盐水补充体液。如果单纯给病人喝白开水，可导致血液内氯化钠浓度进一步下降，细胞外液渗透压降低，引起细胞内水肿，出现脑水肿或肺水肿，形成所谓的水中毒，可危及伤员生命。
不论其他，光看“只能”这么绝对的词，就知道描述错误。

question_en: When performing CPR on an adult, what is the chest compression rate?
question_zh: 在为成人做心肺复苏时，胸外按压频率是多少？
options_en: A. 60-80 per minute | B. 80-100 per minute | C. 100-120 per minute | D. 120-140 per minute
why_en: The CPR compression rate is somewhat higher than a normal heartbeat rate.
explanation_zh: 成人心肺按压频率的要求是每分钟100-120次，按压深度的要求是5-6厘米。

question_en: When moving an unconscious injured person, the first step is to place them on their back (supine position).
question_zh: 搬运昏迷失去知觉的伤员首先要采取仰卧位。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The first priority is to open the airway.
explanation_zh: 正确的做法是首先开放气道，再采取去枕仰卧位，头偏向一侧，保持呼吸道通畅，以防窒息。记住首先是放开气道，再采取仰卧位。

question_en: A thirsty burn victim may drink a small amount of lightly salted water.
question_zh: 烧伤伤员口渴时，可喝少量的淡盐水。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Burn victims should not drink only plain water; lightly salted water helps replenish fluids.
explanation_zh: 较严重的烧伤病人常有口渴的感觉。这是由于皮肤大面积烧伤后，体液从伤面大量外渗，致使体内血容量下降，水分减少所致。伤员口渴感越重，表示伤情越重。按医学要求，烧伤后口渴时不能给伤员饮白开水。因在烧伤后，体液丢失的同时，体液中的钠盐也跟着一起丧失，如果单纯给病人喝白开水，可导致血液内氯化钠浓度进一步下降，细胞外液渗透压降低，引起细胞内水肿，出现脑水肿或肺水肿，形成所谓的水中毒，可危及伤员生命。因此，这时千万别给病人喝白开水，但可喝含盐饮料。

question_en: If an injured person is trapped under a wheel or cargo, immediately pull their limbs to drag them out.
question_zh: 遇伤者被压于车轮或货物下时，要立即拉拽伤者的肢体将其拖出。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Forcibly pulling someone trapped under a heavy object can worsen their injuries.
explanation_zh: 不能硬拽，车轮压住了伤者，必须将车轮或者货物移开后才能将伤者移出，如果硬拖，会使伤者受伤更加严重。

question_en: If no bandage is available for first aid, towels, handkerchiefs, bedsheets, or nylon stockings can be used in place of a bandage.
question_zh: 在没有绷带急救伤员的情况下，可用毛巾、手帕、床单、长筒尼龙袜子等代替绷带包扎。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material.
explanation_zh: 根据受伤位置的不同和创面的大小，你可以利用毛巾、手帕做成简易的三角巾，用于手臂骨折的固定等，长筒尼龙袜子可以作为固定的捆绑绳。

question_en: What should be kept in mind when rescuing an unconscious injured person?
question_zh: 抢救昏迷失去知觉的伤员需注意什么？
options_en: A. Perform CPR immediately | B. Pinch the philtrum (under the nose) hard | C. Repeatedly slap the victim's face | D. Check breathing before starting rescue
options_zh: A. 马上实施心肺复苏 | B. 使劲掐伤员的人中 | C. 连续拍打伤员面部 | D. 抢救前先检查呼吸
why_en: Life comes first: confirm vital signs before taking further action.
explanation_zh: 抢救昏迷的伤员时，应先确认伤员的生命体征，也就是先检查呼吸。然后再根据情况进行施救。

question_en: When treating a scald, the first step should be to continuously rinse the affected area with room-temperature clean water.
question_zh: 对于烫伤进行处理时，应首先考虑用常温清水持续冲洗烫伤部位。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Continuous rinsing with room-temperature water helps cool the scalded area.
explanation_zh: 烫伤处理时候要首先考虑尽快降温，用流动干净清水持续冲洗烫伤部位，直到不红、不疼、不起泡为准。

question_en: How should a person with a spinal fracture be rescued?
question_zh: 怎样抢救脊柱骨折的伤员？
options_en: A. Keep them warm | B. Transport on a soft-board stretcher | C. Immobilize with a triangular bandage | D. Support them to move
options_zh: A. 采取保暖措施 | B. 用软板担架运送 | C. 用三角巾固定 | D. 扶持伤者移动
why_en: A fracture should not be moved; it should be immobilized in place.
explanation_zh: 应该是原地固定等待专业救护人员，脊柱骨折被移动很有可能将导致高位截瘫，用三角巾固定是本题中最安全的措施。

question_en: When rescuing a victim of harmful gas poisoning, move them to fresh air immediately to get them out of the dangerous environment and prevent inhaling more toxic gas.
question_zh: 抢救有害气体中毒伤员时，应第一时间将伤员移送到有新鲜空气的地方，脱离危险环境，防止吸入更多有害气体。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should be moved outdoors to fresh air first.
explanation_zh: 中毒伤员所处的空间肯定空气不流通，空气新鲜的地方可以让人体的呼吸管道起畅通的作用。因此应当先转移位置到空气新鲜的地方。

question_en: To prevent a harmful gas poisoning victim from being further poisoned, first move them to a place with fresh air.
question_zh: 为防止有害气体中毒伤员继续中毒，首先将伤员转移到空气新鲜的地方。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should be moved outdoors to fresh air first.
explanation_zh:
题目说明是“有害气体中毒伤员”，而空气新鲜的地方可以让人体的呼吸管道起畅通的作用。
因此应将这类伤员转移到有新鲜空气的地方，让伤员呼吸新鲜空气，减少有害气体的伤害，再采取其他措施。

question_en: What emergency measure should be taken to help a person whose whole body is on fire?
question_zh: 救助全身燃烧伤员采取哪种应急措施？
options_en: A. Cover the flames with sand to put out the fire | B. Spray cold water on the body to put out the fire | C. Use a fire extinguisher to put out the fire | D. Help remove the burning clothes
options_zh: A. 用沙土覆盖火焰灭火 | B. 向身上喷冷水灭火 | C. 用灭火器进行灭火 | D. 帮助脱掉燃烧的衣服
why_en: The other options risk causing further injury.
explanation_zh:
救助全身燃烧伤员采取的最安全的方式是向身上喷冷水灭火。其他的方式或多或少会对伤员有害或者加重伤情。
首先大家要明确，燃烧过后人体皮肤已经受损。而沙土上附着的病原体会感染受伤者的皮肤，事后的清理和后续治疗也会相当的麻烦；灭火器喷出的东西也可能会对受伤皮肤造成伤害；脱去受伤人员燃烧的衣服可能对其皮肤造成二次伤害。

question_en: In first aid for a poisoning victim at a traffic accident, which of the following actions is incorrect?
question_zh: 交通事故中急救中毒伤员，以下做法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Move the poisoned person out of the contaminated area as quickly as possible | B. Remove clothing exposed to the toxic air | C. Rinse exposed body parts with clean water | D. Wait in place for rescue
options_zh: A. 尽快将中毒人员移出毒区 | B. 脱去接触有毒空气的衣服 | C. 用清水清洗暴露部位 | D. 原地等待救援
why_en: Once poisoned, action must be taken immediately, not simply waiting.
explanation_zh: 交通事故中急救中毒伤员，需要：尽快将中毒人员移出毒区；脱去接触有毒空气的衣服；用清水清洗暴露部位。原地等待救援只会令中毒伤员伤情更严重。

question_en: What should be kept in mind when rescuing a person with a fracture?
question_zh: 抢救骨折伤员时注意什么？
options_en: A. Quickly lift them onto a stretcher and send to hospital | B. Adjust the position of the injury as needed | C. Bandage the fracture site | D. Do not move the fractured body part
options_zh: A. 迅速抬上担架送往医院 | B. 适当调整损伤时的姿势 | C. 用绷带对骨折部位进行包扎 | D. 不要移动身体骨折部位
why_en: Fractures are not visible to the eye, so avoid touching or moving the injured area whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 骨折是肉眼看不到的伤害，随意碰触很有可能造成第二次伤害，所以为了不让骨折情况变严重或恶化，尽量不要去触碰，不要移动身体骨折部位。

question_en: Spraying cold water on a person whose whole body is on fire is an acceptable emergency measure.
question_zh: 救助全身燃烧伤员可以采取向身上喷冷水灭火的措施。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Spraying cold water is the safest way to help someone who is burning.
explanation_zh: 救助全身燃烧伤员最安全的措施就是向伤员身上喷冷水灭火，这样既能给伤员的受伤创面降温，还可以清洁伤口。

question_en: If no bandage is available for first aid, which of the following first-aid actions is incorrect?
question_zh: 在没有绷带急救伤员的情况下，以下救护行为中错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Bandaging with a handkerchief | B. Bandaging with a towel | C. Bandaging with a cotton garment | D. Wrapping with thin rope
options_zh: A. 用手帕包扎 | B. 用毛巾包扎 | C. 用棉质衣服包扎 | D. 用细绳缠绕包扎
why_en: Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material, not rope.
explanation_zh: 首先看清题意，问的是错误的做法。明显细绳不能用来包扎伤口，因为细绳表面不是平整光滑的，也不够柔软，只会让伤口更加严重。

question_en: What is the basic requirement for rescuing injured people at an accident scene?
question_zh: 在事故现场抢救伤员的基本要求是什么？
options_en: A. Treat the injury first, save life second | B. Save life first, treat the injury second | C. Help the lightly injured first | D. Help the seriously injured last
options_zh: A. 先治伤，后救命 | B. 先救命，后治伤 | C. 先帮助轻伤员 | D. 后救助重伤员
why_en: Life comes first: save the person's life before treating the injury.
explanation_zh: 优先救治有生命危险的，再救受伤的。受伤的人员没有生命危险的还可以暂缓一下，有生命危险的救治不及时就可能造成伤者死亡。

question_en: If a fracture site is bleeding, first immobilize it, then stop the bleeding and bandage the wound.
question_zh: 伤员骨折处出血时，要先固定，然后止血和包扎伤口。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The bleeding should be stopped and bandaged first, then the limb immobilized.
explanation_zh: 伤员骨折处出血，应该是先止血消毒包扎再固定。因此本题选择错误。

question_en: Which of the following items should not be used for bandaging to stop bleeding?
question_zh: 包扎止血不能用的物品是什么？
options_en: A. Bandage | B. Triangular bandage | C. Tourniquet | D. Hemp rope
options_zh: A. 绷带 | B. 三角巾 | C. 止血带 | D. 麻绳
why_en: Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material, not rope.
explanation_zh:
首先看清题意，问的是不能用的物品。明显粗糙的麻绳是不能用来止血包扎的，其表面不是平整光滑的，也不够柔软，用了只会加重伤势。
包扎止血，要求包扎物表面平整而且松软，这样才能有效地扎紧受伤部位体内的血管，阻止血管内血液的再流通，达到止血的目的。

question_en: When splinting a fractured limb with no exposed bone, the splint should extend past the joints above and below the wound.
question_zh: 对无骨端外露的骨折伤员肢体固定时，要超过伤口上下关节。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Extending past the joints above and below the wound keeps those joints from moving.
explanation_zh: 超过伤口上下关节是因为不能让这两个关节活动。这样做能防止骨折端的移位，防止造成血管和神经的损伤，后者的损伤是比较头疼的，比单纯的骨折要麻烦多了，尤其是神经的损伤，很可能会造成感觉或运动方面障碍。此外，防止骨折断端戳破皮肤从而造成骨折端的污染影响愈合。

question_en: When moving a person with a spinal fracture, at least two people should support and move them by hand.
question_zh: 移动脊柱骨折的受伤人员，要有两名以上人员扶持移动。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A spinal fracture patient's spine must be kept immobilized, not moved by hand-support alone.
explanation_zh: 脊柱骨折意味着柔软的脊髓面临机械损伤（哪怕是非常微小的震动），所以必须保持脊柱固定（软担架根本不能规避机械损伤），“要有两名以上人员扶持移动”这一点是不对的。因此本题选择【错误】。

question_en: If a fracture site is bleeding, first splint the limb, then stop the bleeding and bandage it.
question_zh: 受伤人员骨折处出血时，要先固定好肢体再进行止血和包扎。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Bleeding must be stopped first, before the limb is splinted.
explanation_zh: 伤员骨折处出血时，应先止血和消毒，然后再固定。

question_en: If a motor vehicle suddenly catches fire, which of the following actions is incorrect?
question_zh: 机动车突然着火，以下做法错误的是什么？
options_en: A. Slow down and stop as soon as possible | B. Evacuate in the downwind direction | C. Move the vehicle away from gas stations | D. Set up a warning sign
options_zh: A. 尽快减速停车 | B. 向下风方向撤离 | C. 车辆远离加油站 | D. 设置警告标志
why_en: Evacuating downwind exposes people to smoke and fire, so this is incorrect.
explanation_zh: 机动车着火时，应尽快减速停车，车里远离加油站，并在车后设置经过标志，车内人员向上风处撤离。

question_en: When a motor vehicle is transporting explosives, flammable or explosive chemicals, or highly toxic or radioactive dangerous goods, if the police-approved designated route does not include a tunnel, the vehicle must not enter a tunnel.
question_zh: 机动车载运爆炸物品、易燃易爆化学品以及剧毒、放射性等危险物品，经公安机关批准的指定行驶路线不包含隧道的，不得进入隧道行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety comes first: the approved route must not be changed without authorization.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》规定：机动车载运爆炸物品、易燃易爆化学物品以及剧毒、放射性等危险物品，应当经公安机关批准后，按指定的时间、路线、速度行驶，悬挂警示标志并采取必要的安全措施。

question_en: While driving through a curve, Xiao Li's improper handling caused the vehicle to overturn, leaving him unconscious. What should a passing pedestrian do?
question_zh: 小李驾车经转弯路段时，因操作不当造成车辆倾翻，导致其昏迷，此时路过的行人应该怎么做？
options_en: A. Perform CPR immediately | B. Repeatedly slap the victim's face | C. Check breathing before starting rescue | D. Pinch the philtrum (under the nose) hard
options_zh: A. 马上实施心肺复苏 | B. 连续拍打伤员面部 | C. 抢救前先检查呼吸 | D. 使劲掐伤员的人中
why_en: For an unconscious victim, breathing should be checked first before any rescue action.
explanation_zh: 抢救昏迷的伤员时，应先确认伤员的生命体征，也就是先检查呼吸，然后再根据情况进行施救。

question_en: If a motor vehicle's engine suddenly stalls while driving, which of the following actions is incorrect?
question_zh: 驾驶机动车在道路上行驶突然熄火，以下错误的做法是什么？
options_en: A. Turn on the hazard warning lights | B. Place a warning sign | C. Move the vehicle to a safe location | D. Stop immediately to inspect and repair it
options_zh: A. 开危险报警闪光灯 | B. 放置警告标志 | C. 车辆移到安全地点 | D. 立即停车检修
why_en: When breaking down, hazard warning lights should be turned on immediately, not an on-the-spot repair.
explanation_zh: 立即停车检修会影响其他车辆正常通行，甚至有可能发生追尾事故，不安全。而其他三个选项是正确的做法，既不影响交通，也能确保驾驶人的安全。另外，在这里需要提示一下的是，危险报警闪光灯不受发动机控制，是单独工作的。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, to attract attention, high beams may be used at night when meeting non-motor vehicles on narrow roads or narrow bridges.
question_zh: 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，为引人注意，夜间在窄路、窄桥与非机动车会车时可以使用远光灯。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Low beams, not high beams, should be used when meeting oncoming traffic at night.
explanation_zh: 夜间会车要开近光灯，远光灯可能造成对方“短暂突盲”，不能随意使用。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when merging into traffic, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety: turn on the turn signal in advance, keep driving in a straight line, check left and right through the mirrors, and merge only after confirming it is safe.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆汇入车流时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应提前开启转向灯，保持直线行驶，通过后视镜观察左右情况，确认安全后汇入合流。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.
explanation_zh: 汇入车流前要提前开启转向灯，确认安全后才能汇入。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when passing through an intersection, scan your surroundings continuously and avoid fixating on any single object for more than 2 seconds, to prevent tunnel vision or staring.
question_zh: 车辆通过路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，要求眼睛不断扫视周边情况，避免注视一个物体超过2秒，防止出现视若无睹和凝视的情况发生。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Staring at the same object for too long causes visual fatigue, so fixation should not exceed 2 seconds.
explanation_zh: 一个东西盯久了可是会疲劳的，尽量不要注视2秒以上哦，反应迟疑可就危险了。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when opening the car door from inside, the driver should carefully check the front and rear surroundings and open the door with the right hand, without obstructing other vehicles or pedestrians.
question_zh: 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人车内开车门时，应认真观察前后情况，在不得妨碍其他车辆和行人通行情况下，用右手开车门。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Vehicles should always park and stop on the right side.
explanation_zh: 停车都是靠右侧，下车前要通过后视镜观察侧后方情况，确认安全的情况下，缓慢开启车门。

question_en: When encountering a slow-moving elderly pedestrian crossing the road, under defensive driving techniques, it is acceptable to continuously honk the horn to hurry them along.
question_zh: 行车中遇老人横过道路，行动缓慢，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，可持续鸣喇叭催促。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 尊老爱幼是传统美德，遇到老年人行动缓慢，要有耐心等他们过完咱再过。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when changing lanes, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety: turn on the turn signal in advance, observe carefully, keep a safe distance, and move into the new lane.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆变更车道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应提前开启转向灯，注意观察，保持安全距离，驶入要变更的车道。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.
explanation_zh: 变更车道记得提前开转向灯，确认安全后再驶入。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, as long as the driver keeps scanning and confirms no vehicle is approaching from behind, it is acceptable to change lanes without using the turn signal.
question_zh: 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，只要驾驶人不断环回视野，在观察后方无来车的情况下，不开转向灯就变更车道也是可以的。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The turn signal must always be turned on before changing lanes.
explanation_zh: 开车要保持良好的驾驶习惯，变更车道要提前开启转向灯，确认安全后再变道。

question_en: When following another vehicle, the following distance does not matter much; under defensive driving techniques, matching the speed of the vehicle ahead is enough to prevent a rear-end collision.
question_zh: 在道路上跟车行驶时，跟车距离不是主要的，只要按照防御性驾驶技术要求，保持与前车相等的速度，即可防止发生追尾事故。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Maintaining a safe following distance is what effectively prevents rear-end collisions.
explanation_zh: 跟车要保持安全车距，谨防追尾。

question_en: Braking on muddy roads can easily cause the wheels to skid sideways or the rear to fishtail, leading to accidents. Under defensive driving techniques, when entering such a section, leave a margin of safety, slow down, and avoid emergency braking.
question_zh: 在泥泞路上制动时，车轮易发生侧滑或甩尾，导致交通事故，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，进入该路段，行车要留有余地，减速慢行，尽量避免紧急制动。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On muddy sections, drivers should slow down and not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 泥泞路段地滑应减速慢行，尽量避免紧急制动防止造成甩尾。

question_en: If an oncoming vehicle forcibly overtakes and occupies your lane, under defensive driving techniques, you may refuse to yield and force the other vehicle to give way.
question_zh: 行车中突遇对向车辆强行超车，占据自己车道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，可不予避让，迫使对方让路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 别人占道能避让就避让，安全第一。

question_en: When a motor vehicle passes through an intersection at night with no traffic signals, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should scan the surroundings, carefully observe the intersection, slow down in advance, and attract attention by ___.
question_zh: 机动车在夜间通过没有交通信号灯控制的交叉路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当环回视野，认真观察路口路况，提前减速，要引人注意，___。
options_en: A. Using high beams | B. Using low beams | C. Using hazard warning lights | D. Alternating between high and low beams to signal
options_zh: A. 使用远光灯 | B. 使用近光灯 | C. 使用危险报警闪光灯 | D. 交替使用远近光灯示意
why_en: With no traffic signal, drivers must actively signal their presence to other road users.
explanation_zh: 夜间通过没有信号灯的交叉路口，要交替使用远、近光灯，引起其他车辆和行人的注意。

question_en: When driving on a flooded road with non-motor vehicles on either side, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention by honking to alert non-motor vehicle riders that a motor vehicle is passing behind and to watch out; leave a margin of safety and anticipate their possible actions by ___.
question_zh: 当驾驶车辆行经两侧有非机动车行驶且有积水的路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，鸣喇叭示意非机动车驾驶人，后方有机动车通过，注意避让，要留有余地，预测非机动车驾驶人可能做的行动，___。
options_en: A. Slowing down | B. Driving normally | C. Accelerating through | D. Honking the horn continuously
options_zh: A. 减速慢行 | B. 正常行驶 | C. 加速通过 | D. 连续鸣喇叭
why_en: On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 积水路面，要减速慢行，与非机动车保持安全车距。

question_en: When meeting an oncoming vehicle that is having difficulty and needs to borrow your lane, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, anticipate what it might do, and ___.
question_zh: 会车中遇到对方来车行进有困难需借道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，预测该车有可能做出的行动，应___。
options_en: A. Do not encroach on the other lane and drive normally | B. Signal the other vehicle to stop and yield | C. Accelerate while staying to the right | D. Yield and let the other vehicle go first whenever possible
options_zh: A. 不侵占对方道路，正常行驶 | B. 示意对方停车让行 | C. 靠右侧加速行驶 | D. 尽量礼让对方先行
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 会车时一定要礼让，这次你让他，下次他让你，礼尚往来嘛。

question_en: Before exiting a roundabout, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, observe the exit direction in advance, attract attention by turning on the ___, and remind following vehicles to keep a safe distance.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆驶出环岛前，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，提前观察出口方向路况，要引人注意，开启___，提醒跟进后车留有安全车距。
options_en: A. Left turn signal | B. Hazard warning lights | C. Right turn signal | D. High beams
options_zh: A. 左转向灯 | B. 危险报警闪光灯 | C. 右转向灯 | D. 远光灯
why_en: No turn signal is needed when entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal must be used when exiting.
explanation_zh: 驶出环岛要提前观察路况，开启右转向灯示意后方车辆。

question_en: While driving, when a non-motor vehicle cuts in ahead, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation and ___, while also attracting attention by tapping the brakes to warn the following vehicle to keep a safe distance.
question_zh: 行车中，遇非机动车抢行时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局，应___，同时要引人注意，通过点刹方式，警示跟进后车，注意保持安全车距。
options_en: A. Honk a warning | B. Accelerate through | C. Proactively slow down and yield | D. Suddenly accelerate when close
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭警告 | B. 加速通过 | C. 主动减速让行 | D. 临近时突然加速
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 机动车让非机动车，时刻注意减速避让。

question_en: When driving in the rain and encountering pedestrians walking on the road with umbrellas or raincoats, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention and leave a margin of safety by ___, and pass cautiously.
question_zh: 雨天行车，遇撑雨伞和穿雨衣的行人在公路上行走时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意、留有余地，应当___，谨慎通行。
options_en: A. Driving at normal speed | B. Honking continuously to signal them to give way | C. Accelerating to go around them | D. Honking in advance and slowing down appropriately
options_zh: A. 以正常速度行驶 | B. 持续鸣喇叭示意其让道 | C. 加速绕行 | D. 提前鸣喇叭，并适当降低车速
why_en: Visibility is poor in the rain, so a horn tap to alert pedestrians is appropriate.
explanation_zh: 雨天视线不好遇行人可以适当鸣笛，一定注意减速慢行。

question_en: When entering a roundabout, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, observe the roundabout in advance, ___, leave a margin of safety, and slow down before entering.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆进入环岛时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，提前观察前方环岛路况，___，要留有余地，进入环岛前，提前减速。
options_en: A. Turn on the right turn signal | B. Turn on the hazard warning lights | C. Turn on the left turn signal | D. No turn signal is needed
options_zh: A. 应开启右转向灯 | B. 应开启危险报警闪光灯 | C. 应开启左转向灯 | D. 不用开启转向灯
why_en: No turn signal is needed when entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal must be used when exiting.
explanation_zh: 驶入环岛要提前观察路况，但无需开启转向灯。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when a motor vehicle enters a complex road section, the driver should have heightened safety awareness, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, and must not overtake a vehicle ahead that is turning left, making a U-turn, or overtaking.
question_zh: 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，驾驶机动车进入复杂路段，要有更强的安全意识，保持360°环视能力，遇到前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车时，不得超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).
explanation_zh: 驶过复杂路段时，前车若正在进行左转、掉头、超车这些操作时可不能超车。

question_en: When changing lanes while driving, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety, attract attention, carefully observe your surroundings, and turn on the turn signal ___ to alert vehicles behind.
question_zh: 行车中变更车道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地、引人注意，认真观察四周情况，___开启转向灯，提醒后方跟车注意。
options_en: A. At least 1 second in advance | B. At least 3 to 5 seconds in advance | C. No advance notice needed | D. Decide based on the situation
options_zh: A. 应提前1秒钟 | B. 应至少提前3～5秒钟 | C. 不需要提前 | D. 根据情况决定是否
why_en: The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.
explanation_zh: 开启转向灯后心中默数3-5秒再转，给后车一定的反应时间。

question_en: If a motor vehicle breaks down during the day, obstructing traffic and difficult to move, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should attract attention by immediately turning on the ___, and place a warning sign 50 to 100 meters from the vehicle in the direction of oncoming traffic.
question_zh: 机动车白天在道路上发生故障，妨碍交通又难以移动的，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应引人注意，立即开启___，并在距来车方向50米至100米处设置警告标志。
options_en: A. Outline marker lights | B. Rear position lights | C. High beams | D. Hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 示廓灯 | B. 后位灯 | C. 远光灯 | D. 危险报警闪光灯
why_en: Warning sign placement: 50-100 meters on ordinary roads, over 150 meters on highways.
explanation_zh: 车辆故障一定要开危险报警闪光灯，并设置警告标志。普通路段设在50-100米处，高速公路设在150米处。

question_en: When approaching a bus stopped at a station, to guard against the bus suddenly pulling away or pedestrians darting out in front of it, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety by ___.
question_zh: 车辆驶近停在车站的公交车辆时，为预防公交车突然起步或行人从车前穿出，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应___。
options_en: A. Slowing down, keeping sufficient distance, and being ready to stop at any time | B. Maintaining normal speed | C. Being ready for emergency braking at any time | D. Honking to alert and accelerating through
options_zh: A. 减速，保持足够间距，随时准备停车 | B. 保持正常车速行驶 | C. 随时准备紧急制动 | D. 鸣喇叭提醒，加速通过
why_en: Extra caution is required when passing a bus stop where buses are stopped.
explanation_zh: 公交车站前要小心减速，留出足够空间，必要时需停车让行。

question_en: When overtaking on the road, under defensive driving techniques, as long as a margin of safety is kept, the driver should maximize lateral distance and may cross a solid line to overtake if necessary.
question_zh: 在道路上超车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，只要留有余地，应尽量加大横向距离，必要时可越实线超车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.
explanation_zh: 实线不能跨越。

question_en: The five principles of defensive driving techniques are: look far ahead, consider the overall situation, scan your surroundings, ___, and attract attention.
question_zh: 防御性驾驶技术五要领是：放眼远方、顾全大局、环回视野、___和引人注意。
options_en: A. Be bold yet careful | B. Be quick with hands and feet | C. Leave a margin of safety | D. Drive slowly
options_zh: A. 胆大心细 | B. 手脚麻利 | C. 留有余地 | D. 慢速行车
why_en: This is a fixed set phrase to memorize.
explanation_zh: 防御性驾驶技术是对驾驶技能和驾驶习惯的总结和归纳，主要包括放眼远方、顾全大局、环回视野、留有余地和引人注意等五要素。

question_en: When driving to a sharp curve in the road, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, keep a safe driving line, and ___.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆行至道路急转弯处，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，保持安全行车路线，___。
options_en: A. Use the opposing lane | B. Brake sharply and pass at low speed | C. Stay to the outside of the curve | D. Slow down substantially and keep to the right
options_zh: A. 借对向车道行驶 | B. 急剧制动低速通过 | C. 靠弯道外侧行驶 | D. 充分减速并靠右侧行驶
why_en: On sharp curves, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 急转弯一定要减速靠右行驶，安全第一。

question_en: On a road without a center line, when the vehicle behind signals an intent to overtake, under defensive driving techniques, the vehicle ahead should consider the overall situation, scan the mirrors, stay aware of its surroundings, and ___.
question_zh: 在没有道路中心线的道路上，遇后车发出超车信号时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，前车应当顾全大局，扫视后视镜，保持对周围环境了解，___。
