options_en: A. Continue driving as before | B. Accelerate | C. Stop quickly and yield | D. Slow down and yield to the right when conditions allow
options_zh: A. 保持原有状态行驶 | B. 加速行驶 | C. 迅速停车让行 | D. 在条件许可的情况下，降低速度、靠右让行
why_en: When a following vehicle signals to overtake, the vehicle ahead should proactively yield when it is safe to do so.
explanation_zh: 别人超车有条件就让超，自己超车可要谨慎哦。

question_en: On the road, a person's natural vision is suited to walking speed, and the average driver's line-of-sight lead time is 3-6 seconds; under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and extend your line-of-sight lead time to 15 seconds.
question_zh: 在道路上，人的自然视力适宜步行速度，一般驾驶人的平均视线提前量为3-6秒，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，要将您的视线提前量提高到15秒。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drivers must stay focused to ensure driving safety.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车要注意观察周围路况，打好提前量，谨防事故发生。

question_en: When encountering a highly distracted pedestrian, such as one talking on a phone, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety and attract attention by ___.
question_zh: 行车中遇到接听手机等注意力高度集中的行人时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地、引人注意，应___。
options_en: A. Honking only when close | B. Accelerating past on one side | C. Maintaining normal speed | D. Slowing down and honking to alert them
options_zh: A. 临近时鸣喇叭 | B. 从一侧加速绕过 | C. 保持常速行驶 | D. 减速、鸣喇叭提醒
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 行人接听手机会分散注意力，所以要减速慢行，并鸣喇叭示意，防止发生事故。

question_en: When a sudden event occurs ahead or a pedestrian suddenly crosses the road, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention and adapt quickly: tap the brakes to slow down, use the flashing brake lights to alert the vehicle behind, make eye contact with the pedestrian to correctly judge their intent, and pass slowly only once it is confirmed safe.
question_zh: 行车中遇到前方突发事件或行人突然横穿路面，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，要随机应变，采用点刹方式减速，并通过刹车灯频繁闪烁提醒后车注意，通过与行人的眼神交流，正确判断行人通行意图，确保安全情况下缓速通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 遇到突发事件或行人横穿，要随机应变，用频繁刹车的方式提醒后车注意。

question_en: When a vehicle ahead is moving slowly, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and keep your vehicle in a position with good visibility; leave a margin of safety, keep an appropriate following distance from surrounding vehicles, preserve an escape route in case of emergency, and ___.
question_zh: 机动车在遇有前方机动车缓慢行驶时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，应当使您的车辆保持在便于观察的位置上；要留有余地，与四周车辆保持有适当的跟车距离，保持出现紧急情况时自己的出路，___。
options_en: A. Weave between the vehicles ahead | B. Stop and wait | C. Pass the vehicles ahead on either side | D. Line up and proceed in turn
options_zh: A. 从前方车辆两侧穿插 | B. 停车等候 | C. 从前方车辆两侧超越 | D. 依次排队行驶
why_en: When traffic ahead is moving slowly, vehicles should queue and proceed in turn rather than adding to congestion.
explanation_zh: 前方车辆行驶缓慢就别再往前添堵了，耐心等候很快就通畅咯。

question_en: When driving on a flooded road with pedestrians on either side, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention by honking to alert pedestrians that a vehicle is passing and to watch out; leave a margin of safety and anticipate their possible actions by ___.
question_zh: 当驾驶车辆行经两侧有行人且有积水的路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，鸣喇叭示意行人有车辆通过注意避让，要留有余地，预测行人可能做的行动，___。
options_en: A. Accelerating through | B. Driving normally | C. Slowing down | D. Honking the horn continuously
options_zh: A. 加速通过 | B. 正常行驶 | C. 减速慢行 | D. 连续鸣喇叭
why_en: On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 积水路面，要减速慢行，与行人保持安全车距。

question_en: When merging into traffic on a main road, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and attract attention by turning on the turn signal 3 seconds in advance, and ___.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆汇入主干道车流时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、引人注意，应提前3秒开启转向灯，___。
options_en: A. Merge directly without observing | B. Force your way into traffic | C. Observe carefully and merge only after confirming it is safe | D. Accelerate to merge, changing lanes repeatedly
options_zh: A. 不用观察，直接汇入车流 | B. 强行汇入车流 | C. 仔细观察，确认安全后汇入车流 | D. 加速汇入，连续变更车道
why_en: Merging into traffic must be done only when it is safe.
explanation_zh: 汇入主干道前一定要注意观察，确认安全才能小心汇入。

question_en: When driving on the road, speed should stay within the safe, legal limit; defensive driving techniques require looking far ahead, meaning the driver's line-of-sight lead time should be extended to 15 seconds.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆在道路上行驶时，车速应当按照规定的速度安全行驶，防御性驾驶技术要求放眼远方，即要驾驶人将视线提前量提高到15秒。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drivers must watch the road ahead and plan for it in advance to ensure driving safety.
explanation_zh: 驾驶机动车要注意观察周围路况，打好提前量，谨防事故发生。

question_en: The main effect of rain on safe driving is a slippery road surface and obstructed visibility. Defensive driving techniques require the driver to keep scanning the surroundings and leave a margin of safety by keeping a sufficient distance from the vehicle ahead.
question_zh: 雨天对安全行车的主要影响是路面湿滑，视线受阻，防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人要环回视野，眼睛要不断观察周围情况，要留有余地，保持与前车足够的行车距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: In rainy weather, slow down and maintain a safe following distance.
explanation_zh: 雨天路滑注意保持安全距离。

question_en: When a vehicle on a multi-lane road encounters abnormal behavior from the vehicle ahead, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, keep a safe distance from surrounding vehicles, promptly anticipate the possible actions of relevant vehicles and people, and preserve a safe escape route in case of emergency.
question_zh: 车辆在多车道通行遇到前方车辆出现异常时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，要保持与四周车辆的安全距离，及时预测相关车辆、人员有可能做的行动，保持出现紧急情况时自己有安全行驶的出路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Keeping a safe following distance gives enough time to react in an emergency.
explanation_zh: 前方车辆出现异常可更要注意保持安全距离。

question_en: A key feature of pedestrians in traffic is that their movement is often unpredictable and their direction can change suddenly. Under defensive driving techniques, when passing through a complex road section, drivers should have heightened safety awareness, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, observe both relevant and seemingly unrelated objects, make eye contact with pedestrians, and adapt as needed.
question_zh: 行人参与道路交通的主要特点是行走随意性大，方向多变，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，驾驶人途经复杂路段，应要有更强的安全意识，保持360°环视能力，观察相关与不相关的物件，多与行人进行眼神交流，随机应变。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 开车遇到行人，一定要谨慎驾驶，遵守“行人优先”法则，防止事故发生。

question_en: When a vehicle is driving slowly in congested traffic and another vehicle forcibly cuts in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation and ___ to ensure driving safety.
question_zh: 车辆在拥挤路段低速行驶时，遇其他车辆强行“加塞”， 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应顾全大局，___，确保行车安全。
options_en: A. Honk a warning and refuse to let it in | B. Accelerate and stay close behind the vehicle ahead to block it | C. Proactively yield and always keep an appropriate following distance | D. Squeeze against the cutting-in vehicle to force it away
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭警告，不得进入 | B. 加速行驶，紧跟前车，不让其进入 | C. 主动礼让，任何时候都保持适当的跟车距离 | D. 挤靠“加塞”车辆，逼其离开
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 能让则让，要顾全大局，安全第一。

question_en: When encountering children playing by the roadside, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, slow down in advance, and drive through cautiously.
question_zh: 行车中遇儿童在路边玩耍，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，要提前减速，谨慎驾车通过。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians in any situation.
explanation_zh: 路遇儿童时注意减速慢行，谨慎行驶以应对突发状况。

question_en: When a vehicle on a main road approaches a junction with a side road, to prevent a collision with a vehicle suddenly entering from the side road, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, leave a margin of safety, and ___.
question_zh: 车辆在主干道上行驶，驶近主支干道交汇处时，为防止与从支路突然驶入的车辆相撞，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方、留有余地，应___ 。
options_en: A. Slow down and observe in advance, drive cautiously | B. Maintain normal speed | C. Honk and pass through quickly | D. Accelerate through in advance
options_zh: A. 提前减速、观察，谨慎驾驶 | B. 保持正常速度行驶 | C. 鸣喇叭，迅速通过 | D. 提前加速通过
why_en: Safety comes first: slow down when it is warranted.
explanation_zh: 主支干道交汇处要注意多观察路况，提前减速，小心谨慎驾驶。

question_en: When driving through a complex road section, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, keep your vehicle in a position with good visibility at all times, and maintain an appropriate following distance at all times.
question_zh: 在复杂路段行驶，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，要求保持360°环视能力，要保证您的车辆始终处于便于观察的位置，在任何时候都保持适当的跟车距离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: On complex road sections, control your speed and keep a safe following distance.
explanation_zh: 复杂路段行车要注意环顾四周，始终保持警惕，安全第一。

question_en: The main effect of fog on safe driving is low visibility and poor sightlines. Under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety by increasing the following distance and attract attention by promptly turning on the ___.
question_zh: 雾天对安全行车的主要影响是能见度低，视线不清，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，适当拉开与前车的跟车距离，要引人注意，及时开启___。
options_en: A. Rear position lights | B. Low beams | C. High beams | D. Hazard warning lights
options_zh: A. 后位灯 | B. 近光灯 | C. 远光灯 | D. 危险报警闪光灯
why_en: In foggy weather, drivers should turn on fog lights and hazard warning lights.
explanation_zh: 雾天视野受阻，开启危险报警灯能引起其他车辆注意。

question_en: When driving normally, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and anticipate road conditions, so that when approaching an obstacle you can ___.
question_zh: 驾驶车辆正常行驶时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，对道路情况的处理要有预见性，在接近障碍时能___。
options_en: A. Brake hard enough to stop | B. Swerve sharply to go around it | C. Dodge quickly and avoid a collision | D. Come to a smooth stop
options_zh: A. 紧急制动能停车 | B. 急转向迅速绕过 | C. 迅速躲避不发生碰撞 | D. 平稳停车
why_en: Driving requires anticipating road conditions in advance.
explanation_zh: 道路行车时尽量放远眼光，提前注意前方路况，遇到障碍物平稳停车。

question_en: When a vehicle has the right of way at an intersection but another vehicle cuts in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and ___.
question_zh: 车辆在交叉路口有优先通行权的，遇有车辆抢行时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应___。
options_en: A. Rush through first | B. Accelerate through in advance | C. Drive normally under the right-of-way rule without yielding | D. Slow down and yield, stopping if necessary
options_zh: A. 抢行通过 | B. 提前加速通过 | C. 按优先权规定正常行驶不予避让 | D. 减速避让，必要时停车让行
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 交叉路口路况复杂，遇到抢行车辆应该减速避让，必要时停车让行。

question_en: Before entering a curve on a mountain road, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety and attract attention, and even if no vehicle is coming from the opposite direction, still ___.
question_zh: 车辆行经山区道路进入弯道前，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地、引人注意，在对面没有来车的情况下，也___。
options_en: A. Slow down, sound the horn, and keep to the right | B. May drive on the outside of the curve | C. May briefly use the opposing lane | D. May accelerate through along the curve's tangent
options_zh: A. 应“减速、鸣号、靠右行” | B. 可靠弯道外侧行驶 | C. 可短时间借用对方的车道 | D. 可加速沿弯道切线方向通过
why_en: On sharp curves, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 山区道路进入弯道前，要减速靠右行驶，并鸣喇叭示意对向来车。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, from 7:00 to 10:00 and 15:00 to 20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and national holidays), the city's 12 elevated roads (urban expressways) and tunnel/bridge restricted sections include the Yangpu Bridge, Nanpu Bridge, and Lupu Bridge.
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行路段包括杨浦大桥、南浦大桥、卢浦大桥。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Knowing exactly which sections are restricted matters for everyday driving; these three bridges are not part of the restricted list.
explanation_zh: 4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行路段包括延安高架路（S20以东段）、南北高架路（呼玛路至鲁班立交段）、逸仙高架路（全线）、沪闵高架路（全线）、中环路（全线）、华夏高架路（全线）、罗山高架路（全线）、度假区高架路（中环路至秀浦路段）、内环高架路（除内圈中山北二路入口至锦绣路出口、外圈锦绣路入口至黄兴路出口以外的路段）、南浦大桥、卢浦大桥、延安东路隧道。其中并没有题目里的杨浦大桥。

question_en: Starting April 1, 2016, this city abolished the nighttime driving test for small passenger vehicles.
question_zh: 自2016年4月1日起，本市取消小型客车夜间考试。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Note that this applies specifically to 'small passenger vehicles'.
explanation_zh: 2016驾考新规4月1日起实施：小型车夜考取消。

question_en: If a temporary license plate has expired but the vehicle is on the road because registration procedures are still being processed, this does not count as a violation.
question_zh: 临时号牌过期，但因办理机动车上牌手续上道路行驶的，不属于违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A motor vehicle without a valid plate may not be driven on the road.
explanation_zh: 机动车涉牌违法，主要包括无牌上路、临时号牌过期、污损遮挡号牌、有牌不装、假套牌等违法行为。

question_en: When a motor vehicle turns left, changes to the left lane, prepares to overtake, pulls away from a parked position, or makes a U-turn, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, keep scanning your surroundings, ___, and make sure to leave a margin of safety for relevant vehicles.
question_zh: 机动车向左转弯、向左变更车道、超车前、驶离停车地点及掉头时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，不断扫视周围情况，___，确保为相关车辆留有余地。
options_en: A. Turn on the turn signal at the same time as turning | B. Turn first and then turn on the signal | C. If no other vehicles are present, the signal is not needed | D. Turn on the left turn signal in advance
options_zh: A. 在转向的同时开启转向灯 | B. 先转向后开启转向灯 | C. 没有其他车辆可以不开转向灯 | D. 提前开启左转向灯
why_en: The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.
explanation_zh: 向左转弯、变更车道、超车、驶离停车地点及掉头时，都需要开启左转向灯。

question_en: When a motor vehicle passes through an intersection with no traffic lights, signs, markings, or police direction, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should scan the surroundings and keep sweeping the intersection with their eyes while ___.
question_zh: 机动车通过没有交通信号灯、交通标志、交通标线或者交通警察指挥的交叉路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当环回视野，用眼睛不断扫视路口周围情况___。
options_en: A. Passing through quickly | B. Slowing down | C. Speeding up appropriately | D. Maintaining driving speed
options_zh: A. 迅速通过 | B. 减速慢行 | C. 适当加速 | D. 保持行驶速度
why_en: Extra caution is required at intersections with no signal control.
explanation_zh: 通过没有任何交通指示的路段，要注意减速慢行。

question_en: If, while overtaking, the vehicle ahead does not slow down or give way, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should consider the overall situation, keep the vehicle in a position with good visibility, and ___.
question_zh: 驾驶人在超车时，前方车辆不减速、不让道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局，使你的车辆保持在便于观察的位置上，要___。
options_en: A. Attract attention by honking continuously and accelerate past | B. Look far ahead and forcibly accelerate past | C. Leave a margin of safety, abandon the overtaking attempt, and preserve an escape route in case of emergency | D. Scan the surroundings, follow closely, and wait for another chance to overtake
options_zh: A. 引人注意，连续鸣喇叭加速超越 | B. 放眼远方，加速继续强行超越 | C. 留有余地，停止继续超车，保持出现紧急状况时有出路 | D. 环回视野，紧跟其后，伺机再超
why_en: Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).
explanation_zh: 没有超车条件就放弃咯，安全最重要。

question_en: A motor vehicle that unlawfully uses a dedicated lane is fined 500 yuan under Articles 37 and 90 of the Road Traffic Safety Law.
question_zh: 机动车违反规定使用专用车道的，依据《道路交通安全法》第37条、第90条的规定，处500元罚款。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Motor vehicles must drive in the lanes designated by regulations; the actual fine amount differs from what is stated here.
explanation_zh: 机动车违反规定使用专用车道的，依据《道路交通安全法》第37条、第90条的规定，处50元罚款。

question_en: When a driver passes through a flooded road while driving, under defensive driving techniques, they should observe carefully, leave a margin of safety, and ___.
question_zh: 驾驶人在行车中经过积水路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应注意观察，留有余地，___。
options_en: A. Take special care to slow down | B. Quickly accelerate through | C. Pass at normal speed | D. Accelerate through in low gear
options_zh: A. 特别注意减速慢行 | B. 迅速加速通过 | C. 保持正常车速通过 | D. 低档加速通过
why_en: On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.
explanation_zh: 积水路面湿滑，要注意减速慢行。

question_en: Driving against traffic does not include running a one-way street or occupying the oncoming lane to force through.
question_zh: 机动车逆向行驶不包括闯单行道、占用对向车道逆行抢道行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Illegal overtaking, failure to yield, or driving against traffic each incur 3 demerit points.
explanation_zh: 闯单行道、占用对向车道逆行抢道行为，都属于机动车逆向行驶。

question_en: If another vehicle forcibly overtakes and occupies your lane, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and the correct response is ___.
question_zh: 行车中突遇对方车辆强行超车，占据自己车道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，正确的做法是___。
options_en: A. Accelerate | B. Slow down and avoid as much as possible, even to a full stop if needed | C. Maintain the original speed | D. Block its path
options_zh: A. 加速行驶 | B. 尽可能减速避让、直至停车 | C. 保持原车速行驶 | D. 挡住其去路
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 别人超车有条件就让超，自己超车可要谨慎哦。

question_en: Under defensive driving techniques, when a driver gets out of the vehicle, they should scan their surroundings and leave a margin of safety by ___.
question_zh: 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人下车时，应环回视野、留有余地，___。
options_en: A. Opening the door and getting out immediately after stopping | B. Checking traffic ahead, then opening the door | C. Opening the door first, then checking behind and to the side | D. Checking behind and to the side first, then slowly opening the door with the right hand
options_zh: A. 停车后立即开门下车 | B. 观察前方交通情况，再开车门下车 | C. 先开车门再观察侧后情况 | D. 先观察侧后情况，再用右手缓开车门下车
why_en: Before getting out, safety must be confirmed and the right hand used to open the door slowly.
explanation_zh: 停车都是靠右侧，下车前要通过后视镜观察侧后方情况，确认安全的情况下，缓慢开启车门。

question_en: Illegal lane occupation by motor vehicles mainly includes unlawfully using bus-only lanes, unlawfully using the emergency lane, and cargo vehicles using passenger vehicle lanes.
question_zh: 机动车乱占道，主要包括违法占用公交专用道、违法占用应急车道、货运车用客车道等违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Civilized driving means never occupying lanes reserved for other uses.
explanation_zh: 违法占用公交专用道、违法占用应急车道、货运车用客车道，都属于机动车乱占道。

question_en: Pedestrian jaywalking mainly includes running a red light, not using the sidewalk, and climbing over barriers, but does not include failing to use the crosswalk.
question_zh: 行人乱穿马路行为，主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、跨越隔离栏等违法行为，但不包括不走横道线。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety first: pedestrians must obey the Road Traffic Safety Law, and failing to use the crosswalk is also a violation.
explanation_zh: 行人乱穿马路行为，主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、不走横道线、跨越隔离栏等违法行为。

question_en: When passing a vehicle parked on the right, to guard against it suddenly pulling out or a door opening, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety by ___, leaving enough space to prevent a collision.
question_zh: 行车中超越右侧停放的车辆时，为预防其突然起步或开启车门，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，应___，留出足够空间，防止碰撞。
options_en: A. Leaving a lateral safety distance and slowing down | B. Maintaining normal speed | C. Honking the horn continuously | D. Accelerating past
options_zh: A. 预留出横向安全距离，减速行驶 | B. 保持正常速度行驶 | C. 长鸣喇叭 | D. 加速通过
why_en: Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).
explanation_zh: 越过右侧停放的车辆，要留有安全距离，并减速通过，谨防他起步或开门。

question_en: If a motor vehicle acquired by purchase, transfer, or gift has not yet been registered, it may only be driven temporarily after applying for a temporary license plate from the vehicle administration office.
question_zh: 经购买、调拨、赠予等方式获得机动车后未注册登陆的，向车辆管理所申请临时行驶号牌后，方可临时上路行驶。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A motor vehicle without a plate may not be driven on the road.
explanation_zh: 经购买、调拨、赠予等方式获得机动车后未注册登陆的，向车辆管理所申请临时行驶号牌后，方可临时上路行驶。

question_en: Illegal passenger transport mainly includes cars, online-hailed cars, and the 'five vehicle types': electric tricycles, standard three-wheeled motorcycles, two-wheeled motorcycles, disability vehicles, and electric bicycles operating as illegal passenger transport.
question_zh: 非法客运，主要包括汽车、网络专车以及电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车、电动自行车这“五类车”非法客运等违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safe driving means refusing illegal passenger transport.
explanation_zh: 汽车、网络专车以及电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车、电动自行车这“五类车”非法客运，这些违法行为都属于非法客运。

question_en: When a motor vehicle travels on a road with no traffic signals and encounters a pedestrian crossing the road, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should leave a margin of safety, anticipate the pedestrian's possible actions, and in advance ___.
question_zh: 机动车行经没有交通信号的道路，遇行人横过道路时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当考虑留有余地，预测行人可能做的行动，提前___。
options_en: A. Honk to make the pedestrian hurry across | B. Accelerate | C. Slow down or stop to yield | D. Drive around them
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭，让行人快走 | B. 加速行驶 | C. 减速或停车避让 | D. 绕行通过
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians.
explanation_zh: 行人具有优先权，通过人行横道要减速或停车避让。

question_en: When a vehicle behind signals a request to overtake, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings, and while keeping a safe distance from surrounding vehicles, ___.
question_zh: 行车中遇到后方车辆要求超车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，扫视周边情况，与周边车辆保持安全距离的情况下，应___。
options_en: A. Slow down promptly and move to the right to let it pass | B. Slow down | C. Accelerate while staying to the right | D. Do not yield
options_zh: A. 及时减速，靠右行驶让行 | B. 减速慢行 | C. 靠右侧加速行驶 | D. 不让行
why_en: When a following vehicle signals to overtake, the vehicle ahead should proactively yield when it is safe to do so.
explanation_zh: 别人超车有条件就让超，自己超车可要谨慎哦。

question_en: If a ball suddenly rolls into the road while driving, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and ___.
question_zh: 行车中突然有皮球滚到路上，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，应___。
options_en: A. Continue at the same speed | B. Swerve quickly around it | C. Slow down immediately and be ready to stop, in case a child runs after it | D. Drive over the ball
options_zh: A. 保持原速行驶 | B. 迅速绕过 | C. 立即减速，随时准备停车，以防碰撞追逐的儿童 | D. 从皮球上骑过
why_en: A ball rolling into the road suggests children may be playing nearby.
explanation_zh: 有皮球证明附近有小孩应立即减速，时刻准备停车。

question_en: License-plate-related violations for motor vehicles include driving without a plate, using an expired temporary plate, defacing or obscuring the plate, having a plate but not mounting it, and using a fake or cloned plate.
question_zh: 机动车涉牌违法，包括无牌上路、临时号牌过期、污损遮挡号牌、有牌不装、假套牌等违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A motor vehicle without a plate may not be driven on the road.
explanation_zh: 无牌上路、临时号牌过期、污损遮挡号牌、有牌不装、假套牌，都属于机动车涉牌违法。

question_en: If the vehicle administration office has doubts about an applicant's eligibility, submitted materials, or declared matters, it may not investigate and verify the substantive content.
question_zh: 车辆管理所对申请人的申请条件及提交的材料、申告的事项有疑义的，不可以对实质内容进行调查核实。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Any doubts must be investigated and verified.
explanation_zh: 《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》规定：车辆管理所对申请人的申请条件及提交的材料、申告的事项有疑义的，可以对实质内容进行调查核实。

question_en: The main effect of the nighttime road environment on safe driving is ___. Under defensive driving techniques, the driver should look far ahead with a line-of-sight lead time of 15 seconds, scan the surroundings continuously to avoid tunnel vision or staring, and attract attention by using short horn taps and switching between high and low beams.
question_zh: 夜间道路环境对安全行车的主要影响是___，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人要放眼远方，视线提前量应达到15秒；要环回视野，眼睛不断观察扫视周围情况，避免出现视若无睹和凝视现象，要引人注意，多使用短促鸣笛，变换远近光灯。
options_en: A. Low visibility, which hinders observation of traffic conditions | B. Complex, ever-changing road surfaces | C. Reduced driver stamina | D. Drivers are prone to impulsiveness or hallucination
options_zh: A. 能见度低、不利于观察道路交通情况 | B. 路面复杂多变 | C. 驾驶人体力下降 | D. 驾驶人易产生冲动、幻觉
why_en: At night, drivers should maintain a safe speed.
explanation_zh: 夜间行驶主要是对驾驶员视线有一定影响，不利于观察道路交通情况。

question_en: When a vehicle reaches an intersection and encounters a turning vehicle cutting in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and ___.
question_zh: 车辆行至交叉路口，遇有转弯的车辆抢行，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应___。
options_en: A. Proactively stop and yield | B. Maintain normal speed | C. Speed up to go first | D. Honk and go first
options_zh: A. 主动停车避让 | B. 保持正常车速行驶 | C. 提高车速抢先通过 | D. 鸣喇叭抢先通过
why_en: Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.
explanation_zh: 安全第一，有人抢行咱就停车避让。

question_en: When a vehicle approaches a pedestrian crosswalk, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety), you should ___.
question_zh: 车辆驶近人行横道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应当___。
options_en: A. Accelerate through | B. Stop immediately | C. Honk the horn to signal pedestrians to yield | D. First carefully observe pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, then pass slowly
options_zh: A. 加速通过 | B. 立即停车 | C. 鸣喇叭示意行人让道 | D. 先认真观察行人、非机动车动态，再慢速通过
why_en: Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.
explanation_zh: 人行横道要注意观察行人和非机动车动态，再缓慢通过。

question_en: If you notice the road ahead is congested, per defensive driving technique, you should consider the overall situation, keep your vehicle where it is easy to observe, leave a margin of safety, and preserve an escape route for yourself and nearby vehicles in an emergency; you should ___.
question_zh: 发现前方道路堵塞，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，正确的做法是顾全大局，使你的车保持在便于观察的位置，要留有余地，保持出现紧急状况时自己及周边车辆的出路，___ 。
options_en: A. Keep weaving through traffic | B. Look for gaps to overtake vehicle by vehicle | C. Honk the horn to signal vehicles ahead to speed up | D. Line up and wait in order
options_zh: A. 继续穿插绕行 | B. 选择空当逐车超越 | C. 鸣喇叭示意前方车辆快速行驶 | D. 按顺序停车等候
why_en: The road is already jammed, so do not add to the congestion.
explanation_zh: 前方道路堵塞就别再往前添堵了，耐心等候很快就通畅咯。

question_en: While a plate is being reissued or replaced, the vehicle administration office should issue a temporary plate valid for no more than 15 days.
question_zh: 补发、换发号牌期间，车辆管理所应当核发有效期不超过15日的临时行驶车号牌。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The original plate number stays the same, and the temporary plate covers the up to 15 days needed to reissue or replace it.
explanation_zh: 《机动车登记规定》第35条：“机动车号牌、行驶证灭失、丢失或者损毁的，机动车所有人应当向登记地车辆管理所申请补领、换领。申请时，机动车所有人应当填写申请表并提交身份证明。 车辆管理所应当审查提交的证明、凭证，收回未灭失、丢失或者损毁的号牌、行驶证，自受理之日起一日内补发、换发行驶证，自受理之日起十五日内补发、换发号牌，原机动车号牌号码不变。 补发、换发号牌期间应当核发有效期不超过十五日的临时行驶车号牌。” 因此答案为正确。

question_en: When reversing on an ordinary road, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, make yourself noticeable), if you see a passing vehicle you should ___.
question_zh: 在一般道路倒车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、引人注意，发现有过往车辆通过，应___。
options_en: A. Keep reversing | B. Honk the horn | C. Stop and yield proactively | D. Reverse faster
options_zh: A. 继续倒车 | B. 鸣喇叭示意 | C. 主动停车避让 | D. 加速倒车
why_en: Reversing must not obstruct the normal passage of other vehicles.
explanation_zh: 倒车不能影响其他车辆正常行驶，要注意观察，主动避让。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, vehicles with temporary plates from other provinces or cities are banned within (and including) this city's outer ring road.
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，本市外环线以内（含外环）禁止外省市临牌车辆通行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The ban actually took effect on April 10, 2016, not April 15.
explanation_zh: 2016年4月10日起，本市外环线以内（含外环）禁止外省市临牌车辆通行。

question_en: To drive a motor vehicle on the road, you must display the plates, display the inspection and insurance stickers, and carry the vehicle registration certificate with you.
question_zh: 驾驶机动车上道路行驶，应当悬挂机动车号牌，放置检验合格标志、保险标志，并随车携带机动车登记证书。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: You must carry the driving licence and vehicle licence, not the registration certificate, along with the two stickers and plates.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第十一条 驾驶机动车上道路行驶，应当悬挂机动车号牌，放置检验合格标志、保险标志，并随车携带机动车行驶证。本题错在“携带机动车登记证书”，应该是行驶证。

question_en: While driving, if you need to borrow the opposing lane to go around an obstacle ahead but an oncoming vehicle has already approached the obstacle, per defensive driving technique (consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety), you should ___.
question_zh: 行车中需要借道绕过前方障碍物，但对向来车已接近障碍物时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应当___。
options_en: A. Slow down or stop and let the oncoming vehicle go first | B. Speed up to get past first | C. Honk the horn to signal the oncoming vehicle to yield | D. Quickly occupy the lane to force the oncoming vehicle to stop and yield
options_zh: A. 降低速度或停车，让对向来车优先通行 | B. 加速提前抢过 | C. 鸣喇叭示意对向车辆让道 | D. 迅速占用车道，迫使对向来车停车让道
why_en: When meeting oncoming traffic at an obstructed section, the side without the obstruction gives way first, unless the obstructed side has already entered the section.
explanation_zh: 开车要讲究先来后到，既然对向来车已经接近障碍物，咱们就先减速或停车让行吧。

question_en: When you encounter children while driving, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety), you should ___.
question_zh: 行车中遇儿童时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应当___。
options_en: A. Honk the horn | B. Slow down, and stop to give way if necessary | C. Quickly pass to one side | D. Speed up and go around
options_zh: A. 鸣喇叭示意 | B. 减速慢行，必要时停车避让 | C. 迅速从一侧通过 | D. 加速绕行
why_en: Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in all circumstances.
explanation_zh: 遇儿童要减速慢行，时刻注意观察，必要时停车避让。

question_en: A driver may apply at a vehicle administration office other than the one that issued the licence for renewal upon expiry, renewal upon reaching a set age, renewal due to information changes, renewal due to damage, renewal for a lower licence class due to a change in physical condition, and reissuance.
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人可以向核发地以外的车辆管理所申请有效期满换证、到达规定年龄换证、信息变化换证、损毁换证、身体条件变化降低准驾车型换证和补证业务。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A driver living outside the issuing area may apply for these renewals at the vehicle administration office of their place of residence.
explanation_zh: 新规规定，可以在“机动车驾驶证核发地或者核发地以外的车辆管理所”申请办理驾驶证有效期满换证、超过规定年龄换领、损坏换领、机动车驾驶人信息变化换领、身体条件变化换领、遗失补发等业务。因此答案为正确。

question_en: A driver may still drive a motor vehicle even if their driving licence has been lost or damaged.
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人的机动车驾驶证丢失、损毁的，仍然可以驾驶机动车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Driving without a valid licence in hand is not permitted.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第二十八条：机动车驾驶人在机动车驾驶证丢失、损毁、超过有效期或者被依法扣留、暂扣期间以及记分达到12分的，不得驾驶机动车。

question_en: Pedestrian jaywalking mainly includes running red lights, not using the sidewalk, and climbing over road dividers, but does not include failing to use the crosswalk.
question_zh: 行人乱穿马路行为主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、跨越道路隔离栏等违法行为，但不包括不走横道线。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Failing to use the crosswalk is also considered pedestrian jaywalking.
explanation_zh: 行人乱穿马路行为，主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、不走横道线、跨越隔离栏等违法行为。

question_en: Illegal motor vehicle parking mainly includes leaving a vehicle unattended, stopping temporarily with the driver still inside, and stopping haphazardly to pick up or drop off passengers.
question_zh: 机动车乱停车，主要包括人不在车内的停放、人在车内的临时停车、乱停靠上下客等违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Follow traffic law and avoid illegal parking in all its forms.
explanation_zh: 不在车内的停放、人在车内的临时停车、乱停靠上下客，都属于机动车乱停车。

question_en: After the night-driving test was removed for small passenger vehicles, a simulated lighting-use test should be assessed instead.
question_zh: 小型客车取消夜间考试后，应当考核模拟灯光使用项目替代。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Under the licensing rules effective April 1, 2016, small passenger vehicles no longer take a night-driving test.
explanation_zh: 小型客车取消夜间考试后，应当考核模拟灯光使用项目替代。

question_en: Illegal passenger transport does not include electric tricycles, three-wheeled motorcycles, two-wheeled motorcycles, disability vehicles, and electric bicycles.
question_zh: 非法客运不包括电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车和电动自行车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: These five vehicle types are exactly the ones classified as illegal passenger transport when used to carry fare-paying passengers.
explanation_zh: 非法客运，主要包括汽车、网络专车以及电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车和电动自行车“五类车”非法客运车等违法行为。

question_en: Running red lights, riding against traffic, not staying in the designated lane, riding non-motor vehicles recklessly, and illegally carrying passengers are all non-motor-vehicle riding violations.
question_zh: 闯红灯、逆向行驶、不按规定车道行驶、非机动车乱骑行、违法载人，都属于非机动车骑行违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Road safety comes first, so all of these count as riding violations.
explanation_zh: 非机动车轮骑行违法行为，包括闯红灯、逆向行驶、不按规定车道行驶、非机动车乱骑行、违法载人。

question_en: According to the Shanghai Public Security Bureau's notice on strengthening road traffic safety management, cars engaged in illegal passenger transport do not include ride-hailing (network car-hailing) vehicles.
question_zh: 根据《上海市公安局关于加强本市道路交通安全管理的通告》，从事非法客运的汽车不包括网络专车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Unlicensed ride-hailing vehicles are also classified as illegal passenger transport under this notice.
explanation_zh: 《上海市公安局关于加强本市道路交通安全管理的通告》第十条规定：禁止汽车（包括网络专车）和“五类车”（包括电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车、电动自行车）从事非法客运。

question_en: No unit or individual may forge or alter a motor vehicle's registration certificate, plates, driving licence, inspection sticker, or insurance sticker.
question_zh: 任何单位或者个人不得伪造、变造机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、检验合格标志、保险标志。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Forging, altering, or using forged or altered vehicle documents leads to confiscation, vehicle detention, up to 15 days detention, and a fine of RMB 2,000-5,000.
explanation_zh: 根据规定，任何单位或者个人不得伪造、变造机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、检验合格标志、保险标志。违者由公安机关交通管理部门予以收缴，扣留该机动车，处十五日以下拘留，并处二千元以上五千元以下罚款。

question_en: Maliciously, continuously, or excessively honking the horn on the road does not count as horn abuse.
question_zh: 道路上恶意、连续、长时间鸣号不属于机动车乱鸣号。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive safely and courteously; excessive honking is prohibited and does count as horn abuse.
explanation_zh: 机动车乱鸣号，主要包括道路上恶意、连续、长时间鸣号等违法行为。

question_en: Starting April 1, 2015, National I emission-standard gasoline vehicles were restricted 24 hours a day within this city's outer ring road, and starting January 1, 2016, National II gasoline vehicles registered before 2005 were also restricted within the outer ring road.
question_zh: 从2015年4月1日起，本市外环内全天24小时限制国I汽油车通行，2016年1月1日起，对2005年前注册的国II汽油车实施外环限行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This matches the actual phased restriction schedule announced by the city for older emission-standard vehicles.
explanation_zh: 从2015年4月1日起，黄标车禁行范围将扩大至郊环（G1501上海-上海市绕城高速范围）以内，同时，在S20外环高速范围内开始禁行国I标准汽油车。2016年1月1日起，对2005年前注册的国II汽油车实施外环限行。故本题答案为正确。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, the traffic restriction hours for this city's 12 elevated roads (urban expressways) and tunnel bridges are 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays).
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通限行管理措施，时间是每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This matches the restriction hours announced by the city's public security bureau for those 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges.
explanation_zh: 上海市公安局发布：2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时，12条高架道路及隧桥限制使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车通行。

question_en: Per the notice on further strengthening environmental management of in-use vehicles, owners of yellow-label vehicles were required to complete scrapping procedures by December 31, 2015; if not done in time, the vehicle's plates and certificate are declared invalid and the traffic police cancel the registration of the overdue yellow-label vehicle.
question_zh: 根据《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通告》要求黄标车车主于2015年12月31日前办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理的公告机动车牌证作废，由本市公安交管部门依法将逾期未办理的黄标车进行注销。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The notice required yellow-label vehicle owners to scrap their vehicles by that deadline, after which the registration documents are voided under the relevant national law.
explanation_zh: 《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通过》规定有关“黄标车”车主应于2015年12月31日之前向公安交管部门办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理，本市公安交管部门依据《中华人民共和国大气污染防治法》、《机动车登记规定》，将“黄标车”的机动车登记证书、号牌和行驶证作废。

question_en: A person residing outside their household registration location may apply for a driving licence in the categories of large passenger vehicle, tractor-trailer, city bus, medium passenger vehicle, or large truck at their place of residence.
question_zh: 在户籍所在地以外居住的，可以在居住地申请大型客车、牵引车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车准备车型的机动车驾驶证。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: These licence categories may indeed be applied for at the applicant's actual place of residence.
explanation_zh: 在户籍所在地以外居住的，可以在居住地申请大型客车、牵引车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车准备车型的机动车驾驶证。

question_en: Blocking an intersection, running a red light, crossing the stop line, and stopping and waiting on a crosswalk or yellow grid marking are not motor vehicle intersection violations.
question_zh: 滞留路口、闯红灯、超越停车线、在人行道或网格线停车等候，这些不属于机动车路口违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: All of these are classified as motor vehicle intersection violations.
explanation_zh: 机动车路口违法行为，包括滞留路口、闯红灯、超越停车线、在人行道或网格线停车等候。

question_en: A physical fitness certificate is valid for one year from the date of issue.
question_zh: 身体条件证明自出具之日起一年内有效。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: It is valid for six months, not one year.
explanation_zh: 新规规定驾驶人体检年龄70周岁以上才要每年提交身体条件证明，条件放宽。明确了体检证明有效期：体检证明自出具之日起6个月内有效。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), the traffic management measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges is: small passenger cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small passenger cars with out-of-province plates, and small passenger cars driven by probationary drivers are prohibited from passing.
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通管理措施是：使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车禁止通行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.
explanation_zh: 上海-上海市市公安局发布：从4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时，12条高架道路及隧桥限制使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车。

question_en: Drivers aged 70 and above should have a physical examination once a year, and within 30 days after the end of the points cycle may submit a physical condition certificate issued by a county-level or higher (or military regiment-level or higher) medical institution.
question_zh: 年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人，应当每年进行一次身体检查，在记分周期结束三十日内，可以提交县级或者部队团级以上医疗机构出具的有关身体条件的证明。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Under the new rules, a physical condition certificate from a qualified county-level or higher medical institution may be submitted for licence renewal.
explanation_zh: 1.年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人，应当每年进行一次身体检查，在记分周期结束后三十日内，提交医疗机构出具的有关身体条件的证明。2.办理残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车驾驶证业务时，提交的身体条件证明应当由经省级卫生健康行政部门认定的专门医疗机构出具。办理其他机动车驾驶证业务时，提交的身体条件证明应当由县级、部队团级以上医疗机构，或者经地市级以上卫生健康行政部门认定的具有健康体检资质的二级以上医院、乡镇卫生院、社区卫生服务中心、健康体检中心等医疗机构出具。

question_en: Under Article 16(3) and Article 96(1) of the Road Traffic Safety Law and the Regulations on Application for and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving Licences, using forged or altered plates results in confiscation, temporary vehicle detention, up to 15 days of detention, a fine of RMB 5,000, and 12 demerit points.
question_zh: 使用伪造、变造的机动车号牌的，依据《道路交通安全法》第16条第3项、第96条第1款、《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》的规定，予以收缴，暂扣该机动车，处十五日以下拘留、5000元罚款、记12分。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If the act constitutes a crime, it must be prosecuted under criminal law instead of receiving only these administrative penalties.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第九十六条：伪造、变造或者使用伪造、变造的机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、驾驶证的，由公安机关交通管理部门予以收缴，扣留该机动车，处十五日以下拘留，并处二千元以上五千元以下罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。

question_en: A person may not apply for a city bus driving licence class if they bear equal or greater responsibility for a fatal traffic accident, have driven under the influence of alcohol, or had their driving licence revoked or cancelled less than ten years ago.
question_zh: 有发生交通事故造成人员死亡，承担同等以上责任的；醉酒后驾驶机动车的；被吊销或者撤销机动车驾驶证未满十年情况之一的，不得申请城市公交车准驾车型。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Bearing equal or greater responsibility for a fatal accident downgrades the licence, and such drivers are permanently barred from class B or higher licences.
explanation_zh: 承担交通死亡事故同等及以上责任的驾驶证会降级，且终身不得领取B照以上驾照。根据《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》第十五条 有下列情形的不得申请大型客车、牵引车、中型客车、大型货车准驾车型：（一）发生交通事故造成人员死亡，承担同等以上责任的；（二）醉酒后驾驶机动车的；（三）被吊销或者撤销机动车驾驶证未满十年的。

question_en: Temporarily stopping with the driver remaining in the vehicle does not count as an illegal parking violation.
question_zh: 人在车内的临时停车不属于乱停车违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Any vehicle not parked according to regulations counts as illegal parking, regardless of whether the driver stays inside.
explanation_zh: 只要机动车未按照规定停放，就属于违停，与人在不在车上没有关系。

question_en: When applying for a transfer-in licence renewal, the applicant should confirm the application information and submit their identity document, driving licence, and physical condition certificate.
question_zh: 申请转入换证时，应当确认申请信息，提交机动车驾驶人的身份证明、机动车驾驶证和身体条件证明。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A driver whose household registration moves out of the original vehicle administration office's jurisdiction must apply for renewal at the new jurisdiction's office.
explanation_zh: 《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》规定： 机动车驾驶人户籍迁出原车辆管理所管辖区的，应当向迁入地车辆管理所申请换证。机动车驾驶人在核发地车辆管理所管辖区以外居住的，可以向居住地车辆管理所申请换证。申请时应当确认申请信息，提交机动车驾驶人的身份证明和机动车驾驶证，并申报身体条件情况。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, the restriction measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges is: during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), small passenger cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small passenger cars with out-of-province plates, and small passenger cars driven by probationary drivers are restricted.
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行管理措施是：每日7时至10时、15时至20时（周六、周日、国定节假日除外），使用临时行驶号牌的小客车、未载客出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车限行。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.
explanation_zh: 上海市公安局发布：从4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时，12条高架道路及隧桥限制使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车通行。

question_en: Under Articles 63 and 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Law, a pedestrian who climbs over road dividing facilities is fined RMB 50.
question_zh: 行人跨越道路隔离设施的，依据《道路交通安全法》第63条、第89条的规定，处50元罚款。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Personal safety comes first, so this penalty under the Road Traffic Safety Law is correct.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第63条、第89条的规定，行人跨越道路隔离设施的，处50元罚款。

question_en: A driver may still drive a motor vehicle after accumulating 12 demerit points but before their licence is confiscated or suspended.
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人在机动车记分达到12分但未被扣留、暂扣期间，可以驾驶机动车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Once 12 points have accumulated, the driver may no longer drive.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第二十八条：机动车驾驶人在机动车驾驶证丢失、损毁、超过有效期或者被依法扣留、暂扣期间以及记分达到12分的，不得驾驶机动车。

question_en: Per the Road Traffic Safety Law implementing regulations and the Road Traffic Safety Law, a non-motor vehicle rider who fails to obey the non-motor-vehicle signal is fined RMB 50; if they refuse to accept the fine, their non-motor vehicle may not be detained.
question_zh: 驾驶非机动车闯红灯，依据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第38条、《道路交通安全法》第38条、第89条的规定，非机动车不按非机动车信号灯表示通行的处50元罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，不得扣留其非机动车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A rider who disobeys the signal is fined RMB 50, but if they refuse the fine the vehicle can in fact be detained.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法实施条例》第38条、《道路交通安全法》第38条、第89条的规定，非机动车不按非机动车信号灯表示通行的，处50元罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，扣留其非机动车。

question_en: Illegal lane changing mainly includes cutting into a queue, changing lanes across a solid line, forcing a lane change, and making consecutive lane changes.
question_zh: 机动车乱变道，主要包括遇排队加塞、实线变道、强行变道、连续变道等违法行为。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Road safety comes first, so all of these count as illegal lane-changing violations.
explanation_zh: 遇排队加塞、实线变道、强行变道、连续变道，都属于机动车乱变道。

question_en: Motor vehicle plates must be mounted as required and kept clear and intact; they must not be deliberately obscured or defaced.
question_zh: 机动车号牌应当按照规定悬挂并保持清晰、完整，不得故意遮挡、污损。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Deliberately obscuring a plate while driving results in 12 demerit points in a single instance.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第二章第十一条 驾驶机动车上道路行驶，应当悬挂机动车号牌，放置检验合格标志、保险标志，并随车携带机动车行驶证。机动车号牌应当按照规定悬挂并保持清晰、完整，不得故意遮挡、污损。任何单位和个人不得收缴、扣留机动车号牌。

question_en: Per the notice on further strengthening environmental management of in-use vehicles, gasoline vehicles registered in this city at National II standard or below, and diesel vehicles at National III standard or below, may not have their emissions and safety inspections conducted outside the province or city. Owners of "yellow-label vehicles" must complete scrapping procedures with the traffic police by December 31, 2015, or the vehicle's registration certificate, plates, and driving licence will be voided under relevant national law.
question_zh: 根据《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通告》中说明，在本市注册的国Ⅱ标准及以下的汽油车、国Ⅲ标准及以下的柴油车不得委托外省市进行排气污染检测和安全技术检测。有关“黄标车”车主于2015年12月31日之前向公安交管部门办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理的，本市公安交管部门将依据《中华人民共和国大气污染防治法》、《机动车登记规定》等法律法规要求，将“黄标车”的机动车登记证书、号牌和行驶证作废。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: This restates the notice's actual requirements accurately.
explanation_zh: 《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通告》中说明，在本市注册的国Ⅱ标准及以下的汽油车、国Ⅲ标准及以下的柴油车不得委托外省市进行排气污染检测和安全技术检测。有关“黄标车”车主于2015年12月31日之前向公安交管部门办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理的，本市公安交管部门将依据《中华人民共和国大气污染防治法》、《机动车登记规定》等法律法规要求，将“黄标车”的机动车登记证书、号牌和行驶证作废。

question_en: Running a red light, not using the sidewalk, not using the crosswalk, and climbing over dividers are all forms of pedestrian jaywalking.
question_zh: 闯红灯、不走人行道、不走横道线、跨越隔离栏，这些违法行为都属于行人乱穿马路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety comes first, and all of these are classified as pedestrian jaywalking violations under road traffic safety law.
explanation_zh: 行人乱穿马路，主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、不走横道线、跨越隔离栏。

question_en: A driver may complete the licence review and submit the physical condition certificate either at the place where the licence was issued or elsewhere.
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人可以在机动车驾驶证核发地或者核发地以外的地方参加审验、提交身体条件证明。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The licence review does not have to take place at the issuing location.
explanation_zh: 根据机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定（2016版）第七十条：机动车驾驶人可以在机动车驾驶证核发地或者核发地以外的地方参加审验、提交身体条件证明。

question_en: If a motor vehicle is driven on the road without the driving licence or vehicle licence at hand, how should the traffic police handle it?
question_zh: 机动车在道路行驶，未随车携带行驶证、驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门应当如何处理？
options_en: A. Detain the driver | B. Confiscate the vehicle's plates | C. Revoke the driving licence | D. Detain the vehicle
options_zh: A. 扣留驾驶人 | B. 扣留机动车牌号 | C. 吊销驾驶证 | D. 扣留机动车
why_en: Driving on the road requires two certificates (driving licence, vehicle licence), two stickers (inspection, insurance), and one set of plates at all times.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第九十五条 上道路行驶的机动车未悬挂机动车号牌，未放置检验合格标志、保险标志，或者未随车携带行驶证、驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门应当扣留机动车。

question_en: After the traffic police confiscate the driving licence of a driver who has accumulated the specified number of demerit points, what happens next?
question_zh: 公安机关交通管理部门对累积记分达到规定分值的机动车驾驶人，扣留机动车驾驶证，然后如何处理？
options_en: A. Administrative detention is imposed by law | B. The driver undergoes education on road traffic safety laws and regulations | C. The driving licence is revoked | D. The vehicle is detained
options_zh: A. 依法进行行政拘留 | B. 进行道路交通安全法律、法规教育 | C. 予以吊销驾驶证的处理 | D. 予以扣留机动车的处理
why_en: After reaching 12 points, the licence is confiscated, and the driver must study and pass an exam to get it back.
explanation_zh: 机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分达到12分的，公安机关交通管理部门应当扣留其机动车驾驶证。 机动车驾驶人应当在十五日内到机动车驾驶证核发地或者违法行为地公安机关交通管理部门参加为期七日的道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识学习。机动车驾驶人参加学习后，车辆管理所应当在二十日内对其进行道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试。考试合格的，记分予以清除，发还机动车驾驶证。考试不合格的，继续参加学习和考试。

question_en: For forging, altering, or using a forged or altered vehicle registration certificate, plates, driving licence, or vehicle licence, the traffic police confiscate the documents and detain the vehicle; what additional penalty may be imposed?
question_zh: 伪造、变造或者使用伪造、变造机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、驾驶证的，由公安机关相关交通管理部门予以收缴，扣留该机动车，还可以如何处理？
options_en: A. A fine of RMB 200-2,000 | B. Up to 15 days detention plus a fine of RMB 200-2,000 | C. A fine of RMB 2,000-5,000 | D. Up to 15 days detention plus a fine of RMB 2,000-5,000
options_zh: A. 并处二百元以上二千元以下罚款 | B. 处十五日以下拘留，并处二百元以上二千元以下罚款 | C. 并处二千元以上五千元以下罚款 | D. 处十五日以下拘留，并处二千元以上五千元以下罚款
why_en: No unit or individual may forge or alter a vehicle's registration certificate, plates, licence, or inspection and insurance stickers.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第九十六条规定，伪造、变造或者使用伪造、变造的机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、驾驶证的，由公安机关交通管理部门予以收缴，扣留该机动车，处15日以下拘留，并处2000元以上5000元以下罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。

question_en: Starting April 10, 2016, vehicles with out-of-province temporary plates are banned within (and including) this city's outer ring road; what will police officers do to violators?
question_zh: 2016年4月10日起，本市外环线以内(外环线)区域禁止外省市临牌通行，违者公安民警将：
options_en: A. Lawfully detain the vehicle | B. Penalize the vehicle for violating the prohibitory sign and order it to leave the restricted area immediately | C. Lawfully revoke the driving licence | D. Only penalize the vehicle for violating the prohibitory sign
options_zh: A. 依法扣留车辆 | B. 机动车违反禁令标志指示进行处罚，责令车辆立即驾离限行区域 | C. 依法吊销驾驶证 | D. 仅机动车违反禁令标志指示进行处理
why_en: When a vehicle violates a prohibitory sign, police may penalize it and order it to leave the restricted area at once.
explanation_zh: 4月10日起，本市外环线以内(外环线)区域外省市临牌通行者，公安民警将对违反禁令标志指示的机动车进行处罚，责令车辆立即驾离限行区域。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), what is the traffic management measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges?
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通管理措施：
options_en: A. Small cars with temporary plates and empty taxis | B. Small cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small cars with out-of-province plates, and small cars driven by probationary drivers are prohibited from passing | C. Small cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small cars with out-of-province plates, small cars driven by probationary drivers, and dedicated ride-hailing cars | D. Small cars with temporary plates, small cars driven by probationary drivers, and empty taxis
options_zh: A. 使用临时行驶号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车 | B. 使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车禁止通行 | C. 使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车、客运专车 | D. 使用临时行驶号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车、未载客的出租小客车
why_en: This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.
explanation_zh: 上海-上海市市公安局发布：从4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时，12条高架道路及隧桥限制使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车。

question_en: Within what time frame should a traffic police officer submit the administrative compulsory measure certificate to their traffic management department?
question_zh: 交通警察应当在（ ）将行政强制措施凭证上交所属公安机关交通管理部门。
options_en: A. Within 24 hours | B. The same day | C. Within 2 days | D. Within 5 days
options_zh: A. 24小时内 | B. 当日 | C. 2日内 | D. 5日内
why_en: Traffic police must submit the administrative compulsory measure certificate to their department within 24 hours.
explanation_zh: 交通警察应当在24小时内将行政强制措施凭证交所属公安机关交通管理部门。

question_en: For using another vehicle's plates, under Article 16(4) and Article 96(3) of the Road Traffic Safety Law and the Measures for Demerit Point Management of Road Traffic Violations, the driver is fined RMB 3,000 and given 12 demerit points; how is the vehicle handled?
question_zh: 使用其他车辆的机动车号牌的，依据《道路交通安全法》第16条第4项、第96条第3款、《道路交通安全违法行为记分管理办法》的规定，处3000元罚款、记12分，予以如何处理该机动车？
options_en: A. Reclaimed and impounded | B. Reclaimed and detained | C. Confiscated and impounded | D. Confiscated and detained
options_zh: A. 追缴，扣押   | B. 追缴，扣留 | C. 收缴，扣押 | D. 收缴，扣留
why_en: Vehicles may not use another vehicle's plates without authorization.
explanation_zh: 使用其他车辆的机动车号牌的，依据《道路交通安全法》第16条第4项、第96条第3款、《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》的规定，处3000元罚款、记12分，予以收缴、扣留该机动车。

question_en: Starting April 10, 2016, the area where out-of-province temporary plate vehicles are banned in this city is:
question_zh: 2016年4月10日起，本市禁止外省市临牌车辆通行的区域为：
options_en: A. Outside the S20 ring (not including S20) | B. Inside the S20 ring (not including S20) | C. Outside the S20 ring (including S20) | D. Inside the S20 ring (including S20)
options_zh: A. S20以外(不含S20) | B. S20以内(不含S20) | C. S20以外(含S20) | D. S20以内(含S20)
why_en: The ban that took effect on April 10, 2016 covers the area inside (and including) the S20 ring road.
explanation_zh: 2016年4月10日起，上海-上海市禁止外省市临牌车辆通行的区域为S20以内(含S20)。

question_en: Under the Regulations on Procedures for Handling Road Traffic Safety Violations, which of the following is NOT an administrative compulsory measure traffic police may lawfully take while enforcing the law?
question_zh: 《道路交通安全违法行为处理程序规定》规定，交通警察在执法过程中，可以依法采取的行政强制措施不包括（）
options_en: A. Testing blood alcohol content | B. Detaining the driver | C. Testing for state-controlled psychotropic substances in the body | D. Testing for state-controlled narcotic substances in the body
options_zh: A. 检验体内酒精含量 | B. 拘留驾驶人 | C. 检验体内国家管制的精神药品含量 | D. 检验体内国家管制的麻醉药品含量
why_en: Traffic police have no authority to detain drivers themselves.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全违法行为处理程序规定》规定，交通警察在执法过程中，可以依法采取的行政强制措施有：（一）扣留车辆；（二）扣留机动车驾驶证；（三）拖移机动车；（四）检验体内酒精、国家管制的精神药品、麻醉药品含量；（五）收缴物品；（六）法律、法规规定的其他行政强制措施。

question_en: A person who has used or injected drugs within how many years may not apply for a motor vehicle driving licence?
question_zh: 多少年内有吸食、注射毒品行为的，不得申请机动车驾驶证？
options_en: A. Three | B. Two | C. One | D. Four
options_zh: A. 三 | B. 二 | C. 一 | D. 四
why_en: A person who has used drugs may not apply for a driving licence for 3 years.
explanation_zh: 《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》规定：3年内有吸食、注射毒品行为或者解除强制隔离戒毒措施未满3年的，不得申请驾驶证。

question_en: When a traffic police officer corrects a violator's behavior (motor vehicle driver, non-motor vehicle driver, pedestrian, or passenger) with a warning or education, what is the standard phrase the officer should use?
question_zh: 交通警察在纠正违法行为人（含机动车驾驶人、非机动车驾驶人、行人、乘车人，下同）的违法行为，对其进行警告、教育时，交通警察应当使用的规范语是：（ ）
options_en: A. Hello! Please show your driving licence and vehicle licence | B. Under Article 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Law, since you refuse to accept the fine, your non-motor vehicle may be detained | C. Your (specific violation) violates road traffic safety laws and regulations; please obey traffic rules, thank you for your cooperation | D. Your (specific violation) violates road traffic safety laws and regulations; under Article ** of the Road Traffic Safety Law and Article ** of its implementing regulations (or local regulation **), you are fined RMB ** on the spot
options_zh: A. 你好！请出示驾驶证、行驶证 | B. 根据《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，你拒绝接受罚款处罚，可以扣留你的非机动车 | C. 你的（列举具体违法行为）违反了道路交通安全法律法规，请遵守交通法规，谢谢合作 | D. 你的（列举具体违法行为）违反了道路交通安全法律法规，依据《道路交通安全法》第**条和《道路交通安全法实施条例》第**条（或**地方法规）的规定，对你当场除以**元的罚款
why_en: Option A is used when checking a violating driver's documents, B when detaining a non-motor vehicle for refusing a fine, and D when fining a non-motor vehicle rider, pedestrian, or passenger; C is the correct warning phrase.
explanation_zh: 交通警察在纠正违法行为人（含机动车驾驶人、非机动车驾驶人、行人、乘车人，下同）的违法行为，对其进行警告、教育时，交通警察应当使用的规范语是：你的（列举具体违法行为）违反了道路交通安全法律法规，请遵守交通法规，谢谢合作。

question_en: How should the traffic police penalize a motor vehicle on the road that lacks the inspection sticker or insurance sticker?
question_zh: 在道路上行驶的机动车，未放置检验合格标志、保险标志的，公安机关交通管理部门应当如何处罚？
options_en: A. Detain the vehicle | B. Confiscate the vehicle's plates | C. Confiscate the driving licence | D. Detain the driver
options_zh: A. 扣留机动车 | B. 扣留机动车号牌 | C. 扣留驾驶证 | D. 扣留驾驶员
why_en: Driving on the road requires two certificates, two stickers, and one set of plates at all times.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第九十五条 上道路行驶的机动车未悬挂机动车号牌，未放置检验合格标志、保险标志，或者未随车携带行驶证、驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门应当扣留机动车。

question_en: What is the intended use of a sky-blue-background, black-bordered temporary driving plate?
question_zh: 天蓝底纹黑框线的临时行驶车号牌，使用范围是什么？
options_en: A. Special-purpose vehicles | B. Test/experimental vehicles | C. Vehicles temporarily driven across administrative jurisdictions | D. Vehicles temporarily driven within a single administrative jurisdiction
options_zh: A. 特殊机动车 | B. 实验用机动车 | C. 跨行政辖区临时行驶的机动车 | D. 行政辖区内临时行驶的机动车
why_en: This plate type is used for vehicles temporarily driven within one administrative jurisdiction.
explanation_zh: 行政辖区内临时行驶的机动车使用天蓝底纹黑框线的临时行驶车号牌。

question_en: What is the correct way to display the vehicle inspection sticker and insurance sticker?
question_zh: 机动车检验合格证标志、保险标志正确的携带方式：
options_en: A. Carry them in the vehicle | B. Affix them to the upper-left corner of the windshield | C. Affix them to the upper-right corner of the windshield | D. Affix them to the lower-right corner of the windshield
options_zh: A. 随车携带 | B. 粘贴在机动车前窗左上角 | C. 粘贴在机动车前窗右上角 | D. 粘贴在机动车前窗右下角
why_en: Driving on the road requires two certificates, two stickers, and one set of plates, with both stickers affixed to the windshield's upper-right corner.
explanation_zh: 机动车检验合格证标志、保险标志应粘贴在机动车前窗右上角。

question_en: If the traffic police detain a motor or non-motor vehicle and the owner fails to come forward, and after a public notice period of ( ) they still do not come forward, the vehicle is disposed of according to law.
question_zh: 公安机关交通管理部门扣留机动车、非机动车，当事人逾期不接受处理，并且经公告（ ）仍不来接受处理的，对扣留的车辆依法处理。
options_en: A. Two months | B. One month | C. Six months | D. Three months
options_zh: A. 两个月 | B. 一个月 | C. 六个月 | D. 三个月
why_en: The public notice period before lawful disposal of an unclaimed detained vehicle is three months.
explanation_zh: 公安机关交通管理部门扣留机动车、非机动车，当事人逾期不接受处理，并且经公告三个月仍不来接受处理的，对扣留的车辆依法处理。

question_en: What is the intended use of a sky-blue-background, black-text, black-bordered temporary driving plate?
question_zh: 天蓝底纹黑字黑框线的临时行驶车号牌，适用范围是什么？
options_en: A. Special-type vehicles | B. Test/experimental vehicles | C. Vehicles temporarily driven across administrative jurisdictions | D. Vehicles temporarily driven within a single administrative jurisdiction
options_zh: A. 特型机动车 | B. 实验用机动车 | C. 跨行政辖区内临时行驶的机动车 | D. 行政辖区内临时行驶的机动车
why_en: This plate type is used for vehicles temporarily driven within one administrative jurisdiction.
explanation_zh: 行政辖区内临时行驶的机动车使用天蓝底纹黑框线的临时行驶车号牌。

question_en: According to the Shanghai Public Security Bureau's notice on strengthening road traffic safety management, honking illegally within which area of this city counts as horn abuse?
question_zh: 根据《上海市公安局关于加强本市道路交通安全管理的通告》，机动车在本市什么区域内违法鸣喇叭属于乱鸣号。
options_en: A. Inner ring road | B. Outer ring road | C. Middle ring road | D. Suburban ring road
options_zh: A. 内环线 | B. 外环线 | C. 中环线 | D. 郊环线
why_en: The city bans motor vehicles from honking within the outer ring road.
explanation_zh: 根据《上海-上海市市公安局关于加强本市道路交通安全管理的通告》，禁止机动车在外环线以内区域违法鸣喇叭。

question_en: Obstructing a police officer's lawful performance of duty is punished with a warning or a fine of no more than ( ); in serious cases, detention of five days or more up to ( ) may be imposed, along with a fine of up to ( ).
question_zh: 阻碍人民警察依法执行职务的，处警告或者（）罚款；情节严重的，处五日以上（）以下拘留，可以并处（）以下罚款。
options_en: A. Below RMB 200; 15 days; RMB 200 | B. Below RMB 200; 15 days; RMB 500 | C. Below RMB 100; 15 days; RMB 500 | D. Below RMB 200; 10 days; RMB 500
options_zh: A. 二百以下；十五日；二百元 | B. 二百元以下；十五日；五百元 | C. 一百元以下；十五日；五百元 | D. 二百元以下；十日；五百元
why_en: Obstructing police officers on lawful duty is punished more severely than ordinary violations.
explanation_zh: 阻碍人民警察依法执行职务的，处警告或者二百元以下罚款；情节严重的，处五日以上十日以下以下拘留，可以并处五百元以下罚款。

question_en: Driving an unlicensed and unregistered electric bicycle or motorized wheelchair, or driving a non-motor vehicle banned from this city's roads, is fined RMB 50-200 under the relevant Shanghai regulation; if the fine is refused, the vehicle is detained under the Road Traffic Safety Law; if legal proof of origin cannot be provided, it is temporarily impounded or ( ).
question_zh: 驾驶无牌无证的电动自行车、残疾人机动轮椅车，或者驾驶本市禁止通行的非机动车上道路行驶的，依据《上海市非机动车管理办法》第14条第1款、第26条第3款、第39条第1款的规定，处50元以上200元以下罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，依据《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，予以扣留；不能提供来源合法凭证的，依据《上海市道路交通管理条例》第65条第1款第3项的规定，予以暂扣或（ ）。
options_en: A. Given a warning | B. Confiscated | C. Seized | D. Reclaimed
options_zh: A. 警告 | B. 没收 | C. 收缴 | D. 追缴
why_en: If the fine is refused, the vehicle is detained under the relevant provisions of the Road Traffic Safety Law.
explanation_zh: 驾驶无牌无证的电动自行车、残疾人机动轮椅车，或者驾驶本市禁止通行的非机动车上道路行驶的，依据《上海市非机动车管理办法》第14条第1款、第26条第3款、第39条第1款的规定，处50元以上200元以下罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，依据《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，予以扣留；不能提供来源合法凭证的，依据《上海市道路交通管理条例》第65条第1款第3项的规定，予以暂扣或没收。

question_en: If a person without a lower-limb disability drives a motorized wheelchair on the road, they are fined RMB 50 under the relevant regulation and law; if they refuse to accept the fine, their non-motor vehicle is ( ).
question_zh: 非下肢残疾人驾驶残疾人机动轮椅车上道路行驶的，依据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第72条第8项、《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，处50元罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，（ ）其非机动车。
options_en: A. Detained | B. Impounded | C. Reclaimed | D. Seized
options_zh: A. 扣留 | B. 扣押 | C. 追缴 | D. 收缴
why_en: Only people with a lower-limb disability are allowed to drive motorized wheelchairs on the road.
explanation_zh: 非下肢残疾人驾驶残疾人机动轮椅车上道路行驶的，依据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第72条第8项、《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，处50元罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，扣留其非机动车。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, what are the restriction hours for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges?
question_zh: 2016年4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通限行管理措施，时间为：
options_en: A. 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays) | B. 6:00-10:00 and 16:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays and public holidays) | C. 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (including Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays) | D. 6:00-10:00 and 16:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays)
options_zh: A. 每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外) | B. 每日6时至10时、16时至20时(周六、周国定假日除外) | C. 每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日) | D. 每日6时至10时、16时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)
why_en: This matches the restriction hours announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.
explanation_zh: 上海-上海市市公安局发布：2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时，12条高架道路及隧桥限制使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车通行。

question_en: A person whose driving licence is revoked by law for driving a commercial vehicle while intoxicated may not apply for a new driving licence for ___ years.
question_zh: 醉酒驾驶营运机动车依法被吊销机动车驾驶证___年，不得申请机动车驾驶证。
options_en: A. For life | B. Less than two years | C. Less than five years | D. Less than ten years
options_zh: A. 终身 | B. 未满两年的 | C. 未满五年的 | D. 未满十年
why_en: Revocation for drunk driving of a commercial vehicle carries a ten-year bar on reapplying, and even afterward the driver may not resume commercial driving.
explanation_zh:
《道路交通安全法》第九十一条：
醉酒驾驶营运机动车的，由公安机关交通管理部门约束至酒醒，吊销机动车驾驶证，依法追究刑事责任；十年内不得重新取得机动车驾驶证，重新取得机动车驾驶证后，不得驾驶营运机动车。

question_en: If a party refuses to sign the summary-procedure penalty decision, which of the following statements is correct?
question_zh: 当事人拒绝在简易程序处罚决定书上签名的，下列表述正确的是（ ）。
options_en: A. The decision is invalid | B. The traffic police officer may note this on the decision | C. The decision is deemed served regardless of whether the party signs | D. The traffic police officer must prepare a separate service document on the spot
options_zh: A. 决定书无效 | B. 交通警察可在决定书上注明 | C. 不论当事人是否签名，决定书即视为送达 | D. 交通警察应当当场制作送达文书
why_en: If the party refuses to sign, the officer may simply note that fact on the decision document itself.
explanation_zh: 当事人拒绝在简易程序处罚决定书上签名的，交通警察可在决定书上注明。

question_en: Which of the following vehicles may NOT use sirens and emergency lights while on an emergency mission?
question_zh: 下列车辆在执行紧急任务时，不可以使用警报器、标志灯具的是（）。
options_en: A. Postal vehicles | B. Ambulances | C. Engineering rescue vehicles | D. Fire trucks
options_zh: A. 邮政车   | B. 救护车 | C. 工程救险车  | D. 消防车
why_en: Police cars, fire trucks, ambulances, and engineering rescue vehicles on duty get priority right-of-way with sirens and lights; postal vehicles do not.
explanation_zh: 《道路交通安全法》第五十三条 警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车执行紧急任务时，可以使用警报器、标志灯具；在确保安全的前提下，不受行驶路线、行驶方向、行驶速度和信号灯的限制，其他车辆和行人应当让行。

question_en: How should a driver who accumulates 24 or more demerit points within one points cycle be handled?
question_zh: 机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积分达到24分以上的，应当如何处置：
options_en: A. Take an off-road driving skills test and an on-road driving skills test | B. Take a test on road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge | C. Take a test on road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge, plus an on-road driving skills test | D. Take an off-road driving skills test
options_zh: A. 场地驾驶技能考试和道路驾驶技能考试 | B. 道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试 | C. 道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试和道路驾驶技能考试 | D. 场地驾驶技能考试
why_en: Reaching 12 points requires study within 15 days and an exam within 20 days; reaching two 12-point cycles requires study within 15 days and exam within 10 days, including a driving skills test.
explanation_zh: 机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内有两次以上达到12分或者累积记分达到24分以上的，车辆管理所还应当在道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试合格后十日内对其进行道路驾驶技能考试。接受道路驾驶技能考试的，按照本人机动车驾驶证载明的最高准驾车型考试。

question_en: Scrapped large passenger vehicles, trucks, and other commercial vehicles must be dismantled under the supervision of ( ).
question_zh: 报废的大型客、货车及其他营运车辆应当在（）的监督下解体。
options_en: A. The motor vehicle product regulatory authority | B. The highway administration department | C. The vehicle owner | D. The public security authority
options_zh: A. 机动车产品主管部门 | B. 公路管理部门 | C. 机动车所有人 | D. 公安机关
why_en: A scrapped vehicle can no longer be driven on the road, and its dismantling must be supervised by the vehicle product regulator.
explanation_zh: 报废的大型客、货车及其他营运车辆应当在机动车产品主管部门的监督下解体。

question_en: For a student without a driving licence practicing driving on the road, which of the following is correct?
question_zh: 未取得驾驶证的学员在道路上学习驾驶技能，下列哪种做法是正确的？
options_en: A. Using a training vehicle of the type being learned, with an instructor accompanying and guiding | B. Using a training vehicle of the type being learned, driving alone without an instructor | C. Using a private car, with an instructor accompanying and guiding | D. Using a training vehicle of the type being learned, accompanied by a non-instructor driver
options_zh: A. 使用所学车型的教练车由教练员随车指导 | B. 使用所学车型的教练车单独驾驶学习 | C. 使用私家车由教练员随车指导 | D. 使用所学车型的教练车由非教练员的驾驶人随车指导
why_en: An unlicensed person may not drive alone; they must be accompanied and guided by a qualified instructor in a proper training vehicle.
explanation_zh: 未取得驾驶证的学员在道路上学习驾驶技能，要使用所学车型的教练车，同时需要教练员随车指导，安全为重。

question_en: Riding an electric bicycle while illegally carrying a passenger is punished, under the relevant Shanghai regulation, with ( ); if the fine is refused, the non-motor vehicle is detained under Article 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Law.
question_zh: 驾驶电动自行车违法载人的，依据《上海市机动车管理方法》第31条、第39条第2款的规定处（  ）；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，依据《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，扣留其非机动车。
options_en: A. A warning or a fine of RMB 5-50 | B. A fine of up to RMB 50 | C. A fine of up to RMB 200 | D. A warning or a fine of RMB 5-200
options_zh: A. 警告或者5元以上50元以下罚款 | B. 50元以下罚款 | C. 200元以下罚款 | D. 警告或者5元以上200元以下罚款
why_en: Safety comes first; illegally carrying passengers on an electric bicycle is prohibited.
explanation_zh: 驾驶电动自行车违法载人的，依据《上海-上海市市机动车管理方法》第31条、第39条第2款的规定处警告或者5元以上50元以下罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，依据《道路交通安全法》第89条的规定，扣留其非机动车。

question_en: No-parking roads in Tianqiao District include Minghu West Road, Minghu North Road, Jingyi Road, Diko Road, Lishan North Road, and ( ).
question_zh: 天桥区禁停道路包括：明湖西路、明湖北路、经一路、堤口路、历山北路、（  ）。
options_en: A. Lihuang Road | B. Wuyingshan Road | C. Shifan Road | D. Shunhe West Street
options_zh: A. 历黄路 | B. 无影山路 | C. 师范路 | D. 顺河西街
why_en: Shunhe West Street is also on Tianqiao District's list of no-parking roads.
explanation_zh: 记不住就背下来吧，还包括顺河西街。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's "five categories always towed" policy includes: vehicles causing traffic congestion or blocking the road due to illegal parking are always towed.
question_zh: 济南交警支队“5个一律拖移”包括：因违法停车引发交通拥堵、影响道路畅通的一律拖移。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Outside of genuine emergencies, a vehicle must not obstruct other traffic.
explanation_zh: 因违法停车引发交通拥堵、影响道路畅通的一律拖移。

question_en: A child safety seat is a seat secured to the car's seat, designed for a child to sit in, equipped with restraints, and able to hold the child in place during a crash to maximize their safety.
question_zh: 儿童安全座椅是一种系于汽车座位上，供儿童乘坐并且有束缚设备并能在发生车祸时，束缚着儿童以最大限度保障儿童安全的座椅。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Child safety seats reduce the injury a child would otherwise suffer in an emergency or crash.
explanation_zh: 记住儿童座椅是束缚儿童，保护他们的安全。

question_en: Allowing a person without a driving licence to drive your vehicle is punished with a fine of RMB 1,000.
question_zh: 将机动车交由未取得机动车驾驶证的人员驾驶的，处一千元罚款。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: A person without a valid licence must not drive a motor vehicle on the road.
explanation_zh: 《四川省〈中华人民共和国道路交通安全法〉实施办法》第七十一条：有下列情形之一的，处相关责任人员一千元罚款：将机动车交由未取得机动车驾驶证或者驾驶证被吊销、暂扣的人员驾驶的。

question_en: A vehicle may make a temporary stop on a road section marked with no-parking signs or markings, or where parking is legally prohibited.
question_zh: 机动车可以在设有禁停标志、标线和依法禁止停车的路段临时停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Parking of any kind, including temporary stops, is prohibited on no-parking sections.
explanation_zh: 禁停路段不能停车，不管是临时还是长期。

question_en: A long-distance coach driver who drives continuously for 2 hours at night must rest for at least 10 minutes.
question_zh: 长途客运汽车驾驶人夜间连续驾驶2小时的，休息时间不少于10分钟。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: After driving 2 hours at night, a commercial driver must rest for at least 20 minutes, not 10.
explanation_zh: 客运司机夜间连续驾驶2个小时，要停车休息不少于20分钟。

question_en: At an intersection with a left-turn waiting area, drivers should quickly enter the waiting area and stop according to the signal.
question_zh: 设左转弯待行区的交叉路口，应当根据提示信号快速进入待行区停车等候。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Safety comes first, so vehicles should slow down and proceed cautiously at intersections, not enter quickly.
explanation_zh: 题中的“快速”是错误的。

question_en: No-parking roads in Huaiyin District include Jingshi Road, Jingsi Road, Weiliu Road, Weishier Road, Jingliu Road, Jingwu Road, Jingyi Road, and ( ).
question_zh: 槐荫区禁停道路包括：经十路、经四路、纬六路、纬十二路、经六路、经五路、经一路、（  ）。
options_en: A. Qizhou Road | B. Qingdao Road | C. Jinger Road | D. Weifang Road
options_zh: A. 齐州路 | B. 青岛路 | C. 经二路 | D. 潍坊路
why_en: Jinger Road is also on Huaiyin District's list of no-parking roads.
explanation_zh: 济南的老铁们记好了，还包括经二路。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's special crackdown on illegal parking targets parking at, or within ( ) meters of, bus stops, first-aid stations, gas stations, fire hydrants, or fire stations.
question_zh: 济南市交警支队组织开展集中违法停车专项整治行动，其整治的重点包括：在公共汽车站、急救站、加油站、消防栓或者消防队（站）门前及距离上述地点（  ）米以内的路段停车的。
options_en: A. 30 meters | B. 40 meters | C. 50 meters | D. 60 meters
why_en: The rule of thumb is 30 meters from a stop and 50 meters from an entrance, both no-parking zones.
explanation_zh: “站30口50”不能停车，即：车站、加油站等30米内不得停车；路口50米内不能停车，弯道、坡道、隧道、窄桥也包括。

question_en: Starting January 22, 2017, on designated no-parking roads citywide, "violating a prohibitory sign or prohibitory marking" is punished with a RMB 200 fine and ( ) demerit point(s).
question_zh: 自2017年1月22日起，对于全市确定的禁停路段，依据《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第九十条规定，对“违反禁令标志、禁止标线指示”（分别使用违法代码13440、13450）处罚款200元、计（  ）分。
why_en: Violating a prohibitory sign or marking carries a RMB 200 fine and 1 demerit point.
explanation_zh: 机动车违反禁令标志、禁止标线指示的，罚款200元，扣1分。

question_en: When a motor vehicle makes a temporary night-time stop on the road, it must turn on its clearance lights and taillights, and the driver may only leave the vehicle briefly.
question_zh: 夜间机动车在道路上临时停车应当须开启示廓灯和后位灯，驾驶人只能短时离开车辆。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The hazard warning (flasher) lights should be turned on immediately when stopping, not just the clearance and tail lights.
explanation_zh: 夜间临时停车还需开双闪（危险报警闪光灯），而且不能离开车辆。

question_en: A vehicle on the road may use variable or concealing plate devices.
question_zh: 上道路行驶的机动车可以使用可变式、遮挡式等号牌装置。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Deliberately obscuring a plate while driving results in 12 demerit points in a single instance.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第十三条：机动车在道路上行驶应当遵守下列规定：号牌变形、残缺、褪色或者字迹模糊的，及时申请换领；号牌不得故意遮挡、污损；除临时行驶车号牌和临时入境车辆号牌外，号牌使用规范的固封装置，禁止使用可变式、遮挡式等号牌装置。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's "five categories always towed" policy includes: vehicles that ignore warnings, refuse to comply, or refuse to leave are always towed; unlicensed illegally parked vehicles are also always towed.
question_zh: 济南交警支队“5个一律拖移”包括：停车不听劝阻、不服管理，拒绝驶离的一律拖移；对于无牌违停车辆一律拖移。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Both defiance of warnings and unlicensed illegal parking are listed among the five always-towed categories.
explanation_zh: 停车不听劝阻、不服管理，拒绝驶离的一律拖移；对于无牌违停车辆一律拖移。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's special crackdown on illegal parking targets illegal parking on the ( ), non-motor vehicle lane, or sidewalk of a publicly posted no-parking road.
question_zh: 济南市交警支队组织开展集中违法停车专项整治行动，其整治的重点包括：在经公示禁停道路上（ ）、非机动车道、人行道违法停车的。
options_en: A. Motor vehicle lane | B. Parking space | C. Dedicated parking lot | D. Garage
options_zh: A. 机动车道 | B. 停车位 | C. 专用停车场 | D. 车库
why_en: Parking spaces, lots, and garages are all legitimate parking places; only the motor vehicle lane is not.
explanation_zh: 用排除法也能选对吧，停车位、停车场、车库都属于合法停车场所，只有机动车道不可以停车。

question_en: Shizhong District's no-parking roads are limited exactly to: Lvyou Road, Jingshi Road, Jingqi Road, Gongqingtuan Road, Jingsi Road, Shungeng Road, Yingxiongshan Road, Da Weier Road, Jida Road, Liulishan South Road, Jingshiyi Road, Ma'anshan Road, Jinger Road, Yuhan Road, Qingnian West Road, Shunhe West Street, Weiyi Road, and Jianshe Road.
question_zh: 市中区禁停道路只包括：旅游路、经十路、经七路、共青团路、经四路、舜耕路、英雄山路、大纬二路、济大路、六里山南路、经十一路、马鞍山路、经二路、玉函路、青年西路、顺河西街、纬一路、建设路。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Jinan's citywide no-parking list has about 100 roads, far more than this partial list, so the word "only" makes the statement false.
explanation_zh: 济南全市100条禁停道路：纬二路、纬十二路、经一路、经七路、经十路(段店立交东口至奥体东路路口)、泺源大街、和平路、旅游路(历阳大街至舜华路口)、明湖东路、明湖西路、明湖北路、花园路、二环东路(旅游路口至工业北路口)、历山路、英雄山路、解放路、泉城路、共青团路、经四路、山大北路、舜华路、舜华南路、历山北路、舜耕路、堤口路、纬六路、黑北路、黑西路、趵北路、大明湖路、济大路、经十一路、马鞍山路、六里山南路、千佛山南路、经六路(纬一路至二环西)、经五路、经二路、化纤厂路、山大路、千佛山西路、青年东路、泺文路、榜棚街、省府前街、玉函路、青年西路、顺河西街、纬一路、建设路、玉函小区南路、历阳大街、八里洼路、二七南路、龙奥南路、龙奥北路、窑头路、文化东路、文化西路、经八路、解放东路、新泺大街、天辰路、山大南路、华龙路、无影山中路、师范路、凤凰路、开拓路、舜华东路、舜华西路、颖秀路、龙奥东路、龙奥西路、转山西路、洪山路、浆水泉路、华信路、燕子山路、闵子骞路、洪家楼南路、燕子山西路、山师东路、千佛山路、舜井街、东关大街、生产路、民生大街、顺河东街、济安街、纬三路、济洛路、纬五路、纬九路、纬十路、郎茂山路、阳光新路、无影山路、营市街、槐村街。其中市中区禁停道路包括：旅游路、经十路、经七路、共青团路、经四路、经一路、舜耕路、英雄山路、大纬二路、济大路、六里山南路、经十一路、马鞍山路、经六路、经五路、经二路、玉函路、青年西路、顺河西街、纬一路、建设路。题目说“只包括”，所以本题描述错误。

question_en: If a temporary stop is genuinely necessary on a no-parking road, the driver should pull close to the right side, may briefly leave the vehicle to let passengers on or off or load and unload goods, then must leave immediately.
question_zh: 在禁停道路上确需临时停车的，应当紧靠道路右侧，机动车驾驶人可以暂时离车，上下人员或者装卸物品后，立即驶离。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: No parking of any kind, temporary or otherwise, is allowed on a no-parking road.
explanation_zh: 禁停道路不允许停车，不管是临时的还是长期的。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's "five categories always towed" policy includes: illegal parking on a motor vehicle lane, crosswalk, or bus stop that seriously blocks traffic flow is always towed.
question_zh: 济南交警支队“5个一律拖移”包括：在机动车道、人行横道、公交站点等严重影响道路畅通的位置违停的一律拖移。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Illegal parking at those locations, which seriously blocks traffic flow, is one of the five always-towed categories.
explanation_zh: 在机动车道、人行横道、公交站点等严重影响道路畅通的位置违停的一律拖移。

question_en: For a traffic accident caused by an illegally parked vehicle, the illegally parked vehicle's owner is always held responsible for the accident.
question_zh: 对因机动车违法停车发生的道路交通事故，一律认为违法停车当事人的交通事故责任。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: If your illegal parking causes an accident, you naturally bear responsibility for it.
explanation_zh: 人家因为你违法停车发生交通事故，你当然要负责咯。

question_en: When a preschool-age child rides in the back seat of a motor vehicle, a dedicated child safety seat must be used as required.
question_zh: 机动车后排搭载学龄前儿童的，按规定使用专用座椅。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Preschool-age children need a child safety seat to protect their safety.
explanation_zh: 学前儿童需要使用儿童安全座椅，保障儿童的安全。

question_en: If a party refuses to leave an accident scene, traffic police forcibly clear it, and the insurance company bears the cost.
question_zh: 交通警察对拒不撤离现场的，予以强制撤离，所需费用由保险公司承担。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: The driver is fined instead; the insurance company would certainly not bear this cost.
explanation_zh: 应对驾驶人处以罚款，保险公司肯定不会承担的。

question_en: Jinan Traffic Police's "five categories always towed" policy includes: illegal parking at a gas station, bridge, residential compound entrance, workplace entrance, road turn, or U-turn point is always towed.
question_zh: 济南交警支队“5个一律拖移”包括：在加油站、桥梁、小区、单位出入口、道路转弯、掉头处违停的一律拖移。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Illegal parking at those locations is one of the five always-towed categories.
explanation_zh: 在加油站、桥梁、小区、单位出入口、道路转弯、掉头处违停的一律拖移。

question_en: Parking at a workplace or residential compound entrance is allowed as long as it does not affect other vehicles' passage.
question_zh: 在单位或小区出入口只要不影响其他车辆通行可以停车。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Parking must not obstruct the normal passage of other vehicles, and entrances are prohibited parking areas regardless.
explanation_zh: 出入口是不能停车的，安全驾驶，文明停车。

question_en: Starting April 15, 2016, during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), which of the following is among the restricted routes for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges?
question_zh: 2016年4月15起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行路线包括（）。
options_en: A. Yangpu Bridge | B. Jungong Road Tunnel | C. Xiangyin Road Tunnel | D. Xupu Bridge
options_zh: A. 杨浦大桥 | B. 军工路隧道 | C. 翔殷路隧道 | D. 徐浦大桥
why_en: The Jungong Road Tunnel is part of the Middle Ring Road, one of the 12 restricted elevated roads and tunnel bridges.
explanation_zh: 4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行路段包括延安高架路（S20以东段）、南北高架路（呼玛路至鲁班立交段）、逸仙高架路（全线）、沪闵高架路（全线）、中环路（全线）、华夏高架路（全线）、罗山高架路（全线）、度假区高架路（中环路至秀浦路段）、内环高架路（除内圈中山北二路入口至锦绣路出口、外圈锦绣路入口至黄兴路出口以外的路段）、南浦大桥、卢浦大桥、延安东路隧道。其中军工路隧道属于中环路，所以选它。

question_en: For a vehicle towed due to illegal parking, the owner must attend a traffic law and regulations study session at the district traffic police brigade and clear all outstanding camera-captured traffic violations.
question_zh: 对因违停被拖移的机动车，车主需到各区交警大队进行交通法律法规学习，并将所有交通违法抓拍记录处理完毕。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: After a tow for illegal parking, the owner must undergo re-education at the traffic police brigade and clear all outstanding violation records.
explanation_zh: 违停被拖车了，要到交警大队学习再教育，还要处理完所有违法记录。

question_en: No-parking roads in the High-Tech Zone include Lvyou Road, Jingshi Road, Shunhua South Road, and ( ).
question_zh: 高新区禁停道路包括：旅游路、经十路、舜华南路、（  ）。
options_en: A. Kanghong Road | B. Shunhua Road | C. Tianchen Road | D. Shunhua North Road
options_zh: A. 康虹路 | B. 舜华路 | C. 天辰路 | D. 舜华北路
why_en: Shunhua Road is also on the High-Tech Zone's list of no-parking roads.
explanation_zh: 高新区禁停道路包括：旅游路、经十路、舜华南路、舜华路。

question_en: No-parking roads in Licheng District include Huayuan Road, Shanda North Road, and ( ).
question_zh: 历城区禁停道路包括：花园路、山大北路、（  ）。
options_en: A. Erhuan East Road | B. Huaxin Road | C. Xinzhu Road | D. Huaneng Road
options_zh: A. 二环东路 | B. 华信路 | C. 辛祝路 | D. 华能路
why_en: Erhuan East Road is also on Licheng District's list of no-parking roads.
explanation_zh: 历城区禁停道路包括：花园路、山大北路、二环东路。

question_en: Motor vehicles must not illegally install sirens or warning lights.
question_zh: 机动车不得非法安装警报器、标志灯具。
options_zh: A. 正确 | B. 错误
why_en: Drive in a civilized way and follow the law.
explanation_zh: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》第十五条第一款：警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车应当按照规定喷涂标志图案，安装警报器、标志灯具。其他机动车不得喷涂、安装、使用上述车辆专用的或者与其相类似的标志图案、警报器或者标志灯具。

question_en: No-parking roads in Lixia District include Lvyou Road, Jingshi Road, Heping Road, Luoyuan Avenue, Jiefang Road, Quancheng Road, Heibei Road, Heixi Road, Zhaobei Road, Daminghu Road, Huayuan Road, Minghu East Road, Erhuan East Road, Lishan Road, Shungeng Road, Qianfoshan South Road, Jingshiyi Road, Ma'anshan Road, Huaxianchang Road, Shanda Road, Qianfoshan West Road, Qingnian East Road, Luowen Road, Bangpeng Road, and ( ).
question_zh: 历下区禁停道路包括：旅游路、经十路、和平路、泺源大街、解放路、泉城路、黑北路、黑西路、趵北路、大明湖路、花园路、明湖东路、二环东路、历山路、舜耕路、千佛山南路、经十一路、马鞍山路、化纤厂路、山大路、千佛山西路、青年东路、泺文路、榜棚路、（  ）。
options_en: A. Yaotou Road | B. Jiefang East Road | C. Wenhua East Road | D. Shengfuqian Street
options_zh: A. 窑头路 | B. 解放东路 | C. 文化东路 | D. 省府前街
why_en: Shengfuqian Street is also on Lixia District's list of no-parking roads.
explanation_zh: 还有省府前街，都是禁停道路。
